title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. body: Human beings are naturally social creatures – we crave friendship and positive interactions, just as we do food and water. However sometimes, some of us face serious relationship problems. So it makes sense that the better our relationships with family, friends, classmates and at work, the happier and more productive we're going to be. · Healthy relationship leads to mental peace and also a positive ambience · Good relationships give us freedom: Instead of spending time and energy overcoming the problems associated with negative relationships, we can, instead, focus on opportunities. · Good relationships are also necessary if we hope to achieve our goals and develop our careers Psychologists from Counseling & Happiness Cell invites students to attend this session and talk about relationship issues. · Learn the art of establishing smooth relationships with people around and live a happy life. · Learn to deal with different relationship challenges and maintain a state of harmony in your lives Resource Person: Ms Malvinder Gill - HOD, Counseling & Happiness cell Ms Anusuya Hazarika - Sr Counseling Psychologist Ms Anuradha- Counseling Psychologist Ms. Prabhleen - Psychologist Date: Thursday 30th Dec 2021 Time: 12 pm – 1:30 pm Register for the session- (Mention your LPU Official email id in the registration form) Registration form link: https://tinyurl.com/yrr4224j Google meet link will be shared only with the students who have registered for the session. Students logging in with LPU Official email id will only be admitted to attend the session.

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

body: Human beings are naturally social creatures – we crave friendship and positive interactions, just as we do food and water. However sometimes, some of us face serious relationship problems. body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. title: LPU Global: Want to Study a Semester at Canada at 100% tuition fee Scholarship for Canada : (12/28/2021)
body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for LPU students to attend a fully tuition fee waived semester in Canada i.e., students have to pay only tuition fees applicable at LPU and they get opportunity to study for one semester(September 2022) at a Partner Canadian University without paying tuition fees of partner University. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

body: Human beings are naturally social creatures – we crave friendship and positive interactions, just as we do food and water. However sometimes, some of us face serious relationship problems. So it makes sense that the better our relationships with family, friends, classmates and at work, the happier and more productive we're going to be. · Healthy relationship leads to mental peace and also a positive ambience · Good relationships give us freedom: Instead of spending time and energy overcoming the problems associated with negative relationships, we can, instead, focus on opportunities. · Good relationships are also necessary if we hope to achieve our goals and develop our careers Psychologists from Counseling & Happiness Cell invites students to attend this session and talk about relationship issues. · Learn the art of establishing smooth relationships with people around and live a happy life. · Learn to deal with different relationship challenges and maintain a state of harmony in your lives Resource Person: Ms Malvinder Gill - HOD, Counseling & Happiness cell Ms Anusuya Hazarika - Sr Counseling Psychologist Ms Anuradha- Counseling Psychologist Ms. Prabhleen - Psychologist Date: Thursday 30th Dec 2021 Time: 12 pm – 1:30 pm Register for the session- (Mention your LPU Official email id in the registration form) Registration form link: https://tinyurl.com/yrr4224j Google meet link will be shared only with the students who have registered for the session. Students logging in with LPU Official email id will only be admitted to attend the session.

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

body: Human beings are naturally social creatures – we crave friendship and positive interactions, just as we do food and water. However sometimes, some of us face serious relationship problems. body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface.
