title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. title: LPU Global: Want to Study a Semester at Canada at 100% tuition fee Scholarship for Canada : (12/28/2021)
body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for LPU students to attend a fully tuition fee waived semester in Canada i.e., students have to pay only tuition fees applicable at LPU and they get opportunity to study for one semester(September 2022) at a Partner Canadian University without paying tuition fees of partner University. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

body: Human beings are naturally social creatures – we crave friendship and positive interactions, just as we do food and water. However sometimes, some of us face serious relationship problems. So it makes sense that the better our relationships with family, friends, classmates and at work, the happier and more productive we're going to be. · Healthy relationship leads to mental peace and also a positive ambience · Good relationships give us freedom: Instead of spending time and energy overcoming the problems associated with negative relationships, we can, instead, focus on opportunities. · Good relationships are also necessary if we hope to achieve our goals and develop our careers Psychologists from Counseling & Happiness Cell invites students to attend this session and talk about relationship issues. · Learn the art of establishing smooth relationships with people around and live a happy life. · Learn to deal with different relationship challenges and maintain a state of harmony in your lives Resource Person: Ms Malvinder Gill - HOD, Counseling & Happiness cell Ms Anusuya Hazarika - Sr Counseling Psychologist Ms Anuradha- Counseling Psychologist Ms. Prabhleen - Psychologist Date: Thursday 30th Dec 2021 Time: 12 pm – 1:30 pm Register for the session- (Mention your LPU Official email id in the registration form) Registration form link: https://tinyurl.com/yrr4224j Google meet link will be shared only with the students who have registered for the session. Students logging in with LPU Official email id will only be admitted to attend the session.

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by student(s)/group(s) registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 21222. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211230/002) : (12/30/2021)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211202/001 dated: 02-12-2021 regarding online creation of student groups for project courses of spring term 21222. All such students are now required to get in touch with the supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-I (Student Grouping) contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their supervisors and should get their consent latest by 5th January 2022. Points to remember: - a) All the students can now view the complete research profile of the prospective supervisors including their key specialization areas, research contributions and best projects guided till date by following the path as per Attachment-2 (Screen shots) which will help them to choose the supervisors judiciously. b) Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of student groups. Therefore, the students must go through the profile of the supervisors and make a connect with them via LPU live app/phone/ email/or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their required specialized field. c) The students must approach the supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-I (Student Grouping) as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. d) The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. e) If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors till 6th January 2022, all such student groups shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is a mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register that student group online via UMS interface. The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 7th January 2022. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva Attachment: 1 Student Grouping.xls 2 Screenshots.pdf

title: Regarding uploading of required documents on UMS interface and related timelines for Project, Dissertation and similar courses to be eligible to appear in final ETP viva (Autumn term 21221). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/211125/002) : (11/25/2021)
body: This is for the information to all the students registered in project, dissertation and similar courses (as per list attached in Annexure-I), that the following documents are to be uploaded on the UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines (mentioned in Annexure-I) to be eligible to appear in the Final End Term Presentation (ETP). 1. Uploading of soft copy of final report All the students need to prepare the final report for their research/ project work as per the guidelines attached (in Annexure-II) and upload the soft copy of the same in three parts i.e. PDF File-1, PDF File-2 and PDF File-3 via their UMS interface as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-I by visiting the following link: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details-->Upload Research Project Report/Internship Certificate --->Project/Dissertation/Internship Contents of each PDF file (size should be less than 5 MBs) are mentioned below: PDF File 1 PDF File 2 PDF File 3 Students need to upload their Complete Project/ research Report as PDF File 1. Students need to upload “only Content Report” which is without any student identification Information (e.g. Student’s Name, Registration Number or Title Page) as PDF File 2. Plagiarism Report is to be uploaded for Standalone Project(s), Capstone-II, Dissertation–II or Dissertation- III (As per Annexure-I). Allowed Plagiarism limit shall be as per the LPU Policy which has been described under the following link available on UMS: https://www.lpu.in/academics/pdf/research-policy.pdf Important points 1. The guidelines attached with this announcement for the preparation of the final reports are suggestive and can vary as per the nature and amount of the work done due to current situation. 2. It is advised that the respective supervisors must ensure the timely uploading of the final report of their students before the last date of submission so that the supervisors get sufficient time to approve or to get the modifications suggested by them incorporated in the final report. No Extension beyond the specified timelines shall be provided for the final report submission through respective supervisor. 3. Respective supervisors must ensure that the reports submitted by the students get approved on or before the last date of submission as specified in Annexure-I. 4. In case student fails to submit his/her final report as per the specified timelines, R grade shall be applicable. 2. Uploading the detail of the research publication/ copyrights on UMS: It is mandatory for each student/ student group to have a research publication (for the course code mentioned in the research publication condition column in Annexure-I) to be eligible to appear in the final ETP viva. All the students in a specific Project group needs to fill the details of the research publications as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-I by visiting the following UMS link: Link for uploading research publication/Copyright details: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details--->Upload Research Project Publication/Copyright details Important Note:- 1. Students having research publication/s affiliated with Lovely Professional University will be only considered eligible for the Final ETP viva. 2. Screenshots for uploading the research publication details along with do’s and don’ts are also attached with this announcement. In case of any query, students may log an RMS using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Category: Academic (Operational issues) Sub-Category: Training/Dissertation/OJT/Thesis/Seminar/Capstone & viva

title: Information regarding polling for mode of classes of MBA programme for the upcoming term (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/211124/001) : (11/24/2021)
body: This is for the information of the students registered in Trimester 5 (Batch 2020) and Module 2 (Batch 2021) of the MBA programme, that the University has initiated the planning for the stated terms which are most likely to be conducted in the offline mode. Only fully vaccinated students i.e., who have taken both the vaccine doses on or before 7th December 2021 shall be eligible to attend the offline mode classes in the upcoming term. Hence, the students who wish to attend offline classes at the University are advised to get themselves fully vaccinated at the earliest. In case any student is unable to report for offline mode classes in the upcoming term due to no/single dose vaccination, personal/medical reasons etc., then a special provision of online classes (via My Class platform) may be extended for such students. Important: The students are advised to select their preferred mode of classes (offline or online) very carefully, as once submitted, change of mode shall not be permitted. Hence, all students registered in Trimester 5 (Batch 2020) and Module 2 (Batch 2021) of the MBA programme are compulsorily required to submit their preference for mode of attending the classes (whether offline or online) on immediate basis through the following UMS link: UMS Navigation -- >Learning Management System (LMS) -- > Polling for Hybrid Mode Classes Reporting for attending offline classes at the University shall commence from 26th November 2021. The students can report at the University latest till 7th December 2021. The students registered in Trimester 5 (Batch 2020) and Module 2 (Batch 2021) of the MBA programme interested to attend offline classes shall be required to follow the following steps: Step 1: Choose “Offline” mode for classes in the UMS interface following the link: UMS Navigation -- Learning Management System (LMS) -- Polling for Hybrid Mode Classes (The uploading of student vaccination certificate and parent consent form as well as booking for hostel facility shall be done through the above given link only. Students who have already uploaded their final vaccination (both doses) certificate on the University interface need not upload it again) Step 2: Follow the link given below and submit your date of reporting in the UMS interface (according to schedule travel arrangements booked by the student) UMS Navigation --- Learning Management System (LMS) --- Reporting Date for Offline Classes Step 3: Download Entry Pass (to be shown at University gate at the time of offline reporting) following the UMS link: UMS Navigation --- Learning Management System (LMS) --- Download Entry Pass Step 4: On the reporting date specified by you, report near Unipolis stage near Block 13 for verification-cum-confirmation of your reporting. Duty leave shall be given to students for their travel days (in case of ongoing classes at that time) subject to verification by the University. Note: The students availing University residential facility should ensure that they pay the hostel dues to confirm their hostel seat before reporting to the University. In case of query, you may log an RMS at link mentioned below: UMS Navigation -- > Relationship Management System (RMS) -- > Log Request Category: Offline Classes/Academic Related Issues Sub-Category: Offline Classes/Academic Related Issues.

body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Opening of Polling for classes in hybrid mode (online + offline) for Academic Term 1, Session 2021-22 for students vaccinated till 20th October 2021. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/211012/001) : (10/12/2021)
body: This is for the information of the students that the polling interface for offline/hybrid classes reporting has been opened for the students who are fully vaccinated i.e. who have taken both the vaccine doses on or before 20th October 2021. The students who did not poll in the previously conducted phases or were not eligible for polling in those phases, can now participate in the polling process. For detailed guidelines and instructions regarding offline reporting, students are advised to refer to previous announcement titled “Information and guidelines regarding commencement of classes in hybrid mode (online + offline) for Academic Term 1, Session 2021-22. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/210826/001)” The students who have previously polled for offline classes in the previous phases need not to poll again. Their reporting dates for offline classes have already been intimated in the “UMS My Messages”. The students who receive both vaccine doses till 20th October 2021 and wish to report for offline classes shall be required to poll online through the following link: UMS Navigation -- >Learning Management System (LMS) -- > Polling for Hybrid Mode Classes (The uploading of student vaccination certificate and parent consent form as well as booking for hostel facility shall be done through the above given link only) The polling process at the above-mentioned link shall remain active till 20th October 2021. After successful polling, the student shall get a confirmation of your registration in the UMS “My Messages” tab. Exact date of reporting in the University shall also be intimated via UMS “My Messages” tab only. After receiving the confirmation message and exact date of reporting, the registered students should ensure that they pay the hostel dues to confirm their hostel seat before reporting to the University. Important: The students should initiate their travel bookings and arrangements only after they receive the confirmation message of registration and exact reporting date in their UMS My Message. It is reiterated that the classes shall operate both in offline and online mode for all the students. Hence, availing the provision of reporting on Campus for attending offline classes is completely optional for the students. Students may continue attending classes in the online mode for the current academic term. However, once the student reports in University for offline classes, then he/she shall not be allowed to move out of the Campus and he/she shall be strictly required to follow all University guidelines and instructions. Note: The students who are still not fully vaccinated are strictly advised to get both their vaccine doses at the earliest, so that they become eligible for reporting in the University in the subsequent phases. In case of query, you may log an RMS at link mentioned below: UMS Navigation -- > Relationship Management System (RMS) -- > Log Request Category: Offline Classes/Academic Related Issues Sub-Category: Offline Classes/Academic Related Issues.

title: Opportunities to work in collaborations with Centre for Space Research, LPU : (9/10/2021)
body: Registrations are invited from interested students, research scholars and faculty members from all disciplines for working in collaboration with Centre for Space Research (CSR), Lovely Professional University under the Direction of Prof. TGK Murthy (Former Advisor, Govt. of India and Ex-Project Director, ISRO) and Prof. DVA Raghava Murthy (Ex-Project Director, ISRO). This will provide an opportunity to extend the collaborative research in order to achieve cutting edge advances in areas related to Centre for Space Research. An Expert Lecture on “Small Satellites and Big Missions” is scheduled on 10-9-2021(Friday) from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM for the same. ‘Centre for Space Research’ was inaugurated by Dr. Sudhir Mishra, a man behind SuperSonic Brahmos Missile of the country. Additionally, Prof. TGK Murthy (Honorary-Chairman, CSR, LPU) and Prof. DVA Raghava Murthy (Advisor, CSR, LPU) are appointed at CSR, to lead the Satellite launch missions, a big dream project of LPU. CSR, is a central facility at Lovely Professional University to conduct advanced space related studies. The centre facilitates the budding technocrats as well as young researchers to pursue their research activities related to space science, technologies and related fields. The prime aim behind this centre is to develop a world-class facility for payload design for the small satellite missions of Lovely Professional University. The centre acts as a key facility in the field of space research for LPU as well as a virtual lab for Universities, Colleges and Schools in India and the neighbouring countries of India to excel in the field of space sciences. The students and faculty members working under this centre will be engaged in satellite system design and system engineering; satellite payload and sub-system design and development; satellite assembly, integration, and testing; satellite launch and operation; payload data processing and application; HAM activities; participating in space competitions; ground station networking; and, scientific extension activities. Interested candidates can register on the following link to work in collaboration with Centre for Space Research, Lovely Professional University. Google Form: https://forms.gle/DkruyPbuJ8w4eoM38 For more information, you may contact: Dr. Jai Sukh Paul Singh – 9463457100 Dr. Sumit Kumar – 9996275181 Dr. Daljeet Singh – 9501934293

title: Registration date extended on demand for Short Term Course on Sustainable & Smart Architecture in Post Covid India : (9/1/2021)
body: Sustainable architecture is architecture that seeks to minimize the negative environmental impact of buildings by efficiency and moderation in the use of materials, energy, development space and the ecosystem at large. The idea of sustainability, or ecological design, is to ensure that our use of presently available resources does not end up having detrimental effects to our collective well-being or making it impossible to obtain resources for other applications in the long run. This Short Term Course focuses on the basic principles of sustainable architecture to prepare professionals for meeting the challenges of post pandemic. The requisite details are appended below for your reference: Title Short Term Course on Sustainable & Smart Architecture in Post Covid India Course Objectives The Course aims at capacity building in: • Acquiring knowledge about Traditional Passive Techniques adopted in Smart Architecture of Buildings • Design process ‘Concept to Execution’ of Architectural Projects • Healthy and Healing Buildings to Immunize Life • Fostering Urban Qualities and Ecological balance Program Schedule Dates: September 06 to 11, 2021 Time:: 2:00- 5:00 PM For topic details, please refer Brochure Register at https://www.lpu.in/hrd/ Platform Online –Link will be shared with registered participants Participants Faculty members, Research Scholars, PG Students from Architecture, Planning, Civil and Mechanical Engineering, Practicing Architects, Builders and Town Planners as per registration Registration Fee Rs. 850/- Mode of Payment Online Resource Persons Eminent Architects, educators with proven track record Since there are limited seats, selection will be on first come first served basis. title: Allotment of Residential Facilities Session 2021-22 : (8/30/2021)
body: Online Allotment Process for Residential Facilities i.e. Residence, Mess, Laundry facility (Session 2021-22) is going to start. Allotment of residence will be done as per the guidelines of UGC, Govt. of Punjab and Ministry of health and family welfare (GOI). The residence facility can be booked as an INDIVIDUAL or as a GROUP (in which more than one student opt for same room) through hostel booking interface in UMS Dashboard. All students wishing to avail hostel facility in future can participate in hostel allotment process by booking residential facilities and avail Early Decision Benefit along with the proportionate charges as per their reporting schedule (if booked on or before 15th Sep. 2021 with a registration amount of Rs. 10000/-). However, in the first phase, the students who are fully vaccinated (i.e. with both doses) shall be considered for offline reporting from 2nd Week of September 2021.The students are advised to plan their travel to the University for offline Classes only after receiving the exact date of reporting in UMS “My Messages”. Booking residential facility will not be the sole criteria to become eligible for attending offline classes. Allotment for Scholarship Holder Students:- Allotment will be separately managed for students awarded hostel charges waiver under any scholarship scheme (like Sports, Cultural, Board topper etc.), such students need not to participate in the Allotment Process of Residential Facilities. Booking of residential facilities can be done through following interface: UMS Navigation >> Learning Management System (LMS) >> Polling for Hybrid Mode Classes The “Allotment Process of Residential Facilities’’ is three-steps process as detailed below. Step 1: Registration for Participating in Allotment Process - Student can book the residence with initial deposit of Rs. 10000/-. However, student must deposit the balance/pending charges by the prescribed date before joining / reporting the university residence. Step 2: Provisional Booking of Residential Facilities - All the registered students can select and provisionally book the desired hostel building, seater and room along with other residential facilities e.g. Mess& Laundry facility. - Students are advised to book the facilities very carefully. Changes may be allowed in the booked facility once the student report in campus by submitting the request in Block-29-301. Step 3: Confirmation of Allotment by Payment of Charges for Residential Facilities - The charges for selected residential facilities will be debited in student’s account to be paid by due date. - The charges of residential facilities can be paid using one of the following modes: o Online Payment:- Through University website www.lpu.in/fee or http://m.p-y.tm/lpu. o DD Mode:- Demand Draft drawn in favor of § LOVELY FACULTY OF TECHNOLOGY & SCIENCES § LOVELY FACULTY OF BUSINESS & ARTS § LOVELY FACULTY OF APPLIED MEDICAL SCIENCES payable at JALANDHAR. o Cash Mode:- Cash payment in University campus (Block 32, Level 1) Important Dates Activity Start Date Registration for Residential Facilities 26 Aug. 2021 Provisional Booking 26 Aug. 2021 Hostels Opening for Stay 02 days before the start of offline classes Date of Depositing Charges Before reporting in the university Note:- 1. Looking at the limited number of students coming for offline classes only Standard Mess (with lunch) option is available for booking. 2. For freshmen, who have already booked hostel, need not to book again. However, uploading the necessary documents i.e. vaccination certificate, parent’s consent etc. is compulsory through the polling interface for hybrid mode classes. For any query contact on: Mob. 62830-52138, 98782-62519 (between 09 AM to 05 PM) The above announcement should be read along with following Enclosures. 1. Charges for residential facilities 2. How to use UMS for three step allotment process.

title: LPU Global: Credit Transfer option for the LPU students : (8/30/2021)
body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for the students who want to get an international degree by getting transferred to partner foreign Universities in USA, Canada, Australia, UK, New Zealand, Latvia, Lithuania & Dubai under credit transfer program. title: Registration for Backlog Courses for Autumn Term 2021-22. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210828/001) : (8/28/2021)
body: To facilitate the students to clear the backlog courses in the regular current term the registration for backlog courses has been started for Autumn Term of Academic Session, 2021-22. The classes for courses registered as backlog courses by the students shall be held along with the regular students in myclass platform . Hence, only those courses shall be offered for backlog registration for which classes are being conducted in this term. The interface for Backlog registration shall remain active from 30th August, 2021 till 08th Sep 2021. Find below important guidelines for the Registration Process of the same. 1. Link to be followed for registration of backlog courses: UMS Navigation→ Examination system→ Backlog Registration → Backlog Course Registration 2. Grade conversion will be applicable for those courses which have been offered in Autumn Term 2021-22. Permissibility of conversions of grades shall be: S. No. Existing grade New Grade Conversion 1. E G Allowed 2. E F Allowed 3. G F Allowed 3. Conditions applicable for backlog registration: A. For Continuing students: In addition to the courses for the current regular term of the student shall be allowed to register in backlog courses if the student has minimum 2.5 CGPA or equivalent percentage (in case of marks based programme). i. If a student wants to register for only F grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of four F grade courses subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. However, the student may request for registration of an extra course which has been offered in this term by sending the email at academic.aac@lpu.co.in during the time of registration. ii. If a student wants to register only G grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of nine G grade courses. iii. A student wants to register both F and G grade courses, he/she can register maximum of nine courses of which maximum of four F grade courses can be registered subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. B. For Non-Promoted students: A student, who is registering only for backlog courses because of the non-promotion to the next year, the student can register for a maximum of 9 courses subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. If a student has studied more than 9 courses in a single term according to program scheme then student may apply for additional backlog courses in the term by sending the email at academic.aac@lpu.co.in during the time of registration. C. Registration in a course for additional courses/courses not mapped/not studied by student: A student who is registering for additional courses/courses not mapped/not studied by the students due to Change of Program, Term off/Year off, Re-joining after gap or Migration is marked as “M” grade in result. Student will be required to register the course(s) as F grade. “M” Grade cannot be converted to G grade. 4. Fee for backlog registration: The student Registration will be confirmed subject to payment of the backlog fee. The backlog fee shall be payable online through the fee payment gateway i. For National Students including “Asia”: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee plus Rs.350/- as examination fee and should be paid at time of registration through online mode only. ii. For International Students: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10thof the student’s standard tuition fee and USD 7 as examination fee and should be paid within 48 hours through University Website as per link:: https://www.lpu.in/frmloginaccounts.aspx iii. For scholarship holders or students for whom the fee has been waived off (fully or partly) by the University, the backlog fee will be 1/10th of the actual or standard tuition fee for the term and not the fee after scholarship or waiver. iv. For students admitted to dual and / or integrated programmes, the backlog fee shall be charged after considering whether the course pertains to the lower degree or the higher degree. v. In case a student’s batch has graduated or passed out, the backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee of the programme. vi. For term off and non-promoted students: Backlog fee will be 1/10 of his/her fellow batch’s fee until his/her fellow batch student is studying that program. Backlog fee will be 1/10 of the last term fee paid by his/her fellow batch in case the batch has passed out. vii. Once student has paid the backlog courses fee, courses cannot be De-registered. 5. Attendance Marking: i. Attendance in backlog courses will be included in the aggregate attendance of the student for the purpose of determining his/her eligibility for appearing in the ETE and for calculating the detention list. ii. Attendance will be counted from very next day of your registration confirmation i.e. after confirmation of your fee payment. 6. Equivalency of Courses: i. Students are required to ensure that the equivalent course allotted to them have not been previously studied by them. If equivalence course has already been studied by them, then they are required to report the same immediately by sending the email at academic.aac@lpu.co.in ii. Also, for equivalent courses, the credits of the new course will be applicable. 7. Step by Step guide for using the interface for backlog registration is attached along with these guidelines.

title: Information and guidelines regarding commencement of classes in hybrid mode (online + offline) for Academic Term 1, Session 2021-22. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/210826/001) : (8/26/2021)
body: Dear Student, As we all know that the world is witnessing COVID-19 outspread and its intensity is varying in waves. Although we have overcome the second wave of the pandemic, we still need to be very cautious in ensuring the physical and mental health, well-being and safety of all. With reference to the earlier circulated UMS announcement, Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/210803/001, you are well aware that the classes for upcoming Autumn Term shall be conducted in the hybrid/blended learning mode (wherein teaching in the physical classrooms and the virtual classrooms will co-exist). Considering the updated guidelines of various regulatory bodies, Central and State governments, the University shall be starting the hybrid (online + offline) classes tentatively from 2nd week of September 2021 in a phased manner. In view of the same, certain important points should be noted by all students: 1. In interest of student health and safety, in the first phase, only the students who are fully vaccinated i.e. who have taken both the vaccine doses before 31st August 2021, shall be considered for attending the offline classes in the University. 2. The students shall be required to submit an option that whether they want to stay in hostels after reporting to University for offline classes or whether they shall be making their own stay arrangements outside University Campus. 3. In the first phase, the students who shall be availing the University hostel facility, shall be considered for reporting in Campus as these students shall be compulsorily required to undergo 1 week quarantine in the hostels. 4. However, in the subsequent phases, the students who shall be staying outside the University on own arrangements, may be considered for offline classes reporting (depending upon the COVID guidelines prevailing at that time). 5. The students who have taken only their first dose till 31st August 2021 should ensure that they update their vaccination status on the below given link once they receive their second dose so that they can be considered in the subsequent reporting phases. 6. For day scholars reporting for offline classes, it shall be mandatory to get RT-PCR test done and submit the negative report to the University after every 15 days. 7. It is mandatory for students to seek written consent from their parent/guardian permitting them to report physically at University Campus. The parent consent form should be submitted online strictly as per the format provided by the University which is attached with this communication. 8. Upon reporting in University, the student shall have to submit his/her self-attested vaccination certificate and parent consent form. Also, the student shall submit an undertaking to the University that he/she shall abide by all COVID related guidelines and instructions issued by the University from time-to-time. 9. To safeguard the well-being of students, movement of students within the campus shall be strictly restricted. 10. The students staying in the University hostels shall not be allowed to go out of the University. 11. Keeping in mind the protocols of health safety, students will be prohibited from physically meeting anyone from outside the University. No visitors shall be allowed. 12. The University shall designate a drop-point where the parents can drop their wards on the first day of their reporting on Campus. No parent shall be allowed beyond that drop-point and only the student shall proceed inside the Campus. 13. The students who have reported on Campus shall not be allowed to go back to his/her hometown. In case of an emergency, the student shall be allowed to return to his/her hometown only after his/her parent’s consent. In such a case, the student shall be once again shifted to online mode of learning for the remaining part of current term, and he/she shall not be allowed for offline mode classes for remaining part of the current term. 14. In case any unforeseen situation, if the offline classes are withdrawn due to closure of University in view of COVID situation or any guidelines issued by govt./regulatory bodies, then the students shall be solely responsible for making their own travel arrangements to their hometowns. Guidelines with respect to conduct of offline classes: 1. The conduct of classes shall follow a hybrid mode i.e. the classes shall be conducted both in online mode as well as in offline mode. 2. The offline classes can be conducted in various models: regular lectures, doubt clearing sessions, classes on alternate days, hybrid classes etc. 3. The students shall be intimated about the offline classes model depending on their programme and course nature, class strength etc. The time-table of these students shall also be revised and they shall be required to follow the updated time-table for attending offline classes. 4. However, till the students do not report in the University for offline classes, they shall continue attending online classes as per their current time-table. 5. Duty leave shall be given to students for their travel days subject to verification by the University. 6. In case for a programme, the number of students reporting for offline classes is very less, then only special doubt clearing sessions shall be conducted in offline mode. The students who wish to report for offline classes in the first phase in the University tentatively from 2nd week of September 2021 shall be required to poll online through the following link: UMS Navigation -- >Learning Management System (LMS) -- > Polling for Hybrid Mode Classes (The uploading of student vaccination certificate and parent consent form as well as booking for hostel facility shall be done through the above given link only) The polling process at the above-mentioned link shall start from 26th August 2021 and the last date of polling is 29th August 2021. After successful polling, you shall get a confirmation of your registration in the UMS “My Messages” tab. Exact date of reporting in the University shall also be intimated via UMS “My Messages” tab only. After receiving the confirmation message and exact date of reporting, the registered students should ensure that they pay the hostel dues to confirm their hostel seat before reporting to the University. Detailed guidelines regarding the hostel booking process and the fee structure shall be communicated to the students shortly via a separate UMS announcement. Important: The students should initiate their travel bookings and arrangements only after they receive the confirmation message of registration and exact reporting date in their UMS My Message. It is reiterated that the classes shall operate both in offline and online mode for all the students. Hence, availing the provision of reporting on Campus for attending offline classes is completely optional for the students. However, once the student reports in University for offline classes, then he/she shall not be allowed to move out of the Campus and he/she shall be strictly required to follow all University guidelines and instructions. In case of query, you may log an RMS at link mentioned below: UMS Navigation -- > Relationship Management System (RMS) -- > Log Request Category: Offline Classes/Academic Related Issues Sub-Category: Offline Classes/Academic Related Issues.

title: Registration for R grade ETP viva for project, dissertation or similar courses. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210826/002) : (8/26/2021)
body: This is for the information of all the students who have been awarded with R grade in Capstone Projects, Dissertations, and similar courses (List attached as attachment I) in Spring Term 20212 that the interface for the registration in R grade is active now. The students can register for the R grade by following the below mentioned steps: a. Filling of Online Registration Form: All the students having R grade in the list of courses attached are required to apply online for the registration in R grade and pay the R grade registration fee online via visiting following UMS Link: UMS Navigation----> Examination System------> Exam Registration------> R grade courses Registration The Last date for R grade registration and fee payment is 1st September (without any late fee) and 8th September 2021 (with late fee of Rs.2000/-). Important points- i) The detailed process along with the screen shots to register and pay the R grade fee is also attached with this announcement as attachment 2. ii) No request of R grade registration shall be entertained after 8th September 2021. b. Uploading Soft Copy of Report After online registration and paying the requisite fee for the R grade, the students are required to upload the soft copy of final report as per the requirement of the course (List of courses is attached as attachment 1) by visiting the following UMS link: UMS-->LMS-------> Upload Research Project/Internship certificate details->Upload Project Report/Internship certificate The last date to upload soft copies of the report on UMS is 10th September 2021. c. Uploading of Publication details Students can upload their publications in either of UGC/ SCOPUS/ WOS/ IEEE/NAAS (rating greater than 5) indexed journal for the courses as per Attachment-1. The publication details can be uploaded by visiting following UMS link. UMS -->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details--->Upload Research Project Publication/Copyright details The last date to upload publication details on UMS is 10th September 2021. Important points: i) It is expected that the students upload the soft copies of their final report as well as publication details well in advance so that the respective supervisors can recommend the same within the timelines. ii) Mere proof of submission of publication or publication without LPU affiliation will not be considered. iii) Only proof of reviewer comments/acceptance of paper or publication of paper (with LPU affiliation) shall be considered as a valid proof for the publication. d. Recommendation of the uploaded soft copy of reports and publication details through respective supervisors The last date to recommend the soft copies of the reports is 13th September 2021 The students are also required to get their soft copies of the final reports/publication details recommended by their respective supervisors. The supervisors can visit the following UMS link for the recommendation of the soft copies of the final report and publication details uploaded by their respective students: UMS Navigation------>LMS-------> Project-------> Project file Recommendation The last date to recommend the soft copies of the reports is 13th September 2021 Important points- a) Registration for the R grade shall be considered only after completion of all the above mentioned steps or else the registration shall be assumed incomplete and F grade shall be awarded. b) R Grade viva schedule shall be communicated to the students via UMS my messages at least 7 days in advance from the ETP viva date. c) The student must have laptop/ desktop or any other suitable mean with proper audio/ video facility. d) The student must have high speed internet facility to appear for the online ETP evaluation. In case, the student has registered for the R grade but could not appear for the same due to any issue, he/she shall be marked absent for the evaluation and grade would convert to F. e) In case a student does not register for R grade or misses the report submission as per UMS timelines then R grade viva shall not be conducted and grade would be converted to F. f) All the respective supervisors are required to ensure the timely uploading of the soft copies of the final reports/publication details by their students and recommendation of the same within the timelines Any queries can be directed to Mr. Mohit Prakram, (COC), Projects and Internships Cell on academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in or in Block-Room: 30-310.

title: Fresh/Renewal Scholarship for Minorities students has been opened on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2021-22. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210825/003) : (8/25/2021)
body: Fresh/ Renewal scholarship registration process on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2021-22 has been started. Students who come under Minorities i.e. Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain and Zoroastrians (Parsis) can apply for the Post Matric Scholarship- Minorities and Merit Cum Means scholarship on National Scholarship Portal. The link for applying for the scholarship is as under: Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Last date for the scholarship is 30-11-2021. Eligibility Criteria 1. Scholarship will be awarded to the students who have secured more than 50% marks or equivalent grade in the previous year final examination. 2. The annual income of parents/guardian from all sources is as under:- · For Post Matric Scholarship Minorities equal to or less than Rs.2.00 lakh per annum. · For Merit Cum Means equal to or less than 2.5 lakh per annum. 3. The students obtaining benefits under these scholarship schemes shall not be allowed to avail benefits under any other scholarship scheme implemented by State Government / UT Administration. The scanned documents required for verification are as under:- 1. Print Application form duly signed by student. 2. Academic details 10th onwards (e.g. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Provisional Academic Transcript etc.) Link for applying Provisional Academic Transcript is UMS Navigation----- examination ---- Certificate request --- Apply Certificate. 3. Fee Receipts (Current session 2021-22). Link for applying Fee receipts is UMS Navigation – Finance Management System--- Fee receipt { export file to pdf }. 4. The latest Income Certificate (Issued by the concerned State/UT Govt.). 5. Aadhaar Card of student (linked with bank account). 6. Bank Passbook of student (linked with Aadhar Card). 7. Domicile / Residence Certificate. 8. Recent Passport Size Photo (1). 9. Scholarship received proof of previous year(s) i.e Bank Statement or PFMS report downloaded from the portal https://pfms.nic.in/NewDefaultHome.aspx (In case of Renewal Application for the session 2021-2022). 10. NSP Bonafide Certificate with recent passport size photograph at the space provided on the certificate. All the eligible students have to submit the scan copies of the above mentioned documents on email id ( scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in ) on or before 25.10.2021. In case of any query, the students can sent an email at scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in. ­­The students are advised to mention the University Registration No., NSP Application ID & Password and the latest mobile number for proper communication through email. In case of any grievances, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on email id anil.11928@lpu.co.in Note:- a) While entering the university detail the students have to select the University name as per the following detail:- State – Punjab , District – Kapurthala, University Name – Lovely Professional University, JULLUNDER (AISHE CODE-U-0379). b) The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying for these scholarship schemes can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login:- Link: - UMS Navigation -----> Scholarship Management System ----> Scholarship Policies ----> Session 2021 ----> National Scholarship Schemes. c) Signed Bonafide Certificate will be sent to you on your email id within two/three working days after receiving the complete documents from your side.

body: Registration process for applying in Ambassador’s Scholarship for the session 2021-22 has been opened. Last date for the scholarship is 30th September 2021. Year/ Semester in which studying present year: - Students have to select present year option from drop down. Important Instructions 1. Bhutanese students who are already in receipt of some other Government of India scholarship or Royal Government of Bhutan scholarship such as the India Bhutan Friendship scholarship, Nehru Wangchuck Scholarship, ICCR Scholarship, Nalanda University scholarship, SAARC scholarship, Undergraduate scholarship etc. are not eligible to apply for the Ambassador’s scholarship. 2. title: Enrollment into Career Services - 2023 graduating batch students (Revised timelines w.e.f. 21-Aug-2021) : (8/23/2021)
body: Kind attention: Students expected to graduate in 2023. This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the students graduating in 2023 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2023. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. Registration Deadline: For non-first year students (i.e. for 3/more years’ duration program students admitted till 2020 and expected to graduate in 2023; including Lateral entry students being admitted in 2021): Career Services Registration with access to applicable campus placement/internship opportunities w.e.f. 01-Jan-2022, is open from 21-Aug-2021 to 31-Oct-2021. For first year students (i.e. for 2-year programs students to be admitted in 2021 and graduating in 2023; excluding Lateral entry students being admitted in 2021): Career Services Registration with immediate access to applicable campus placement/internship opportunities will be open from 01-Sep-2021 to 30-Sep-2021. Registration Process: * Pathway: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration * Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: * Process Step-I: Initial Consent for enrollment into Career Services * Process Step-II: Profile Update and PEP Fee payment ** Process Step-I: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. Process Step-I will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). ** Process Step-II: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-I. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface. PEP Fee shall be paid online (full payment or part payment) through Placement Registration interface itself. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. Student will not be allowed to avail Career Services/PEP activities without paying the PEP test fees. The registration is considered complete only after Process Step-II is successfully completed with applicable PEP fee payment. Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. In case of any queries, students may: 1) Contact their respective school Training and Placement Coordinators (TPCs), or 2) Log an RMS in category "Division of Career Services --- Placement --- Career Services Policy Registration".

body: Xethon: Hackathon Challenge 2021 Xebia’s Hackathon is a 48-hour Coding Marathon where participating students will contribute solutions to some prevalent industry challenges by building tech- innovative solutions through their out of the box thinking and technical and problem solving skills. All the eligible students must register with the team name and members name at this link - https://bit.ly/XebiaHackthon The last date to fill and register for this hackathon is 26th August 2021 After this the team will be shortlisted by the experts based on the company parameters. title: Important information regarding updation of vaccination status of students. (Ref. No. (LPU/DAA/IC/210816/005) : (8/16/2021)
body: Dear Students, The previous year has been full of challenges and the world faced unprecedented tough situations. In these trying times everyone, be it students or teachers, kept their hopes high and went an extra mile eyeing the academic progress. The University has put in its best efforts to ensure timely achievement of academic targets through seamless shifting to online teaching and evaluation mode. The University was thus able to successfully complete the entire Academic session 2020-2021 as per pre-defined timelines at uncompromised quality standards. In the current scenario we anticipate the things to settle down. But this is also the time to not let our guard down and practice prescribed precautions. For this we must follow the guidelines issued by the government and get ourselves fully vaccinated for COVID-19 as soon as possible and adhere to all government guidelines. The University expects its students to serve as role model for the society by getting themselves and their near and dear ones vaccinated at the earliest. Further, as per the recent government directives, those students who have taken first/both dose(s) of vaccine are required to update the information with the University through below mentioned link and upload vaccination certificates as issued to them by the government. This information shall help in the future planning of academic activities. Link for uploading vaccination status: UMS Navigation --- Examination system --- Student Vaccination Status Students who have not taken even one dose of vaccination are required to register for vaccination at the earliest possible and the snapshot of the same (confirming registration for vaccination) should be uploaded through the same link as mentioned above. Further, the students who have already taken their first vaccination dose are advised to take their second dose as per the timelines prescribed by the government. Students are required to provide the above said information at the portal latest by 22 Aug 2021. Important: The link to upload the details will be editable for students who have submitted their vaccination status as none/only first dose i.e. they can later update after taking first/second dose respectively and upload the certificates. All the students are required to refer only to the UMS announcements regularly for updates and avoid referring to any other information shared via any other platform.

title: Short Term Course on Sustainable & Smart Architecture in Post Covid India : (8/13/2021)
body: Sustainable architecture is architecture that seeks to minimize the negative environmental impact of buildings by efficiency and moderation in the use of materials, energy, development space and the ecosystem at large. The idea of sustainability, or ecological design, is to ensure that our use of presently available resources does not end up having detrimental effects to our collective well-being or making it impossible to obtain resources for other applications in the long run. This Short Term Course focuses on the basic principles of sustainable architecture to prepare professionals for meeting the challenges of post pandemic. The requisite details are appended below for your reference: Title Short Term Course on Sustainable & Smart Architecture in Post Covid India Course Objectives The Course aims at capacity building in: • Acquiring knowledge about Traditional Passive Techniques adopted in Smart Architecture of Buildings • Design process ‘Concept to Execution’ of Architectural Projects • Healthy and Healing Buildings to Immunize Life· Fostering Urban Qualities and Ecological balance Program Schedule Dates: September 06 to 11, 2021 Time:: 2:00- 5:00 PM For topic details, please refer Brochure Register at https://www.lpu.in/hrd/ Platform Online –Link will be shared with registered participants Participants Faculty members, Research Scholars, PG Students from Architecture, Planning, Civil and Mechanical Engineering, Practicing Architects, Builders and Town Planners as per registration Registration closes August 31, 2021 Registration Fee Rs. 850/- Mode of Payment Online Resource Persons Eminent Architects, educators with proven track record Since there are limited seats, selection will be on first come first served basis. (OC.26851.2021.20841) is scheduled as follows: Date: 13-08-2021 Time: 2 pm to 3:30 pm NOTE: 1. Test shall comprise of aptitude, reasoning, DI, Technical and coding questions. 2. The online test duration will be 90 minutes. 3. They will be receiving a test link from Snigdha Zakaria by tomorrow 12pm on their email ids. General Instructions:- 1. A laptop with a functional webcam is mandatory. 2. The candidates need to take the test on a computer/laptop system, equipped with a working Web-Cam (external or built-in) and smooth internet connectivity throughout the test session. 3. Candidates are advised to take the test in all fair means. 4. Candidates are advised that if the link is not working by clicking on it then kindly copy and paste the link to the different browsers. 5. Do not try to click ‘Print Screen’ or Copy the content while the test is in progress. The system will disqualify the candidate instantly. Use of mobile phones and cameras during the entire duration of the test is strictly prohibited. 6. There should not be any hindrance to the Web-Cam’s lenses. It should not be covered with any object and should always have the candidate right in front of it. 7. While taking up the online test, candidates are advised not to move out of the test screen, e.g., Do not open another tab or application like notepad, excel or web browsers. NOTE for Attendance:- 1. It is Mandatory to mark drive attendance as duty leaves will be given based on the attendance marked by the students. 2. Link to mark drive attendance will be open from 01:30 PM to 02:00 PM 3. To mark drive attendance: Go to Placement portal > Mark drive attendance. 4. Select the name of the drive & Round for which the attendance has to be marked. 5. Scan the QR code using the Barcode scanner Menu from the LPU Touch App menu. 6. In case the student is not able to mark the attendance due to the mobile camera not working, Mobile software not supporting, Internet issue then the candidate can select not able to mark the attendance and save the attendance by selecting a specific reason using the interface. 7. If any disparity is found between placement drive attendance (Marked by the student using QR SCAN CODE) & company data then action will be taken as per the placement policy.

title: Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS) of Ph.D. Scholars(Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210811/001) : (8/11/2021)
body: This is in reference to the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) which will be conducted tentatively in October, 2021. It is mandatory for all research scholars to clear SAS within two years from the date of registration otherwise their admission may be deemed as cancelled. The key points for SAS evaluation are as follows: a) To finalize the Title of the proposed research work. b) To finalize the Objectives of the proposed research work. c) To finalize the research methodology of the proposed research work. I. The research scholars are required to follow the following three steps to be eligible for appearing in SAS. 1. Registration for SAS: Research scholars who have successfully completed their course work or exempted from the course work (due to M.Phil.) can register for SAS seminar through the interface available in the UMS at the following link. UMS Navigation --> Examination system --> Research Degree Evaluation --> Registration for upcoming activity --> SAS Interface for registration will remain active from 10th August 2021 to 27th August 2021. Only those research scholars should register for their SAS seminar who are willing to appear for the evaluation in the month October 2021 and have the approval of their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor for the same. 2. Uploading of synopsis: Once the research scholar has registered for the SAS, he/ she needs to upload the synopsis for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the panel of experts. The research scholar needs to visit the same UMS link for uploading of the synopsis of SAS along with the other relevant documents. UMS Navigation --> Examination system --> Research Degree Evaluation --> Registration for upcoming activity --> SAS The last date for uploading the synopsis report is 1st Sept., 2021. 3. Recommendation of the synopsis by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded the synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Research Degree Evaluation --> Ph.D. Seminar File Verification --> SAS --> Reg. No. --> Download The last date for verification of the synopsis is 6th Sept., 2021. II. Evaluation of the State of the Art Seminar (SAS) via online platform: It is for the information of the all concerned that due to prevailing situation the SAS evaluation shall be planned via online platform google meet. Important Note: For Registration: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt of their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisors/Co-Supervisors/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension shall be given for registration beyond the last date. c) No request for deregistration shall be entertained beyond the last date of registration and the scholar shall be marked absent. d) Research scholars having pending dues are not eligible to register for the SAS evaluation. Therefore, research scholars are requested to clear the pending dues and get registered for the SAS evaluation before the last date. e) If a research scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from December 2021 onwards) only after the clearance of fine. For Uploading Synopsis: a) The research scholar shall not be eligible for uploading any synopsis report without completing registration process. b) The research scholars are strongly advised that synopsis file must be uploaded only after the thorough discussion with the Supervisor. Same should be defended during the presentation on the day of evaluation. For preparing the presentation the research scholar should refer to the format for SAS presentation (Attachment) c) No extension shall be given for uploading synopsis report beyond the last date. d) Read the attached guidelines very carefully before uploading the synopsis. e) All the research scholars must upload single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I as per the attached guidelines or else their SAS registration may be cancelled. Upon cancellation, he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation (with fee of Rs. 5000/-). No second chance shall be given to upload the synopsis. f) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using SAS registration interface) before registering and uploading the synopsis at the interface. For recommendation of the Synopsis: a) The research scholar must upload the synopsis well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. For online evaluation of the State of the Art Seminar (SAS): a) The research scholar must have laptop/ desktop or any other suitable mean with proper audio/ video facility. b) The research scholar must have high speed internet facility to appear for the online SAS evaluation. In case, the research scholar has registered for the SAS evaluation but could not appear for the same due to any issue, he/she shall be marked absent for the evaluation and he/shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. c) The research scholar must be well versed with the online google meet platform. It is strongly advised that the research scholar must present his/ her presentation to the respective supervisor prior to appearing in actual SAS evaluation so that there is no confusion on the day of evaluation. d) All the research scholars who have the last chance to appear in the SAS evaluation in October 2021 are advised strongly to register for the same. e) All the scholars who have already completed two years from date of registration are required to get the extension through CRDP for timely registration in the SAS evaluation. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues: 1. For Registration/Uploading of synopsis, write at rdc.sas@lpu.co.in 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor /fee, write at drp@lpu.co.in
