title: Registration for Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210806/002) : (8/6/2021)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from September 2021 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs after July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after each 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. The main aim of the End Term Presentation is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation The research scholars are required to follow the following two steps for appearing in ETP: Step-1. Registration and uploading of ETP reports All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation and upload their files through following UMS link: UMS Navigation ---> Examination System -----> Research Degree Evaluation -----> Registration of Upcoming Activity The last date for registration and uploading of report is 25th August, 2021. Step-2. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar have registered for the ETP and uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS navigation ----> Division of Examination ----> Research Degree Evaluation ----> PhD Seminar File Verification ---> ETP The last date for verification of the report is 30th August, 2021. Evaluation of the End Term Presentation (ETP) via online platform It is for the information of the all concerned that due to the prevailing situation, the End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation shall be planned via online platform google meet. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of ETP report: 1. As per current guidelines, the research scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such research scholars who have either missed or have been awarded “Not Recommended” in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the ETP evaluation. 2. The research scholars must upload single PDF file for end term report strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 3. In case the research scholars are unable to get a signed copy of the synopsis from their respective supervisor due to prevailing situation, they can upload the soft copy of the synopsis without supervisor signature. But it is required that the synopsis uploaded by them must be strictly as per the guidelines and it must be verified by their supervisor through UMS interface as per prescribed timelines. 4. Research scholars are also required to submit 2 hard copies of the reports duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) in Research Degree and Evaluation Cell (RDEC) (Block-30; Room Number- 310) for which the separate communication shall be made in due course of time. 5. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 6. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. 7. Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using ETP registration interface) before registering and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. 8. As per current guidelines, the research scholars who are eligible for ETP evaluation as per the attached list but do not completely register for the same will be marked absent for the ETP evaluation and result of the evaluation will stand as "Not recommended". 9. The research scholars who are not able to register for the ETP evaluation due to pending dues are advised to clear the same and register for the ETP evaluation as per the timelines failing which their ETP result of will stand as "Not recommended". 10. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. For online evaluation of the End Term Presentation (ETP) a) Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars uploads the files within stipulated timeline. b) The research scholar must have laptop/ desktop or any other suitable mean with proper audio/ video facility. c) The research scholar must have high speed internet facility to appear for the online ETP evaluation. In case, the research scholar has registered for the ETP evaluation but could not appear for the same due to any issue, he/she shall be marked absent for the evaluation. Result of all such research scholars for ETP evaluation shall stand as “Not Recommended” and the will be required to re-register for the next scheduled ETP evaluation with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. d) The research scholar must be well versed with the online google meet platform. It is strongly advised that the research scholar must present his/ her presentation to the respective supervisor prior to appearing in actual ETP evaluation so that there is no confusion on the day of evaluation. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query, write us at rdc.etrs@lpu.co.in

title: Enrollment into Career Services - 2023 graduating batch students (Registration deadline extended till 20-Aug-2021) : (8/3/2021)
body: Kind attention: Students expected to graduate in 2023. This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the students graduating in 2023 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2023. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. Registration Deadline: Career Services Registration with immediate access to applicable campus placement/internship opportunities is open from 14-Apr-2021 to 20-Aug-2021 (extended deadline). Registration Process: * Pathway: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration *Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: * Process Step-I: Initial Consent for enrollment into Career Services * Process Step-II: Profile Update and PEP Fee payment ** Process Step-I: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. Process Step-I will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). ** Process Step-II: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-I. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface. PEP Fee shall be paid online (full or partial ) through Placement Registration interface itself. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. Student will not be allowed to avail Career Services/PEP activities without paying the PEP test fees. The registration is considered complete only after Process Step-II is successfully completed with applicable PEP fee payment. Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. In case of any queries, students may: 1) Contact their respective school Training and Placement Coordinators (TPCs), or 2) Log an RMS in category "Division of Career Services --- Placement --- Career Services Policy Registration".

title: Workshop on 3D Designing and Printing : (7/17/2021)
body: 3D Printing is an Additive Manufacturing technique that creates a physical object from a virtual 3D CAD model by depositing successive layers of material. They work like the traditional inkjet printers, but instead of ink, a 3D printer deposits desired material to manufacture an object from its digital format. 3D printing and rapid prototyping, in general, are widely claimed to have revolutionized not only the manufacturing industry but also many other walks of life like medicine, aerospace and automotive industry. title: Financial Education Program : Basics of Investing in a Stock Market in collaboration with Paytm Money : (7/17/2021)
body: Dear Students, Warren Buffet once said, “I made my first investment at the age of 11. I was wasting my time until then.” While few of us have entered the finance world, many just like ourselves are yet to begin their investment journey. Considering the current market volatility owing to Covid - 19 pandemic, we’ve observed a lot of young individuals have burnt their hands by making uninformed heresy decisions. We are here to help you navigate this river of misinformation, fraudulent schemes, and false goals. Lovely Professional University in collaboration with Paytm Money brings to you a 3-day course on Basics of Investing in the Stock Market. We believe one should educate ourselves in order to make an informed investment decision that fulfills your personal goals and ambitions. Why take this course? This course is specifically designed for young individuals who would like to begin early just like Warren Buffet and reap the benefits of the 8th wonder of the world i.e. compound interest. What will you learn in the 3 Day Basics of Investing in Stock Market Course? Day 1 - Understand the Market - Introduction to Stock Markets, how they work, Equity, Mutual Funds, ETFs and so on Day 2 - Understand Yourself - Identify your goals, your risk appetite, long term and short-term objectives. Day 3 - Understand by Action - Learn how to apply practical trading strategies that work! Who will deliver this course? Delivered to you by some of the most knowledgeable stock market expert - Sankha Mukherjee DGM – Equity Education What else? Become a part of the Paytm Wealth Community * Course completion certificate * An Exchange traded fund (ETF) for FREE! * Knowledge exchange program with other top institutions * Student Ambassador Program So why wait, invest your time today to reap the benefits tomorrow. Register now for the 3-day course starting soon : Link: https://insider.in/basic-of-investing-in-stock-market-jul14-2021/event

title: Tips to avoid doomscrolling- Internet addiction Shared by psychologists from Counseling & Happiness Cell. (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/210716/001) : (7/16/2021)
body: Dear Students, Does your phone ever call out to you saying, “Don’t you want to catch up on everything that’s going around? Maybe you’ll find something that interests you?” Your thumb may get a mind of its own and the next thing you know, you’re scrolling on and on, until you realize that you’re bingeing on doom-and-gloom posts. In these pandemic times most of us have learnt a habit of scrolling the content on Social media. And sometimes it is not in our control and we feel stuck in that. There is a great saying- “Excess of everything is bad”. Balancing the time spent on social is important as it may create stress, anxiety and a feeling of social isolation at times. So, how to deal with internet addiction? Psychologists from counseling & happiness cell - share tips to help you learn how to deal with internet addiction. We care about your emotional and psychological well being. Please email us – counseling.happiness@lpu.co.in

title: NPTEL Course Enrollment open for the Jul - Dec 2021 semester : (7/13/2021)
body: SWAYAM - National Program on Technology Enhanced Learning (NPTEL), a joint initiative of seven premier IITs and IISC Bangalore seeks registration for around 500+ online courses of various streams and disciplines. You can pick & choose the course(s) relevant to your domain and discipline and avail the opportunity of adding an IIT Certificate to top up your educational qualification. The list of courses offered in this term is available at https://swayam.gov.in/NPTEL Event 4 Weeks Set I 8 Weeks Set I 12 Weeks 4 Weeks Set II 8 Weeks Set II Start of course Jul 26, 2021 Jul 26, 2021 Jul 26, 2021 Aug 23, 2021 Aug 23, 2021 End of course Aug 20, 2021 Sep 17, 2021 Oct 15, 2021 Sep 17, 2021 Oct 15, 2021 Exam Dates Sep 26, 2021 (2 Sessions: 9am-12 noon; 2pm-5pm) Sep 26, 2021 (2 Sessions: 9am-12 noon; 2pm-5pm) Oct 23 + 24, 2021 (2 Sessions: 9am-12 noon; 2pm-5pm) Oct 23 + 24, 2021 (2 Sessions: 9am-12 noon; 2pm-5pm) Oct 23 + 24, 2021 (2 Sessions: 9am-12 noon; 2pm-5pm) Note: All faculty/staff members are expected to attend at least one NPTEL course during the academic year 2021-22. REGISTRATION PROCESS: 1. Register for the course at https://swayam.gov.in/NPTEL 2. Use a unique email id throughout the course run. 3. title: Workshop on 3D Designing and Printing : (7/13/2021)
body: 3D Printing is an Additive Manufacturing technique that creates a physical object from a virtual 3D CAD model by depositing successive layers of material. They work like the traditional inkjet printers, but instead of ink, a 3D printer deposits desired material to manufacture an object from its digital format. 3D printing and rapid prototyping, in general, are widely claimed to have revolutionized not only the manufacturing industry but also many other walks of life like medicine, aerospace and automotive industry. Student Research and Project Cell under the aegis of Division of Student Welfare brings you this program on 3D Designing & Printing which will helps the participants to understand the design, functioning and operation of a basic 3D Printer. Workshop Requirements: Laptop with minimum 2GB Graphics card and 4 GB RAM Registration FEE: Rs 250/- per student. Registration Link: http://tiny.cc/3ddesignworkshop Workshop Platform: Google Meet. Certificate will be Provided to students Resource Person: 1)Mr. Mandeep Singh- Assistant Professor ,Lovely Professional University, Designer of Megastructure Metal Magna 2) Mr. Anant Rajput, Designer of Go Algae Air Purifier . title: Important information regarding updation of vaccination status of students. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/210710/001) : (7/10/2021)
body: Dear Students, The previous year has been full of challenges and the world faced unprecedented tough situations. In these trying times everyone, be it students or teachers, kept their hopes high and went an extra mile eyeing the academic progress. The University has put in its best efforts to ensure timely achievement of academic targets through seamless shifting to online teaching and evaluation mode. The University was thus able to successfully complete the entire Academic session 2020-2021 as per pre-defined timelines at uncompromised quality standards. In the current scenario we anticipate the things to settle down. But this is also the time to not let our guard down and practice prescribed precautions. For this we must follow the guidelines issued by the government and get ourselves fully vaccinated for COVID-19 as soon as possible and adhere to all government guidelines. The University expects its students to serve as role model for the society by getting themselves and their near and dear ones vaccinated at the earliest. Further, as per the recent government directives, those students who have taken first/both dose(s) of vaccine are required to update the information with the University through below mentioned link and upload vaccination certificates as issued to them by the government. This information shall help in the future planning of academic activities. Link for uploading vaccination status: UMS Navigation --- Examination system --- Student Vaccination Status Students who have not taken even one dose of vaccination are required to register for vaccination at the earliest possible and the snapshot of the same (confirming registration for vaccination) should be uploaded through the same link as mentioned above. Further, the students who have already taken their first vaccination dose are advised to take their second dose as per the timelines prescribed by the government. Students are required to provide the above said information at the portal latest by 31st July 2021. Important: The link to upload the details will be editable for students who have submitted their vaccination status as none/only first dose i.e. they can later update after taking first/second dose respectively and upload the certificates. All the students are required to refer only to the UMS announcements regularly for updates and avoid referring to any other information shared via any other platform.

title: ONGC Scholarship to Meritorious SC, ST, OBC and General Category students for the session 2020-21.(Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210709/001) : (7/9/2021)
body: Registration process for applying for ONGC Scholarship for the academic session 2020-21 has been started on ONGC Foundation Scholarship Portal. 1000* scholarships worth `Rs. 48,000/- per annum each ONGC Foundation offers scholarships to meritorious SC/ST category students pursuing professional courses in Engineering, Medical stream and Master’s degree course in Business Administration, Geology and geophysics. 500* scholarships worth ` Rs. 48,000/- per annum each ONGC Foundation offers scholarships to meritorious OBC category students pursuing professional courses in Engineering, Medical stream and Master’s degree course in Business Administration, Geology and geophysics. 500* scholarships worth ` Rs. 48,000/- per annum each ONGC Foundation offers scholarships to meritorious economically weaker General category students pursuing professional courses in Engineering, Medical stream and Master’s degree course in Business Administration, Geology and geophysics. The link for ONGC Scholarship Portal is as under: Link: https://ongcscholar.org Last date for applying for the scholarship is 06-08-2021 Guidelines for the following schemes are enclosed for your reference along with undertaking & declaration. Eligibility Criteria for the Scholarship is as under: · Gross joint Income of the family of the candidate from all sources during a financial year should not be more than Rs. 4.50 lakhs per annum. (For SC/ST category) · Gross joint Income of the family of the candidate from all sources during a financial year should not be more than Rs. 2 lakhs per annum. (For OBC/Gen. category) · The scholarship is admissible for full-time regular courses only. · Only 1st year students are eligible for this scholarship (Batch 2020)\ · The scholarship holder under this scheme will not hold any other scholarship/stipend. · Only Zone-1 (J & K, Delhi, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Chandigarh, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh) students are eligible for this scholarship. body: 3D Printing is an Additive Manufacturing technique that creates a physical object from a virtual 3D CAD model by depositing successive layers of material. title: Opportunity for students to appear in GO4Youth Examination. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/210907/001) : (7/9/2021)
body: The extensive and accelerating use of natural resources is posing as a serious threat to the existence of mankind. Concern for the environment and sustainable development are being regarded as key to the future of mankind. Youth has always played a pivotal role in the success of critical areas of concern. Upon understanding these factors The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI), a pioneering organization has taken up an important step to merge the two i.e. the concern for Environment and the Youth by planning to actively engage youth towards environment through its different ESD (Education for Sustainable Development) programmes. One such programme GO4Youth, initiated in the year 2020 is an annual MCQ based examination for undergraduate and postgraduate students that evaluate environmental consciousness, behaviour and aptitude of our future citizenry. GO4Youth is an online examination comprising of multiple choice questions that tests the environment knowledge, aptitude and attitude of students. This examination aspires to address mandated environmental studies for undergraduate courses in India and is a step in a direction to achieve Sustainable Development Goals as established by the United Nations. Students and Staff of Lovely Professional University have always shown the highest possible degree of concern towards environment. Students have actively involved themselves in various endeavours for the protection and sustenance of the environment. In this direction it is highly desired that students should actively participate in this initiative by TERI of the GO4Youth Examination. GO4Youth examination will be held from August, 17th to August 19th August in the candidate’s preferred time slot. Last date for registration for GO4Youth examination is 31st July, 2021. Applications received after the due date will not be considered. Registration fee for the test is Rs.150/- For reference of the students the Guidelines for Registration for the examination, Pattern of Examination, Broad topics (syllabus) for the examination and a Sample Paper are being attached. For any further details the students can refer to the official website of The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI), https://www.teriin.org/olympiad/

body: 3D Printing is an Additive Manufacturing technique that creates a physical object from a virtual 3D CAD model by depositing successive layers of material. They work like the traditional inkjet printers, but instead of ink, a 3D printer deposits desired material to manufacture an object from its digital format. 3D printing and rapid prototyping, in general, are widely claimed to have revolutionized not only the manufacturing industry but also many other walks of life like medicine, aerospace and automotive industry. Student Research and Project Cell under the aegis of Division of Student Welfare brings you this program on 3D Designing & Printing which will helps the participants to understand the design, functioning and operation of a basic 3D Printer. title: Grounding techniques for anxiety Shared by psychologists from Counseling & happiness Cell. (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/202706/001) : (7/6/2021)
body: Dear Students, Do you worry about the future? Do you feel how long this pandemic will continue? Sometimes these questions might be coming in your mind creating a feeling that makes you uncomfortable. You feel anxious and don’t know how to deal with such feelings. Psychologists explain that it starts with a “What if something bad happens?” worry, snowballs into more worries, your heart speeds up, you tense up and experience anxiety. So, what should we do about it? First, recognize that it’s OKAY to feel anxious amidst the current situation. Second, we’ve come a long way and third, we CAN manage anxiety with the help of grounding techniques. Psychologists from counseling & happiness cell - share techniques to deal with anxiety. We care about your emotional and psychological well being. Please email us – counseling.happiness@lpu.co.in

title: Workshop on 3D Designing and Printing : (7/5/2021)
body: 3D Printing is an Additive Manufacturing technique that creates a physical object from a virtual 3D CAD model by depositing successive layers of material. They work like the traditional inkjet printers, but instead of ink, a 3D printer deposits desired material to manufacture an object from its digital format. 3D printing and rapid prototyping, in general, are widely claimed to have revolutionized not only the manufacturing industry but also many other walks of life like medicine, aerospace and automotive industry. Student Research and Project Cell under the aegis of Division of Student Welfare brings you this program on 3D Designing & Printing which will helps the participants to understand the design, functioning and operation of a basic 3D Printer. Course Outcomes Learn about the materials. Working of a 3D Printer. Fundamentals of Software Understand how to build and calibrate a 3D printer Understand the basics of G code generation Workshop Requirements: Laptop With minimum 2GB Graphics card and 4 GB RAM Registration FEE: Rs 250/- per student. Registration Link: http://tiny.cc/3ddesignworkshop Workshop Platform: Google Meet. Certficate will be Provided to students Resource Person:1)Mr. Mandeep Singh- Assistant Professor ,Lovely Professional University, Designer of Megastructure Metal Magna 2) Mr. Anant Rajput, Designer of Go Algae Air Purifier . title: Workshop on 3D Designing and Printing : (7/3/2021)
body: 3D Printing is an Additive Manufacturing technique that creates a physical object from a virtual 3D CAD model by depositing successive layers of material. They work like the traditional inkjet printers, but instead of ink, a 3D printer deposits desired material to manufacture an object from its digital format. 3D printing and rapid prototyping, in general, are widely claimed to have revolutionized not only the manufacturing industry but also many other walks of life like medicine, aerospace and automotive industry. Student Research and Project Cell under the aegis of Division of Student Welfare brings you this program on 3D Designing & Printing which will helps the participants to understand the design, functioning and operation of a basic 3D Printer. Course Outcomes Learn about the materials, designing of CAD models, working of a 3D Printer. Fundamentals of Software Understand how to build and calibrate a 3D printer Understand the basics of G code generation Workshop Requirements: Laptop with i5 Processor. Process Step-I will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). ** Process Step-II: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-I. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface. PEP Fee shall be paid online (in full or part) through Placement Registration interface itself. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. Student will not be allowed to avail Career Services/PEP activities without paying the PEP test fees. The registration is considered complete only after Process Step-II is successfully completed with applicable PEP fee payment (in full or part). Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. In case of any queries, students may: 1) Contact their respective school Training and Placement Coordinators (TPCs), or 2) Log an RMS in category "Division of Career Services --- Placement --- Career Services Policy Registration".

title: Employability Diagnostic Assessment for freshmen 2021 (6/20/2021)
body: Dear Students, We once again welcome you all to Lovely Professional University ! As we say that the best way to get something done is to begin. So working on the mantra of Why Wait, University has taken an innovative step to introduce a Diagnostic Assessment Test right at the beginning of your academic journey to ensure overall skill enhancement and to make you industry ready. Diagnostic Assessment helps you to know your strengths, areas to fill the gaps, building capacity, stand out amongst your peers, and have a clear road map ahead and finally you will be an inch closer to get your dream job. These tests assess you on critical areas like communication skills, logical reasoning and quantitative skills. These skills play a pivotal role in the entire placement process and help the recruiter to identify the suitability of a candidate. This methodology is rapidly emerging as an industry benchmark with companies like Cognizant, Capgemini, Amazon, TCS, Infosys, and Microsoft for recruitment at entry level roles. The diagnostic assessment test will also help the University to plan appropriate activities and training initiatives for your future endeavours. Based on this Diagnostic Assessment, your placement specific credited and non-credited input will be planned. On the whole, the Diagnostic Assessment Test will act as a Gateway to Placements. title: Join the launch of the new Compassionate Integrity Training- Self-Directed Learning (CIT-SDL) Course developed with UNESCO MGIEP. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/210617/001) : (6/17/2021)
body: The impact of the COVID -19 global pandemic on all of us has been on both physical as well as emotional levels. The youth have been severely impacted - suffering fear, anxiety and stress, greatly affecting their mental well-being. To build emotional resilience among the youth, Compassionate Integrity Training (CIT) has partnered with UNESCO MGIEP (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, Mahatma Gandhi Institute for Education for Peace and Sustainable Development) and the Charter for Compassion to offer a global self-directed online version of CIT accompanied by MasterClass interactive sessions. UNESCO MGIEP and Life University (USA) invite the world’s youth (18 – 34 years old) to enroll for Self-directed Emotional Learning for Empathy and Kindness (SEEK) – a free online course that will help the students to: a. develop self-awareness to understand your strengths. b. learn the skills to build and nurture lasting relationships. c. inculcate empathy, mindfulness and compassion to live a fulfilling life. Self-directed Emotional Learning for Empathy and Kindness (Brochure attached) is a 40 hour, self-directed/self-paced course in the English language. A Masterclass for Skill 2 will be conducted virtually on June 19. 1. Course Introduction: Compassionate integrity refers to the ability to live one’s life in accordance with one’s values with a recognition of common humanity, our basic orientation to kindness and reciprocity. Compassionate Integrity Training (CIT) is a resiliency-informed program (Brochure attached) that helps in cultivating human values as skills so we can thrive as individuals and society. The original blended course has been taken by thousands of people in over fifty countries around the world. 2. Course Duration: This course is a three-part online learning program that one can complete at one’s own pace. It includes practices that include reflective writing, contemplative journaling exercises and guided audio practices, which assist in helping one master the skills. The course will take approximately 40 hours to complete. 3. Certification: There are no assignments or tests in CIT. At the end of the course, participants will be awarded a Course Completion certificate jointly by UNESCO MGIEP and Life University. 4. Course Advantages: This course is online and self-directed, which means you can go through the course at your pace, anytime, anywhere. Use the masterclass to practice the techniques guided by expert facilitators, interact with your peers, and get your doubts clarified. Certification by UNESCO MGIEP and Life University. To derive maximum benefit, University encourage all students to enroll in the social and emotional resilience course on Self-directed Emotional Learning for Empathy and Kindness (SEEK) on FramerSpace. title: Nano-Satellite Design Competition : (6/16/2021)
body: Nano-Satellite Design Competition Centre of Space Research, LPU invites call for abstract submission for Nano-Satellite Design Competition, to design a cost-efficient nanosatellite payload system, with an objective to draw as much information from space. Students have to provide an abstract for the payload concept (purpose of satellite design), which will be passed through a rigorous review process with panels of experts from the space industry. The competition aimed to reach out to people from multiple scientific and engineering fields. Objective: To design cost efficient satellite (nanosatellite), unique technology (payload) with a huge scientific return. Competition Phase: The competition is separated into three main phases 1. Idea Selection (Abstract) 2. Research & Design phase 3. Build & Test phase Primarily a unique idea(s) will be selected in the first phase. In the second phase the research & design module, shortlisted teams have to submit their report to the reviewer. Once all reports have been reviewed and evaluated, the three best teams will be selected to the next phase, where they will be involved in payload design work. Learning outcomes: Challenge to perform a complex, systems engineering task for the development of a payload to a set of real space mission requirements Gain exposure and experience of the typical design processes Enable researchers to apply qualified technical skills and learn new ones relevant to the space industry Provide students with an opportunity to develop skills, such as teamwork, leadership, and project management. Team size: 4-6 students (Interdisciplinary) Abstract length: 150-200 Words Abstract Submission: jaisukhpal.23875@lpu.co.in Submission Deadline: 17/06/2021 (till 5 PM) For any query please contact: Dr. Kamal Kumar: 9812299990 Dr. Shelej Khera: 9466731632 Dr. Jai Sukh Paul Singh: 9463457100 Mr. Mohd. title: Regard Before you Discard: Best Out of Waste Challenge : (6/7/2021)
body: Handling and proper disposing household waste without affecting nature these days is becoming a challenge. There is a lot of household waste which can be converted into useful things. With the growing increase in wastes in our society from households to industrial wastes, we now require a very innovative approach to get rid of them. Recycling and reusing the valuable waste material can result in development of fantastic and usable products. Student Research and Project Cell-Division of Student Welfare announces a competition “Regard Before you Discard: Best Out of Waste Challenge” to transform and create best out of household waste or discarded material. Eligibility: Kids from any age Group(Category 1) Undergraduate and Postgraduate Student.(Category 2) Rules: 1. Team shall consist of maximum 2 members. 2. Participants must submit a video starting from selecting the material, processes and then final product in a video of minimum of 2 minutes (time lapse can also be used to show fast processes) and maximum of 3 minutes. 3. Waste material could be anything like tetra packs, bottles, newspapers, old utensils, jute material or any second hand items that otherwise would be thrown away 4. Participants will be judged on the basis of Creativity, Utilization of Resources, Artistic composition & design, Eco-friendly rating, Utility of the Product and Overall presentation. To know more about Rules go through Rule Book as attached Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/makingbestoutofwaste Last Date of Registration: 10th June Last Date of Submission of Video: 18th June. Submit your videos at: mandeep.16853@lpu.co.in Or Send us your video via WhatsApp: 9888121794 Benefits: Winner will get Trophies and Certificate of Merit Top 3 videos will be uploaded on the official Instagram page Of SRPC Certificate of Participation will be provided to all

title: Call for Applications – Hackathon 2021 with the theme She The Force (Ref No. LPU/DII/IC/210604/001) : (6/4/2021)
body: Dear All, Women In Technology Women in Technology (WiT), India Forum focuses on increasing women's participation in STEM. It purports to fulfill a gap in gender diversity in STEM leadership roles by engaging, enabling and employing women across various life stages from a girl child to a seasoned professional. Hackathon "She the Force: Hack for Sustainability with Tech Solutions", and is a way for women to collaborate and create a positive impact, with the power to save our planet, as well as, pave way for a safer future for generations to come. Timeline : Registration Closes - 9th June Mentoring & Technology Enablement session by IBM & WiT ACE – 10th to 15th June Hackathon Event timeline – 16th to 18th June Last date of idea submission - 18th June Hackathon Rules and Guidelines: · Teams can consist of a maximum of five members with not more than 2 male members. Team leader has to be a female candidate. Each team can have one mentor apart from five team members. Mentors can be male or female. You are not allowed to be a part of more than one team at the event. · In the spirit of Hackathon, we recommend participants to not start development before the actual date of event. However, teams can brainstorm ideas and create wireframes before the event. · A team can submit only one entry for the Hackathon. · Post registration on WIT ACE platform, teams are advised to register for the Call for Code (https://developer.ibm.com/callforcode/get-started/) and be a part of the slack channel for discussion on any query resolution. · Your submission must use one or more of IBM Cloud Services or IBM Systems. See the IBM Cloud catalog for a list of services that can be used. Your application can use additional data sets, libraries, and externally hosted services to complement the IBM Cloud Services or IBM Systems. Submission Guidelines: To submit your solution for ‘She the Force: Hack for Sustainability with tech solutions’, your team leader will require to provide following details: · Submission name: The name for your solution in five words or less. · Long description: Describe your solution in more detail. Give us a more-detailed description of what you’re building, what problem you are solving, and why it matters in less than 500 words. · Solution roadmap: How mature is your submission and where do you intend to take it from here? · Link to GitHub code repository. You can provide additional description and diagrams here. · Link to a three-minute demo video. Record a demo of your project, upload it to YouTube or Vimeo, and share the URL. · List of IBM Cloud Services or IBM Systems used in the solution. · Team leaders will need to provide information on up to four additional team members. Interested candidates can register themselves on the below mentioned link: https://wit-ace.com/login For Further details, please contact Ms. Garvita Malhotra, Division of Industry Interface on garvita.22737@lpu.co.in.

title: Regard Before you Discard: Best Out of Waste Challenge : (6/4/2021)
body: Handling and proper disposing household waste without affecting nature these days is becoming a challenge. There is a lot of household waste which can be converted into useful things. With the growing increase in wastes in our society from households to industrial wastes, we now require a very innovative approach to get rid of them. Recycling and reusing the valuable waste material can result in development of fantastic and usable products. Student Research and Project Cell-Division of Student Welfare announces a competition “Regard Before you Discard: Best Out of Waste Challenge” to transform and create best out of household waste or discarded material. Eligibility: Kids from any age Group(Category 1) Undergraduate and Postgraduate Student.(Category 2) Rules: 1. Team shall consist of maximum 2 members. 2. Participants must submit a video starting from selecting the material, processes and then final product in a video of minimum of 2 minutes (time lapse can also be used to show fast processes) and maximum of 3 minutes. 3. Waste material could be anything like tetra packs, bottles, newspapers, old utensils, jute material or any second hand items that otherwise would be thrown away 4. Participants will be judged on the basis of Creativity, Utilization of Resources, Artistic composition & design, Eco-friendly rating, Utility of the Product and Overall presentation. To know more about Rules go through Rule Book as attached Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/makingbestoutofwaste Last Date of Registration: 10th June Last Date of Submission of Video: 18th June. title: Call for Proposal - SUPRA, SERB : (6/2/2021)
body: Scientific and Useful Profound Research Advancement (SUPRA) SERB has developed a newly approved scheme that seeks to explore new scientific breakthroughs, with long-term impact on our fundamental scientific understanding, and offer disruptive technologies at the cutting edge. SERB-SUPRA (Scientific and Useful Profound Research Advancement) is a scheme beyond normal core grants and purposefully designed for high quality proposals consisting of new hypothesis or challenge existing ones, and provide 'out-of-box' solutions. Transformative and disruptive research concepts based on innovative and unproven hypothesis, possessing a high degree of uncertainty, yet having conviction to produce a lasting impact across discipline boundaries qualify for support under SERB-SUPRA. Most important measures of this scheme are: - Quantum of advances (incremental and short terms gains are strongly discouraged). - Extent of disruption in fundamental understanding or impact on outstanding research grand challenges: new areas, new concepts, new products, new disruptive technologies. - Ability of research outcomes in enhancing scientific knowledge of the cutting-edge at the international level and/or emergence of critical technologies. - Global impact, outstanding publications, advancement of science. Link: https://www.serbonline.in/SERB/Supra Last Date: Jun 10 2021

title: Enrollment into Career Services - 2023 graduating batch students - Registration Timeline Extended : (5/31/2021)
body: Kind attention: Students expected to graduate in 2023. This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the students graduating in 2023 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2023. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs Registration Deadline: Career Services Registration with immediate access to applicable campus placement/internship opportunities is open from 14-Apr-2021 till 30-Jun-2021 (extended). Registration Process: * Pathway: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration *Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: * Process Step-I: Initial Consent for enrollment into Career Services * Process Step-II: Profile Update and PEP Fee payment ** Process Step-I: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. Process Step-I will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). ** Process Step-II: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-I. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface. PEP Fee shall be paid online (in full or part) through Placement Registration interface itself. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. Student will not be allowed to avail Career Services/PEP activities without paying the PEP test fees. The registration is considered complete only after Process Step-II is successfully completed with applicable PEP fee payment (in full or part). Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. In case of any queries, students may: 1) Contact their respective school Training and Placement Coordinators (TPCs), or 2) Log an RMS in category "Division of Career Services --- Placement --- Career Services Policy Registration".

title: What Not to say to someone who’s grieving Shared by psychologists from Counseling & Happiness Cell. (LPU/DSR/IC/210531/001) : (5/31/2021)
body: Dear LPU Community, What’s your response to a situation where, say a classmate or a friend expresses loss of a loved one? Do you, at once, go on a search, trying to find the right words, willing to make things better? Well, you may not be alone out there, feeling this pressure to lessen their pain. But truth be told, grieving is something we can’t fix, not even a little bit. Psychologists say that there’s no ‘quick-fix’ when it comes to grieving. So what can we do instead? Psychologists from Counseling & Happiness Cell would like to share the DO’s and DON’T’s of supporting a loved one in grief. We care about your emotional and psychological well being. Please email us – counseling.happiness@lpu.co.in

title: Call for Proposal - SUPRA : (5/29/2021)
body: Scientific and Useful Profound Research Advancement (SUPRA) SERB has developed a newly approved scheme that seeks to explore new scientific breakthroughs, with long-term impact on our fundamental scientific understanding, and offer disruptive technologies at the cutting edge. SERB-SUPRA (Scientific and Useful Profound Research Advancement) is a scheme beyond normal core grants and purposefully designed for high quality proposals consisting of new hypothesis or challenge existing ones, and provide 'out-of-box' solutions. Transformative and disruptive research concepts based on innovative and unproven hypothesis, possessing a high degree of uncertainty, yet having conviction to produce a lasting impact across discipline boundaries qualify for support under SERB-SUPRA. Most important measures of this scheme are: - Quantum of advances (incremental and short terms gains are strongly discouraged). - Extent of disruption in fundamental understanding or impact on outstanding research grand challenges: new areas, new concepts, new products, new disruptive technologies. - Ability of research outcomes in enhancing scientific knowledge of the cutting-edge at the international level and/or emergence of critical technologies. - Global impact, outstanding publications, advancement of science. Link: https://www.serbonline.in/SERB/Supra Last Date: June 10 2021

title: Opportunity for students to complete their Community Development Project (MGN231) through WNS cares foundation (Autumn Term-21221). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210528/001) : (5/28/2021)
body: This is in reference to the UMS announcement dated 21/4/2021 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210421/002) regarding the various options available to the students to complete their community development project (CDP) during June-July 2021 as per their programme scheme by working in collaboration with NGO/ local organization or via MOOCS certification. In order to further facilitate the students, additional option has been provided to complete their CDP via Internship Program with WNS Cares Foundation named as “CyberSmart awareness program”. The details of this internship programs are as follows: Introduction about WNS Cares Foundation WNS was established in 1996 and currently is a global provider of Business Process Management and Outsourcing solutions worldwide across a wide spectrum of 200+ industries. WNS delivers an entire spectrum of BPM solutions including industry-specific offerings, customer interaction services, finance and accounting, human resources, procurement, and research and analytics to re-imagine the digital future of businesses. WNS Cares Foundation has created a holistic Cyber safety learning ecosystem for education & empowerment of students, teachers, volunteers and parents called ‘CyberSmart‘. CyberSmart portal’s objective is to keep children safe on the internet/digital platforms. Introduction about CyberSmart Program Given the prevailing situation, millions of people are exposed to online learning. Spending up more time on Internet-connected devices has exposed many to unfiltered content making them vulnerable in the cyber space. All the students who register for this program shall undergo training provided by WNS on how to further train other students regarding cyber security. This project will involve the students to reach out schools, organizations and train the teachers, students as well as other employees on the CyberSmart portal about cyber security. It is a free online gamified learning platform that uses thematic quiz-based modules. The portal offers age-appropriate learning journeys that are based on curriculum advisories and challenges that people commonly encounter in cyberspace. This platform offers a host of features that makes learning immersive and engaging for children. The portal is currently available in English & 7 other Indian languages. Skill enhancement through CyberSmart Program Essential skills that will be utilized as well as developed in the Students during the project will be: · Presentation Skills · Research · Territory Management · Excellent verbal and written communication · Social service and community outreach · Relationship Management. What is expected from the CyberSmart Program? . All the students who register for this program need to attend one day training session organized by WNS cares foundation via online platform during which they shall be trained on how to keep children safe on the internet/digital platforms. . After completion of their training, each student needs to further train at least 150 persons from the society using online platform which can include students from different schools/ colleges/ organizations which are extensively using internet for their use, teaching/ nonteaching staff members or any other person who is likely to be benefitted from the training. . Each session conducted by the student should not have more than 10 participants i.e. each student after training shall conduct at least 15 sessions of 1 hour duration. . The students who have successfully completed this program shall be awarded internship certificate by WNS. Registration process There is no registration fee to register for this internship program. All the interested students can register for this program by visiting the following link and submitting the required details latest by 7th June 2021. https://forms.gle/ZApToYmt55n6DUDS9 Important points 1. The students need to keep record of their training sessions which they have delivered that can be asked at any point of time by LPU, failing which he/ she will not be eligible to appear in final ETP viva. \ 2. The students also need to submit a report (format attached) wherein all the details of the participants as well as the snapshots of start of session and end of session are required for record maintenance. For detailed information on the programme, the student can refer to the following link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=13SdfE-OVKE&t=51s In case of any issue or query kindly contact Mr. Manu Prakram in 30-302B or email at manu.14704@lpu.co.in.

title: Online mode facilities extended by university Record Cell for students during current pandemic times. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210527/001) : (5/27/2021)
body: The unprecedented disruption has caused us to pivot and rethink almost every aspect of our academic community related to student operations. During this time of the COVID pandemic we have modified the Record cell processes to be fully online in the interest and safety of the students. We have taken initiatives for providing the students with online facilities so that the need of coming to University Campus is eliminated. The following online provisions have been made available to the students who have completed their programme: Online application of certificates: All major certificates required by the students can be applied through the online interfaces integrated in the University Management System (UMS). The UMS links to access these interfaces have been given in the FAQ attached file with this communication. This shall eliminate the need of in person visit by the student in the university for applying certificates. Dispatch of Original Academic Certificates with scanned copy: To ensure that the students do not suffer due to transit delay by post/courier partner, and they receive the copies of their documents online, the University has also started issuing a scanned copy of the applied documents to the students before dispatching the same through post/courier. Education Credential Evaluation & Application for Sealed documents: A dedicated University online portal caters to requests of students for obtaining Education Certificate Evaluation (ECA) or sending a sealed validated copy of the Degree and Academic Transcript to school / college / universities / agencies for different purposes. The request for the same can be submitted by the student at link http://lpu.in/documentverification. Detailed instructions in this regard have been provided in the interface. Correction of student credentials on printed documents: Although students are advised and rather, they should cross-check their credentials which shall be printed on their certificates/documents at the time of application, still in case this step is not performed by the student and the student wishes to correct/update the credentials printed on received documents/certificates, then the students have been given a provision for the same. Refer to the FAQ file attached for more details. Verification or authentication of Degree and Academic Transcript: The student academic transcript or degree can be authenticated online anytime by employers, recruitment/verification agencies etc. by submitting the certificate number to www.lpu.in/authenticate. The request for authentication may also be submitted by writing to Examination Division, Lovely Professional University, Jalandhar-Delhi GT Road, Phagwara 144402, Punjab, India. Letter of Recommendation: The students can also apply for Letter of Recommendation if required, in the online mode. For the same, the student shall have to contact their concerned faculty through whom the Letter of Recommendation will be punched in UMS and forwarded via the approving authority to Record Cell. They can coordinate with the concerned faculty member for the preparation of letter of recommendation. Student may request for the printed document delivery by post/scanned copy of document by submitting request at ao.records@lpu.co.in or it can be collected from Block-32, Room No. 101. In addition to this, the online facilities extended to the continuing students are detailed below: Provision of applying for scanned copy of certificates: Continuing or active students can get the following certificates (hard copy or scanned copy) by applying through UMS interface (wherever applicable) or by requesting the same at ao.records@lpu.co.in: 1. Bonafide Certificate 2. Fee Structure or Loan Letter 3. Admission Basis 4. English Medium Certificate (Refer to the FAQ file attached for application process and more details.) Correction of student credentials: Students can check their profile credentials in UMS such as name, father’s name, mother’s name, (as per 10th class certificate) and gender. The academic certificates will be printed as per the UMS record. In case need for correction is identified in profile details, request for correction can be submitted at respective UMS interface. (Refer to the FAQ file attached for UMS link and more details.) Note: In case of any other query or information kindly write us at ao.records@lpu.co.in along with your Registration Number, Mobile Number and address, our dedicated staff shall help you. You can also call us at 01824-444548. (9:00am to 5:00pm, Monday to Saturday)

title: Registration for End Term Report Evaluation of Ph.D. Scholars. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210524/001) : (5/24/2021)
body: This is in reference to Ph.D. End Term Report (ETR) evaluation tentatively scheduled from June, 2021 onwards. All the Ph.D. Scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs before July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to register for End Term Report (ETR). The main aim of the End Term Report (ETR) is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the suggestions given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation The scholars are required to follow the following 2 steps for appearing in ETR: 1. Registration and uploading of ETR All eligible scholars as per the attached list (List of scholar’s eligible for ETR) are required to register for ETR evaluation and upload their files through following UMS link: UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Scholar Activity Details --> Upcoming Activity The last date for registration and uploading of ETR report is 15th June, 2021. 2. Recommendation of End Term Report by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor Once the Scholars have registered and uploaded their End Term Reports for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> PhD Seminar File Verification --> ETR The last date for verification of the ETR report is 18th June, 2021. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of End Term Report: 1. As per current guidelines, the scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such scholars who have either missed or are Not Recommended in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the ETR evaluation. 2. The scholars must upload single PDF file for End Term Report duly verified and signed by respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETR ) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 3. In case the scholars are unable to get a signed copy of the synopsis from their respective supervisor due to prevailing situation, they can upload the soft copy of the synopsis without supervisor signature. But it is required that the synopsis uploaded by them must be strictly as per the guidelines and it must be verified by their supervisor through UMS interface on or before 18th June, 2021. 4. Scholars are required to submit one hard copy of the report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) in Block -30, Room Number- 302B till the date which shall be communicated separately in due course of time 5. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 6. No extension shall be given for uploading report beyond the last date. 7. Students should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using ETR registration interface) before registering and uploading the End Term Reports at the interface For Recommendation of the End Term Report: The scholar must upload the End Term Report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues: 1. Registration/Uploading of synopsis write at rdc.etrs@lpu.co.in 2. Supervisor / Co-supervisor /fee related query write at drp@lpu.co.in.

Timelines for change of Program:- Phase From To Declaration of decisions on UMS for approved cases Last date for submitting the Change of Program Fee (For approved cases) I 22th May, 2021 18th June, 2021 28th June, 2021 5th July, 2021 II 19th June, 2021 5th August, 2021 12th August, 2021 16th August, 2021 No program change option will be allowed after 5th August, 2021 under any circumstances. All students who apply for change of program shall be required to pay the “processing fee” of Rs. 1000/- online after submitting their request (Screenshot attached) along with the parent’s consent letter which shall be duly signed by them. (Note: - The processing fee is non-refundable even if the change of program request of student is not approved by competent authorities) 2. The program of the student shall be changed for the notified students (approved cases) after the payment of change of program fee (Rs 4000/-) within the given timelines and the final approval of the competent authorities. 3. In case student fails to pay the fee as per timelines, the approval for the Change of Program shall stand cancelled and he/she would be required continue in the ongoing program only. 4. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old program after approval of Change of Program. Also fee paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances. 5. Due to course mapping if student is allocated additional courses to study to complete the requirements of the new program he/she will have to register the courses as backlog by paying the 1/10th of the tuition fee (per course) without any scholarship. 6. Only one chance is given to the students for change of program during the entire program duration, hence the students are advised to be very careful while availing this chance. 7. No benefit of missed CA or Attendance will be given to the student applying for change of program after start of classes. To avoid this, students are strongly advised to apply for the change of program before the start of the term. 8. The attendance will be calculated from the date of start of classes of the new program in which the student has sought change and not from the date the student gets registered in the course of the new program. title: Pathway Elective Courses Polling for Autumn Term of Session 2021-22. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210520/001) : (5/20/2021)
body: All the students as per the attached list of programs, are informed that the polling of Pathway Elective Courses (as applicable according to their Program Scheme) has been opened. For the reference of students, the details of Pathway Elective courses being offered to them, is available at link: UMS Dashboard -> Important Links -> Examination Instructions and Guidelines -> Pathway Elective Students must note that the start date for polling of Electives is May 21, 2021 10:00 AM and last date for polling is May 26, 2021 4:00 PM. UMS link for participating in the polling: - UMS Dashboard -> UMS Home -> UMS Navigation -> Learning Management System (LMS) -> Electives Polling LPU TOUCH app link: “Electives Polling” (Go through the help files attached for more details about usage of the interface for the Polling of Electives Or Refer to the video link: https://youtu.be/LruF9pM8JHg for the details about How to use Electives Polling interface) It is reiterated that this polling is only applicable to the students for the Program and Batch details as per the attached file. All the students are required to poll for their Pathway Elective courses within the given timelines. If any student does not poll for the elective courses, then, courses would be assigned to the student by default from backend and student will be required to study the courses assigned to him/her and the Course assigned by default shall not be changed later on. Note: Polling for the Pathway Elective types shall not be on First Come First Serve basis. Polled courses will be offered subject to minimum number of students in the course. For any queries, contact Academic Operations Coordinator (AOC) of your respective School.

title: Waiting is Over Now Admission Open for Foreign Languages Certification Courses Fresh Batch FRENCH,GERMAN & JAPANESE : (5/19/2021)
body: Dear Students, “Turn your obstacles into opportunities and your problems into possibilities.” The Department of Foreign Languages is pleased to announce the launch of Certification Course in Foreign Languages (French,German & Japanese). Objective: In the age of globalization, knowledge of a foreign language will help in opening many professional avenues for the students. Courses Offered: Intensive Courses Programme (Duration: 4 Months) Programme Name Duration Course Code Intensive Course in French Language A1 120 hours FRNS103 Intensive Course in German Language A1 120 hours GERS103 Intensive Course in Japanese Language N5 120 hours JAPS103 Fundamental A2 Level in French Language 120 hours FRNS203 Fundamental A2 Level in German Language 120 hours GERS203 Tentative batch timings are as follows: Weekdays: 05:00 PM – 07:00 PM (Mon to Fri) Course Fee: For LPU students and Staff : Rs 7000/- For students other than of LPU : Rs. 8000/- Non-Intensive Courses (Duration: 1yr : 2 Semesters) Programme Name Semester-1 Duration Course Code Certificate in French Language A1 60 hours FRNS101 Certificate in German Language A1 60 hours GERS101 Certificate in Japanese Language N5 60 hours JAPS101 Tentative batch timings are as follows: Weekend : 10:00 AM – 01:00 PM (Sat & Sun) Course Fee: -For LPU students and Staff : Rs 3500/Semester -For students other than of LPU : Rs. 4000/Semester Career Options: 1. Translation: Medical/Literature texts, websites, official documents etc. 2. Interpretation: At seminars & conferences. 3. Teaching : At Schools, Universities, Institutes, Language academies and Companies. 4. Jobs in embassies: Foreign Embassies in India and Indian embassies abroad 5. India’s foreign services: Jobs at Ministry of External Affairs 6. Publishing: News, Periodicals, Books, directories etc. 7. Tourism: As a tour guide/operator in India or abroad, Travel agent etc. 8. Entertainment: Dubbing/Subtitles, works related to cinema, theatre, advertising etc. 9. Business and marketing: international business/trade, Import/Export etc. 10. Public relations and media: Jobs with TV channels, newspapers, journals etc. Admission Details: Last date of Admission for Fresh Courses is 30th July 2021 (Admission is based on first come first serve basis) Session Details: The batches will commence tentatively as per the schedule below: - Weekend batches: 2nd Week of August2021 - Weekday batches: 2nd Week of August2021 For Admission kindly click on Below Link: u.lpu.in/shortterm Note: 1) The cost of the books (approx. Rs. 1,000/-) to be purchased separately. 2) Fee is not refundable, hence choose the Language wisely For more information contact: Mr. Saurav Sharma COD - Department of Foreign Languages +91 (0)7009106440 (WhatsApp Only)

body: In view of the multiple student requests received, the students who wish to register for Re-appear / Improvement examination to be conducted in the months of May-July, 2021, but have not registered till date due to any reason are now given an opportunity to register for re-appear/improvement examination 3 days prior to the date of examination for the concerned course code. Link for registration: UMS Navigation -> Examination System->Exam Registration-> ReAppear Registration The date sheet for the E grade/improvement courses available for registration shall be visible in the student's UMS account in the above mentioned registration interface. On exceeding the stipulated timeline, the student shall not be able to register for the course. The Re-appear / Improvement examination shall be conducted in the online mode. The fee for Re-appear / Improvement registration is Rs. 350/- per course code. In case there is any scheduled lecture having a clash with the examination slot, duty leave shall be given to the student for those lectures only (particularly in the time slot of exam time). In addition, duty leave shall also be given to the student for classes scheduled one hour prior and one hour after the time of examination.

title: Call for Applications K-Startup Grand Challenge 2021 (Ref. No. LPU/DII/IC/210513/001) : (5/13/2021)
body: Dear All, The Korean government is working to transform the country's economy for another century of success, ultimately raising employment, the GDP and Korea's place in the world. In order to do this, the government is supporting talented entrepreneurs and promising startups, to turn Korea and Pangyo Creative Economy Valley into a global startup hub in Asia. The top ranked 60 teams selected by the accelerators will be invited to stay in Korea to participate a 3.5 month accelerating program in Pangyo, located in the south of Seoul. At the end of the acceleration program, the government will host a demo day to select top 30 startups. These startups will get additional financial incentives, and if they choose to establish their businesses in Korea, they will get additional support from the government. Qualification to apply KSGC program · A startup or a pre-startup team of not more than 7 years, whose representative has foreign nationality · The team must have a clear growth objective for entering the overseas market, with their base in the Korean market, with the goal of settling down in Korea. · The team leader and members must not be disqualified from staying in Korea or acquiring a related visa in Korea, and the team must have one or more member with a bachelor’s degree or higher. · The team must have people who can communicate in English(required) and Korean(optional) to establish a business in Korea. There is no other limitation such as investment or revenue status, etc. Process · APPLICATION PERIOD: April 15th – June 15th · APPLICATION REVIEW: June 21st – June 25th · GLOBAL AUDITIONS (On-line) : July 5th – 9th · DEMO DAY: Late November · ACCELERATING PROGRAM: August 16th – November 30th Benefits 1. Accelerating Program 2. Free Office and Project Space (Startup Campus) 3. Living Expenses 4. Korean Interns Support 5. Help Desk & Visas 6. Final Package : Each of the selected top 30 startups will be eligible to receive funding for 3.5 months. · $10,840 per team of 1 person Grant for Top 10 Startups 1st Prize : $120,000 2nd Prize : $70,000 3rd Prize : $40,000 4th Prize : $25,000 5th Prize : $15,000 6-10th Prize : $10,000 each 7. Corporate Sponsorship and Support STARTUP SELECTION CRITERIA 1. Technology-based startups that have prototype or product/service and at initial investment stage. 2. Global startups. 3. Startups that have been established within that past 7 years are eligible to apply. When KSGC Program Period: August 16 – November 30. 2021 Deadline to Apply: June 15. 2021 Interested candidates can register themselves on the below mentioned link: https://www.k-startupgc.org/login/login.do For more details, please login to https://www.k-startupgc.org/ For any further queries, contact Ms. Garvita Malhotra, Division of Industry Interface on garvita.22737@lpu.co.in.

body: Dear Students If You’ve got Problems, We’ve got Ears. During this Pandemic some of you may be overthinking, feeling lonely and going through emotions of frustration, anger, stress, sadness and relationship issues. Avoiding emotions affect your body and mind. It can lead to problems with memory and concentration due to stress and anxiety In LPU we endeavour to strive towards better student mental health and psychological well-being which are important to a student’s success and confidence. Talking about your problems can release pent-up feelings Don't suffer alone, come and talk to trained professionals about your concerns. We can help you find new ideas in order to move forward. title: Registration for Re-appear / Improvement examination to be conducted in the months of May-July, 2021. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210508/001) : (5/8/2021)
body: The interface for registration of Re-appear / Improvement examination to be conducted in the months of May-July, 2021 has been opened for all students. Student having ‘E’ grade(s) in any course code(s) can register for re-appear through the provided interface. Link for registration: UMS Navigation -> Examination System->Exam Registration-> Registration Form The detailed procedure is attached for reference. The Re-appear / Improvement examination shall be conducted in the online mode. The date sheet and details of examination shall be displayed in the UMS login of the student as per dates mentioned below. The fee for Re-appear / Improvement registration is Rs. 350/- per course code and the last date with this fee is 10th May ,2021. Note that after 10th May,2021, no Re-appear / Improvement registration shall be allowed. However, if the result is still pending, then the student should register the Re-appear / Improvement course only after declaration of the result. In case, the result is declared after the close of Re-appear / Improvement registration interface, then due consideration shall be given to the student for registering the Re-appear / Improvement. For any lecture falling in the same time slot of the examination, duty leave shall be given to the student for those lectures only (particularly in the time slot of exam time). In addition, duty leave shall also be given to the student for classes scheduled one hour prior and one hour after the time of examination. Important dates: - Registration start date 23rd April,2021 Last date of registration 10th May,2021 Display of date sheet in UMS login 15th May,2021 Schedule of Re-appear / Improvement examination Examination will be equitably spanned within May,2021 to July,2021

A Personal Computer / Laptop / Tablet. 2. A Webcam. 3. Smooth and uninterrupted Internet connectivity (throughout the testing session, which will last for approximately 130 minutes) Browser Requirements: This Assessment is supported by the below listed Browsers/Versions only. Mozilla Firefox (version 50 and above) Google Chrome (version 50 and above) In case you're taking the test on Windows 8, make sure you disable all the popups/ notifications. IMPORTANT NOTE: You are NOT allowed to open any other Browser/Switch between the Test Screen and other windows/ Minimize the Test Window. The Test will automatically log out if a candidate is found switching through windows while taking the Test. General Instructions: 1. There is no negative marking. 2. You have to answer all the questions mandatorily i.e. you cannot skip any question. 3. You cannot change your answer of any previous question. 4.Please block Pop up before starting test. 5. If somehow your test is stopped in between, (due to power failure/internet disconnection) wait for five minutes. Now, you may login again using the same details. After entering the username and password click on Resume Test. Select your AMCAT Id and then re enter Username and Password to ‘Re-Confirm Your Credentials’. 6. Please ensure that you Resume Test within 2 hours of your test being stopped. (Please Resume the Test only after 5 minutes of halting the Test). NOTE for Attendance: 1. It is Mandatory to mark drive attendance as duty leaves will be given based on the attendance marked by the students. 2. Link to mark drive attendance will be open from 9:00 AM to 09:30 AM 3. Scan the QR code using the Barcode scanner Menu from the LPU Touch App menu. 6. In case the student is not able to mark the attendance due to the mobile camera not working, Mobile software not supporting, Internet issue then the candidate can select not able to mark the attendance and save the attendance by selecting a specific reason using the interface. 7. title: LPU Global: Credit Transfer option for the LPU students : (5/4/2021)
body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for the LPU students who want to get their credits transferred to partner foreign Universities in Canada, USA, UK, Australia &Dubai etc. Under credit transfer the students will be doing the following programs: · 2 years at LPU and rest 2/2.5 years at partner foreign university in case of Bachelor’s degree · 1 year at LPU and rest 1/1.5 year at partner Foreign university in case of Master’s degree and eventually get degree from partner foreign university after successful completion of the program in the foreign University. Benefits: · Students are allowed to work 20 hours per week while studying. · Students can easily cover their living expenses with earnings from part time job · Students get PSWR (Post Study Work Rights) after successful completion of the program at foreign University · Cost Effective- Students can save their 50% of money as they would be paying 2 years fees only rather than 4 years fees · Opportunity to be global citizen · Option of PAID industrial training at United Kingdom Eligibility: · 7 CGPA and above with no backlogs and reappearances at the time of application · IELTS score of 6.5 band overall not less than 6 in each module (Possibility of Waiver in UK Universities) · Enough funds to sustain yourself at the foreign University. · 2nd year students (2019 Batch) Interested students must fill the form: https://forms.gle/6WxrRhvCLhWYh3Sf8 For further information please contact division of International Affairs at 9780036427. title: Want to talk about your problems and learn to deal with issues of stress, anxiety, anger, relationships and overthinking ? Join an interactive session with Counseling Psychologists on Wednesday 5th May 2021. (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/210503/001) : (5/3/2021)
body: Dear Students If You’ve got Problems, We’ve got Ears. During this Pandemic some of you may be overthinking, feeling lonely and going through emotions of frustration, anger, stress, sadness and relationship issues. Avoiding emotions affect your body and mind. It can lead to problems with memory and concentration due to stress and anxiety In LPU we endeavour to strive towards better student mental health and psychological well-being which are important to a student’s success and confidence. Talking about your problems can release pent-up feelings Don't suffer alone, come and talk to trained professionals about your concerns. We can help you find new ideas in order to move forward.
