title: Call for Applications – Comviva InnoNXT Tech Challenge (Ref No. LPU/DII/IC/210430/001) : (4/30/2021)
body: Dear All, Comviva is the global leader of mobility solutions catering to The Business of Tomorrows. The company is a subsidiary of Tech Mahindra and a part of the $21 billion Mahindra Group. The Comviva InnoNXT Tech Challenge in partnership with Startup India, invites Startups from across India to participate and take on the challenges in the highly emerging areas of Digital, AI/ML, 5G, and Fintech. All these sectors have seen immense interest, demand, and growth in the last few years. And Comviva, being at the forefront of the emerging technologies, invites new-gen Startups to come along and shape the future with us. Detailed Eligibility Criteria: Startups who meet either of these 2 criteria are eligible to apply. 1. Startups, as defined and recognized by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT). 2. Startups who have valid MVP/POC, possibly with pilot customers. Note: It is mandatory that this challenge is taken up in line with the problem statements mentioned in the program. Themes for Challenges: · Gamification · Media and Entertainment · AI/ML · 5G · Fintech · Telecom · ChatBot · Digital/Social Problem Statement: Details are in the attachment. Kindly refer the same. Incentives: Winner - INR 7,25,000 cash grant 1st Runner up ~ INR 3,60,000 cash grant 2nd Runner up- INR 1,80,000 cash grant Selection Process: Startups apply online. The applications are evaluated and the top 10 shortlisted applicants will be asked to present a detailed demo, which will be evaluated by a panel of experts and winners will be announced. body: Dear Students , ASK YOURSELF Do you fume and fret , feel frustrated, irritable, testy , touchy, offended, easily upset and easily angered ? Do you show aggressive behavior , get violent and angry often ? Do you get easily annoyed or bothered, and show snappish behavior? Do you start shouting, throwing things around , get angry on small things ? Anger is a known symptom of several mental health conditions. title: Backlog course preferences for Summer Term (May-July) 2021 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210428/001) : (4/28/2021)
body: The University shall be conducting the summer term classes for all students (except Part-time) in the period from May-July 2021. In view of the prevailing critical times due to COVID-19, the summer term shall be conducted in online mode for students via online academic connect with the faculty through the LPU MyClass platform. Only the courses in which online teaching is feasible shall be offered to students in this summer term. The detail of courses shall be visible to the students in the concerned UMS interface itself. The summer term registration shall be carried out in following two phases: Phase I: Preference polling of courses: 1. The list of courses in which a student is eligible to register summer term shall be displayed to him/her in the polling interface. 2. The student shall give the preference for the course(s) which he/she wishes to register in this summer term. 3. The preference polling interface for all students shall remain active from 29th April, 2021 till 12th May, 2021. 4. The link to submit the preferences for course codes for summer term registration is given below: UMS Navigation→ Examination System → Backlog/Summer Term → Summer Term Backlog Course Preference 6. A student while submitting preferences should keep in mind that he/she will be allocated a maximum of total 9 F grade and G grade courses (taken together), out of which he/she can select only upto 4 F grade courses in this summer term. 7. Step-by-step guidelines to use the above-mentioned interface are attached with this communication or watch a video using the link https://youtu.be/9qAXDN1EgDA Important: Submission of course preferences, does not guarantee the availability of those course codes for summer term registration process. Phase II: Registration of courses 1. On the basis of preferences received from students, a tentative course wise time-table shall be generated and displayed in the student UMS login. If preferences received for any course code are very less in number, then time-table for those courses shall not be generated and they shall not be available for registration in the upcoming summer term. 2. Based on the displayed timetable, the student can select the finalized course codes and register for those courses in this summer term. 3. The detailed timelines and process for registration shall be informed via a separate UMS announcement. 4. The student shall be required to pay the summer term fee, in online mode, at the time of registering the backlog courses. Confirmation of registration shall be done only after the payment of summer term fee. Note: Before registering for summer term, the students should judiciously and carefully go through the below mentioned important points for strict compliance. Important Points: i. The classes for summer term shall be held tentatively from last week of May 2021 to July 2021 for all courses except 1st year and from 2nd week of June 2021 to July 2021 for 1st year courses. ii. Attendance of students shall be mandatory as per the university guidelines for regular terms. iii. As the faculty-student interaction as well as the student attendance marking shall be carried out via online sessions, thus, having a laptop and good internet connectivity are pre-requisites for students for attending the upcoming summer term classes. iv. The final attendance and detention calculation for summer term shall be done in accordance to University rules and regulations. In case of any clarification, the students can mail their query at academic.operations4@lpu.co.in

title: Online Summer Training Course on Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) : (4/22/2021)
body: Linux has much favourable position over a portion of the other driving working systems with regards to IT security circle. Because of its sharp and all around tuned security highlights, numerous government and private companies have switched on to Linux. RHCSA: This certification is provided by Red Hat, Inc. and furnishes IT professionals with best training and performance-based evaluations in the business. An IT professional who has earned the Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) certificate is able to perform the core system administration skills required in Red Hat Enterprise Linux environments. It helps the students and IT professional to excel in the field of information security, management of servers and other devices running on Linux operating system. Addressing the importance of the certification HRDC in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is conducting ‘Online Summer Training Course on Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)’ as an Outreach Training Program as per the details appended below: Title Online Summer Training Course on Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) Resource Persons Mr. Gaurav Kwatra , Corporate Trainer, Senior Devops Engineer, RHCI, Sysinfocom Pvt. body: Dear Students, ASK YOURSELF Are you worrying about exams? Are you feeling stressed and under pressure? Does your memory blank out when you see the Question paper? Do you forget what you studied? Does thinking of exams scare you? Do you suffer from insomnia before the exams? body: Student Organization AIESEC under the aegis of Division of Student Welfare is organizing The Changemakers Day: E-Green (E-Cleanup Drive) another tremendously absolute impact-making event, “ E-CLEAN UP” on 25th April, 2021. In the digital world, similar to the environment, there is a huge amount of trash. Unnecessary emails, files, apps, duplicates of photos and videos are all digital waste. This digital trash creates digital pollution that continues to consume energy even when we have forgotten it. Digital trash sits in the backups on servers that provide us with cloud service and continue consuming electricity. Each year the internet and its supporting systems produce 900 million tons of CO2, which is more than the annual output of the whole Germany. Some studies estimate that in a decade the internet network will consume20 percent of the world’s total energy*. "Be a part of the solution, not part of the pollution." The Changemakers' Day brings you a chance to be a part of the solution with E-Clean - Aninitiative aimed at cleaning your electronic waste and lowering your carbon emissions. Join hands and let’s bring in tonnes together of satisfaction of saving our environment and stopping right by sitting at our homes. Volunteering Key Points: 1. Deleting old apps from your phone which costs you a lot of energy. 2. Delete all the junk mails which indirectly cuts off the CO2 emission. 3. Keep your PC or laptop organized, removing all the duplicate files and photos on the drives also resulting is low loads on the servers indirectly saving huge electricity and coal consumption. title: Important information related to Community Development Project/CDP (MGN231) (Autumn Term-21221). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210421/001) : (4/21/2021)
body: It is for the information of all the students who are required to undergo a community development project/CDP during June-July 2021 as per their program scheme that the students can complete their CDP by choosing any one of the 3 options given below. These options have been designed so that all students can feasibly complete their CDP even in the prevailing times of COVID-19. Option-1: Projects which can be completed in collaboration with NGO/local organizations involved in community development areas allowing physical reporting so as student can gain real time knowledge and experience. Important points: 1. The students are required to produce the certificate from the NGO/ local organizations involved in community development areas describing the topic and number of hours the student has worked with the NGO/local organization to complete the project. The certificate should be included in the final report to be submitted by the student, to be eligible for appearing in the ETP. 2. Minimum number of hours required to complete the community development project should be at least 30 hours or it should be for at least 4 weeks. Option-2: Projects which can be completed in collaboration with NGO/local organizations involved in community development areas offering work from home and do not require to work in field or be in contact with any person. Important points: 1. The students are required to produce the certificate from the NGO/ local organizations involved in community development areas offering work from home option describing the topic and number of hours the student has worked from home to complete the project. The certificate should be included in the final report to be submitted by the student, to be eligible for appearing in the ETP. 2. Minimum number of hours required to complete the community development project should be at least 30 hours or it should be for at least 4 weeks. Option-3: The students can register and obtain a MOOCs certification in relevant areas/topics which are available online (listed below), which shall then be equated to the community development project. Important points: 1. The students are required to produce the MOOC completion certificate to be eligible for appearing in the final ETP viva. 2. The student must complete at least 30 hours or 4 weeks of MOOC certification to be eligible for appearing in ETP. Probable list of topics While opting for any MOOC certification, the student must ensure that the broader area of his/her MOOC topic falls under either of the following category: 1. Environmental studies 2. Yoga 3. Renewable sources of energy 4. Sustainable agriculture practices 5. Pollution management 6. Re-cycling/ reuse of waste 7. Social awareness 8. Management of diseases 9. Innovative practices in teaching 10. e-resources development The students can approach their respective heads for more information on the topics for community development project or the portals where such MOOCs are available. Option-4: In case a student is unable to find any of the above mentioned three options then a student can also request for completing the CDP in successive year i.e. in June-July 2022 by forwarding his/her opting out request to respective School AOC. All such students will be allowed to complete their CDP work in June-July 2022 without any late fee. The final ETP viva for Community Development Project shall be tentatively scheduled after commencement of classes of Upcoming Autumn Term 21221. The final schedule shall be communicated to students at least 7-10 days in advance in due course of time. Any queries can be directed to Mr. Mohit Prakram, (COC), Projects and Internships Cell on academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in or in Block-Room: 30-302B.

title: Important information related to upcoming Summer Internship/ Industrial training (Autumn Term-21221). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210420/001) : (4/20/2021)
body: It is for the information of all the students who are required to undergo compulsory Summer Internship/ Industrial training during June-July 2021 as per their program scheme that the students can complete their summer internship/ industrial training by choosing any one of the 4 options given below. These options have been designed so that all students can feasibly complete their summer internship/ industrial training even in the prevailing times of COVID-19. Option-I: Summer internship/Industrial training/ with Industry/Other relevant organization (Where Physical Presence in the concerned industry or organization is required). Option-2: Summer internship/Industrial training/ with Industry/Other relevant organization (where concerned industry or organization allows Work from Home option). Option-3: Through Online MOOC Certification. Option-4: In case a student is unable to find any of the above mentioned three options then a student can also request for completing the summer Internship in successive year i.e. during June-July 2022 by forwarding his/her opting out request to respective School TPC. The table below provides detailed information about all the above listed 4 options. Available Options for Summer Internship/ Industrial training Important points Option-1: Summer internship/Industrial training/ with Industry/Other relevant organization (Where Physical Presence in the concerned industry or organization is required). The student can opt for summer internship/Industrial training with Industry/organization, that allows in person visit so that student can gain the real time knowledge and experience during the summer Internship/ industrial training. The approval of the company for summer internship/ industrial training shall be done through School TPC as per the existing guidelines (Annexure-I). Option-2: Summer internship/Industrial training/ with Industry/Other relevant organization (where concerned industry or organization allows Work from Home option). The student can opt for summer internship/Industrial training with organization that offer them work from home, that can be undertaken in collaboration with Industry/Organization/Company at their hometown which does not involve travel, contact with outsiders etc. The approval of the company for summer internship/ industrial training shall be done through School TPC as per the existing guidelines (Annexure-I). Option-3: Through MOOCs Student can also opt for MOOCs certification from the list of relevant areas/ specializations offered by respective School-TPC which shall be treated equivalent to summer internship/ industrial training. 1) The students must ensure that the MOOCs are approved from their respective TPC otherwise they shall not be considered for final evaluation. 2) The minimum duration of MOOCs which shall be considered equivalent to summer internship/ industrial training should be minimum of 50 hours or 4 weeks. Option-4: Opt out from current year and carry forward the summer internship in successive year i.e. during June-July 2022. In case a student is unable to find any of the above mentioned three options then a student can also request for completing the summer Internship in successive year i.e. during June-July 2022 by forwarding his/her opting out request to respective School TPC. All such students will be allowed to complete their summer training in June-July 2022 without any late fee. Important points: 1.School TPC’s are requested to get the list of Company/MOOC courses for Summer Internship approved by respective School HOS/HOF and share the same with respective students on UMS latest till 26th April 2021. 2. The students shall choose any one of the options listed above and should confirm same to School-TPC latest till 5th May 2021 for final approval. 3. Respective School TPC shall then intimate the final approved course to the students latest till 10th May 2021. 4. The final evaluation of all the option shall be conducted through End Term Evaluation. The final ETP viva for Summer Internship courses shall be tentatively scheduled after commencement of classes of Upcoming Autumn Term 21221. The final schedule shall be communicated to students at least 7-10 days in advance in due course of time. In case of any queries or concerns, kindly email at academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in

body: Dear All, Comviva is the global leader of mobility solutions catering to The Business of Tomorrows. The company is a subsidiary of Tech Mahindra and a part of the $21 billion Mahindra Group. The Comviva InnoNXT Tech Challenge in partnership with Startup India, invites Startups from across India to participate and take on the challenges in the highly emerging areas of Digital, AI/ML, 5G, and Fintech. All these sectors have seen immense interest, demand, and growth in the last few years. And Comviva, being at the forefront of the emerging technologies, invites new-gen Startups to come along and shape the future with us. Detailed Eligibility Criteria: Startups who meet either of these 2 criteria are eligible to apply. 1. Startups, as defined and recognized by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT). 2. Startups who have valid MVP/POC, possibly with pilot customers. Note: It is mandatory that this challenge is taken up in line with the problem statements mentioned in the program. Themes for Challenges: · Gamification · Media and Entertainment · AI/ML · 5G · Fintech · Telecom · ChatBot · Digital/Social Problem Statement: Details are in the attachment. Kindly refer the same. Incentives: Winner - INR 7,25,000 cash grant 1st Runner up ~ INR 3,60,000 cash grant 2nd Runner up- INR 1,80,000 cash grant Selection Process: Startups apply online. The applications are evaluated and the top 10 shortlisted applicants will be asked to present a detailed demo, which will be evaluated by a panel of experts and winners will be announced. The top 3 Startups get a chance to work with Comviva team for the complete cohort - 6 Months, along with receiving the Fiscal and non-fiscal benefits. Timelines: Last Day of Submitting Applications: 26th Apr, 2021 Announcement of Top 10 Shortlisted Startups: 3rd May, 2021 Demo of the 10 shortlisted Startups – 12th, 13th & 14th May Winner declaration and starting with the cohort – 25th May Interested candidates can register themselves on the below mentioned link: https://tinyurl.com/358986k3 For Further details, please contact Ms. Garvita Malhotra, Division of Industry Interface on garvita.22737@lpu.co.in.

Theme of Idea Competition: Students need to submit ideas on Food-Water-Energy Nexus. The idea should essentially cover two of the three elements of Food-Water-Energy Nexus. Incentives: The best ideas will be considered for funding upto 1 Lakh INR (individual entry) & 3 Lakh INR (group entry). Top -3 Individual entries and Top-3 Group entries will be awarded with seed funding. Mentoring & learning from Shell Mentors and Experts from the industry. title: Call for Applications – Hindustan Unilever Ltd. (HUL) Grand Water Saving Challenge (Ref. No. LPU/DII/IC/210419/005) : (4/19/2021)
body: Dear All, In support of the Prime Minister’s Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) and the UN SDGs, Hindustan Unilever Ltd. (HUL) in association with Invest India, Startup India, and AGNIi are launching the Grand Water Saving Challenge. Run by Toilet Board Coalition (TBC), the Challenge aims to address the need for an efficient flush system in public toilets to ensure optimum usage of water while ensuring a clean and hygienic toilet. The World Economic Forum’s Healthy Cities and Communities initiative which catalyzed this Innovation Challenge aims to improve people’s well-being holistically by enabling them to live longer and fuller lives in their local environments. The Grand Water Saving Challenge is a national hackathon inviting Technologists, Inventors, and start-ups from the field of Water and Sanitation to participate. Winners of the challenge will receive a cash prize of Rs. 5 Lakh in addition to an opportunity to install and pilot the invention at a Suvidha centre, developed by HUL. THEMES FOR CHALLENGES · Water · Sanitation · Social Impact PROBLEM STATEMENT An innovative water saving flush system designed for squat latrines to ensure clean and hygienic toilets for all Community and public toilets remain one of the most challenging shared spaces in terms of cleanliness, hygiene, and operations and maintenance. Water supply to these is often limited and the burden of wastewater and fecal sludge management & treatment is high as well. There is a need for a better flush system that uses less water while ensuring a clean and hygienic toilet. The participants of this challenge need to design (stage 1) and prototype (stage2) a flush system on a squat toilet pan (can be made from ceramic or recycled plastic) that uses no more than 2.5 liters of water to clean the pan surface of any visible fecal residues evaluated using actual or simulated human feces. Incentives 1st Prize – Rs. 5,00,000; 2nd Prize – Rs. 2,50,000 And Opportunity to install and pilot the invention at one of the upcoming Suvidha centres or alternate testing and evaluation site How to Submit the Entry · Entry for the first round is by virtue of an engineering drawing and/ or a computer animation or simulation · The entry must also be accompanied by a technical write-up explaining the scientific rationale of the inventive steps. The write-up shall not exceed 1000 words · Top teams to receive mentoring from experts on their submissions. Timelines: Application end Date: 25th May, 2021 Application Result Date: 15th July, 2021 Interested candidates can register themselves on the below mentioned link: https://tinyurl.com/4bkrjfvw For Further details, please contact Ms. Garvita Malhotra, Division of Industry Interface on garvita.22737@lpu.co.in.

title: Registration for Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210416/003) : (4/16/2021)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from May 2021 (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs after July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after each 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. The main aim of the End Term Presentation is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation The research scholars are required to follow the following two steps for appearing in ETP: Step-1. Registration and uploading of ETP reports All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation and upload their files through following UMS link: UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Scholar Activity Details --> Upcoming Activity The last date for registration and uploading of report is 12th May 2021. Step-2. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar have registered for the ETP and uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. Evaluation Cell --> PhD Seminar File Verification --> ETP The last date for verification of the report is 15th May 2021. Evaluation of the End Term Presentation (ETP) via online platform It is for the information of the all concerned that due to the prevailing situation, the End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation shall be planned via online platform google meet. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of ETP report: 1. As per current guidelines, the research scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such research scholars who have either missed or have been awarded “Not Recommended” in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the ETP evaluation. 2. The research scholars must upload single PDF file for end term report strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 3. In case the research scholars are unable to get a signed copy of the synopsis from their respective supervisor due to prevailing situation, they can upload the soft copy of the synopsis without supervisor signature. But it is required that the synopsis uploaded by them must be strictly as per the guidelines and it must be verified by their supervisor through UMS interface as per prescribed timelines. 4. Research scholars are also required to submit 2 hard copies of the reports duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) in Research Degree and Evaluation Cell (RDEC) (Block-30; Room Number- 302B) for which the separate communication shall be made in due course of time. 5. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 6. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. 7. Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using ETP registration interface) before registering and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. For Recommendation of the ETP Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. For online evaluation of the End Term Presentation (ETP) a) The research scholar must have laptop/ desktop or any other suitable mean with proper audio/ video facility. b) The research scholar must have high speed internet facility to appear for the online ETP evaluation. In case, the research scholar has registered for the ETP evaluation but could not appear for the same due to any issue, he/she shall be marked absent for the evaluation. Result of all such research scholars for ETP evaluation shall stand as “Not Recommended” and the will be required to re-register for the next scheduled ETP evaluation with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. c) The research scholar must be well versed with the online google meet platform. It is strongly advised that the research scholar must present his/ her presentation to the respective supervisor prior to appearing in actual ETP evaluation so that there is no confusion on the day of evaluation. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query, write us at rdc.etrs@lpu.co.in

title: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210416/002) : (4/16/2021)
body: Registration process for the Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles has been started on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2020- 21. Last date to apply for the scholarship is extended till 25th April 2021 The students can apply for the above scholarship scheme on the NSP scholarship portal from the link mentioned below:- Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Eligibility Criteria for applying on PMSSS 1. Wards/widows of deceased CAPFs & AR personnel died in harness/election duty, wards of personnel disabled due to causes attributable to Government service and Wards of Ex-CAPFs & AR personnel in receipt of Gallantry Awards. 2. Wards/widows of retired and serving CAPFs & AR Personnel. (Personnel below Officer Rank). 3. Pursuing first professional degree programme in the field of Engineering, BBA, BCA, B. Pharma, B.SC (Agriculture etc.), MBA and MCA etc. (For details related to the programme, the enclosed guidelines may be referred). 4. Having minimum 60% marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 10+2/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent in case of new applicant. Or For applicants applying under renewal category, it is mandatory to pass the each subsequent academic year of the professional courses being pursued by them with minimum 50% marks. 5. Students admitted in 2nd year of technical/professional Bachelor Degree Course (BE / B. Tech. etc.) through lateral entry after completion of Diploma courses are eligible. 6. In case of applicant passed XII exam from CBSE, marks obtained in best of five subjects out of 500 will be considered for calculating the percentage of marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ). Exclusions 1. Students pursuing professional courses through correspondence / distance learning are not eligible. 2. Students availing benefits of other scholarship scheme/ getting stipend and financial assistance are not eligible. 3. Students already availed scholarship under PMSS scheme are not eligible. The following clear scanned self-attested documents are required for the verification purpose and the same must be sent on email id "scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in" :- 1. Print Application Form (Signed by student after final submission of application online on the portal). 2. Service Certificate to be issued by the Head of Office (H.O.O) in case of serving personnel as per Annexure- A. (Refer attached guidelines). 3. PPO/Discharge Certificate/Book (Mandatory for category A to F) (Refer attached guidelines). 4. Disability Certificate (Mandatory for category B & D) (Refer attached guidelines). 5. Death Certificate (Mandatory for category A & C) (Refer attached guidelines). 6. Certificate of Gallantry award (Mandatory for category E) (Refer attached guidelines). 7. Academic details 10th onwards (e.g. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Provisional Academic Transcript etc.) (Link for applying Provisional Academic Transcript is UMS Navigation-- Examination -- Certificate request -- Apply Certificate). 8. Aadhar Card (linked with bank account). 9. Salary Slip of Father. 10. Bank Passbook (Aadhar number linked with bank account is mandatory). 11. Domicile/ Residential Certificate. 12. Caste Certificate (SC / OBC/ ST) if applicable. 13. Fee Receipts (Current Session 2020-21). 14. Scholarship received proof of previous year(s) (In case of Renewal Application). 15. Bonafide Certificate with recent Photograph (Passport size), [Student needs to download the certificate from his/her NSP login ID and email the scan copy of NSP Bonafide on the email id of scholarship cell (i.e. scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in). 16. One passport size photo. Note:- While entering the university detail students have to select the University name as per the following detail:- State – PUNJAB District – KAPURTHALA, University Name – Lovely Professional University, JULLUNDER (AISHE CODE-U-0379). The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying this scholarship can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of student:- Link: - UMS Navigation ----> Scholarship Management System ----> Scholarship Policies ---> Session 2020-21 ----> National Scholarship schemes ----> Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles All the eligible students have to submit the scan copies on or before 10.04.2021. In case of any query, the students can send an email at scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in . ­­ The students are advised to submit the latest mobile number & email id for proper communication. In case of any grievances, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on email id anil.11928@lpu.co.in

title: Webinar on Vehicle Dynamic by Industry Expert : (4/16/2021)
body: Student Research and Project Cell-DSW in association with Elite Techno Groups presents webinar on Vehicle Dynamics by Industry Expert. In this webinar you will learn the basics of the Vehicle Dynamics Blockset (VDBS) and delve into some of the example models. We will present how to use the Unreal Engine to visualize and compare results in an intuitive manner. After exploring the blocks included in the VDBS and the example models, you will learn how to customize these examples to easily optimize an anti-lock braking system for split road driving conditions and how to effectively show the results of the optimized controller. Lastly, we will explore some of the other ways to use VDBS to accelerate the pace of development within automotive and automated driving industries. body: This is for the information of all the students registered in project, dissertation and similar courses (as per list attached in Annexure-I), that the following documents are to be uploaded on the UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines (mentioned in Annexure-I) to be eligible to appear in the Final End Term Presentation (ETP). 1. Uploading of soft copy of final report All the students need to prepare the final report for their research/ project work as per the guidelines attached (in Annexure-II) and upload the soft copy of the same in three parts i.e. PDF File-1, PDF File-2 and PDF File-3 via their UMS interface as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-I by visiting the following link: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details-->Upload Research Project Report/Internship Certificate --->Project/Dissertation/Internship Contents of each PDF file (size should be less than 5 MBs) are mentioned below: PDF File 1 PDF File 2 PDF File 3 Students need to upload their Complete Project/ research Report as PDF File 1. Students need to upload “only Content Report” which is without any student identification Information (e.g. Student’s Name, Registration Number or Title Page) as PDF File 2. Plagiarism Report is to be uploaded for Standalone Project(s), Capstone-II, Dissertation–II or Dissertation- III (As per Annexure-I). title: Enrollment into Career Services - 2023 graduating batch students : (4/14/2021)
body: Kind attention: Students expected to graduate in 2023. This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the students graduating in 2023 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2023. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. Registration Deadline: Career Services Registration with immediate access to applicable campus placement/internship opportunities is open from 14-Apr-2021 to 31st May 2021. Registration Process: * Pathway: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration *Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: * Process Step-I: Initial Consent for enrollment into Career Services * Process Step-II: Profile Update and PEP Fee payment ** Process Step-I: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. Process Step-I will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). ** Process Step-II: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-I. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface. PEP Fee shall be paid online (full or part) through Placement Registration interface itself. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. Student will not be allowed to avail Career Services/PEP activities without paying the PEP test fees. The registration is considered complete only after Process Step-II is successfully completed with applicable PEP fee payment (in full or part). Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. In case of any queries, kindly contact your school Training and Placement Coordinators or log an RMS in category "Division of Career Services --- Placement --- Career Services Policy Registration".

title: Want to talk about your problems and learn to deal with issues of stress, anxiety, anger, relationships and overthinking ? Join an interactive session with Counseling Psychologists on Thursday 15th April 2021. (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/210413/001) : (4/13/2021)
body: Dear Students If You’ve got Problems, We’ve got Ears. During this Pandemic some of you may be overthinking, feeling lonely and going through emotions of frustration, anger, stress, sadness and relationship issues. Avoiding emotions affect your body and mind. It can lead to problems with memory and concentration due to stress and anxiety In LPU we endeavour to strive towards better student mental health and psychological well-being which are important to a student’s success and confidence. Talking about your problems can release pent-up feelings Don't suffer alone, come and talk to trained professionals about your concerns . We can help you find new ideas in order to move forward. Resource Persons: Ms. Malvinder Gill- HOD- Counseling & Happiness Cell Ms. Anusuya Hazarika - Sr Clinical Psychologist Ms. Anuradha - Counseling Psychologist/Moderator Date: Thursday, 15th April 2021 Time: 12 pm -1.30 .pm Join with Google meet meet.google.com/wwi-oxdi-gto Join by phone (US) +1 747-248-3255 (PIN: 192092076)

title: LPU Global: Opportunity to spend a semester abroad at 100% tuition fee scholarship : (4/10/2021)
body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for LPU students of various program in the attached list to attend a fully tuition fee waived semester at partner foreign University i.e. students have to pay only tuition fees applicable at LPU and they get opportunity to study for one semester at partner University in Canada, France, Sweden, Lithuania etc. without paying tuition fees of partner university. All formalities and fees relating to VISA, travel, accommodation, food and any other fees of the partner foreign University has to be borne by the student. Details of available institutions are attached. Eligibility: · Minimum CGPA 6.5 with no backlogs and reappearances · Regular Attendance · Active Participant in extracurricular activities · Excellent communication skills · Capacity to Sustain himself/herself overseas while studying (Estimated budget 2 Lakh to 4 Lakh depending on country and university of choice · A valid Passport Interested students must fill the form before: 30th April 2021 https://forms.gle/xgyNcGR1kTwUwgoc9 Please Note: · Selection would be based on multi-level interviews · Student can apply only to one university at a time for second university please fill the form again · Seats would be filled on first in-first out basis and are fully at the discretion of selection committee at LPU & partner University · There can be possibility of online, offline or hybrid classes by the partner university. title: Kendriya Sainik Board Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Wards of Ex Serviceman/ Ex Coast Guard personnel and their widows –reg.(Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210409/007) : (4/9/2021)
body: Registration process for Kendriya Sainik Board -Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Wards of Ex Serviceman/ Ex Coast Guard personnel and their widows has been started for the session 2020- 21. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30th April 2021 The students can apply for the above scholarship scheme from the link mentioned below:- Link: https://ksb.gov.in/ Eligibility Criteria for the KSB Prime Minister Scholarship scheme: 1. Students who have taken admission in 1st year are only eligible to apply for this scheme. 2. Students who have taken admission in lateral entry & Integrated Courses are not eligible to apply for KSB Prime Minister Scholarship scheme. 3. Students should have scored 60% and above in Minimum Educational Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 10+2 / Diploma / Graduation are eligible for this scheme. 4. Students studying in 2nd or subsequent years are not eligible (except for integrated courses - where 1st portion is academic and 2nd portion is integrated as professional course). In such cases student need to apply for scholarship on taking admission as per ‘Para 18 of Important Instructions’ available at link https://ksb.gov.in/ -- PMSS – New Application - How to Apply for Scholarship. 5. Students who are Dependent Wards / Widows of Ex Servicemen & Ex Coast Guard personnel are Eligible. 6. In case of Renewal Scholarship - 50% marks are mandatory in each semester / academic year. Passing of all subjects in each semester / year in FIRST ATTEMPT is mandatory requirement for continuation of scholarship. If a student failed / get RA in any subject, his / her scholarship will be closed forever. He will not be entitled for subsequent installments of PMSS. The student can apply for renewal of scholarship within ONE YEAR from declaration of result. Exclusions for the KSB Prime Minister Scholarship scheme: 1. Wards of Civilians including Para Military Personnel are NOT ELIGIBLE. 2. Students pursuing in 2nd or subsequent year of course (except Lateral Entry and Integrated Courses) are not eligible. 3. Students are already getting scholarship / concession from other source which is more than the amount given by PMSS are not eligible i.e For Boys Rs. 30,000/- per year and For Girls Rs. 36,000/- per year. 4. Students pursuing academic course and courses which are not included in List of Courses for PMSS (List of courses available on website) are not eligible. 5. Student studying distance learning course are not eligible. Master Degree Courses are not eligible for PMSS except MBA / MCA Courses. The following clear scanned self-attested documents are required for the verification purpose and the same must be sent on email id of SSIV Cell i.e “ scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in “ :- 1. Print Application Form (Signed by student after final submission of application online on the portal). 2. Ex-Servicemen / Ex-Coast Guard Certificate duly filled up and signed by ZSB/Coast Guard HQ as per Annexure-1 (ORIGINAL TO BE SCANNED AND UPLOADED). The Annexure 1 to be checked from the guidelines of the scheme available on KSB website. 3. Bonafide Certificate duly filled up correctly and signed by the University officials as per Annexure-2 (ORIGINAL TO BE SCANNED AND UPLOADED). The Annexure 2 to be checked from the guidelines of the scheme available on KSB website. 4. Certificate from his/her bank stating that Aadhaar Card of student linked with his / her bank account number as per Annexure-3(ORIGINAL TO BE SCANNED AND UPLOADED). The Annexure 3 to be checked from the guidelines of the scheme available on KSB website. 5. Academic details 10th onwards (e.g. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Provisional Academic Transcript etc.) (Link for applying Provisional Academic Transcript is UMS Navigation-- Examination -- Certificate request -- Apply Certificate) 6. Aadhar Card (linked with bank account). 7. Bank Passbook (1st page of Bank Pass Book (preferably PNB/SBI only) clearly showing name and A/c Number of Student and IFS code of the bank). 8. Fee Receipts (Current Session 2020-21). 9 . Scholarship received proof of previous year(s) (In case of Renewal Application). 10. One passport size photo. The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying this scholarship can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of student:- Link: - UMS Navigation ---> Scholarship Management System ----> Scholarship Policies -----> Session 2020-21 ---> Kendriya Sainik Board PM Scholarship Scheme. All the eligible students have to submit the scan copies on or before 22 April 2021. In case of any query, the students can send an email at scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in . ­­The students are advised to submit the latest mobile number & email id for proper communication. In case of any grievances, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on email id anil.11928@lpu.co.in Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30th April 2021 Link: https://ksb.gov.in/

body: As earlier intimated to the students regarding taking up courses as Open Minor and Open Electives in the upcoming term the process for submitting option in that regard has been started. Step 1: Selection between Open Minor and Open Elective The students are first of all required to make selection between whether he/she wants to take up Open Minor (i.e. set of four courses) or Open Elective (wherein the student shall select the course in every term) as an option. As of now the process of filling preferences for Open Minor Area has been initiated. (For Open Elective courses the preference taking process shall be scheduled shortly, through a separate UMS announcement). To submit option for Open Minor Area or Open Elective Courses the students are required to follow the given below link- UMS Home- UMS Navigation---->Learning Management System---->OM/OE Choice Selection UMS Dashboard- Academics ---->Polling ---->OM/OE Choice Selection. Or through LPU TOUCH app at the link “OM/OE Choice Selection” In order to facilitate the students to make the choice, School wise folder of list of Open Minors and Open Electives to be offered is available at the link: Important Links---->Examination Instructions and Guidelines ---->Open Minor Folder Important Links---->Examination Instructions and Guidelines ---->Open Elective Folder Link of the video describing in detail about Open Minors and Open Electives before polling for the same: https://youtu.be/74_cNx8DZio Step 2: Submitting of Open Minor Area Preferences The students who wish to opt for Open Minor can fill their preferences for Open Minor Area in the above interface only. (Refer Video link- https://youtu.be/R-CNZPhuHWM or attached User Manual for details) For the students who wish to opt for Open Elective Course, the polling shall be scheduled shortly. Details will be shared in a separate UMS announcement. It is for your information that the preference polling for Open Minor for session 2021-22 will NOT be on First Come First Serve basis. The choice filling for Open Minor Area/ Open Elective Course and submission of Open Minor Area preferences shall start on 9th April, 2021 (12:00 PM onwards) till 13th April, 2021 midnight (12:00 AM). For any query, please contact your school Academic Operations Coordinator (AOC) on the email ID as per list attached below. OM allocation criteria, Disclaimer and User Manual for using polling interface are attached below. Note: 1. It is compulsory to follow “Step 1” and select Open Minor/Open Elective option latest by 13th April 2021. Failure to do so will lead in opening of only Open Elective polling and student shall not be able to participate in Open Minor polling after 13th April 2021. 2. Once you submit “Open Minor Area Preferences”, you shall not be able to make any changes in the same. Also, you cannot participate in the polling for “Open Elective Course”. 3. The allocation of OM/OE through polling shall be done through allocation criteria mentioned in the interface and NOT ON FIRST COME FIRST SERVE BASIS. 4. Polling process is just for recording preferences. Polling for a particular OM/OE does not guarantee its allocation to the students.

title: Schedule for Online Test of INFINEON TECHNOLOGIES INDIA PVT LTD (TC.14151.2022.19203) : (4/7/2021)
body: This is for the information of all the concerned that the online test for shortlisted students (as per attached list) of INFINEON TECHNOLOGIES INDIA PVT LTD (TC.14151.2022.19203) is scheduled as follows: Date: 07-04-2021 Time: 6:00 P.M NOTE: Link & other necessary details will be shared with the students directly by the company. General Instructions:- 1. The candidates need to take the test on a computer/laptop system, equipped with a working Web-Cam (external or built-in) and smooth internet connectivity throughout the test session. 2. Candidates are advised to take the test in all fair means. 3. Do not try to click ‘Print Screen’ or Copy the content while the test is in progress. The system will disqualify the candidate instantly. Use of mobile phones and cameras during the entire duration of the test is strictly prohibited. 4. There should not be any hindrance to the Web-Cam’s lenses. It should not be covered with any object and should always have the candidate right in front of it. 5. While taking up the online test, candidates are advised not to move out of the test screen, e.g., Do not open another tab or application like notepad, excel or web browsers Important Prerequisites: The Onus is on the candidate to ensure a stable internet connection for this test via broadband or hotspot of at least 2 MBPS & a laptop with full power backup. The Supported Web Browsers on the Laptop are Chrome and Firefox. A laptop with a functional webcam is mandatory. A smartphone is required with a web browser for the Mobile Proctoring as explained below. NO APP INSTALLS REQUIRED ON MOBILE GeeekAssess Assessments also perform an additional Proctoring - so, your Mobile phone will be required throughout the Assessment for Invigilation & streaming purpose. There is a mandatory demo test that will require you to complete your Hardware Verification & Allow Proctoring Permissions to ready your platform & further help you with an understanding of the GeeekAssess interface. PLEASE FOLLOW THE ILLUSTRATION BELOW AS THE CORE STEPS TO BE DONE BEFORE TEST (giving permissions) & then AT THE START OF A TEST (Demo/Main) Core process: Login ID and Password- same one used across both Demo & Main test/s- the same credentials require logging in for demo & main test. Completing Auto-Invigilation setup to verify that the following are allowed by your system Desktop Sharing Webcam Sharing Mobile streams Capture Completing Demo Test to get acquainted with the Assessment Environment Main Assessment/s at the scheduled time slots. Do's & Dont's: Keep an ID card to capture a pic of you with your ID card in the ID Capture Frame or alternatively a piece of paper with your handwritten roll number & name in case you are missing an ID card. Don't Collaborate, No Screen Exits, Keep your Gaze & Position clearly on your system or on your rough sheet only. No Calculators. No Parallel Screens. All of these lead you to immediate disqualification. All Video Proctoring streams should be continually on throughout your Test - Desktop, Webcam & Mobile. In case of Internet Downtime where your internet is unable to recover, Immediately call the Helpline before you exit your screen. In case of Auto-invigilation setup where you are stuck, call the Helpline Immediately; Do not Proceed. What's next? Please look forward to a detailed invitation mail from GeeekAssess Team and ensure to follow all the Instructions as mentioned here and resolving to keep your Credentials in the invite email confidential. To address your queries and issues, GeeekAssess Support team will be available on the published email and Phone number (at the end of your next email) Paper Type & Details: The demo paper will be a 10 minute mandatory test that resembles the main test and familiarizes you with the coding environment. This will NOT BE GRADED. This demo test will ALREADY BE AVAILABLE ON LOGIN. You need to complete the setup for auto-invigilation & complete demo test next. The main paper Tomorrow evening will be a multi-section paper. Students will need to attempt each section within a limited time with the ability to toggle(jump) between sections to attempt it. The timers are paused/unpaused accordingly. Plan your attempt well at the start of the paper. Students will need to login using the same link each time to start the demo test (ASAP) & main test (at the specific time it goes live) as shown in the above illustration & detailed in the NEXT EMAIL you receive. NOTE for Attendance: 1. It is Mandatory to mark drive attendance as duty leaves will be given based on the attendance marked by the students. 2. Link to mark drive attendance will be open from 5:00 P.M to 6:00 P.M 3. To mark drive attendance: Go to Placement portal > Mark drive attendance. 4. Select the name of the drive & Round for which the attendance has to be marked. 5. Scan the QR code using the Barcode scanner Menu from the LPU Touch App menu. 6. In case the student is not able to mark the attendance due to the mobile camera not working, Mobile software not supporting, Internet issue then the candidate can select not able to mark the attendance and save the attendance by selecting a specific reason using the interface. 7. If any disparity is found between placement drive attendance (Marked by the student using QR SCAN CODE) & company data then action will be taken as per the placement policy.

title: Want to talk about your problems and learn to deal with issues of stress, anxiety, anger , relationships and overthinking ? Join an interactive session with Counseling Psychologists on Wednesday 7th April 2021. (Ref.No. LPU/DSR/IC/210405/001) : (4/5/2021)
body: Dear Students If You’ve got Problems, We’ve got Ears. During this Pandemic some of you may be overthinking, feeling lonely and going through emotions of frustration, anger, stress, sadness and relationship issues. title: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles –reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210401/005) : (4/1/2021)
body: Registration process for Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles has been started on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2020- 21. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 15th April 2021 The students can apply for the above scholarship scheme on the NSP scholarship portal from the link mentioned below:- Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Eligibility Criteria for applying on PMSSS 1. Wards/widows of deceased CAPFs & AR personnel died in harness/election duty, wards of personnel disabled due to causes attributable to Government service and Wards of Ex-CAPFs & AR personnel in receipt of Gallantry Awards. 2. Wards/widows of retired and serving CAPFs & AR Personnel. (Personnel below Officer Rank). 3. Pursuing first professional degree programme in the field of Engineering, BBA, BCA, B. Pharma, B.SC (Agriculture etc.), MBA and MCA etc. (For details related to the programme, the enclosed guidelines may be referred). 4. Having minimum 60% marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 10+2/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent in case of new applicant. Or For applicants applying under renewal category, it is mandatory to pass the each subsequent academic year of the professional courses being pursued by them with minimum 50% marks. 5. Students admitted in 2nd year of technical/professional Bachelor Degree Course (BE / B. Tech. etc.) through lateral entry after completion of Diploma courses are eligible. 6. In case of applicant passed XII exam from CBSE, marks obtained in best of five subjects out of 500 will be considered for calculating the percentage of marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ). Exclusions 1. Students pursuing professional courses through correspondence / distance learning are not eligible. 2. Students availing benefits of other scholarship scheme/ getting stipend and financial assistance are not eligible. 3. Students already availed scholarship under PMSS scheme are not eligible. The following clear scanned self attested documents are required for the verification purpose and the same must be sent on email id “ scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in “ :- 1. Print Application Form (Signed by student after final submission of application online on the portal). 2. Service Certificate to be issued by the Head of Office (H.O.O) in case of serving personnel as per Annexure- A. (Refer attached guidelines). 3. PPO/Discharge Certificate/Book (Mandatory for category A to F) (Refer attached guidelines). 4. Disability Certificate (Mandatory for category B & D) (Refer attached guidelines). 5. Death Certificate (Mandatory for category A & C) (Refer attached guidelines). 6. Certificate of Gallantry award (Mandatory for category E) (Refer attached guidelines). 7. Academic details 10th onwards (e.g. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Provisional Academic Transcript etc.) (Link for applying Provisional Academic Transcript is UMS Navigation-- Examination -- Certificate request -- Apply Certificate) 8. Aadhar Card (linked with bank account). 9. Salary Slip of Father. 10. Bank Passbook (Aadhar number linked with bank account is mandatory). 11. Domicile/ Residential Certificate. 12. Caste Certificate (SC / OBC/ ST) if applicable. 13. Fee Receipts (Current Session 2020-21). 14. Scholarship received proof of previous year(s) (In case of Renewal Application). 15. Bonafide Certificate with recent Photograph (Passport size), [Student needs to download the certificate from his/her NSP login ID and email the scan copy of NSP Bonafide on the email id of scholarship cell (i.e. scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in) 16. One passport size photo. Note:- While entering the university detail students have to select the University name as per the following detail:- State – PUNJAB District – KAPURTHALA, University Name – Lovely Professional University, JULLUNDER (AISHE CODE-U-0379). The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying this scholarship can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of student:- Link: - UMS Navigation ----> Scholarship Management System ----> Scholarship Policies ---> Session 2020-21 ----> National Scholarship schemes ----> Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles All the eligible students have to submit the scan copies on or before 10.04.2021. In case of any query, the students can send an email at scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in . ­­The students are advised to submit the latest mobile number & email id for proper communication. body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for the LPU students who want to get their credits transferred to partner foreign Universities in Canada, USA, UK, Australia &Dubai etc. Under credit transfer the students will be doing the following programs: · 2 years at LPU and rest 2/2.5 years at partner foreign university in case of Bachelor’s degree · 1 year at LPU and rest 1/1.5 year at partner Foreign university in case of Master’s degree and eventually get degree from partner foreign university after successful completion of the program in the foreign University. title: Registration for the Annual Seminar of Ph.D. Scholars. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210331/001) : (3/31/2021)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. Annual Seminar evaluation tentatively scheduled during May-June 2021. All the Ph.D. Scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs before July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for Annual Seminar after each year from the date of successful completion of SAS. The main aim of the Annual Seminar is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the suggestions given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation. The scholars are required to follow the following 2 steps for appearing in Annual Seminar: 1. Registration and uploading of Annual Seminar report Scholars who have successfully received their candidacy letter and have cleared at least one End Term Report (ETR) are eligible to register for Annual seminar through the following UMS interface link: UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Scholar Activity Detail --> Upcoming activity --> Annual Seminar Interface for registration will remain active till 2 May, 2021. Once the scholar has registered for the Annual seminar, he/she needs to upload the annual progress report for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC). The Scholar should visit the following UMS link for uploading of the annual progress report. The guidelines for preparation of report and presentation along with their respective formats are attached with UMS announcement. UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Scholar Activity Detail --> Upcoming activity --> Annual Seminar The last date for uploading the Annual Seminar report is 2 May, 2021. All eligible scholars as per attached list (List of Eligible Scholars for Annual seminar) are required to register for Annual Seminar Evaluation and Upload their files. 2. Recommendation of the Annual Seminar Report by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor Once the Scholars have registered for the Annual Seminar and uploaded their Annual seminar report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> PhD Seminar File Verification --> Annual Seminar --> Download The last date for verification of the Report is 7 May, 2021. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of Annual seminar report: 1. Scholars need to register for the evaluation and upload the annual report strictly as per the guidelines for completion of registration process or else their registration shall be deemed cancelled and they will be marked absent for the evaluation. 2. As per current guidelines, the scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such scholars who have either missed or are Not Recommended in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the Annual Seminar evaluation. 3. The scholars must upload single PDF file for Annual seminar report duly verified and signed by respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for Annual Seminar) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 4. In case the scholars are unable to get a signed copy of the synopsis from their respective supervisor due to prevailing situating of novel coronavirus, they can upload the soft copy of the synopsis without supervisor signature. But it is required that the synopsis uploaded by them must be strictly as per the guidelines and it must be verified by their supervisor through UMS interface on or before 7 May 2021. 5. Scholars are required to submit one hard copy of the reports duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/co-supervisor/administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) in Block 30, Room Number– 302B for which the date which shall be communicated separately in due course of time. 6. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 7. No extension shall be given for uploading report beyond the last date. 8. Scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using Annual registration interface) before registering and uploading the Annual seminar reports at the interface. For Recommendation of the Annual seminar report The scholar must upload the Annual seminar report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. For online evaluation of the Annual Seminar a) The research scholar must have laptop/ desktop or any other suitable mean with proper audio/ video facility. b) The research scholar must have high speed internet facility to appear for the online Annual Seminar evaluation. c) The research scholar must be well versed with the online google meet platform. It is strongly advised that the research scholar must present his/ her presentation to the respective supervisor prior to appearing in actual Annual Seminar evaluation so that there is no confusion on the day of evaluation. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues: 1. Registration/Uploading of synopsis write at rdc.sas@lpu.co.in or contact Ms. Poonam (7986479141)/ Dr. Jashanpreet Singh (8968875079) 2. Supervisor / Co-supervisor /fee related query write at drp@lpu.co.in.

Both SVAR & WriteX Assessments are important for you in terms of placement perspective. Hence participate in these assessments with full enthusiasm. About WriteX: The only Written English Test driven on Machine Learning to help you in assessing the overall quality of a candidate's written sample. major factors that attribute towards the construction of a great write-up like grammar, usage, mechanics, style, organization and development etc. About SVAR: IVR Based, Spoken English Test to assess Student's Fluency, Pronunciation, Active Listening, Spoken English Understanding, Grammar, Vocabulary & more. title: Regarding information for Open Minors and Open Elective courses (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210326/001) : (3/26/2021)
body: All the concerned students of the program and batches mentioned in the attached list please note that they can participate in the polling to select either an Open Minor Area or an Open Elective course of their choice in this term which they shall be studying in their upcoming terms. To enhance your understanding about the Open Minor and Open Elective, click on the link of the video describing in detail about Open Minors and Open Electives before polling for the same- https://youtu.be/74_cNx8DZio A brief review about Open Minors and Open Electives is presented below for reference: For Students going to opt Open Minor Area For Students going to opt Open Elective course What is an Open Minor? An Open Minor is a group of 4 courses that shall be offered to the students in a new area to develop additional skills enhancing employment opportunities. Polling for Open Minor shall be held only once and selection once made shall automatically lead to selection of the 4 courses corresponding to the area for subsequent terms. What is an Open Elective? In case of Open Electives, a student has to choose one or two courses(as per scheme) to study in the next term in the current polling and subsequent polling shall be held in future for the subsequent terms for the Open Elective courses that the student has to study. List of Folders containing options of Open Minor Areas offered- In order to facilitate you to make this choice when the polling for Open Minor starts, School wise folder of list of Open Minor areas to be offered to you is available at the link: Important Links ---> Examination Instructions and Guidelines----> Students ----> Open Minor Folder The folder contains a list of open minors along with a brief description of 4 courses to be offered in each open minor option. You are required to critically analyze each OM option being offered in your school from the same so that you are ready with your choice before the polling starts. List of Folders containing options of Open Elective Courses offered- For the Open Elective courses to be offered school wise a description of courses to be offered for your school to help you understand the dimensions of the courses the description has been made available at the link: Important Links ---> Examination Instructions and Guidelines----> Students ----> Open Elective Folder You are required to critically analyze each open elective option being offered in your school from the same so that you are ready with your choice before the polling starts. Note that there are limited seats available in each of the Open Minor Area as well as the Open Elective courses. You are hence advised to rigorously go through the description of each of the option available in your school (from UMS Links specified in the above table) and be ready with atleast 5 preferences during polling. The Open Minor Area or Open Elective Course will be allocated on the basis of CGPA as per allocation criteria. For your reference, the file regarding allocation criteria to be followed is attached below. All students should note that if a student does not participate in the polling for Open Minor, then he/she can participate in the subsequent polling for Open Elective. However, once the polling for Open Minor is closed, no request to poll for Open Minor shall be entertained afterwards. Information regarding polling process and schedule shall be informed to you soon.

title: Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS) of Ph.D. Scholars (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/210324/001) : (3/24/2021)
body: This is in reference to the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) which will be conducted tentatively in May-2021. It is mandatory for all research scholars to clear SAS within two years from the date of registration otherwise their admission may be deemed as cancelled. The key points for SAS evaluation are as follows: a) To finalize the Title of the proposed research work. b) To finalize the Objectives of the proposed research work. c) To finalize the research methodology of the proposed research work. I. The research scholars are required to follow the following three steps to be eligible for appearing in SAS. 1. Registration for SAS: Research scholars who have successfully completed their course work or exempted from the course work (due to M.Phil.) can register for SAS seminar through the interface available in the UMS at the following link. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development --> SAS Registration form Interface for registration will remain active from 23rd March 2021 to 10th April 2021. Only those research scholars should register for their SAS seminar who are willing to appear for the evaluation in the month May 2021 and have the approval of their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor for the same. 2. Uploading of synopsis: Once the research scholar has registered for the SAS, he/ she needs to upload the synopsis for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the panel of experts. The research scholar needs to visit the same UMS link for uploading of the synopsis of SAS along with the other relevant documents. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development -->SAS Registration form The last date for uploading the synopsis report is 16th April, 2021. 3. Recommendation of the synopsis by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded the synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> Scholar File Verification --> SAS --> Download The last date for verification of the synopsis is 21st April, 2021. II. Evaluation of the State of the Art Seminar (SAS) via online platform: It is for the information of the all concerned that due to prevailing situation the SAS evaluation shall be planned via online platform google meet. Important Note: For Registration: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt of their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisors/Co-Supervisors/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension shall be given for registration beyond the last date. c) No request for deregistration shall be entertained beyond the last date of registration and the scholar shall be marked absent. d) Research scholars having pending dues are not eligible to register for the SAS evaluation. Therefore, research scholars are requested to clear the pending dues and get registered for the SAS evaluation before the last date. e) If a research scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but is absent at the date of seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from Sept. 2021 onwards) only after the clearance of fine. For Uploading Synopsis: a) The research scholar shall not be eligible for uploading any synopsis report without completing registration process. b) The research scholars are strongly advised that synopsis file must be uploaded only after the thorough discussion with the Supervisor. Same should be defended during the presentation on the day of evaluation. For preparing the presentation the research scholar should refer to the format for SAS presentation (Attachment) c) No extension shall be given for uploading synopsis report beyond the last date. d) Read the attached guidelines very carefully before uploading the synopsis. e) All the research scholars must upload single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I as per the attached guidelines or else their SAS registration may be cancelled. He/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation (with fee of Rs. 5000/-). No second chance shall be given to upload the synopsis. f) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using SAS registration interface) before registering and uploading the synopsis at the interface. For recommendation of the Synopsis: a) The research scholar must upload the synopsis well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. For online evaluation of the State of the Art Seminar (SAS): a) The research scholar must have laptop/ desktop or any other suitable mean with proper audio/ video facility. b) The research scholar must have high speed internet facility to appear for the online SAS evaluation. In case, the research scholar has registered for the SAS evaluation but could not appear for the same due to any issue, he/she shall be marked absent for the evaluation and he/shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. c) The research scholar must be well versed with the online google meet platform. It is strongly advised that the research scholar must present his/ her presentation to the respective supervisor prior to appearing in actual SAS evaluation so that there is no confusion on the day of evaluation. All the research scholars who have completed two years from date of registration and have the last chance to appear in the SAS seminar in May 2021 are advised to avail this chance as no further extension shall be given for the same. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues: 1. Registration/Uploading of synopsis write at rdc.sas@lpu.co.in or contact Ms. Poonam (7986479141)/ Dr. Jashanpreet Singh (8968875079) 2. Supervisor / Co-supervisor /fee related query write at drp@lpu.co.in

title: Programming Test for Product Based Pathway [for 2nd year CSE/IT students] : (3/23/2021)
body: School of Computer Science and Engineering will be offering a pathway named “Corporate – Product Based (Placement oriented track of Competitive Programming for product based companies)” to the students currently in second year of their study under CSE/IT programmes. Under this pathway, the following 03 courses based on competitive coding theme will be offered in the next two terms i.e. Term 5 and Term 6 besides the Engineering minor, Open Minor/Open Elective and other regular courses. 1. PRELUDE TO COMPETITIVE CODING 2. COMPETITIVE CODING APPROACHES-TECHNIQUES 3. CODING PEARLS Maximum of 135 students will be registered for this pathway. The students will be selected on the basis of performance in online programming test. Following are the details of the shortlisting process: 1. A separate coding based diagnostic test of 50 marks shall be conducted on 21st April, 2021 (Wednesday) at 5:15 pm on HackerRank platform. The test will have 02 coding problems (each of 25 marks) to be solved in 01 hour. Solutions to questions can be framed using any coding language supported by HackerRank platform. Candidates must have familiarity with programming language and should be aware of data structures and algorithms. 2. Students who are willing to go for Product based pathway must register themselves through the following link by 12th April 2021. http://tinyurl.com/pbtregistration 3. Students having maximum of 01 E/F/G grade courses at the time of taking the test are allowed to take this pathway. 4. Instructions to follow during the test will be sent to registered students through UMS message after 12th April 2021. 5. The number of courses for the students in the coming semesters will remain the same as for all the other students in 3rd year. These courses will replace some of the courses. 6. Students must participate in pathway elective polling to be done online. Student who would not be participating in polling process will be considered in service based only. Later on, students selected in above mentioned programming test will be registered in product based pathway no matter which other pathway they have opted for. The shortlisted students from next term onwards will have to continue with the above mentioned pathway only. There will not be any separate process to take options for product based. 7. Students selected for product based pathway will have to register for placement services of University in the first phase of placement registration process. For any further queries regarding the same, the students can contact their respective section HoDs.
