title: Webinar : Examinophobia (fear of exams) & How to reduce exam stress (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/201231/001) : (12/31/2020)
body: Dear Students, Some of you have already started and others are getting ready for End term exams. However – Examinophobia – the fear of exams is real. Some students get excessively nervous before or during an important exam. This is a very common phenomenon among some students especially when an important examination is approaching close Exam fever can affect one psychologically, socially and emotionally In fact, Albert Einstein also suffered from exam fever when he appeared for an entrance exam. Stress levels can go up and this can stop students from performing their best in the exams · If you’re feeling stressed about exams, you’re not alone. · There are many students who suffer from examinophobia or exam stress To help all students, Counseling & Happiness cell under the aegis of Division of student Relationship (DSR ) has planned a session specially to talk about this kind of stress. Join this session to learn techniques, tips and tricks to get rid of exam stress and achieve high grades. title: LPU Global: Info-Sessions for Credit transfer and Semester Abroad Program for LPU students. : (12/30/2020)
body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for the students of Lovely Professional University to have an international exposure through programs like credit transfer and semester abroad program. Here is the brief synopsis of both the programs being offered by the Division of International Affairs to the students of Lovely Professional University 1. Credit Transfer Program: We offer the students to get an international degree by taking the option of Credit Transfer. Under this opportunity student can study 2/2.5 years at LPU and complete the rest of his/her degree at a foreign university and get a degree from the partner University after successful completion of the program at the partner university. Credit transfer is the process by which one institution matches its courses or requirements to course work at another institution. Credits earned at LPU can be transferred to the host University. Students use credit transfer to assure that courses they complete will not have to be repeated at the institution to which they are transferring. 2. Semester Abroad: Under Semester exchange student spends a full semester at partner foreign university. After studying for a semester at a Partner University the student gets his/her credits transferred back to LPU. This opportunity can be availed by the student who has completed one year of study at home university. Other expenses relating to VISA, Accommodation (where applicable), food, and any other charges of home or host institute has to borne by the student.A semester at a partner university can be of two types: · Scholarship Semester Abroad · Paid Semester Abroad Under tuition fee waived semester the student pays only the tuition fees of the home university and does not pay tuition fees of the host university. Under tuition paid semester the student pays tuition fee of the home as well as Host University. The interested students can interact with representative of Division of International Affairs on one to one basis and get their queries solved on your preferred date as per the schedule provided below in the table Date Time Topic of Session Link to register for the session 07/01/2021 4 PM to 5 PM Semester Abroad https://forms.gle/nz5ESi4fhrJqhKuWA 08/01/2021 4 PM to 5 PM Credit Transfer https://forms.gle/7W4VUoGz22WP7iaR7 21/01/2021 4 PM to 5 PM Credit Transfer https://forms.gle/vnY9Cu2GFX2xNxPk8 22/01/2021 4 PM to 5 PM Semester Abroad https://forms.gle/9njMNX932duSnF8BA For further information please contact Division of International Affairs at studyabroad@lpu.co.in

body: Greetings from Developer Student Clubs - LPU!! Android Study Jams are community-organized study groups for people to learn how to build Android apps in the Kotlin programming language, using the curriculum provided by Google. This is an event series for people who have prior programming experience and are interested in learning Android app development with the support of a study group. Starting on 30 December 2020, participants will be meeting to learn the essentials of the Kotlin programming language and the fundamentals of how to build Android apps in Kotlin. The first session is about ramping up on the Kotlin programming language, including syntax and basic language features, and the second one on 31 December 2020, where you will start diving into Android development with a curriculum offered by Google. All you need to bring is your laptop computer. Do not forget to install Android Studio ahead of time. Having an Android device is optional, but if you do have one, bring that with a USB cable so you can learn to run your apps on your device. Your knowledge will build on itself week over week as you build a collection of Android apps that showcase what you have learned. There is never been a better time to learn Android development in Kotlin, Hope to see you soon! Register using the link below and confirm your spot among fellow student developers. title: MY Perfectice as learning and practice platform for SCSE and SEEE Placement registered students of 2022 passing out batch : (12/26/2020)
body: Dear Aspirants, To prepare you for your dream companies’ University is providing you a learning and practice platform named as Myperfectice. MyPerfectice has come up with a whole new "Gamification feature called Cognite Game" to prepare you while having fun. Yet you must be wondering what exactly the “Gamification Feature” is, and what is this all about?? In this Gamification, the tests have been divided into "Beginner (Level 1), Elementary (Level 2), Intermediate (Level 3) to Advanced (Level 4)”. You begin at Level 1, and every level has a no. of mock tests of Quantitative, Reasoning & Verbal along with practice tests of each topic of different subjects. In version 2 of Cognite , you can immediately see the explanation and methodology to approach a particular question after attempting it. So, that you can improve upon the basics and then attempt further questions to achieve the desired criteria. Eligible School: · School of Computer Science and Engineering (SCSE) · School of Electronics and Electrical Engineering (SEEE) List of eligible 2022 passout batch placement registered students and student manual has been attached with this announcement. Cognitive Skills Package - Myperfectice Level Clearing deadline Level Deadline to complete Level Benchmarking Test 1-Jan Level 1 31-Jan Level 2 28-Feb Level 3 31-Mar Level 4 30-Apr Level 5 15-Jun Cognitive Skills Package - Myperfectice Level Clearing Criteria Level Subjects Minimum No. of Questions to Attempt Min %age Accuracy to achieve 1 1.Quantitative Aptitude 2.Verbal Ability 3.Reasoning Ability 45 Questions in each subject 65% in each subject 2 1.Quantitative Aptitude 2.Verbal Ability 3.Reasoning Ability 60 Questions in each subject 60% in each subject 3 1.Quantitative Aptitude 2.Verbal Ability 3.Reasoning Ability 90 Questions in each subject 60% in each subject 4 1.Quantitative Aptitude 2.Verbal Ability 3.Reasoning Ability 120 Questions in each subject 60% in each subject How to Login: Your login details and how to login criteria will be shared via UMS my messages. Note:- 1. All students need to go to the "Package" menu in their respective account in both Web and Mobile Application. There they will find the package named "COGNITE GAME". 2. "View" the package and below you will find all the Tests that you need to attempt to cross every level one after another.3. All the tests of Level 1 in the package will be enabled; you can view anyone from it and attempt the test. 4. Check the Proficiency Tab on the Left side of your Dashboard (For Web).There you will find "Proficiency". Click the drop down, and select Cognitive Skills. You will find all the updates of your criteria and it will update automatically after every attempt of Level 1 Tests. You will also find a Proficiency Tab in your mobile Application under Dashboard. Select "Cognitive Skills" for your current Level update. 5. You can take attempts both from Web and Mobile Application (LPU Perfectice only for Android Users). 6. You can contact your TPC office in case of any query

title: LPU Global: Info-Sessions for Credit transfer and Semester Abroad Program for LPU students. : (12/22/2020)
body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for the students of Lovely Professional University to have an international exposure through programs like credit transfer and semester abroad program. Here is the brief synopsis of both the programs being offered by the Division of International Affairs to the students of Lovely Professional University 1. Credit Transfer Program: We offer the students to get an international degree by taking the option of Credit Transfer. Under this opportunity student can study 2/2.5 years at LPU and complete the rest of his/her degree at a foreign university and get a degree from the partner University after successful completion of the program at the partner university. Credit transfer is the process by which one institution matches its courses or requirements to course work at another institution. Credits earned at LPU can be transferred to the host University. Students use credit transfer to assure that courses they complete will not have to be repeated at the institution to which they are transferring. 2. Semester Abroad: Under Semester exchange student spends a full semester at partner foreign university. After studying for a semester at a Partner University the student gets his/her credits transferred back to LPU. A semester at a partner university can be of two types: · Scholarship Semester Abroad · Paid Semester Abroad Under tuition fee waived semester the student pays only the tuition fees of the home university and does not pay tuition fees of the host university. Under tuition paid semester the student pays tuition fee of the home as well as Host University. This opportunity can be availed by the student who has completed one year of study at home university. Other expenses relating to VISA, Accommodation (where applicable), food, and any other charges of home or host institute has to borne by the student. title: ATAL TUNNEL: ENGINEERING FEAT AND TECHNOLOGICAL MARVEL : (12/21/2020)
body: Subject: Webinar on “ATAL TUNNEL- Engineering Feat and Technological Marvel” on 28th Dec, 2020 @ 6 PM onward Dear all “As you are aware that ATAL TUNNEL is world’s longest Motorable tunnel in Rohtang and it has been dedicated to nation by Honorable Prime minister on 3rd October, 2020. Situated at an altitude above 10,000 ft., this 9.02 km long tunnel has been constructed in an extremely difficult and hostile climate, deploying the latest and best practices in tunnel technology with state of art features including semi-transverse ventilation, SCADA controlled fire-fighting, Illumination and monitoring system. This engineering feat is expected to reduce travel time between Manali and Leh by 4-5 hours. It is important for us to understand the technological marvel of the country, encompassing the best practices in engineering, design, planning, construction and project management”. In this regard, School of Civil Engineering, Lovely Professional University, Punjab has taken initiative and has invited Dr. Sunil Vasudevan Former-CEO (Chief Executive Officer), D2 Consults (Austria) who was closely involved in the planning, analysis, design and construction of this engineering feat and technological marvel. Please find attached poster of the event. To attend the session, registration is must. body: Hey Folks, Greetings of the day from the Developer Student Clubs - LPU!! We are super excited to invite you all to be a part of Android Study Jams. title: Important information regarding Change of Program for students of batch 2020-21. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201219/002) : (12/19/2020)
body: It is for the information of all the students of batch 2020-21 that if they want to change their program, they can do through the link given below: UMS Navigation -->Change of Program--> Request for Change of Program Timelines for change of program:- Phase From To Declaration of Decision on UMS for approved/not approved cases. Last Date of Submission of Change of Program Fee for Approved Case. Processing fee Rs.1000/- 20th December,2020 31st December,2020 6th January, 2021 13th January,2021 Processing fee Rs.1000/- 1st January,2021 20th January, 2021 27th January,2021 3rd February,2021 No program change will be allowed after 20th January, 2021 under any circumstances. Important Note:- 1. All students who apply for change of program shall be required to pay the “Processing Fee” of Rs 1000/- online after submitting their request (Screenshot attached) along with the parent’s consent letter which shall be duly signed by them. (Note: - The processing fee is non-refundable even if the change of program request of student is not approved by competent authorities) 2. The program of the student shall be changed after the payment of change of program fee (Rs 4000/-) within the given timelines and the final approval of the competent authorities. 3. In case student fails to pay the fee as per timelines, the approval for the Change of Program shall stand cancelled and he/she would be required continue in the ongoing program only. 4. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old program after approval of Change of Program. Also fee paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances. 5. Due to course mapping if student is allocated additional courses to study to complete the requirements of the new program he/she will have to register the courses as backlog by paying the 1/10th of the tuition fee (per course) without any scholarship. 6. Only one chance is given to the students for change of program during the entire program duration, hence the students are advised to be very careful while availing this chance. 7. No benefit of missed CA or Attendance will be given to the student applying for change of program after start of classes. To avoid this, students are strongly advised to apply for the change of program before the start of the term. The students are strictly advised to go through the timelines and detailed guidelines judiciously which have been provided with this communication as attachment before applying for change of program. Any query from students can be clarified by sending an email at academic.aac@lpu.co.in.

title: Regarding online polling of supervisors by students registered in project, dissertation and similar courses for spring term 20212 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201216/001) : (12/16/2020)
body: This is in continuation with announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201124/001 dated: 24-11-20 regarding online polling of students who will be registering in project, dissertation or similar courses in spring term 20212 for formulation of student group for doing project work. All such students are now required to get in touch with the prospective supervisors in groups so that each group can be allocated supervisor of their choice. For this purpose, following interfaces have been activated. 1) Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information (for Students) 2) Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface (for Supervisors) 1. Capstone Dissertation Supervisor Information- The attachment-1 contains the details of the groups allocated to the students for capstone, dissertation and similar courses for the purpose of supervisor allocation. The students are required to visit the following UMS link to check the detail of supervisors available as per their specialization. UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project Dissertation Supervisor Information All the groups are required to start interacting with their prospective supervisors and should get their consent latest by 26th DEC 2020. Important points 1. Each supervisor can guide only a limited number of students. Therefore, the students are required to go through the profile of the prospective supervisors and start interacting with them via phone/ email/ LPU live app or any suitable medium as soon as possible so that they can choose the supervisor of their own choice. 2. The students must approach the prospective supervisor in groups allocated to them as per attachment-1 as each student in a particular group shall be allocated same supervisor. 3. The student groups who are not able to opt for the supervisors of their first priority because those supervisors have already taken the maximum groups, are required to approach the next supervisor of their choice and so on till they get the supervisor. 4. If a student group has not approached any of the available supervisors, that group shall be allocated the supervisor randomly as per the availability of the same at that time. 2. Capstone Dissertation Polling Interface: Once there is mutual agreement between the student group and the prospective supervisor for supervisor allocation, the respective supervisors are required to register the group on online UMS interface by visiting the following UMS link: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Project-->Capstone/Dissertation Polling Interface The last date for Capstone/Dissertation Polling interface is 26th December 2020. Important points 1. The screenshots for the use of the interface is attached as attachment-2. 2. The Polling interface is applicable only for courses where weightage of CA is greater than zero and where the exam pattern of the course is X7RA, X7RB, X7RC, X7RD, X7RE/ X8RA, X8RC, X8RD. In case any course requires Supervisor allocation and is not having any of the above mentioned exam pattern, respective school head is requested to get the exam pattern corrected immediately and to get the process of supervisor allocation started through department of projects and internships (DPI). 3. In case any faculty wants to work on the project in a domain which is different from his/her parent domain, the faculty member should take consent from respective HOS of his/her school and provide the same to the AOC of the other School where the faculty wants to carry out the project work. The AOC shall finally punch the load of the faculty and will ensure that the faculty profile is visible to the students of that school. Any queries can be directed to Mr. Mohit Prakram, (COC), Projects and Internships Cell on academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in or in Block-Room: 30-302B.

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (12/11/2020)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Enrollment into Career Services-2022 graduating batch (first year/non first year students)- Revised Timelines as on 10-Dec-2020 : (12/10/2020)
body: Kind attention: First year/Non-first year students expected to graduate in 2022. The university has always offered an immense support to its students in shaping their career. Keeping in mind the current employment scenario and aspirations of the students, as a very special gesture, University is extending the most immediate deadline of Career Services Registration to 12th Dec 2020 for first year and non-first year students expected to graduate in 2022. Registration Timelines for Non-first year students (REVISED as on 10-Dec-2020): a) Career Services Registration with access to placement/internship opportunities from 01-Jan-2021 is extended till 12th Dec 2020. b) Career Services Registration with access to placement/internship opportunities from 01-Mar-2021 is open from 13th Dec 2020 till 31st Dec 2020. Registration Timelines for First year students (REVISED as on 10-Dec-2020): a) Career Services Registration with immediate access to placement/internship opportunities is extended till 12th Dec 2020. b) Career Services Registration with access to placement/internship opportunities from 01-Mar-2021 is open from 13th Dec 2020 till 31st Dec 2020. This benefit is also being extended to 2022 graduating batch students who have already registered from 16th Oct 2020 to 1st Dec 2020. Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2022. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. Registration Process: The registration process is divided into two parts- PROCESS STEP-1 and PROCESS STEP-2. For the details of Step 1 and Step 2, please refer the attached file. Part Payment option: Looking into the request of the students, as a special gesture university has enabled the part payment option of the PEP fee payment for the 2022 graduating batch students w.e.f 1st Oct 2020. They need to pay 50% of the applicable PEP fee now (immediately at the time of registration process) and rest by 31st Dec 2020. If student takes Exit from Career services, then rest of the PEP fee will be made due against the student fee account for recovery. Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. title: International Webinar on “Strength through Diversity: Investigating Molecular Mechanisms of Neuronal Diversity Using Single-Cell RNA Sequencing” : (12/8/2020)
body: Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship presents webinar on “Strength through Diversity: Investigating Molecular Mechanisms of Neuronal Diversity Using Single-Cell RNA Sequencing”. Single cell technologies have revolutionized our understanding of cell lineages in developing systems and disease models. Advances in sequencing and imaging technologies have given us unprecedented insight into the variations in gene expression programs across tissues, as well as into clonal dynamics across time. The field of neuronal imaging at the cellular and sub-cellular levels has significantly benefited from the advances in genetic engineering, development of sophisticated high-resolution instrumentation, novel probe development, enhanced computing power, and machine learning algorithms. Title- “Strength through Diversity: Investigating Molecular Mechanisms of Neuronal Diversity Using Single-Cell RNA Sequencing”. title: Enrollment into Career Services-2022 graduating batch (non first year students)- Revised Timelines as on 01-Dec-2020 : (12/1/2020)
body: Kind attention: Non-first year students expected to graduate in 2022. The university has always offered an immense support to its students in shaping their career. Keeping in mind the current employment scenario and aspirations of the students, as a very special gesture, University is providing a special window of registration to non-first year students graduating in 2022 till 10th Dec 2020 to register for Job Placements and avail PEP activities starting from 15th Dec 2020 and be eligible for campus recruitment opportunities w.e.f 1st Jan 2021. Registration Timelines (REVISED as on 01-Dec-2020): a) Career Services Registration with access to placement/internship opportunities from 01-Jan-2021 is extended till 10th Dec 2020. b) Career Services Registration with access to placement/internship opportunities from 01-Mar-2021 is open from 11th Dec 2020 till 31st Dec 2020. This benefit is also being extended to 2022 graduating batch students who have already registered from 16th Oct 2020 to 1st Dec 2020. Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2022. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. Registration Process: The registration process is divided into two parts- PROCESS STEP-1 and PROCESS STEP-2. For the details of Step 1 and Step 2, please refer the attached file. Part Payment option: Looking into the request of the students, as a special gesture university has enabled the part payment option of the PEP fee payment for the 2022 graduating batch students w.e.f 1st Oct 2020. They need to pay 50% of the applicable PEP fee now (immediately at the time of registration process) and rest by 31st Dec 2020. If student takes Exit from Career services, then rest of the PEP fee will be made due against the student fee account for recovery. Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. In case of any queries, (a) Kindly contact your respective School Training and Placement Coordinators (TPCs), OR (b) Log an RMS request in category PLACEMENT and subcategory CAREER SERVICES POLICY REGISTRATION.

title: Examinophobia (fear of exams ) How to get rid of exam stress. (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/201126/001) : (11/26/2020)
body: Dear Students, Some of you have already started and others are getting ready for End term exams . However – Examinophobia – the fear of exams is real . Some students get excessively nervous before or during an important exam This is a very common phenomenon among some students especially when an important examination is approaching close Exam fever can affect one psychologically, socially and emotionally In fact, Albert Einstein was also the one who suffered from exam fever when he appeared for an entrance exam. Stress levels can go up and this can stop students from performing their best in the exams · If you’re feeling stressed about exams, you’re not alone. · There are many students who suffer from examinophobia or exam stress To help all students Counseling & Happiness cell under the aegis of Division of student Relationship (DSR ) has planned a session specially to talk about this kind of stress . Join this session to learn techniques , tips and tricks to get rid of exam stress and score good results . Resource person : Ms Malvinder Gill - HOD Counseling & Happiness cell Date :Thursday 26th Nov 2020 Time : 5pm -6pm Join with Google Meet meet.google.com/juf-webf-ror Join by phone (US) +1 321-805-3638 (PIN: 258842384)

body: Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship is organizing a webinar on "Innovations in Mass spectrometry based Proteomics in farm animals". In recent years, most areas of proteomics, bioinformatics, mass spectrometry, computational biology and medical informatics have experienced significant advances driven by computational techniques and novel research. title: Opportunity to participate in GYTI (Gandhian Young Technological Innovation) Awards, 2021 : (11/21/2020)
body: Student projects which address an important social, environmental or technological problem faced by masses or disadvantaged people/sectors/spaces or micro and small enterprises, or have the potential to impact a pressing national need are invited. The applications may be made by the past or present students of technical institutions/universities. Note- Please register only if you have a project ready to display to solve any of mentioned issues, it is not for the idea level proposals. The last date for submission of entries to us by 25 November, 2020. Team Enrollment Link: https://tinyurl.com/GYTI2021 The awards will be given to young student innovators in the following categories: · MLM (More from less for many), Frugal Innovation award: technologies that economize on the use of materials/energy, are extremely sustainable · SRISTI - socially relevant technological innovation award-products/prototypes that address unmet social needs or improve the functioning of existing solutions, increase affordability and/or improve circularity i.e. ecological compatibility. · Technological-edge award/ideas that push the frontiers in any technological domain. Eligibility: An Indian Student pursuing UG/PG/PhD in Engineering/technology is eligible to apply for this award. The student should have a valid ID issued by the Institution/University. A No objection Certificate (NoC), as per prescribed format needs to be submitted along with the application. The full project report of the shortlisted projects will be needed for final evaluation. Video, photographs, test reports, comparative advantage vis a vis existing solutions in that domain, literature & patent review, etc. may be with the full project report. For any query, please contact at anita.23401@lpu.co.in Looking forward to your enthusiastic cooperation to make India inclusive, Innovative and collaborative to address the unmet social needs.

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (11/17/2020)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Examinophobia (fear of exams ) How to get rid of exam stress. (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/201116/001) : (11/16/2020)
body: Dear Students, Its time to get ready for End term exams . However – Examinophobia – the fear of exams is real . Some students get excessively nervous before or during an important exam This is a very common phenomenon among some students especially when an important examination is approaching close Exam fever can affect one psychologically, socially and emotionally In fact, Albert Einstein was also the one who suffered from exam fever when he appeared for an entrance exam. Stress levels can go up and this can stop students from performing their best in the exams · If you’re feeling stressed about exams, you’re not alone. · There are many students who suffer from examinophobia or exam stress To help all students Counseling & Happiness cell under the aegis of Division of student Relationship (DSR ) has planned a session specially to talk about this kind of stress . Join this session to learn techniques , tips and tricks to get rid of exam stress and score good results . title: Post Matric Scholarship scheme for SC & OBC students from Manipur has been opened for registration for the session 2020-21. (Re. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201112/001) : (11/12/2020)
body: Registration process for applying in Post Matric Scholarship scheme for SC & OBC for Manipur students has been started for the session 2020-21. The students have to apply online for this scholarship scheme by using the following link:- Link:- https://osmsmanipur.in/ Last date of scholarship: - 22nd December 2020 Eligibility Criteria for MOBC scholarship: 1. Scholarship holder under this scheme will not avail any other scholarship / stipend for pursuing the same course from any other government agencies/department. 2. The annual income of parents/ guardian from all sources is as under: Income Ceiling: For SC Students – Less than Rs.2,50,000/- (Per annum) For OBC Students – Less than Rs.1,50,000/- (Per annum) 3. Students, who are applying for new course or who want to change their course, they should apply the scholarship in the Fresh Category. If applied in Renewal Category, application will be rejected. Every first year of a course (no matter he/she got the scholarship in the previous year) should apply the scholarship as “FRESH”. 4. Students having a study break of less than 3 (Three) years should upload an Affidavit/Break Certificate stating the reason of break in his/her academic studies from the competent authorities. 5. Students having a study break of more than 3 (three) year will not be eligible for this Scholarship under any circumstances. 6. Students who, after having completed their educational career in one professional line, e.g., LLB after B.T/B. Ed will not be eligible. 7. Intern students will not be eligible for this Scholarship under any circumstances. Note: Incomplete entries, wrong entries, Over income, double applications, non-furnishing of the required certificate and documents and absence of Head of Institution’s signature on Institute Verification Form will be rejected. Scan Documents required for verification are as under: 1. DMC of 10th class. 2. DMC of last qualification. 3. Bank passbook copy of applicant. 4. Aadhaar Card of applicant. 5. Residential Certificate. 6. Latest Income Certificate issued by the competent authorities/executive magistrates 7. Caste certificate copy of applicant issued by the competent authorities/executive magistrates. 8. Fee Receipts (For the Current Session 2020-21). 9. LPU id card of the student. 10. Passport Size photo. 11. Student have to submit the Bank authorization letter with stamp and signature of the Bank also paste one Revenue stamp on right end corner of the authorization letter (students can download the authorization letter from link) https://osmsmanipur.in/backend/web/index.php?r=registration%2Finstruction) (Format enclosed) 12. Institution Verification form (students must download from link and submit along with the scholarship form) https://osmsmanipur.in/backend/web/index.php?r=registration%2Finstruction) (Format enclosed) The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying for this scholarship scheme can also be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of student:- Link: - UMS Navigation -----> Scholarship Management System ------> Scholarship Policies -------> Session 2020-21 ----->Post Matric Scholarship for SC/OBC students from Manipur. All the eligible students have to submit the scan copies of the above mentioned documents on email id scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in on or before 10.12.2020. In case of any query the students can call at 01824-444378 between 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM ­­The students are advised to mention the University Registration No. and the latest mobile number for proper communication in the email. In case of any grievances, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on email id anil.11928@lpu.co.in.

title: Regarding preference polling of Open Elective for Spring Term 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201111/004) : (11/11/2020)
body: The preference polling for Open Elective shall be started from 12th November, 2020 (1:00 PM onwards) till 18th November, 2020 (12:00 Midnight). The student will be required to fill 5 preferences for the Open Elective in the provided interface. Merit List shall be generated according to CGPA criteria. Details of allocation mode can be referred from attachment Allocation Criterion. In the current open elective polling, student has to choose the courses (as per programme scheme) to study in the next term i.e. 20212 as Open Electives. For the open electives to be studied in the subsequent terms, separate polling stations shall be scheduled prior to start of each term. In order to facilitate the students to make the choice when the polling for Open Elective starts, School wise folder of list of Open Elective to be offered to you is available at the link: Important Links---->Examination Instructions and Guidelines----->Open Elective Folder The link to participate in preference polling is given below- UMS Navigation--->Learning Management System---->Open Elective Course Preference Or through LPU TOUCH app at the link “Open Elective Course Preference” OE allocation criteria, Disclaimer and User Manual for using polling interface are attached below. For any query, please contact your school Academic Operations Coordinator (AOC) on the email ID as per list attached below. The polling is only applicable to the students for the Program and Batch details as per the attached file. Note: 1. The allocation of OEs through polling shall be done through allocation criteria mentioned in the interface and NOT ON FIRST COME FIRST SERVE BASIS. 2. Polling process is just for recording preferences. Polling for a particular OE does not guarantee its allocation to the students. 3. Students who are already studying Open Minor course will not be allowed to participate in the preference polling of Open Elective. 4. title: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201111/003) : (11/11/2020)
body: Registration process for INSPIRE scholarship has been stated. Total of 10,000 scholarships are available annually under this scheme. The scholarships are limited to the candidates who have passed Class XII in the year 2020 only from various recognized Indian State and Central Boards and studying regular courses in natural/ basic sciences three years B.Sc., B.Sc. (Hons), four years B.S and five years integrated M.Sc./M.S. Programs in any UGC recognized College/ University/ Institutions in India. Last date for the scholarship is 31st December 2020 The link for INSPIRE Scholarship is as under: Link: http://online-inspire.gov.in/ Eligibility Criteria for INSPIRE Scholarship: 1. The applicant must be within the age group of 17-22 years. 2. Performance in Board examinations within the cut-off threshold (top 1%) for State or Central Board Examination in the year 2020 at Class XII level as listed in table 1 in attached file. 3. Performance in any of the specified Competitive Examinations within stipulated cut off ranks recipient of various scholarships and medals as listed in Table 2 & Table 3 in the attached file. 4. The applicants who are among the top 10,000 rankers in Joint Entrance Examination of IIT, AIEEE (top 20,000 rankers) & cleared CBSE-Medical (AIPTM) and have opted to study Natural/Basic Sciences are eligible. Scan documents to be uploaded on portal are as under: 1. Passport size photograph. 2. Community /Caste Certificate (if student belongs to SC/ST/OBC) 3. Eligibility Note/ Advisory Note (if provided by State or Central Government (Not mandatory). 4. Class 12th Marksheet. 5. Class 10th Marksheet. 6. Certificate specifying Rank or Award in JEE (Main)/ JEE (Advanced)/ NEET/ KVPY /JBNSTS/ NTSE / International Olympic Medalists [Only if the candidate is eligible under this criteria] 7. Endorsement Form/ Certificate signed by the Principal of the College/Director of the Institute/Registrar of the University. (Mandatory) 8. Bank Passbook of student. 9. Aadhar Card of student. Note: 1. The Scheme in its current format does not include courses in Engineering, Medicine, Technology and other Professional/Technical /Applied Science Courses. 2. The applications must be submitted through the on-line mode only on the scholarship portal. 3. Incomplete or wrongly filled up application or application with lack of essential documents will summarily be rejected by the concern authority. 4. The applicant’s own valid and functional email address must be used for submission of the On-line application. The status of the application will be informed only through On-line portal to the student. 5. Do not submit more than one application on the portal. 6. The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying for these scholarship schemes can also be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login:- Link: - UMS Navigation---->Scholarship Management System---->Scholarship Policies---->Session 2020---->INSPIRE Scholarship All the eligible students have to submit the scan copies of the above mentioned documents on email id scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in . In case of any query the students can call at 01824-444378 between 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM. The students are advised to mention the University Registration No. and the latest mobile number for proper communication. In case of any grievances, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on email id anil.11928@lpu.co.in

body: NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge (NHERC) - 2021 is organized at United States of America every year under the aegis of NASA at US Space and Rocket Center, Huntsville, Alabama. The competition is based on research and manufacturing of Rover which will be manufactured by the team without using any commercial parts available. Lovely Professional University is one of the 4 teams from India selected to compete in this event from last 3 years and this year also, LPU got selected and going to compete. This year, Student Research and Project Cell-DSW will be recruiting a team to compete for NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge-2021 at USA. A team of dedicated, skilled and hardworking members will be formed after personal interview that will be representing LPU Team (VISIONAUTS) in NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge 2021. The team will comprise of 6 departments: 1: Manufacturing 2: Designing 3: Suspension and steering system 4: Transmission 5: Administration 6: Promotion Interested students, who are willing to participate in the competition, can register themselves. The Total Expense for the event which include (Team registration fee, Air fare/ticket (both way), hotel stay, local travel for competition at Alabama- USA, manufacturing of Rover and transport cost of rover is INR 2, 70,000.Visa fee is Excluded and to be borne by the student separately irrespective of the VISA granting. Other terms and conditions will be elaborated during personal interview. Note- Students once register themselves cannot withdraw their name as names once finalized has to be sent to embassy by the organizer for visa formalities. title: Regarding uploading of required documents on UMS interface and related timelines for Project, Dissertation and similar courses to be eligible to appear in final ETP viva (Autumn term 20211) (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201107/001) : (11/7/2020)
body: This is for the information of all the students registered in project, dissertation and similar courses (Annexure-I), that the following documents are to be uploaded on the UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines (Annexure-I) to be eligible to appear in the Final End Term Presentation (ETP). 1. Uploading of soft copy of final report All the students need to prepare the final report for their research/ project work as per the guidelines attached (Annexure-II) and upload the soft copy of the same in three parts i.e. PDF File-1, PDF File-2 and PDF File-3 via their UMS interface as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-I by visiting the following link: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details-->Upload Research Project Report/Internship Certificate-->Project/Dissertation/Internship i) In PDF File 1, Students need to upload their Complete Project/ research Report. ii) In PDF File 2, Students need to upload “only Content Report” which is without any student identification Information (e.g. Student’s Name, Registration Number or Title Page). Important point- 1. The guidelines attached with this announcement for the preparation of the final reports are suggestive and can vary as per the nature and amount of the work done due to current situation. 2. In case where the students have not performed the experimental work, they can include the detailed discussion about the literature review done till date as part of the final report, research methodology/ experimental discussion to be done in successive term/s. iii) In PDF File 3, Plagiarism Report is to be uploaded for Standalone Project(s), Capstone-II, Dissertation–II or Dissertation- III (As per Annexure-I). Allowed Plagiarism limit shall be as per the LPU Policy which has been described under the following link available on UMS: https://www.lpu.in/academics/pdf/research-policy.pdf In continuation to the UMS announcement made on 21st Oct. 2020, regarding the judicious use of plagiarism detecting software, only URKUND software to be used for checking the plagiarism of the final reports for all the courses. 2. Uploading the detail of the research publication/ copyrights on UMS: In reference to the UMS announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200819/002, dated- 8/19/2020, it is mandatory for each student/ student group to have mandatory research publication/ copyrights for the courses (Annexure-I) to be eligible to appear in the final ETP viva. All the students in a specific Project group needs to fill the details of the research publications as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-I by visiting the following UMS link: Link for uploading research publication/Copyright details: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details--->Upload Research Project Publication/Copyright details The screen shots for the use of the interface to upload the research publication details along with Do’s and Don’ts are also attached with this announcement. Important Note- 1. It is mandatory to have the research publication/copyright affiliated to Lovely Professional University otherwise the student would not be -eligible for the Final ETP viva. 2. It is advised that the respective supervisors must ensure the timely uploading of the final report of their students before the last date of submission so that the supervisors get sufficient time to approve or to get the modifications suggested by them incorporated in the final report. No Extension beyond the specified timelines shall be provided for the final report submission through respective supervisor. 3. Respective supervisors must ensure that the reports submitted by the students get approved on or before the last date of submission as specified in Annexure-I. 4. In case extension in report submission is required then the student can apply for maximum of 1 month extension with the applicability of extension fee of Rs 1000/- for final report submission by submitting the Extension request via respective Supervisor to academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in. 5. In case student fails to submit his/her final report as per the specified timelines, R grade shall be applicable. Any queries can be directed to Mr. Mohit Prakram, (COC), Projects and Internships Cell on academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in or in Block-Room: 30-302B.

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (11/5/2020)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Schedule for the Online Test for GENC Next Profile of COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS (OC.450.2021.17641) : (11/4/2020)
body: This is for the information of all the concerned that the online test for GENC NEXT Profile of COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS (OC.450.2021.17641) is scheduled as follows: Date: 04-Nov-2020 Time: 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM Test Guidelines: 1. The candidates need to take the test on a computer/laptop system, equipped with a working Web-Cam (external or built-in) and smooth internet connectivity throughout the test session. 2. Candidates are advised to take the test in all fair means. 3. The test system is built with various artificial intelligence mechanisms to track malpractice and any extended help. Any candidate found to be using unfair means would be disqualified from the recruitment process without notice. 4. Other than the intended candidate, should an image of any other person be captured in the vicinity during the test process, the candidate’s test will be disqualified. This disqualification may happen at any stage of the process and is solely a discretion of the Cognizant team. 5. Do not try to click ‘Print Screen’ or Copy the content while the test is in progress. The system will disqualify the candidate instantly. Use of mobile phones and cameras during the entire duration of the test is strictly prohibited. 6. There should not be any hindrance to the Web-Cam’s lenses. It should not be covered with any object and should always have the candidate right in front of it. 7. While taking up the online test, candidates are advised not to move out of the test screen, e.g., Do not open another tab or application like notepad, excel or web browsers like Google, etc. The Test will be locked permanently if a candidate is found switching through windows while taking the Test. 8. In case the test stops/halts due to an Internet or electricity failure, you will be able to resume your assessment from the same point you got logged out, without losing any time. Wait for 5 minutes, login again using the same credentials, and click on ‘Resume Incomplete Test’. You will have to select your name and continue attempting the test. 9. After you login into the test, you have to finish the test within 3 hours. Please ensure that you have smooth electrical and internet connectivity to complete the test in one go. 10. Ensure to click on the Allow option for both web-cam and Location to start your assessment. General Instructions: 1. There is no negative marking. 2. You have to answer all the questions mandatorily, i.e., you cannot skip any question. 3. Do not click on Module Exit or Test Exit. 4. You cannot change your answer of any previous question. Test Basic Requirements: 1. Ensure you have a Webcam connected to your System. 2. Browser/OS Requirements: This Assessment is supported by the below listed. Browsers/Versions only Google Chrome (version 50.0 and above). Mozilla Firefox (version 50.0 and above). 3. In case you are taking the test on Windows 8, make sure you disable all the popups/ notifications. 4. Ensure you are in a quiet area with good lighting. 5. An internet connection with good speed will ensure a smooth process, for this exercise please ensure that you have at least 2mbps. 6. To ensure your webcam is working fine please Click Here 7. Please ensure that you finish your test within 3 hours of logging into the test. 8. Students are advised to attempt the test any time before the end time Following are the steps for taking the test: 1. For taking the AMCAT exam, click on the URL provided in the email and follow the instructions. 2. At several instances during the test, you will be prompted to allow the access of your webcam. Please grant the test software access to your webcam. 3. Once your webcam has been tested, enter the username and password provided to you in this mail. Select the check box, “I have read & agree to the terms and conditions and wish to continue the test". 4. Click on Start New Test and fill the registration form. 5. Click on Start Test. A 14 digit number will appear, this is your AMCAT ID. Kindly save it for your future reference. 6. To answer a question click on Confirm and then Next to submit your answer. 7. Please enter same Cognizant ID that you have entered in the first round 'Gen C' test process. Disclaimer: 1. Cognizant does not entertain payments of any kind from candidates or vendors for employment. 2. If you encounter anyone who claims to offer jobs at Cognizant in return for any benefit (monetary or non-monetary), please do not entertain them. Please be informed that Cognizant shall not be held responsible for any such instances or payments you make. 3. We recommend that you do not respond to spam emails/ messages you do not trust; never disclose your personal or financial details to anyone you do not know. 4. To ascertain that you are receiving an official call from cognizant, please ensure you collect the recruiter's details (full name; employee ID; and mobile number) during the call. Please refrain from paying/depositing any money and promptly add it to your spam mail. In case you have already made a payment, please lodge a complaint with the nearest police station so that necessary action can be taken against the imposters. 5. Your entire AMCAT online assessment will be recorded and will be referred for compliance/audit purposes

title: Webinar on “Innovation & Intellectual Property Rights(IPR)” : (11/3/2020)
body: Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship is organizing a webinar on Innovation & Intellectual Property Rights(IPR). Registration Link: http://tiny.cc/IPR-webinar (Limited seats with first come first serve basis) Date :9th Nov, 2020 Time: 6 pm -7pm Registration Fess- Free Last date for registration 8th Nov. 2020 (4:00P.M) This webinar will provide you with an introduction to basic concepts and definitions of Intellectual Property (IP) and Role of Innovation in Intellectual Property Rights (IPR). Additionally, participants are given a first overview of existing practices and processes related to IP management. We invite all the faculties and students to register and join the event. title: Enrollment into Career Services-2022 graduating batch (first year students) : (10/30/2020)
body: Kind attention: First year students expected to graduate in 2022. This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the first year students graduating in 2022 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2022. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. Registration Deadline: a) Students completing Career Services Registration from 01-Nov-2020 to 10-Dec-2020 will be allowed to have immediate access to placement/internship opportunities (irrespective of Full/Part PEP Fee payment). b) Students completing Career Services Registration from 11-Dec-2020 to 31-Dec-2020 will be allowed to have access to placement/internship opportunities w.e.f. 01-Mar-2021 (irrespective of Full PEP fee payment or Part PEP fee payment). Registration Process: The registration process is divided into two parts- PROCESS STEP-1 and PROCESS STEP-2. For the details of Step 1 and Step 2, please refer the attached file. Part Payment option: Looking into the request of the students, as a special gesture university has enabled the part payment option of the PEP fee payment for the 2022 graduating batch students. They need to pay 50% of the applicable PEP fee now (immediately at the time of registration process) and rest by 31st Dec 2020. If student takes Exit from Career services, then rest of the PEP fee will be made due against the student fee account for recovery. Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. In case of any queries, (a) Kindly contact your Training and Placement Coordinators in School Placement Office of your respective block, OR (b) Log an RMS request in category PLACEMENT and subcategory CAREER SERVICES POLICY REGISTRATION.

title: AMCAT Diagnostic exam for B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA/MBA/Pharmacy placement registered students graduating in 2022. : (10/29/2020)
body: Dear Aspirants, Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled a Placement Assessment test named - AMCAT Diagnostic on 01st Nov – 04th Nov 2020. Good Score in AMCAT will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So consider it very important as this is your first step towards a great career ahead. About AMCAT: AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates on the basis of their core skills which includes reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills.. AMCAT is also known as an employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. Aspiring Minds conducts AMCAT Test for engineering freshers who apply for IT jobs. The objective of the AMCAT test is to grade the students based on their performance. For more information you can also visit on web link: https://www.myamcat.com Key Pointers: 1. AMCAT test is mandatory for all students attached in the file. 2. Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not appear in the test, hence attempt it with full spirit. 3. You must go through the detailed guidelines of the test (file attached) before attempting. 4. Duty leave will not be provided for the attempting test. So attempt accordingly. 5. Login Credentials of the test will be shared with you through UMS my messages on the day of the test.

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (10/27/2020)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Uploading of (MGN231) Final Report by Students to be eligible to appear in final ETP viva (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201027/001) : (10/27/2020)
body: This is in continuation to the UMS announcement Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200424/001 dated 24/4/2020 where following three options were provided to the students to complete their Community Development course (MGN231) for Autumn Term, 20211 which were supposed to be completed latest by August 2020. All the students who are registered in MGN231 are now required to upload their final reports as per the following details to be eligible to appear in the final ETP viva which shall be conducted tentatively from 9th Nov 2020 onwards. The exact schedule shall be communicated with the students via UMS messages in due course of time. The screenshots of the interface for uploading of the reports are also attached with the announcement for reference. 1) Option-1: Students who have completed their Community Development Project with NGO/local organizations involved in community development areas offering work from home All the students who have completed their community development project as per Option-1 are required to upload the soft copy of their final report (with project completion certificate from respective NGO/local organization as the first page of the report) as per the attached guidelines in PDF format (Maximum up to 5MB) on UMS by visiting the following UMS link: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project> Internship Certificate > Upload File 2) Option-2: Students who have completed their Community Development Project through MOOCs All the students who have completed their community development project as per Option-2 are required to upload the soft copy of their final report (with MOOC certificate as the first page of the report) as per the attached guidelines in PDF format (Maximum up to 5MB) on UMS by visiting the following UMS link: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project> Internship Certificate > Upload File 3) Option-3: Students who have completed their Community Development Project on the best practices related to community development followed by different organizations All the students who have completed their community development project as per Option-3 are required to upload the soft copy of the final report as per the attached guidelines in PDF format (Maximum up to 5MB) on UMS by visiting the following UMS link: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project> Internship Certificate > Upload File Important Note- 1. All the respective heads of the School are requested to ensure the timely uploading of all the required documents by the students of their respective Schools. 2. The last date for uploading of the required documents for all the options described above is 7th Nov 2020. No extension shall be given beyond the last date. 3. The project completion certificates/ MOOC’s certificate to be included in the report by the students must be authenticated by the respective organization. 4. The reports without the completion certificates/ MOOC’s certificate shall not be considered for evaluation and all such students shall be awarded with R grade in the said course. 5. All the students are required to give presentation on the day of evaluation. The students need to be ready with the soft copy of the reports which may be asked by the panel members. 6. Students should select the correct course code i.e. MGN231 while uploading the soft copy of the final report. 7. If the required documents are not uploaded by the student as per timelines, ETP Viva for all such students shall not be conducted. Further, they will be marked absent and will be awarded R grade. 8. In case the Report/certificate produced at the time of viva is found to be different from the one uploaded on the UMS, concerned student’s result may be cancelled and all such students may be awarded R grade. Any queries can be directed to Mr. Mohit Prakram, (COC), Projects and Internships Cell on academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in or in Block-Room: 30-302B.

body: Division of Innovation & Entrepreneurship presents an Webinar on Opportunities In IOT : A Trojan Horse of the Modern Day . Complete IoT embedded device security is not just about the device but involves the entire product’s identity, data/control integrity, and services traversing the cloud. A device can no longer be looked at as an island, it is a part of a system. And given the cross-domain interactions enabled by IoT it could be a part of many systems. Also, depending on where the device is deployed. The webinar paves a path to understand the students/faculties about the basic building blocks of IOT structure and the perquisite knowledge and requirement to enter the world of Internet of Things. The webinar also enables the various career opportunities of IOT . Topics to Be covered: 1)What specifically are the present and future security concerns that product developers have to consider when deploying solutions in a specific segment? 2)IOT building Blocks and Architecture. 3)Who are the real customers, and what are they asking for? 4)What are the business/financial benefits for customers to consider in IoT Embedded Security, Reliability and Safety? body: "INTERNATIONAL GO-KART CHAMPIONSHIP 2020 SEASON-8 VIRTUAL EVENT AWARD CEREMONY" About Event: From being India's first student go-kart event in 2012, we are proud to announce that we are the first to conduct a go-kart event virtually in India, opening a large possibility in student motor sports in our country.This year we have a total of 19 teams who participated in the virtual event and we even have a team from Bangladesh University of Engineering & Technology and an all-girls team from UP.The entire event had to be re-tailored to the virtual platform so that no team is left behind with respect to learning. title: Webinar on “How to publish with F1000 Research” by Taylor & Francis Group : (10/21/2020)
body: Division of Innovation & Entrepreneurship invites the students and faculty to join webinar on “How to publish with F1000 Research” Taylor & Francis Group. Date- 29th Oct. 2020 Time- 06:00 P.M-7:00 P.M Registration link-https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/2491086939650201871 (Meeting link will be shared through E-mail) Speaker- Liz Allen, Director of Strategic Initiatives at F1000 Research Liz is involved in shaping new initiatives & partnerships to promote and foster open research publishing. Prior to joining F1000Research in 2015, Liz has spent over a decade leading the Evaluation Team at Wellcome and have considerable experience working across funding agencies. She is currently a Board Director for Crossref, co-founder and one the project leads on the CRediT project (Contributor Roles Taxonomy), & serve on the Advisory Board for the Software Sustainability Institute. She was one of the first Board Directors at ORCID and involved in its establishment from 2010. She is a Visiting Senior Research Fellow in the Policy Institute at King's College London. Registration fees- Free Target Audience - Open for faculty & students of LPU This webinar will cover Open Access Publishing with F1000Research (Taylor and Francis Publishers) which is an open access publishing platform designed to speed up research publication. Key features are: - Rapid Publication of research articles - Capable of publishing multiple research formats such as research articles, data sets, null results, protocols, posters etc. - Article level indexing in major indexes like Scopus, PubMed, PubMed Central, MEDLINE, Europe PMC, Scopus, Chemical Abstract Service, British Library, CrossRef, DOAJ and Embase. - Better outreach, more citations compared to traditional publishing models - Reduce research waste by virtue of its unique publishing model “Publish first & Peer review post publication” - Promote research use and reproducibility - Transparent peer review - Plan S compliant platform trusted & used by Department of Biotechnology (DBT) Govt of Indian in alliance with Wellcome Trust. Bill & Melinda gates Foundation, European Commission & leading universities and research labs across world The session will cover: - The F1000Research publishing model - The different types of research you can publish with F1000 Research - How to submit your research on F1000Research - A deep dive into the F1000 Research editorial and peer review process - Q&A For any query please send an email to rajesh.23402@lpu.co.in

body: Most of us are curious to find out , how color effects behavior ? Some interesting facts about color psychology · Different colors evoke different emotions · Colors can even play tricks on your mind. · You’re more likely to forget something when it’s in black and white. · It’s possible to be afraid of certain colors. · Men and women see red differently. · 62-90% of a first impression is due to colors. Your personality is important because it determines how you interact with your environment and the people around you. Psychologist from Counseling & Happiness cell has selected a very interesting personality Test on color Psychology Colorquiz is a five minute personality test based on decades of research by color psychologists around the world. This test is based on the work of Dr. Max Lûscher and is widely used in Europe and overseas. There are a number of corporations and colleges that use this test as part of their hiring/admissions processes. There are no complicated questions to answer, you simply choose colors with a click of the mouse! Your test results are completely confidential. Take the test now. http://www.colorquiz.com/ We care greatly about your Psychological and Mental wellness, To connect - Mail us at- Counseling.Happiness@lpu.co.in . title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (10/20/2020)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Schedule for the Online Test of ON CAMPUS Drive of DXC TECHNOLOGY (OC.21051.2021.17578) : (10/19/2020)
body: This is for information of all concerned that the online test for the registered students of ON CAMPUS Drive of DXC TECHNOLOGY (OC.21051.2021.17578) is scheduled as follows: Date: 20-10-2020 Time: 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM NOTE: Students will receive the test details in their registered email ids. Basic Requirements for the Online Test: 1) A Personal Computer / Laptop only. 2) A Webcam 3) Resume (as per DXC format) 4) Smooth and uninterrupted Internet connectivity (throughout the testing session) Browser Requirements:This Assessment is supported by the below listed Browsers/Versions only. 1) Mozilla Firefox (version 60 and above) 2) Google Chrome (version 60 and above) In case you're taking the test on Windows 8, make sure you disable all the popups/ notifications. IMPORTANT NOTE: 1) This test duration is approximately 110 minutes, please make sure you are finishing the test in one go. 2) You are NOT allowed to open any other Browser/Switch between the Test Screen and other windows/minimize the Test Window. 3) The Test will automatically log out if a candidate is found switching through windows while taking the Test. General Instructions: 1) There is no negative marking. 2) You have to answer all the questions mandatorily i.e. you cannot skip any question. 3) You cannot change your answer to any previous question. 4) Please do not use headphones/earphones while taking the test, presence of any such wearable will result in disqualification from the hiring process. 5) If somehow your test is stopped in between, (due to power failure/internet disconnection) wait for five minutes. Now, you may login again using the same details. After entering the username and password click on Resume Test. Select your AMCAT Id and then re-enter the Username and Password to login again. Please ensure that you Resume Test within 2 hours of your test being stopped. (Please Resume the Test only after 5 minutes of halting the Test). Following are the steps for taking the test: 1) For taking the AMCAT exam, click on the URL provided in the email. 2) Enter the username and password provided to you in this mail. 3) At several instances during the test you will be prompted to allow the access of your webcam, please allow the permissions. 4) Kindly read Data Protection Notice and click on 'Accept & Proceed'. 5) Select the check box "I have read & agree to the terms and conditions and wish to continue the test" 6) Click iCard image as per instructions given on the screen. 7) Click on Start Test. A 15 digit number will appear. This is your AMCAT ID. Note it and keep it safe with you. 8) To answer a question click on Confirm and then Next to submit your answer. 9) Please do not click on the ‘Tab button’ of your keyboard, your test will get invalidated and you will not be able to resume the test. NOTES for Attendance: 1. It is Mandatory to mark drive attendance as duty leaves will be given based on the attendance marked by the students. 2. body: This is for the information of all the concerned that the online test of Shared Day 1- COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS (OC.450.2021.17641) is scheduled as follows: Date: 16-10-2020 & 17-10-2020 UserName & Password: Shared directly by the company with the candidates on their registered email ids.. IMP NOTES: Students should be ready with the soft copy of the documents required to be uploaded for the online test. Important Instructions for the Online Test: 1) Candidates take the test where there is ample lighting. It is their responsibility to ensure that their image is clearly captured. 2) A candidate can attempt the test only once. 3) Candidates can take the test on a computer/laptop with a functioning web-cam (external or built-in) and continuous internet connectivity for the 120-minute duration. Malpractices disclaimer for candidates: 1) Any malpractice will lead to disqualification: 2) If we find any evidence of malpractice through mechanisms that we have enabled- that particular candidate would be disqualified from the recruitment process as per discretion of the Cognizant team. 3) If any other person’s image, besides that of the test taker, is captured in the vicinity during the test process, that candidate’s test will be disqualified as per discretion of the Cognizant team. Candidates should refrain from doing the following: 1) While taking up the online test, please do not move out of the test screen- all instances and movements are captured for audit purposes. 2) Opening another tab or application like notepad, excel or web browsers like Chrome, Firefox etc. are strictly prohibited.** Please do not try to click print screen or copy the content while the test is in progress- this will lead to instant disqualification. 3) Please ensure that the web-cam is not covered with any object. The web-cam should be focused on the candidate throughout the test duration. 4) Please do not try to take any snapshots while the test in progress. 5) Usage of mobile phones, cameras and any other external devices during the duration of test is strictly prohibited. The test will automatically be terminated upon detection of any external devices. Interruptions during the test: 1) On the event that the test is halted due to internet or electricity failure, the candidate will be able to resume his/her assessment from the same point it was logged out without losing any time. 2) We request the candidates to wait for 5 minutes and then login again using the same credentials. 3) Once logged in, the candidates needs to click on ‘Resume Incomplete Test’ and select his/her name and continue the test. 4) The candidate will be able to login within 2 hours of the test being halted. 5) The test will expire if the candidate does not login again within the 2-hour time frame.

body: Division of Innovation & Entrepreneurship presents a Webinar on "Opportunities In IOT : A Trojan Horse of the Modern Day". A Complete IoT embedded device security is not just about the device but involves the entire product’s identity, data/control integrity, and services traversing the cloud. A device can no longer be looked at as an island, it is a part of a system. And given the cross-domain interactions enabled by IoT it could be a part of many systems. Also, depending on where the device is deployed, The webinar paves a path to understand the students/faculties about the basic building blocks of IoT structure and the perquisite knowledge and requirement to enter the world of Internet of Things. The webinar also enables the various career opportunities of IoT . Topics to Be covered: What specifically are the present and future security concerns that product developers have to consider when deploying solutions in a specific segment? IoT building Blocks and Architecture. Who are the real customers, and what are they asking for? title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (10/15/2020)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light colour clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. -Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. -Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

People with high psychological well-being report feeling capable, happy, well-supported and satisfied with life. Why It Matters? · Studies have discovered that people with higher psychological well-being are more likely to live healthier and longer lives. · They are also more likely to enjoy a better quality of life. · Better psychological well-being also is associated with fewer social problems. · They have better relationships · They become more confident and achieve their goals · They can face challenges in life · They are less stressed and deal better with anxiety .
