body: This is for the information of all the concerned that the online test of Shared Day 1- COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS (OC.450.2021.17641) is scheduled as follows: Date: 16-10-2020 & 17-10-2020 IMP NOTES: 1. The further update on test link and batch schedule will be shared soon through UMS Announcement. 2. Students should be ready with the soft copy of the documents required to be uploaded for the online test. Important Instructions for the Online Test: 1) We request the candidates to take the test where there is ample lighting. It is their responsibility to ensure that their image is clearly captured. 2) Each candidate will be assigned a unique username and password along with his or her Cognizant ID. We will enable these during the time slot planned for your campus. 3) A candidate can attempt the test only once. Malpractices disclaimer for candidates: 1) Any malpractice will lead to disqualification: 2) If we find any evidence of malpractice through mechanisms that we have enabled- that particular candidate would be disqualified from the recruitment process as per discretion of the Cognizant team. 3) If any other person’s image, besides that of the test taker, is captured in the vicinity during the test process, that candidate’s test will be disqualified as per discretion of the Cognizant team. Candidates should refrain from doing the following: 1) While taking up the online test, please do not move out of the test screen- all instances and movements are captured for audit purposes. 2) Opening another tab or application like notepad, excel or web browsers like Chrome, Firefox etc. are strictly prohibited.** Please do not try to click print screen or copy the content while the test is in progress- this will lead to instant disqualification. 3) Please ensure that the web-cam is not covered with any object. The web-cam should be focused on the candidate throughout the test duration. 4) Please do not try to take any snapshots while the test in progress. 5) Usage of mobile phones, cameras and any other external devices during the duration of test is strictly prohibited. The test will automatically be terminated upon detection of any external devices. Interruptions during the test: 1) On the event that the test is halted due to internet or electricity failure, the candidate will be able to resume his/her assessment from the same point it was logged out without losing any time. 2) We request the candidates to wait for 5 minutes and then login again using the same credentials. 3) Once logged in, the candidates needs to click on ‘Resume Incomplete Test’ and select his/her name and continue the test. 4) The candidate will be able to login within 2 hours of the test being halted. 5) The test will expire if the candidate does not login again within the 2-hour time frame.

title: Compliance to Code of Ethics : (10/12/2020)
body: This is for the information of all students that compliance to code of ethics policy given in chapter 2 of the Research Policy of The Lovely Professional University should be strictly followed which has been framed in line with the UGC guidelines. Plagiarism of content should be avoided and wherever required proper copyright permissions should be taken to include relevant information/images/data etc. from another research document. Also cite the relevant document from where the data is being fetched. University has provided access to two plagiarism detecting software (PDS) i.e. Turnitin and URKUND to check the extent of similarity. Students/Scholars shall approach their respective supervisors for the scanning of their documents through PDS. Any deviation from the policy may invite strict disciplinary actions as stated in the research policy extract of which is given below: Level Similarities Penalties in case of plagiarism in submission of thesis and dissertations Penalties in case of plagiarism in academic and research publications/IPR Level 0 Upto 10% Minor Similarities, no penalty Minor Similarities, no penalty. Level 1 10% to 40% Submit a revised thesis and dissertations within stipulated time period not exceeding 6 months. Leave points, bonus points and incentives will be withdrawn if plagiarism is reported. Level 2 40% to 60% Debarred from submitting a revised thesis and dissertations for a period of one year Withdraw manuscript, shall be denied a right to one annual increment, Shall not be allowed to be a supervisor to any new Master’s, M.Phil., Ph.D. Student/scholar for a period of two years. Level 3 Above 60% Registration for that programme shall be cancelled Withdraw manuscript, Shall be denied a right to two annual increments, Shall not be allowed to be a supervisor to any new Master’s, M.Phil., Ph.D. Student/scholar for a period of three years. Detailed policy may be referred at the following link: https://www.lpu.in/academics/pdf/research-policy.pdf For any clarity regarding this Academic Resource Cell shall be contacted at academic.reosurce@lpu.co.in.
uploaded_by: Office of HOD Central Library *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

We have planned these tests from 10th October onwards. A detailed plan is attached below for your reference. Please find mentioned below a brief description of the tests. Write X: The only Written English Test driven on Machine Learning to help you in assessing the overall quality of a candidate's written sample. major factors that attribute towards the construction of a great write-up like grammar, usage, mechanics, style, organization and development etc. Write X will be conducted in 2 different versions; Write X Essay Writing & Email Writing. SVAR: IVR Based, Spoken English Test to assess Student's Fluency, Pronunciation, Active Listening, Spoken English Understanding, Grammar, Vocabulary & more. A crucial test essential for Interviews or Client based Interaction Profiles. Based on CEFR Levels. Important pointers: 1. Both AMCAT (SVAR & Write X) tests are mandatory for every student. 2. Re-attempt is not allowed in any of these tests. So attempt carefully. 3. For SVAR & WriteX, kindly check your schedule in the file attached below with name “SVAR-WriteX”. Make sure that you take this test on the date mentioned against your name. 4. SVAR test can only be taken on app. (app link for android/IOS is mentioned in the SVAR instructions file. 5. For SVAR make sure you have Earphones/Headphones with mic in working conditions. 6. Kindly go through to the instruction files of both tests before taking your test. 7. Duty leave will not be provided for these tests. So attempt accordingly. 8. Test username and password will be shared on the test day itself through UMS My messages.

title: Registration for Annual Seminar of Ph.D. Scholars (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201007/002) : (10/7/2020)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. Annual Seminar evaluation tentatively scheduled from November-December 2020. All the Ph.D. Scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs before July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for Annual Seminar after each year from the date of successful completion of SAS. The main aim of the Annual Seminar is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the suggestions given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation. The scholars are required to follow the following 2 steps for appearing in Annual Seminar: 1. Registration and uploading of Annual Seminar report Scholars who have successfully received their candidacy letter and have cleared at least one End Term Report (ETR) are eligible to register for Annual seminar through the following UMS interface link: UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Scholar Activity Detail Interface for registration will remain active till 10th November, 2020. Once the scholar has registered for the Annual seminar, he/she needs to upload the annual progress report for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC). The Scholar should visit the following UMS link for uploading of the annual progress report. The guidelines for preparation of report and presentation along with their respective formats are attached with UMS announcement. UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Scholar Activity Detail The last date for uploading the Annual Seminar report is 10th November, 2020. All eligible scholars as per attached list (List of Eligible Scholars for Annual seminar) are required to register for Annual Seminar Evaluation and Upload their files. 2. Recommendation of the Annual Seminar Report by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor Once the Scholars have registered for the Annual Seminar and uploaded their Annual seminar report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> PhD Seminar File Verification --> Annual --> Download The last date for verification of the Report is 14th November, 2020. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of Annual seminar report: 1. Scholars need to register for the evaluation and upload the annual report strictly as per the guidelines for completion of registration process or else their registration shall be deemed cancelled and they will be marked absent for the evaluation. 2. As per current guidelines, the scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such scholars who have either missed or are Not Recommended in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the Annual Seminar evaluation. 3. The scholars must upload single PDF file for Annual seminar report duly verified and signed by respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for Annual Seminar) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 4. In case the scholars are unable to get a signed copy of the synopsis from their respective supervisor due to prevailing situating of novel coronavirus, they can upload the soft copy of the synopsis without supervisor signature. But it is required that the synopsis uploaded by them must be strictly as per the guidelines and it must be verified by their supervisor through UMS interface on or before 14th November 2020. 5. Scholars are required to submit one hard copy of the reports duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/co-supervisor/administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) in Block 30, room Number– 302B till the date which shall be communicated separately in due course of time. 6. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 7. No extension shall be given for uploading report beyond the last date. 8. Scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using Annual registration interface) before registering and uploading the Annual seminar reports at the interface. For Recommendation of the Annual seminar report: The scholar must upload the Annual seminar report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. For online evaluation of the Annual Seminar a) The research scholar must have laptop/ desktop or any other suitable mean with proper audio/ video facility. b) The research scholar must have high speed internet facility to appear for the online Annual Seminar evaluation. c) The research scholar must be well versed with the online google meet platform. It is strongly advised that the research scholar must present his/ her presentation to the respective supervisor prior to appearing in actual Annual Seminar evaluation so that there is no confusion on the day of evaluation. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues: 1. Registration/Uploading of synopsis write at rdc.sas@lpu.co.in or contact Ms. Poonam (7986479141)/ Dr. Jashanpreet Singh (8968875079) 2. Supervisor / Co-supervisor /fee related query write at drp@lpu.co.in.

body: This is in reference to Ph.D. End Term Report (ETR) evaluation tentatively scheduled from December, 2020 onwards. All the Ph.D. Scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs before July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to register for End Term Report (ETR). The main aim of the End Term Report (ETR) is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the suggestions given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation The scholars are required to follow the following 2 steps for appearing in ETR: 1. Registration and uploading of ETR All eligible scholars as per the attached list (List of scholars eligible for ETR) are required to register for ETR evaluation and upload their files through following UMS link: UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Scholar Activity Details --> Upcoming Activity The last date for registration and uploading of report is 20th December, 2020. 2. Recommendation of End Term Report by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor Once the Scholars have registered and uploaded their End Term Reports for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> PhD Seminar File Verification --> ETR The last date for verification of the synopsis is 23rd December, 2020. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of End Term Report: 1. As per current guidelines, the scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such scholars who have either missed or are Not Recommended in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the ETR evaluation. 2. The scholars must upload single PDF file for End Term Report duly verified and signed by respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETR ) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 3. In case the scholars are unable to get a signed copy of the synopsis from their respective supervisor due to prevailing situation, they can upload the soft copy of the synopsis without supervisor signature. But it is required that the synopsis uploaded by them must be strictly as per the guidelines and it must be verified by their supervisor through UMS interface on or before 20th December, 2020. 4. Scholars are required to submit one hard copy of the report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) in Block -30, Room Number- 302B till the date which shall be communicated separately in due course of time 5. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 6. No extension shall be given for uploading report beyond the last date. 7. Students should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using ETR registration interface) before registering and uploading the End Term Reports at the interface. For Recommendation of the End Term Report The scholar must upload the End Term Report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues: 1. Registration/Uploading of synopsis write at rdc.etrs@lpu.co.in or contact Mr. Gagandeep Singh Cheema (7888816232) 2. Supervisor / Co-supervisor /fee related query write at drp@lpu.co.in.

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (10/6/2020)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a bite from the Aedes aegypti mosquito. This mosquito is a daytime biter, both inside and outside homes, and is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. They breed inside and outside the home in containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. --Signs and symptoms This disease has a sudden onset and symptoms may include: • Fever for 3 to 7 days • Intense headache and pain behind the eyes • Muscle and joint pain • Loss of appetite • Vomiting and diarrhea • Skin rash • Bleeding, usually from the nose or gums. Recovery is sometimes associated with prolonged fatigue and depression. Repeated episodes of dengue fever may result in excessive bleeding and shock but, with appropriate treatment, are rarely fatal. --Prevention • There is no vaccine to prevent human infection by this virus. • Wear long, loose fitting, light coloured clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. Mosquitoes can bite through tight clothing like jeans. • Personal protection and the environmental management of mosquitoes are important in preventing illness. • When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. • Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. • Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label. * All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use.

title: Registration for Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201003/003) : (10/3/2020)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from November-December 2020 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs after July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after each 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. The main aim of the End Term Presentation is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation The research scholars are required to follow the following two steps for appearing in ETP: Step-1. Registration and uploading of ETP reports All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation and upload their files through following UMS link: UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Research scholar Activity Details --> Upcoming Activity The last date for registration and uploading of report is 2nd November 2020. Step-2. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar have registered for the ETP and uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> PhD Seminar File Verification --> ETP The last date for verification of the synopsis is 5th November 2020. Evaluation of the End Term Presentation (ETP) via online platform It is for the information of the all concerned that due to the prevailing situation, the End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation shall be planned via online platform google meet. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of ETP report: 1. As per current guidelines, the research scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such research scholars who have either missed or have been awarded “Not Recommended” in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the ETP evaluation. 2. The research scholars must upload single PDF file for end term report strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP October 2020) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 3. In case the research scholars are unable to get a signed copy of the synopsis from their respective supervisor due to prevailing situation, they can upload the soft copy of the synopsis without supervisor signature. But it is required that the synopsis uploaded by them must be strictly as per the guidelines and it must be verified by their supervisor through UMS interface on or before 18th September 2020. 4. Research scholars are also required to submit 2 hard copies of the reports duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) in Research Degree and Evaluation Cell (RDEC) (Block-30; Room Number- 302B) for which the separate communication shall be made in due course of time. 5. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 6. No extension shall be given for registration for c beyond the last date. 7. Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using ETP registration interface) before registering and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. For Recommendation of the ETP Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. For online evaluation of the End Term Presentation (ETP) a) The research scholar must have laptop/ desktop or any other suitable mean with proper audio/ video facility. b) The research scholar must have high speed internet facility to appear for the online ETP evaluation. In case, the research scholar has registered for the ETP evaluation but could not appear for the same due to any issue, he/she shall be marked absent for the evaluation. Result of all such research scholars for ETP evaluation shall stand as “Not Recommended” and the will be required to re-register for the next scheduled ETP evaluation with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. c) The research scholar must be well versed with the online google meet platform. It is strongly advised that the research scholar must present his/ her presentation to the respective supervisor prior to appearing in actual ETP evaluation so that there is no confusion on the day of evaluation. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query, write us at rdc.etrs@lpu.co.in or contact Mr. Gagandeep Singh Cheema (7888816232)/ Dr. Jashanpreet Singh (8968875079).

title: Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS) of Ph.D. Scholars (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201003/002) : (10/3/2020)
body: This is in reference to the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) which will be conducted tentatively in Nov-Dec 2020. It is mandatory for all research scholars to clear SAS within two years from the date of registration otherwise their admission may be deemed as cancelled. The key points for SAS evaluation are as follows: a) To finalize the Title of the proposed research work. b) To finalize the Objectives of the proposed research work. c) To finalize the research methodology of the proposed research work. I The research scholars are required to follow the following three steps to be eligible for appearing in SAS. 1. Registration for SAS: Research scholars who have successfully completed their course work or exempted from the course work (due to M.Phil.) can register for SAS seminar through the interface available in the UMS at the following link. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development --> SAS Registration form Interface for registration will remain active as for following : School Last Date of Registration For All Schools apart from Mittal School of Business (Management) 31st October 2020 For Mittal School of Business(Management) 25th October 2020 Only those research scholars should register for their SAS seminar who are willing to appear for the evaluation in the month of Nov-Dec, 2020 and have the approval of their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor for the same. 2. Uploading of synopsis: Once the research scholar has registered for the SAS, he/ she needs to upload the synopsis for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the panel of experts. The research scholar needs to visit the same UMS link for uploading of the synopsis of SAS along with the other relevant documents. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development -->SAS Registration form The last date for uploading the synopsis report is as following: School Last Date of Uploading For All Schools apart from Mittal School of Business 7th November 2020 Mittal School of Business 25th October 2020 3. Recommendation of the synopsis by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded the synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> Scholar File Verification --> SAS --> Download The last date for verification of the synopsis is as follows: School Last Date of Recommendations from Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor For All Schools apart from Mittal School of Business 10th November 2020 Mittal School of Business 30th October 2020 II. Evaluation of the State of the Art Seminar (SAS) via online platform It is for the information of the all concerned that due to prevailing situation the SAS evaluation shall be planned via online platform google meet. Important Note: For Registration: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt of their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisors/Co-Supervisors/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension shall be given for registration beyond the last date. c) No request for deregistration shall be entertained beyond the last date of registration and the scholar shall be marked absent. d) Research scholars having pending dues are not eligible to register for the SAS evaluation. Therefore, research scholars are requested to clear the pending dues and get registered for the SAS evaluation before the last date. e) If a research scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but is absent at the date of seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. For preparing the presentation the research scholar should refer to the format for SAS presentation (Attachment) c) No extension shall be given for uploading synopsis report beyond the last date. d) Read the attached guidelines very carefully before uploading the synopsis. e) All the research scholars must upload single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I as per the attached guidelines or else their SAS registration may be cancelled. He/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation (with fee of Rs. 5000/-). No second chance shall be given to upload the synopsis. f) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using SAS registration interface) before registering and uploading the synopsis at the interface. It is strongly advised that the research scholar must present his/ her presentation to the respective supervisor prior to appearing in actual SAS evaluation so that there is no confusion on the day of evaluation. All the research scholars who have completed two years from date of registration and have the last chance to appear in the SAS seminar in Nov-Dec, 2020 are advised to avail this chance as no further extension shall be given for the same. title: Regarding Updation in proration policy in case of duty leave for term 20211 onwards (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/201003/001) : (10/3/2020)
body: Students participating in sports or other cultural events organized by the university are provided with duty leaves as per the university guidelines so that the any of the academic tasks, Mid Term Examination (MTE) or ETE examination missed by the students can be taken care of by providing the benefit of proration on the basis of attempted academic tasks or rescheduling of the exams. Further, certain updation in the existing proration guidelines have been made while taking in consideration formal and informal feedback from all concerned stakeholders. These guidelines are applicable to all the students who have missed any of the academic task or examination (either theory or practical), due to duty leave. The Key changes in the CA proration policy are mentioned below: a) Scope of the guidelines: Benefit of proration shall not be provided if the student had chance to appear in the minimum number of required CA components or have missed ETE. b) Treatment of compulsory CA component in case of duty leave: The compulsory component shall be treated as non compulsory component for purpose of proration. c) Treatment of Project/Dissertation courses: Provision for proration of project/Dissertation courses is included in the policy which was not covered in the earlier guidelines. d) Process of CA proration: Actual process of proration with examples has been explained in the updated guidelines. The detailed policy is also attached for your kind reference. In case of any concern, please contact Mr. Manu Prakram in 30-302B or through email at: aerc@lpu.co.in

title: Registration Open for Dare To Innovate(LPU Innovation Hackathon) : (9/30/2020)
body: Student Research & Project Cell under the Aegis of Division of Student Welfare providing this platform with innovative themes and seeking the participation from students to come with unique solution to the societal problems and win exciting prizes. SRPC is organizing Dare to Innovate (LPU Innovation Hackathon) to bring each school of LPU under a single umbrella and to learn from pragmatic aspects of science and technology. It is a nationwide initiative to provide students a platform to solve some of pressing problems we face in our daily lives, and thus inculcate a culture of product innovation and a mindset of problem solving. This platform will play a vital role to connect the inter-disciplinary students for the realization of innovative and useful products for the society. This event will also provide platform to the students for participating national / international competitions. Exciting prizes for the winners!!!! Process for Participation: 1) Students need to register in the following link to participate in the launch event of Dare to Dream. 2) The registration link for Participation in Dare to Innovate competition will be disclosed in the launch event. 3) The Themes/Problem statement for the hackathon will be disclosed in the event. Note :Only the students present in the launch event will be allowed to participate in Dare to Innovate(LPU Innovation Hackathon) 2020. Launch Date of the LPU Innovation Hackathon 5th October 2020 from 6 pm Onwards. The student must register themselves in Launch event in order to participate in the LPU Innovation Hackathon. Registration Link for Dare to Innovate Launch Event: http://bit.ly/hackathon-launch Registration Fee: No Registration Fees The event is open for all engineering and non engineering Students.

title: Prime Minister Scholarship Scheme for wards of RPF/RPSF (Ministry of Railway) –reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200930/001) : (9/30/2020)
body: Prime Minister Scholarship Scheme (Fresh/Renewal) for wards of RPF/RPSF (Ministry of Railway) has been started on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2020-21. The link for National Scholarship Portal is as under:- Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Last date for the scholarship is 31-10-2020. Courses Eligible for PMSS 1. Professional Degree Courses like BE, B.Tech, B.Ed, BBS, BCA, MCA B. Pharma, etc. duly recognized by the respective Government Regulatory Bodies, such as All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), University Grants Commission (UGC), National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) etc. (Master Degree Courses are not eligible for PMSS except MBA, MCA). 2. Students pursuing their studies from Distance Education are not eligible. 3. Students must have secured 60% and above in Minimum Educational Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 12th Std., Diploma/Graduation. Scanned copies of the following documents are required for verification purpose:- 1. Marksheets of class 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Provisional Academic Transcript etc.) 2. Fee Receipts (Current session 2020-21). 3. The latest Income Certificate (Issued by the designated State/UT authority). 4. Aadhaar Card of student (linked with bank account). 5. Bank Passbook Copy of student (linked with Aadhar Card). 6. Domicile / Residence Certificate. 7. Recent Passport Size Photo (1). 8. Scholarship received proof of previous year(s) (In case of Renewal Application). 9. Bonafide Certificate with recent Photograph (Passport size), [Student needs to download the certificate from his/her NSP login ID and email the scan copy on the email id of scholarship cell (i.e. scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in) 10. Service certificate issued by respective offices of the serving personnel. All the eligible students have to submit the scan copies of the above mentioned documents on email id scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in on or before 15.10.2020. In case of any query, the students can call at 01824-444378 between 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM The students are advised to mention the University Registration No., NSP Application ID & Password and the latest mobile number for proper communication. In case of any grievances, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on email id anil.11928@lpu.co.in Note:- a) While entering the university detail the students have to select the University name as per the following detail:- State – Punjab, District – Kapurthala, University Name – Lovely Professional University, JULLUNDER (AISHE CODE-U-0379). b) The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying for these scholarship schemes can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login:- Link: - UMS Navigation---->Scholarship Management System---->Scholarship Policies---->Session 2020---->National Scholarship Schemes. c) Signed Bonafide Certificate will be sent to you on your email id within two/three working days after receiving the complete documents from your side.

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (9/28/2020)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a bite from the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Only the female mosquito transmits the dengue virus. This mosquito is a daytime biter, both inside and outside homes, and is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed inside and outside the home in containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. They do not breed in creeks, swamps, pools or other bodies of water. --Signs and symptoms This disease has a sudden onset and symptoms may include: • Fever for 3 to 7 days • Intense headache and pain behind the eyes • Muscle and joint pain • Loss of appetite • Vomiting and diarrhea • Skin rash • Bleeding, usually from the nose or gums. Recovery is sometimes associated with prolonged fatigue and depression. Repeated episodes of dengue fever may result in excessive bleeding and shock but, with appropriate treatment, are rarely fatal. --Prevention • There is no vaccine to prevent human infection by this virus. • Wear long, loose fitting, light coloured clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. Mosquitoes can bite through tight clothing like jeans. • Personal protection and the environmental management of mosquitoes are important in preventing illness. • When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. • Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. • Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label. * All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use.If Desert Cooler are in use please change water daily

title: Short Term Course on Scientific Writing Using Typesetting Software LaTeX : (9/26/2020)
body: LaTeX is a high-quality typesetting system. It includes features designed for the production of technical and scientific documentation widely used in academia for the communication and publication of scientific documents in the fields like mathematics, statistics, engineering, chemistry, physics, economics and medical sciences. Many publishers provide style files for writing scientific papers in LaTeX. One of the biggest advantages in using this software is that the user need not concentrate on the layout of the document because LaTeX takes care of all that by itself, resulting in really impactful and professional documents. Here is an opportunity to hone your skill in Short Term Course on Scientific Writing Using Typesetting Software LaTeX from the Maestros of Lovely Professional University. As per program schedule appended below: Title Short Term Course on Scientific Writing Using Typesetting Software LaTeX Resource Panel Dr. Sanjay Mishra, Professor, School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences, Lovely Professional University Dr. Ajeet Kumar Srivastava, Professor, School of Computer Science and Engineering, Lovely Professional University Date October 17- 18; 24- 25, 31, 2020 & November 01, 2020 (Sat-Sun) Time 4:00-06:30 pm Content Synopsis Refer Brochure attached Registration Fee Rs. 750/- Register at https://www.lpu.in/hrd/ Registration Closes Oct 14, 2020 (Wednesday) NOTE: Duty leave will be applicable for registered students as per policy. title: CoCubes (Pre assess -2) Exam for (Engineering/MCA) placement registered students graduating in 2021. (9/26/2020)
body: Dear Aspirants, Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled a renowned exam named CoCubes (Pre Assess-2) for 2021 batch placement registered students(Engineering/MCA) on 28th Sep , 2019. Good Score in CoCubes will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So come prepared and attempt the exam with full enthusiasm. Why CoCubes Exam is important: CoCubes is an industry renowned testing platform. Most of the companies use CoCubes as their testing platform during placement drives. CoCubes is India’s largest assessment and hiring platform. CoCubes helps us in gauging your current performance levels which will be utilized to design customized training inputs for the students. You can know more about CoCubes at: www.cocubes.com Important Instructions: It is mandatory for all the students. Total duration of the exam is 240 minutes approx. containing different modules. You must attempt every module. In case you miss any module your exam will not be considered as completed and will not be evaluated for final result. You can attempt any module at any time within the given time span (9 AM, to 11 PM). Score of this exam will also be considered for shortlisting students for special training and companies therefore students should attempt this seriously. Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not take this exam, hence attempt the test with full spirit. No Duty Leave will be provided for test attempts. title: Invitation for the Talk show with "Dr Ritesh Malik" an entrepreneur, doctor and investor : (9/25/2020)
body: Invitation for the Talk show with "Dr Ritesh Malik" an entrepreneur, doctor and investor The talk show aims at creating awareness for the students in the fields of entrepreneurship, startup, and importance of self-branding in relation with the times of pandemic. After the success of seven talk shows of Student organization SANYUKT CULTURE, under Division of Student Welfare, Lovely Professional University is hosting another live talk show in series "SAMVAADH" with an eminent personality who stood as an inspiration for the people who want to try in the field entrepreneurship and one who have already entered in the idea and looking for strategies to attract investors. About Guest: Dr. Ritesh Malik, an entrepreneur, doctor, and orator with distinguished speaking skills. title: Recoup Classes for freshmen who have taken late admission (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/200925/001) : (9/25/2020)
body: This is for the information of all the students who have taken late admission (excluding students of October batch) or were not able to attend classes due to prolonged leave due to pending entrance / qualifying exams, medical emergency or any other valid reason, that they are now being given an opportunity to cover their missed syllabus via Recoup Classes. The students who have joined late or have attendance less than 40% till date are eligible to register for the Recoup Classes. The students shall be offered academic guidance on the first 3 syllabus units of the course code. Depending on the count of student registration, these classes shall be conducted in two modes: Mode 1: Lecture notes/Power Point Presentations/Video lectures shall be shared with the students for self-study and regular doubt clearing sessions shall be conducted by the faculty to resolve their queries. Mode 2: Regular live online video lectures shall be conducted by the faculty according to a pre-informed schedule. The final mode applicable for a particular course code shall be informed to students before the start of classes. The classes shall be conducted in the month of October 2020 tentatively starting from 5th October 2020. The timings of the classes shall be in evening i.e. after 5:00 PM to avoid any clash with the regular scheduled lectures. Note: Once registered, it is mandatory for the student to attend of the Recoup classes/lectures. Attendance shall be mandatory, and it shall be considered towards the final regular attendance calculation of the term. In case, a student does not want to attend classes/seek guidance for all 3 syllabus units but wishes to attend classes/seek guidance for 1 or 2 syllabus units only for a particular course code, the student can also do so while registration by selecting only the desired syllabus units. Link for registration of Recoup Classes: UMS Navigation --> Examination System --> Exam Registration --> Recoup Class Registration The guidelines regarding the interface usage have been attached below. title: Fresh/Renewal Scholarship for Minorities students has been opened on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200924/001) : (9/24/2020)
body: Fresh/ Renewal scholarship registration process on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2020-21 has been started. Students who come under Minorities i.e. Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain and Zoroastrians (Parsis) can apply for the Post Matric Scholarship- Minorities and Merit Cum Means scholarship on National Scholarship Portal. The link for applying for the scholarship is as under: Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Last date for the scholarship is 31-10-2020. Eligibility Criteria 1. Scholarship will be awarded to the students who have secured more than 50% marks or equivalent grade in the previous year final examination. 2. The annual income of parents/guardian from all sources is as under:- · For Post Matric Scholarship Minorities equal to or less than Rs.2.00 lakh per annum. · For Merit Cum Means equal to or less than 2.5 lakh per annum. 3. The students obtaining benefits under these scholarship schemes shall not be allowed to avail benefits under any other scholarship scheme implemented by State Government / UT Administration. Documents to be required for verification are as under:- 1. Academic details 10th onwards (e.g. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Provisional Academic Transcript etc.) 2. Fee Receipts (Current session 2020-21). 3. The latest Income Certificate (Issued by the designated State/UT authority). 4. Copy of Aadhaar Card of student (linked with bank account). 5. Copy of Bank Passbook Copy of student (linked with Aadhar Card). 6. Domicile / Residence Certificate. 7. Recent Passport Size Photo (1). 8. Scholarship received proof of previous year(s) (In case of Renewal Application). 9. Bonafide Certificate with recent Photograph (Passport size), [Student needs to download the certificate from his/her NSP login ID and email the scan copy on the email id of scholarship cell (i.e. scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in) All the eligible students have to submit the scan copies of the above mentioned documents on email id scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in on or before 15.10.2020. In case of any query the students can call at 01824-444378 between 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM The students are advised to mention the University Registration No., NSP Application ID & Password and the latest mobile number for proper communication. In case of any grievances, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on email id anil.11928@lpu.co.in Note:- a) While entering the university detail the students have to select the University name as per the following detail:- State – Punjab, District – Kapurthala, University Name – Lovely Professional University, JULLUNDER (AISHE CODE-U-0379). b) The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying for these scholarship schemes can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login:- Link: - UMS Navigation--->Scholarship Management System--->Scholarship Policies--->Session 2020--->National Scholarship Schemes. c) Signed Bonafide Certificate will be sent to you on your email id within two/three working days after receiving the complete documents from your side.

title: Central Sector Scholarship scheme for students who have above 80th percentile in Class XII of Board Merit list–reg (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200921/001) : (9/21/2020)
body: Students who have above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective Board of Examination in Class XII of 10+2 pattern or equivalent and pursuing regular courses and not availing benefit of any other scholarship scheme including State run scholarship schemes/Fee waiver and reimbursement scheme are eligible under the scheme. Last date for the scholarship is 31st October 2020 The link for National Scholarship Portal is as under:- Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Eligibility Criteria for CSSS for Fresh Students 1. The Students must secure above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective Board of Examination in Class XII. This scholarship is not applicable for distance education students. 2. Student should not be availing benefit of any other scholarship scheme 3. Students pursuing Diploma courses are not eligible for this scheme. 4. The parental/family income from all sources must be less than Rs. 8 lakh per annum. Eligibility Criteria for CSSS for Renewal Students 1. For applicants applying under renewal category, it is mandatory to pass the each subsequent academic year of the professional courses being pursued by them with minimum 50% marks. 2. The students must maintain 75 % attendance in all semesters. Documents to be required for verification are as under :- 1. Academic details 10th onwards (e.g. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Provisional Academic Transcript etc.) 2. Fee Receipts (Current session 2020-21). 3. The latest Income Certificate (Issued by the designated State/UT authority). 4. Copy of Aadhaar Card of student (linked with bank account). 5. Copy of Bank Passbook Copy of student (linked with Aadhar Card). 6. Domicile / Residence Certificate. 7. Recent Passport Size Photo (1). 8. Scholarship received proof of previous year(s) (In case of Renewal Application). 9. Copy of Board Merit List. 10. Bonafide Certificate with recent Photograph (Passport size) [Student needs to download the certificate from his/her NSP login ID and email the scan copy on the email id of scholarship cell i.e. scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in]. All the eligible students have to submit the scan copies of above mentioned documents on email id scholarships-ssiv@lpu.co.in on or before 15.10.2020. In case of any query, call at 01824-444378. The students are advised to submit the latest mobile number & email id for proper communication. In case of any grievances, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on email id anil.11928@lpu.co.in Note: 1. While entering the university detail students have to select the University name as per the following detail:- State – Punjab, District – Kapurthala, University Name – Lovely Professional University, JULLUNDER (AISHE CODE-U-0379). 2. Signed Bonafide Certificate will be sent to you on your email id within two/three working days after receiving the complete documents from your side. 3. The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying for these scholarship schemes can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login:- Link: - UMS Navigation---->Scholarship Management System---->Scholarship Policies---->Session 2020---->National Scholarship Schemes.

body: This is for information of all concerned that the online test for students (as per attached list) of ON CAMPUS Drive of HEXAWARE TECHNOLOGIES (OC.11857.2021.17332) is scheduled as follows: Date: 17-09-2020 Time: 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM Duration of Test: 78 minutes IMP NOTE: The assessment must be taken on desktop or a laptop. Taking the assessment on a phone/tablet might lead to your entry being disqualified. INSTRUCTIONS for Test General You have to upload your resume with photo in it & a passport size photo while filling in the custom form for the test. The custom form shall appear once you click the 'Take Assessment' button You will have 13 sections in the assessment, Total number of questions will be 78 Assessment duration is 78 minutes. Plan your time accordingly so that you can attempt all the sections. The test will auto submit at the end of 78 minutes, keep an eye on the timer in your dashboard once you begin your assessment. Assessment begins at 10:00 AM IST on 17/09/20 and need to completed by 12:00 PM IST. Photo and Resume needs to be uploaded before Start of the Test. Proctoring This assessment is browser proctored and video proctored, which means, we will capture if you try to exit full screen mode, copy-paste, tab change, or any other suspicious browser activities. Please ensure there are no photo frames/posters/images in the camera view that the AI might detect as another face in the frame. Common things to watch out for: Photo frames Deity posters Clothing articles depicting a face Scoring The total marks of this assessment is 78. For MCQ questions, you will be scored on the basis of correct answer marked. There is no negative or partial marking. Browser/Internet connection For the better experience, we recommend the latest version of Google Chrome/Chromium or Mozilla Firefox browsers. Take the assessment from a computer with a stable internet connection for the best experience. If something goes wrong with your computer or your internet connection gets disconnected, your previously submitted answers will not be lost. They will remain safe on our servers. You can re-login on our website and continue coding from where you left. However, the timer will remain running. Thus, make sure that you use a computer or a browser that you know works fine. Recommended: Please close all other applications and tabs before taking the assessment. It may happen that sometimes an internal page may not load correctly, due to a network issue. Such issues can be fixed simply by refreshing your assessment window. NOTE for Attendance: 1. title: Updation in the Mid-Term/Test Instructions (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200910/002) : (9/10/2020)
body: The Mid Term Test scheduled for students of 2nd year and onwards shall be held in the online mode and shall start from 15th September, 2020. In this regard the students are advised to go through the below stated points: 1. The date sheet (schedule of examination) shall shortly be provided to you in your UMS login. Kindly refer to the same and strictly adhere to it. The schedule shall be available to you in your “Exam Seating Plan” tab. UMS Navigation---->Examination System---->Exam Seating Plan 2. Mock test are being conducted to apprise the students about the platform for the conduct of the Mid Term Test has been scheduled, the details for the same shall be intimated to the students. Kindly check the same and adhere to the schedule of mock test. 3. An absolutely new platform (other than the platform used for the conduct of the End Term Examination for the previous term) shall be used for the conduct of the Mid Term Test. Hence, it is mandatory for all students to take the mock test so that they get comfortable in using the interface for the test. The students should note that in case they do not appear in the mock test they shall not be allowed to appear in the Mid Term Test. 4. The Mid Term Test shall be held in the online mode and students have to use the URL: myclass.lpu.in to approach the platform for the test. 5. The user name for the test is your registration number and password for the test is same as that of the UMS. Students of 4th year and onwards students can also now access this platform by using their UMS username and password. 6. Pattern of Examination: The examination shall have 30 MCQ questions in the following pattern:- a. There shall be 10 questions from Unit I of the syllabus. b. There shall be 10 questions from Unit II of the syllabus. c. There shall be 10 questions from Unit III of the syllabus. d. All questions shall be compulsory. e. The total duration of the Mid Term Test for each course shall be 60 minutes. f. Each question shall be of 1 mark and there shall be a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer given by the student. 7. Conduct of Examination: a. All questions shall be displayed to the student in the sequential order (i.e. Q. No. 1 followed by Q. No. 2 followed by Q. No. 3 so on upto Q. No. 30). The display shall be one way which means that the student won’t be able to come back to any previous question. This means that all questions shall be displayed to the student. However, in case the student does not want to attempt a question the student can skip the question by pressing the next button but in such a case at any later stage the student won’t be able to come back to that skipped question. b. A student shall be allocated 2 minute (timer monitored) for attempting each question. In this regard the student should note the following: i. After completion of the stipulated time (2 minute) allocated for a question or after successfully attempting the question the student shall be moved to the next question. ii. Time saved (from the stipulated time of 2 minute) for a question shall not be available for the upcoming questions. Once the student has reached the next question the student shall not be able to move to the previous question. 8. The student can attempt the Examination through any of the following two modes: The student can attempt through either of the two modes: Mode1: Through Laptop/Desktop Mode 2: Smart Phone (By using the browser of the smart phone) Details of browser are as mentioned: Windows: Google Chrome 80+ Edge Browser: 80+ Linux: Google Chrome: 80+ Mac OS: Google chrome: 80+ Android: Mobile Chrome 80+ iOS: Safari 13.0 or above However, it is advisable that the student attempts the Examination through Mode 1 i.e. Laptop/Desktop. This shall give optimum opportunity to the student to properly view the questions (which may include diagrams/images/case studies etc. requiring scrolling). 9. Requirement of Examination: Find below the list of certain basic infrastructure requirements for attempting the examination. a. Laptop/Desktop with minimum 2GB RAM. b. Uninterrupted Active Internet connection of 2-3 Mbps speed. The students should also try to make provisions for a backup internet connection. c. For students attempting through smart phone should use smart phones with minimum 2GB RAM. d. Charging facility along with electricity backup for the duration of examination. e. Working webcam of good resolution. f. Allow to access camera and microphone. g. Basic examination stationary including pen, pencil, A4 size sheets, calculator, water bottle etc. h. An isolated place with no distraction and proper lighting as examination area. 10. Proctoring of Examination: The examination to be conducted shall be proctored and there shall be continuous monitoring of candidates appearing in the examination by allocated faculty members. The faculty members shall continuously view the allocated students for invigilation for the complete duration of the Examination. In this regard the students shall ensure the following: a. The webcam of the student is on and sending images during the complete duration of the examination failing which the student shall be disqualified from the examination and shall not be allowed to continue his/her examination. b. In case the student attempts to navigate away from the examination window, after two warnings the examination of the student shall be auto submitted. c. In case a student is found using any unfair means during the examination by the proctor including calling, messaging, using any other device the same shall be treated as an unfair means case and necessary disciplinary action shall be taken. d. In case the student is found misbehaving with proctoring Faculty or seeking any unnecessary help, such a student shall be disqualified from the examination. 11. The link of video explaining various aspects of using the platform to attempt the Mid Term Test is attached along with this communication. Same has also been updated in the seating plan of the students. All the students are advised to judiciously go through the video so that they become familiar and fully equipped to use platform. Link to access the video: https://youtu.be/UQY832NFrv8

Under this partnership, CoL and Coursera are offering unlimited and free access to over 3,800 courses designed to skill and reskill citizens of Commonwealth Member States for livelihoods till 31st December 2020. CoL is offering 7,500 scholarships to eligible Indian citizens on a first cum first serve basis. These courses are offered by highly reputed professors and mentors from well recognised universities and institutions from across the globe. You can browse the list of courses from here: https://www.coursera.org/browse Registration Fee: Free till 30th September, 2020 (Otherwise, you will be paying USD 39 to 89 per month). Registration URL: https://forms.gle/wAmfTSZyzhJkHLSA8 Refer attachment for detailed information. For more information, please write to CoL India Helpdesk at ccwr.india@gmail.com OR Contact Dr. Jatinder Kumar (University Librarian), Ph: 9872842292, Email: jatinder.24171@lpu.co.in

title: Important information regarding Mid Term Examination, Autumn Term, 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200908/005) : (9/8/2020)
body: The Mid Term Test scheduled for students of 2nd year and onwards shall be held in the online mode and shall start from 15th September, 2020. In this regard the students are advised to go through the below stated points: 1. The date sheet (schedule of examination) shall shortly be provided to you in your UMS login. Kindly refer to the same and strictly adhere to it. The schedule shall be available to you in your “Exam Seating Plan” tab. UMS Navigation---->Examination System---->Exam Seating Plan 2. A mock test to apprise the students about the platform for the conduct of the Mid Term Test has been scheduled, the details for the same shall be intimated to the students. Kindly check the same and adhere to the schedule of mock test. 3. An absolutely new platform (other than the platform used for the conduct of the End Term Examination for the previous term) shall be used for the conduct of the Mid Term Test. Hence, it is mandatory for all students to take the mock test so that they get comfortable in using the interface for the test. The students should note that in case they do not appear in the mock test they shall not be allowed to appear in the Mid Term Test. 4. The Mid Term Test shall be held in the online mode and students have to use the URL: myclass.lpu.in to approach the platform for the test. 5. The user name for the test is your registration number and password for the test is same as that of the UMS. Students of 4th year and onwards students can also now access this platform by using their UMS username and password. 6. Pattern of Examination: The examination shall have 40 MCQ questions in the following pattern:- a. There shall be 13 questions from Unit I of the syllabus. b. There shall be 13 questions from Unit II of the syllabus. c. There shall be 14 questions from Unit III of the syllabus. d. All questions shall be compulsory. e. The total duration of the examination shall be 60 minutes. f. Each question shall be of 1 mark and there shall be a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer given by the student. 7. Conduct of Examination: a. All questions shall be displayed to the student in the sequential order (i.e. Q. No. 1 followed by Q. No. 2 followed by Q. No. 3 so on upto Q. No. 40). The display shall be one way which means that the student won’t be able to come back to any previous question. This means that all questions shall be displayed to the student. However, in case the student does not want to attempt a question the student can skip the question by pressing the next button but in such a case at any later stage the student won’t be able to come back to that skipped question. b. A student shall be allocated 1 minute & 30 seconds (timer monitored) for attempting each question. In this regard the student should note the following: i. After completion of the stipulated time (1 minute & 30 seconds) allocated for a question or after successfully attempting the question the student shall be moved to the next question. ii. Time saved (from the stipulated time of 1 minute & 30 seconds) for a question shall not be available for the upcoming questions. Once the student has reached the next question the student shall not be able to move to the previous question. 8. The student can attempt the Examination through any of the following two modes: The student can attempt through either of the two modes: Mode1: Through Laptop/Desktop Mode 2: Smart Phone (By using the browser of the smart phone) Details of browser are as mentioned: Windows: Google Chrome 80+, Edge Browser: 80+ Linux: Google Chrome: 80+ Mac OS: Google chrome: 80+ Android: Mobile Chrome 80+ iOS: Safari 13.0 or above However, it is advisable that the student attempts the Examination through Mode 1 i.e. Laptop/Desktop. This shall give optimum opportunity to the student to properly view the questions (which may include diagrams/images/case studies etc. requiring scrolling). 9. Requirement of Examination: Find below the list of certain basic infrastructure requirements for attempting the examination. a. Laptop/Desktop with minimum 2GB RAM. b. Uninterrupted Active Internet connection of 2-3 Mbps speed. The students should also try to make provisions for a backup internet connection. c. For students attempting through smart phone should use smart phones with minimum 2GB RAM. d. Charging facility along with electricity backup for the duration of examination. e. Working webcam of good resolution. f. Allow to access camera and microphone. g. Basic examination stationary including pen, pencil, A4 size sheets, calculator, water bottle etc. h. An isolated place with no distraction and proper lighting as examination area. 10. Proctoring of Examination: The examination to be conducted shall be proctored and there shall be continuous monitoring of candidates appearing in the examination by allocated faculty members. The faculty members shall continuously view the allocated students for invigilation for the complete duration of the Examination. In this regard the students shall ensure the following: a. The webcam of the student is on and sending images during the complete duration of the examination failing which the student shall be disqualified from the examination and shall not be allowed to continue his/her examination. b. In case the student attempts to navigate away from the examination window, after two warnings the examination of the student shall be auto submitted. c. In case a student is found using any unfair means during the examination by the proctor including calling, messaging, using any other device the same shall be treated as an unfair means case and necessary disciplinary action shall be taken. d. In case the student is found misbehaving with proctoring Faculty or seeking any unnecessary help, such a student shall be disqualified from the examination. 11. The link of video explaining various aspects of using the platform to attempt the Mid Term Test is attached along with this communication. Same has also been updated in the seating plan of the students. All the students are advised to judiciously go through the video so that they become familiar and fully equipped to use platform. Link to access the video: https://youtu.be/UQY832NFrv8

title: Schedule for the Online Test of on campus drive of COMMVAULT SYSTEMS INDIA PVT. LTD (OC.3477.2021.17434) : (9/8/2020)
body: This is for the information of all the concerned that the Online Test for the shortlisted students (as per attached list) of on campus drive of COMMVAULT SYSTEMS INDIA PVT LTD is scheduled as follows: Date: 8th September 2020 Time: 7.00 PM NOTES: 1. Students will receive the test link in their registered email ids. 2. On receiving the mail: Complete Demo Test (Mandatory): Access the link in the invitation email & complete ASAP 3. Access for Main Test : Access the same link & refresh your page . Goes live SHARP at 7:00 PM TODAY. 4. Look for an email with Subj:: <Commvault>Invitation.... (Dont forget to check your spam folder) AHEAD OF YOUR SLOT: THE SAME LINK & CREDENTIALS Contain your DEMO & MAIN TESTS : LOGIN USING THE CONFIDENTIAL CREDENTIALS YOU WILL RECEIVE SHORTLY Demo Test: Login & complete the Mandatory Demo Test as described in your mail (On Receipt) at the earliest by accessing the URL with your Credentials - ensuring a Timely Start & Smooth Experience. Time Slot: Make a Mental Note of your Screening Paper Time Slot. Login Just-in-Time & wait/refresh your screen per Exact Slots Do Not Miss it. There will be NO RETEST. Check Hardware: Auto-invigilation setup as described in the Invitation email is to be verified & completed during Demo Test & the same hardware is to be used for the Screening (& Main Test if you clear Screening) should be the same RECOMMENDED Config: Windows OS (Strongly Recommended), Linux/Ubuntu/MAC are also fine. You may proceed with the SysCheck if it allows you. + Chrome/Firefox only Multi-Stage Assessment:Commvault Systems has a Multi-stage process - Demo Test (Practice & Setup), Screening Test (SDE, SDET, or BOTH) .....& Main Test for shortlisted YOU OWN The Credentials sent to your Official Email ID. Please keep it CONFIDENTIAL. All Assessment Stage will require you to use SAME CREDENTIALS. DO'S 1. Do keep your College ID CARD next to you during your Test Attempt. 2. Do Click a clear picture during the Mandatory ID capture process - both during your Demo & Main Test. 3. Do Make sure the card is visible to a human 4. Don't have your ID Card Handy? Write down your Particulars on a piece of paper and hold it in front of the camera for a click 5. The note has your Name, Roll number & a message at the bottom saying ID card missing. in BIG LEGIBLE HANDWRITTEN TEXT 6. You are ALLOWED TO KEEP ONLY 1 PAGE OF PAPER & PEN for ROUGH WORK Do not keep any notebooks or textbooks or Additional ElectronicDevices NEAR YOUR WORKING area DONT'S 1. DON'T CHECK YOUR WHATSAPP/PHONE - THE MOMENT VIDEO COMES ON. Do not leave any scope for doubt with your Gaze on the WORKING AREA OF THE SCREEN ONLY. 2.YOUR PHONE SHOULD BE NOWHERE NEAR YOUR WORKING AREA. ANY SHRED OF DOUBT LEAVES YOU PRONE TO DISQUALIFICATION 3. In case you are using a Hotspot, please let it be known that it is not recommended for online interviewing as it is minimum data. However,we recommend that you go ahead and leave the phone AWAY at a few feet, where it is inaccessible to you. 4. DON'T COLLABORATE OR SEARCH EXTERNAL SOURCES - Straight Disqualification, No questions asked. 5. DON'T try to Act as TechSupport for any friends/colleagues. Each person asks their own questions Directly to Support 6. A CLEAR SUPPORT EMAIL & PHONE NUMBER IS PROVIDED IN YOUR MAILS Camera & Desktop activity are an integral part of a valid submission and any activity/text checking/calls is Strictly Viewed leaving you prone to DisQualification. 7. It is a Single Sitting Test . Plan Well Ahead your Laptop, Power Backup (including Battery), Internet Connectivity (we have sent clear recommended requirements). 8. No Leaving the Seat in the midst of your round and will leave you prone to DisQualification. 9. The Test Plays in Full-Screen Session. NO NAVIGATION outside the Full-Screen Session of the Test. It leaves you prone to a Straight Disqualification. 10. In case of Network issues (Only) - DO NOT EXIT SCREEN STRAIGHT AWAY - please see the instructions in the next section clearly. INTERNET & NETWORK/POWER ISSUES/FAILSAFES/RULES&REGULATIONS: 1. Students should have fast & steady internet connection. 2. You shoud have sufficient Laptop backup for TWO HOURS from Test Start Time so power cuts don't impact you. Measures during test taking are : 1. The Assessment platform continuously & automatically saves State of the Paper including Marks of your Answers at Minute Intervals, so rest assured 2.There is ALSO a "Save Responses" button in case you wish to save every now and then The moment your internet goes down, a MESSAGE pops up on top This MESSAGE stays as long as the internet is down ALL ANSWERS (INCLUDING PAPER TIMER) are saved DURING that temporary downtime/glitch - THOUGH, the timer seems to be moving 3. You can continue answering WITHOUT LEAVING SCREEN. It often may be a small/temporary glitch and you can click on "Reconnect" WITHIN THE MESSAGE itself 4. If you reconnect in the same timeframe, the timer will re-sync with the new time on your window - as that time period is considered active If you are STILL UNABLE to connect after a few "Reconnect attempts" - ONLY ON SUCH OCCASIONS YOU MAY PROCEED TO "Directly Close of your test window" and resolve your internet. 5. Once you are ready again, refresh the dashboard to see "Resume Test". The answers until the internet went down & timer will be back at that point. IN EXTREME SITUATIONS CALL THE HELPLINE NUMBER PROVIDED IN YOUR INVITATION EMAIL NOTE for Attendance: 1. It is Mandatory to mark drive attendance as duty leaves will be given based on the attendance marked by the students. 2. The link to mark drive attendance will be open from 6:30 PM to 7:00 PM 3. To mark drive attendance: Go to Placement portal > Mark drive attendance 4. Select the name of the drive & Round for which the attendance has to be marked. 5. Scan the QR code using the Barcode scanner Menu from the LPU Touch App menu 6. In case the student is not able to mark the attendance due to the mobile camera not working, Mobile software not supporting, Internet issue then the candidate can select not able to mark the attendance and save the attendance by selecting a specific reason using the interface. 7 . If any disparity is found between placement drive attendance (Marked by the student using QR SCAN CODE) & company data then action will be taken as per the placement policy.

title: Important information regarding Mid Term Examination, Autumn Term,2020-21. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200907/001) : (9/7/2020)
body: The Mid Term Test scheduled for students of 2nd year and onwards shall be held in the online mode and shall start from 15th September, 2020. In this regard the students are advised to go through the below stated points: 1. The date sheet (schedule of examination) shall shortly be provided to you in your UMS login. Kindly refer to the same and strictly adhere to it. The schedule shall be available to you in your “Exam Seating Plan” tab. UMS Navigation --------> Examination System------>Exam Seating Plan 2. A mock test to apprise the students about the platform for the conduct of the Mid Term Test has been scheduled, the details for the same shall be intimated to the students by today i.e. 7th September,2020. 3. An absolutely new platform (other than the platform used for the conduct of the End Term Examination for the previous term) shall be used for the conduct of the Mid Term Test. Hence, it is mandatory for all students to take the mock test so that they get comfortable in using the interface for the test. The students should note that in case they do not appear in the mock test they shall not be allowed to appear in the Mid Term Test. 4. The Mid Term Test shall be held in the online mode and students have to use the URL: myclass.lpu.in to approach the platform for the test. 5. The user name for the test is your registration number and password for the test is same as that of the UMS. 6. Pattern of Examination: The examination shall have 40 MCQ questions in the following pattern:- a. There shall be 13 questions from Unit I of the syllabus. b. There shall be 13 questions from Unit II of the syllabus. c. There shall be 14 questions from Unit III of the syllabus. d. All questions shall be compulsory. e. The total duration of the examination shall be 60 minutes. f. Each question shall be of 1 mark and there shall be a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrongly attempted question by the student. 7. Conduct of Examination: a. All questions shall be displayed to the student in the sequential order (i.e. Q. No. 1 followed by Q. No. 2 followed by Q. No. 3 so on upto Q. No. 40). The display shall be one way which means that the student won’t be able to come back to any previous question. This means that all questions shall be displayed to the student. However, in case the student does not want to attempt a question the student can skip the question by pressing the next button but in such a case at any later stage the student won’t be able to come back to that skipped question. b. A student shall be allocated 1 minute & 30 seconds (timer monitored) for attempting each question. In this regard the student should note the following: i. After completion of the stipulated time (1 minute & 30 seconds) allocated for a question or after successfully attempting the question the student shall be moved to the next question. ii. Time saved (from the stipulated time of 1 minute & 30 seconds) for a question shall not be available for the upcoming questions. Once the student has reached the next question the student shall not be able to move to the previous question. 8. Requirement for Examination: Find below the list of certain basic infrastructure requirements for attempting the examination. a. Laptop/Desktop with minimum 2GB RAM. b. Uninterrupted Active Internet connection of 2-3 Mbps speed. c. Charging facility along with electricity backup for the duration of examination. d. Working webcam of good resolution. e. Allow to access camera and microphone. f. Basic examination stationary including pen, pencil, A4 size sheets, calculator, water bottle etc. g. An isolated place with no distraction and proper lighting as examination area. 9. Proctoring of Examination: The examination to be conducted shall be proctored and there shall be continuous monitoring of candidates appearing in the examination by allocated faculty members. The faculty members shall continuously view the allocated students for invigilation for the complete duration of the Examination. In this regard the students shall ensure the following: a. The webcam of the student is on and sending images during the complete duration of the examination failing which the student shall be disqualified from the examination and shall not be allowed to continue his/her examination. b. In case the student attempts to navigate away from the examination window, after two warnings the examination of the student shall be auto submitted. c. In case a student is found using any unfair means during the examination by the proctor including calling, messaging, using any other device the same shall be treated as an unfair means case and necessary disciplinary action shall be taken. d. In case the student is found misbehaving with proctoring Faculty or seeking any unnecessary help, such a student shall be disqualified from the examination. 10. The link of video explaining various aspects of using the platform to attempt the Mid Term Test is attached along with this communication. Same has also been updated in the seating plan of the students. All the students are advised to judiciously go through the video so that they become familiar and fully equipped to use platform. Link to access the video: https://youtu.be/z71qx0Bal-k
uploaded_by: Office of HOD Division of Examination *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature
