title: Schedule for the Online Test of One year Internship drive of KEKA (TC.20019.2021.17401) : (9/4/2020)
body: This is for the information of all the concerned that the ONLINE TEST for the shortlisted students (as per attached list) of One Internship drive of KEKA is scheduled as follows: Date:04-09-2020 Time: 05:00 PM IMP NOTES: 1. Test link and the Pass key will be shared 10 minutes prior to the test. 2. Refer attached word document regarding important instructions for the test. 3. Passkey will only be valid for 10 Minutes ( From the time, the test starts ). All the candidates should login within 10 minutes. System will not allow the candidates who login after the passkey expires ( System will show a message that the test time exceeded ) – We will not allow anyone who fails to login within the given time. 4. In case, if the candidate gets an error message or blank screen after they attempt to login,candidate should clear cache, clear browser history and login ( Incognito mode ) before the passkey expires. Candidates need to act quick in this case. 5. If, the candidate gets any issue while logging in using Laptop / Desktop, they should not attempt to take the test using another laptop or desktop – If they do so, the system will detect it as a malpractice and will not allow the candidate to login again. ( Candidate will get – Multiple Logins Found issue ). The same issue will come if, the candidate tries to login using a mobile phone, logs out and tries to take the test using a laptop again. 6. Candidates need to make sure that they have an Un-Interrupted internet connectivity of 2 MBPS ( Minimum ). If, the candidates are having issues with the internet connectivity, they will face a lot of issues – They will not be able to compile the code, the submit button won’t work, the candidate will not be able to move to the next question, etc. In case, if the network is lost and is re-established, please ask the candidates to refresh the page only once ( Press F5 Key ). A warning message will be displayed on the screen. Candidates can click on I agree ( Tick mark the option at the bottom of the warning page ) and then can start taking the test. ( Note : Candidate can only refresh the page only once. If, the candidate refreshes the page more than thrice / come out of the full screen mode / tries to switch between the tabs, the system will consider it as malpractice and the test will be submitted automatically ) Instructions for Programming Test : 1. Programming assessment contains 4 simple programming questions ( Overall 45 Minutes ). Candidates can start with any question, switch to any question at any point of time. 2. Candidate can choose any programming language of their choice. Can also choose different programming languages to answer different questions ( If, they want ). But, the candidates need to make sure they select the programming language in the dropdown given in the application before they start writing the code. If, the selected language and syntax are different – Candidate will get compiler issues. 3. Candidate need to read the question carefully before attempting it: Most of the candidates fail “this test” because they don’t read the question properly. 4. If, it is mentioned in the question not to use any pre-defined functions and If, the candidate still writes the answer using pre-defined functions ( Even after mentioning clearly ), even if the candidate gets the expected output, even if all the test cases pass, the candidate will be given 0 marks for the answer. Example 1 : In the question, if we ask the candidate to reverse a given string and If, it is clearly mentioned in the question not to use any pre-defined function, then if the candidate writes the code using “ String Reverse “ – Then, we will not be considering the answer submitted. Example 2 : In the question, if we ask the candidate to split a string and if, it is clearly mentioned in the question not to use any pre-defined function, then if the candidate write the code using “Split”- Then, we will not be considering the answer submitted. 5. If, it is mentioned in the question not to sort the array, the candidate should not use any kind of sorting logic to answer the question. Even if the candidate solves the question by sorting the array, candidate will not be awarded any marks ( Even if the output is correct ). 6. Candidate should write the login for N. Not for the given example. The example given there is only for the better understanding of the question. If, the candidate HARD CODES for the given example, candidates will not be awarded any marks. 7. Candidates need to make sure that there are No Syntax Errors. 8. In case, if the candidate gets any compiler issues or any other minor issues during the test, please inform the candidate not to worry and waste time. We will be checking every ones code manually again ( we will go through each and every line of code they write ) as a part of our process - We don’t just rely on the compiler and the score given by the system. If, the logic is right, optimized and if works for N and if, the candidate answers the question according to the clause given in the question ( If, any ) – We will still give full marks.

title: CHUNAUTI - NextGen Startup Challenge : (9/3/2020)
body: NextGen Startup Challenge Contest (CHUNAUTI - Challenge Hunt Under NGIS for Advanced Uninhibited Technology Intervention)is an online Challenge under NGIS to find the products &solutions to address the issues/challenges faced during and post pandemic situation. CHUNAUTI is looking to identify and support the solutions which can support Government,industries & public at large for their seamless operations and enabling them to face the varied difficulties& bottlenecks during and post pandemic situation. Who can apply: • The challenge invites the proposals/applications from Indian Start-ups who are working in domain related to software product development. • Start-ups registered with DPIIT under start-up India programme are encouraged to participate in this programme. • Individual Academicians, Researchers, Educators, Entrepreneurs, partnership firms, LLPsmay also participate, however, if they are selectedthen they will have to register as private limited company in a stipulated time (preferably within 3 months). Key Domains: 1. Edu-Tech, Agri-Tech & Fin-Tech Solutions for masses 2. Supply Chain, logistics & Transportation Management 3. Infrastructure & remote monitoring 4. Medical Healthcare, Diagnostic, Preventive & Psychological Care 5. Jobs & Skilling, Linguistic tools & technologies Financial Incentives/Funding Support: • Cloud Credits from leading third-party service providers. • A seed funding of upto Rs. 25.00 Lakhs will be provided through Financial Institution to each beneficiary/supported Start-ups selected through CHUNAUTI under NGIS based on innovative idea, novel solutions, strong team & sound business proposal. * Disbursal of seed fund to Start-ups will be based on milestones achieved,periodic review and recommendations. * Seed funding to Start-ups will be against equity participation by STPI or its affiliate. • Start-ups who are in ideation stage may be selected under pre-incubation programme& mentored for upto six months to evolve their business plan & solution around the proposed idea. Each intern (start-up under pre-incubation) will be paid Rs. 10,000/- per month for a period of 6 months. Timelines & Duration: 1. Application submission– End Date- 07th September 2020 2. Evaluation of Application- 21st September 2020 3. Announcement of result- 28th September 2020 Register here: https://ngis.stpi.in/chunauti/ For any query: Contact: Mr. Harsh at harsh.20370@lpu.co.in

title: Registration for R grade ETP viva for Project, Dissertation or similar (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200901/004) : (9/1/2020)
body: This is for the information of all the students who have been awarded with R grade in Capstone Projects, Dissertations, and similar courses (List attached) in Spring Term 19202 that the interface for the registration in R grade is active now. The students can register for the R grade in 3 steps as follows: 1. Filling of Online Registration Form: All the students having R grade in the list of courses attached are required to apply online for the registration in R grade and pay the R grade registration fee online via visiting following UMS Link: UMS Navigation----> Examination System------> Exam Registration------> R grade courses Registration The Last date for R grade registration and fee payment is 8th Sept. 2020 (without any late fee) and 15th Sept. 2020 (with late fee of Rs.2000/-). Important points- a) The detailed process along with the screen shots to register and pay for the R grade fee is also attached with this announcement as attachment 2. b) No request of R grade registration shall be entertained after 15th September 2020. 2. Uploading Soft Copy of Report: After online registration and paying the requisite fee for the R grade, the students are required to upload the soft copy of final report as per the requirement of the course (List of courses is attached as attachment 1) by visiting the following UMS link: UMS Navigation------>LMS-------> Upload Research Project The last date to upload soft copies of the reports is 16th September 2020. Important points- a) It is expected that the students upload the soft copies of their final report well in advance so that the respective supervisors can recommend the same with in the timelines. 3. Recommendation of the uploaded soft copy of reports through respective supervisors The students are also required to get their soft copies of the final reports recommended by their respective supervisors. The supervisors can visit the following UMS link for the recommendation of the soft copies of the final report uploaded by their respective students: UMS Navigation------>LMS-------> Project-------> Project file Recommendation The last date to recommend the soft copies of the reports is 17th September 2020. Important points- a) All the respective supervisors are required to ensure the timely uploading of the soft copies of the final reports by their students and recommendation of the same within the timelines b) Registration for the R grade shall be considered only after completion of all the above mentioned 3 steps or else the registration shall be assumed incomplete and F grade shall be awarded. c) R Grade viva schedule shall be communicated to the students via UMS my messages at least 7 days in advance from the ETP viva date. d) In case a student does not register for R grade or misses the report submission as per UMS timelines then R grade viva shall not be conducted and grade would be converted to F. Any queries can be directed to Mr. Mohit Prakram, (COC), Projects and Internships Cell on academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in or in Block-Room: 30-302B.

title: Schedule for the Online Test of One year Internship drive of KEKA (TC.20019.2021.17401) : (9/1/2020)
body: This is for the information of all the concerned that the ONLINE TEST for the students (as per attached list) of One Internship drive of KEKA is scheduled as follows: Date:01-09-2020 Time: 12:00 PM NOTE: Test link and the Pass key will be shared 10 minutes prior to the test. Instructions - Online Aptitude Test: 1. Students to use Chrome Browser ( Preferred ), if not available then they can use any other browser. 2. Candidate should only open the test link 5 minutes before the test starts. 3. Once they enter, the application will ask for the below credentials. Email ID - "The Email ID with which the candidates have registered for the Drive " Hall Ticket Number - " Since they have registered for the drive, they should be having already" General issues : Invalid Hall Ticket number / Email ID : If the candidate gives a different Email ID during registration and gives some other Email ID for logging in, they will get this error. During Registration - abc@gmail.com During the test - abc@gmail.com So, students to recheck their Email & Hall ticket number typed and the issue will be resolved. Error Message while logging in : Ask the candidate to try logging in using some other browser, clearing all the cache, and by opening a incognito window. Multiple Logins Found : If, the candidate starts the test in a system and due to "Hardware issue" or "system power off " if, the candidate change their system and try to login from some other system they will get this error. Max Limit Error : In case, if the candidate tries to login late, they will get this error. Choosing the Role : Once the candidates enter the passkey and log in to the application, they will get basic instructions and the application will ask for the role they are looking for. " We expect the candidates to choose the role they want ( Ex- Full-Stack Developer, Front-End Developer, UX Designer, Quality Analyst ( Testing ) etc. If, they clear the aptitude test, the further interview process will be according to the role they choose. " Once they choose the role, they cannot change it later ". Application will also ask if they have attended any training before - They can answer Yes/No. Application will also ask for their skillet - They can mention any skill they have ( Example - Technologies they are familiar with, Communication skills, Interpersonal skills, Leadership skill etc. ) Once they fill-in all the details, then they can start the test. 3 sections in the Online Aptitude Test. Each section will have an individual timer. Candidate can start with any section they want, and move to any section and to any question at any point of time. We have negative marking of 0.5 marks. So please instruct the candidates to only answer the questions they know. Otherwise there is every possibility that they will end up getting -Ve marks. The answers they mark will be saved automatically even In case of power failure, or any other issues. In case if the candidates face such issues, please tell them not to panic. For taking the Online Test, the candidates need to have very good internet connectivity ( Minimum – 2 MBPS ) if, there is a problem with the internet bandwidth the candidates will face a lot of issues ( Example : They will not able to navigate from one section to another, and they will not be able to move from one question to another ). The candidates cannot refresh the page/exit the full screen mode for more than 2 times, if that happens the candidates test will stop/get submitted automatically. Please instruct the candidates not to submit the test unless and until they are done with all the sections. After the test is done ( Time out / The candidate submits the test ), the result of the test is displayed on the screen itself. If, the candidate clears the Online Aptitude test : A message will be displayed - "Congratulations!! You have cleared the test". If, the candidate is not able to clear the test : A message will be displayed saying "Sorry, you couldn't clear the test". NOTE for Attendance: 1. It is Mandatory to mark drive attendance as duty leaves will be given based on the attendance marked by the students. 2. The link to mark drive attendance will be open from 11:30 AM to 12:00 PM 3. To mark drive attendance: Go to Placement portal > Mark drive attendance 4. Select the name of the drive & Round for which the attendance has to be marked. 5. Scan the QR code using the Barcode scanner Menu from the LPU Touch App menu 6. In case the student is not able to mark the attendance due to the mobile camera not working, Mobile software not supporting, Internet issue then the candidate can select not able to mark the attendance and save the attendance by selecting a specific reason using the interface. 7 . If any disparity is found between placement drive attendance (Marked by the student using QR SCAN CODE) & company data then action will be taken as per the placement policy.

title: Enrollment into Career Services-2022 graduating batch (non first year students) : (8/31/2020)
body: Kind attention: Non-first year students expected to graduate in 2022. This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the non-first year students graduating in 2022 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2022. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. Registration Deadline (REVISED): a) Career Services Registration with immediate access to placement/internship opportunities is open till 31st Aug 2020. b) Career Services Registration with access to placement/internship opportunities from 01-Jan-2021 is open till 30th Sep 2020. Registration Process: * Pathway: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: * Process Step-I: Initial Consent for enrollment into Career Services * Process Step-II: Profile Update and PEP Fee payment ** Process Step-I: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. Process Step-1 will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). ** Process Step-II: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-1. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. (At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface). PEP Fee shall be paid online through Placement Registration interface itself. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Student will not be allowed to avail Career Services/PEP activities without paying the PEP test fees. The registration is considered complete only after Process Step-II is successfully completed with applicable PEP fee payment. Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. In case of any queries, (a) kindly contact your Training and Placement Coordinators in School Placement Office of your respective block, OR (b) Log an RMS request in category PLACEMENT and subcategory CAREER SERVICES POLICY REGISTRATION.

body: Most of us are curious to find out, how color effects behavior? Some interesting facts about color psychology · Different colors evoke different emotions · Colors can even play tricks on your mind. · You’re more likely to forget something when it’s in black and white. · It’s possible to be afraid of certain colors. · Men and women see red differently. · 62-90% of a first impression is due to colors. Your personality is important because it determines how you interact with your environment and the people around you. Psychologist from Counseling & Happiness cell has selected a very interesting personality Test on color Psychology Colorquiz is a five minute personality test based on decades of research by color psychologists around the world. This test is based on the work of Dr. Max Lûscher and is widely used in Europe and overseas. There are a number of corporations and colleges that use this test as part of their hiring/admissions processes. title: Guidelines with regard to classes for Students of 3rd year for Autumn Term, 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/200822/001) : (8/22/2020)
body: In an endeavor to further enhance the experience of online teaching, the classes of all the registered courses except open minor/open elective courses for the students of 3rd year will be shifted from “Google Meet” Platform to the “LPU My Class” Platform from Wednesday i.e. 26.8.2020 onwards. All arrangements in this regard have been completed from the University end. In this regard the following are for the important consideration of the students: 1. The link for assessing this platform is myclass.lpu.in 2. In this context, find attached the links to a series of videos explaining various aspects of using the LPU My Class platform. All the students are advised to judiciously go through these videos so that you become familiar and fully equipped to use “LPU My Class” platform. a. How to Join online Class: https://youtu.be/KtxJy6djQFc b. How to Interact with Teachers: https://youtu.be/0BKj03veTmI c. How to Use Presenter Tools: https://youtu.be/cuvwuEyq048 d. Giving Mobile Version Chrome Browser permission in Android phones: https://youtu.be/BO1YQ_P4ki0 Certain important issues with regard to the conduct of online classes on the new platform i.e. LPU My Class worth noting for the students are given below. All students are advised to meticulously go through them and strictly adhere to them: Regarding Time Table and Attendance: 1. The time table of the courses registered to the students in the current term shall remain the same (as earlier) and is available to the students on the dashboard of UMS and Home Page in parallel to the path: UMS Navigation--->LMS--->View Time Table The students are expected to always keep a copy of their time table and ensure that no class is missed. 2. The attendance for a particular online class shall be calculated automatically by the associated software with “LPU My Class” platform. The attendance for each lecture shall be based on the following parameters: a. Ontime during the complete online session for each lecture. b. Participation in the MCQ based polling during the lecture session conducted by the faculty. The students must make a note that the LPU My Class platform has an inbuilt feature through which the faculty can ask MCQ questions from the students and all polling activity shall be done through this only. Conduct of Classes 1. The online classes will be compulsorily held as per the time table on the “LPU My Class” platform. It is reiterated that students should watch the related videos using the links given above, so as to get a clear-cut understanding regarding the use and features of “LPU My Class” platform. 2. Although, the classes shall be held on the “LPU My Class” platform, however, all supporting material for the classes including video lectures, supportive PPTs and explanations, link of YouTube channels, reading materials etc. shall be provided by the faculty through the “LPU LIVE” app. Hence, it is mandatory for all the students to download this app. The students can download the app from Google Play Store or App Store. 3. From the courses offered in the online mode, if some of these courses require practical or hands on learning, opportunity for the same shall be provided to all students when the University re-opens. Academic Tasks (Assignments/Tests) 1. The number and structure of Assignments shall remain the same as earlier intimated to the students and all Assignments shall be allocated to the students and submitted by the students through the UMS only. Access to Online Resources: For the students requiring extra learning materials in addition to their regular classroom activities, University is providing e-resources and online databases for their support: 1. To access these library resources, LPU has also subscribed to a remote access software EzProxy which can be accessed through UMS from outside the campus. The link to access the same is: UMS Navigation---->Library Management System---->e-resources A student can directly login using http://ezproxy.lpu.in/login 2. For complete information regarding University library facilities, kindly visit University Website https://www.lpu.in/academics/libraries.php. LPU Live App: It is again being reiterated that all students must download the LPU Live App as the faculty members shall be extensively using this app for various purposes including providing details about their upcoming lectures, providing additional reading material to the students, for important announcements like allocation of Assignments etc., for doubt clearing activities of the students, for taking up any problems faced by the students in the course of their studies. It is also ensured that we have a dedicated team allocated to handle all your queries and concerns regarding your classes. You can approach your faculty mentor for resolution of your queries or call at 01824-517450 in case of any required support.

title: NPTEL Awareness Workshop for LPU Faculty, Staff and Students : (8/20/2020)
body: E-Learning being the need of the hour, Lovely Professional University encourages faculty, staff and students to participate in Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs). Human Resource Development Center, Local Chapter-LPU invites registration from interested participants for NPTEL Awareness Workshop as per the schedule appended below: Date Aug 25, 2020 (Tuesday) Resource Persons Dr. Sunaina Ahuja, Professor & Associate Dean, HRDC Dr. Savita Gupta, Professor, HRDC Mr. Sarabjit Singh Kwatra, Dy. Dean, HRDC Session Duration 04:00 pm to 06:00 pm Platform Zoom Registration Link Book your Spot Fast at : https://forms.gle/mPfRnCdJYr6XsVVz9 Last Date of Registration Aug 24, 2020 (Monday) by 11:00 a.m or till seats last As per HRD Policy 2020-21 :- Sec. 2.3 : All faculty members to complete at least one MOOC certification from SWAYAM-NPTEL or equivalent national/international platforms with proctored exam subject to availability of job relevant course. Successful completion of these courses will entitle the faculty / staff members to :- 1. Achievement of targeted Training Hours as per Key Performance Indicator 2. Research and Academic Extension Leave (RAEL) and Bonus Points: I. About AMCAT AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates on the basis of their core skills which includes reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills.. AMCAT is also known as an employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. Students who work during their college careers may develop better time-management skills than their counterparts because they have to apply it to their daily lives. They earn money that can be used for fun or for tuition, while gaining experience in the workplace that will be attractive to future employers after graduation. title: Registration for Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200818/001) : (8/18/2020)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from October 2020 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs after July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after each 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. The main aim of the End Term Presentation is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation The research scholars are required to follow the following 2 steps for appearing in ETP: Step-1. Registration and uploading of ETP reports All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP in October 2020) are required to register for ETP evaluation and upload their files through following UMS link: UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Research scholar Activity Details --> Upcoming Activity The last date for registration and uploading of report is 11th September 2020. Step-2. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar have registered for the ETP and uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> PhD Seminar File Verification --> ETP The last date for verification of the synopsis is 18th September 2020. Evaluation of the End Term Presentation (ETP) via online platform It is for the information of the all concerned that due to the prevailing situation, the End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation shall be planned via online platform google meet. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of ETP report: 1. As per current guidelines, the research scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such research scholars who have either missed or have been awarded “Not Recommended” in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the ETP evaluation. 2. The research scholars must upload single PDF file for end term report strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP October 2020) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 3. In case the research scholars are unable to get a signed copy of the synopsis from their respective supervisor due to prevailing situation, they can upload the soft copy of the synopsis without supervisor signature. But it is required that the synopsis uploaded by them must be strictly as per the guidelines and it must be verified by their supervisor through UMS interface on or before 18th September 2020. 4. Research scholars are also required to submit 2 hard copies of the reports duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) in Research Degree and Evaluation Cell (RDEC) (Block-30; Room Number- 302B) for which the separate communication shall be made in due course of time. 5. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 6. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. 7. Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using ETP registration interface) before registering and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. For Recommendation of the ETP Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. For online evaluation of the End Term Presentation (ETP) a) The research scholar must have laptop/ desktop or any other suitable mean with proper audio/ video facility. b) The research scholar must have high speed internet facility to appear for the online ETP evaluation. In case, the research scholar has registered for the ETP evaluation but could not appear for the same due to any issue, he/she shall be marked absent for the evaluation. Result of all such research scholars for ETP evaluation shall stand as “Not Recommended” and they will be required to re-register for the next scheduled ETP evaluation with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. c) The research scholar must be well versed with the online google meet platform. It is strongly advised that the research scholar must present his/ her presentation to the respective supervisor prior to appearing in actual SAS evaluation so that there is no confusion on the day of evaluation. In case, any of the eligible scholar has query, write us at rdc.etrs@lpu.co.in or contact Mr. Gagandeep Singh Cheema (7888816232)/ Dr. Jashanpreet Singh (8968875079).

title: Regarding Updation in OJT/Internship Policy for term 20211 onwards (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200812/002) : (8/12/2020)
body: With On the Job Training (OJT) and Internship becoming need of the hour, Updation in the existing On Job Training & Internship policy have been made while taking in consideration formal and informal feedback from all concerned stakeholders. The key changes/Updation in the policy are mentioned below: a) Provision for online application for OJT/Internship: Student can now apply online through UMS for OJT/Internship. The UMS link for the same is given below. UMS Navigation----->Placement Services----->OJT/Internship Application b) Provision for Change in company for students on OJT/Internship: In case where student wants to change the company for the training/ internship, the same must be brought into the notice of the respective TPC well in advance. Change in the company or cancellation of the training/ internship is not allowed without the prior consent of the respective TPC. c) Updation in the process of OJT/Internship Cancellation: In extreme in-disciplinary cases by the students, the ETP viva already given by student for the previous term OJT/ Internship may be cancelled and the student may be awarded F grade for the previous and future term courses along with the debarment in future internship drives through DCS or through independent offer. d) Scheduling of ETP viva for students opting for one year OJT/Internship: The scheduling of the final ETP viva for cases where student opt for the OJT/ Internship for one year where the date of the joining is before the start of the (n-1) term and the internship/ training is ending after the end of the last term (nth term) shall be done after end of the each term. e) Academic treatment for students in case of Trimester system for Mittal School of Business: Academic treatment for trimester programs have been explained in detail in the updated policy. The complete guidelines for OJT/Internship is also attached herewith for your reference. For detailed guidelines of OJT/Internship kindly refer to the following link:- UMS Navigation---->Division of Examination---->Examination policies and guidelines---->Students---->AERC---->On-Job Training_Internship_ policy_students.pdf You all are requested to kindly go through the detailed policy and in-case of any concern, please contact Mr. Manu Prakram in 30-302B or through email at: aerc@lpu.co.in.

title: Colors and Personality - How color affects behavior? (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/200811/001) : (8/11/2020)
body: Most of us are curious to find out , how color effects behavior ? Some interesting facts about color psychology · Different colors evoke different emotions · Colors can even play tricks on your mind. · You’re more likely to forget something when it’s in black and white. · It’s possible to be afraid of certain colors. · Men and women see red differently. · 62-90% of a first impression is due to colors. Your personality is important because it determines how you interact with your environment and the people around you. Psychologist from Counseling & Happiness cell has selected a very interesting personality Test on color Psychology Colorquiz is a five minute personality test based on decades of research by color psychologists around the world. This test is based on the work of Dr. Max Lûscher and is widely used in Europe and overseas. There are a number of corporations and colleges that use this test as part of their hiring/admissions processes. There are no complicated questions to answer, you simply choose colors with a click of the mouse! Your test results are completely confidential. Take the test now. http://www.colorquiz.com/

title: Registration for Backlog Courses for Autumn Term, 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200809/001) : (8/9/2020)
body: To facilitate the students to clear the backlog courses in the regular current term the registration for backlog courses has been started for Autumn Term of Academic Session, 2020-21. The classes for courses registered as backlog courses by the students shall be held along with the regular students in the online mode. Hence, only those courses shall be offered for backlog registration for which classes are being conducted in this term. The interface for Backlog registration shall remain active from 8th August, 2020 till 16th August 2020. Find below important guidelines for the Registration Process of the same. 1. Link to be followed for registration of backlog courses: UMS Navigation→ Examination system→ Backlog Registration → Backlog Course Registration 2. Grade conversion will be applicable for those courses which have been offered in Autumn Term 2020-21. Permissibility of conversions of grades shall be: S. No. Existing grade New Grade Conversion 1 E G Allowed 2 E F Allowed 3 G F Allowed 3. Conditions applicable for backlog registration: A. For Continuing students: In addition to the courses for the current regular term of the student shall be allowed to register in backlog courses if the student has minimum 2.5 CGPA or 25% cumulative mark percentage (in case of marks based programme). i. If a student wants to register for only F grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of four F grade courses subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. However, the student may request for registration of an extra course which has been offered in this term by sending the email at academic.aac@lpu.co.in during the time of registration. ii. If a student wants to register only G grade courses, then he/she can register for maximum of nine G grade courses. iii. A student wants to register both F and G grade courses, he/she can register maximum of nine courses of which maximum of four F grade courses can be registered subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. B. For Non-Promoted students: A student, who is registering only for backlog courses because of the non-promotion to the next year, the student can register for a maximum of 9 courses subject to availability of clash-free time table schedule. If a student has studied more than 9 courses in a single term then student may apply for additional backlog courses in the term by sending the email at academic.aac@lpu.co.in during the time of registration. C. Registration in a course for additional courses/courses not mapped/not studied by student: A student who is registering for additional courses/courses not mapped/not studied by the students due to Change of Program, Term off/Year off, Re-joining after gap or Migration is marked as “M” grade in result. Student will be required to register the course(s) as F grade. “M” Grade cannot be converted to G grade. 4. Fee for backlog registration: The student Registration will be confirmed subject to payment of the backlog fee. The backlog fee shall be payable online through the fee payment gateway i. For National Students including “Asia”: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee plus Rs.350/- as examination fee and should be paid at time of registration through online mode only. ii. For International Students: Backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10thof the student’s standard tuition fee and USD 7 as examination fee and should be paid within 48 hours through University Website as per link: https://www.lpu.in/frmloginaccounts.aspx iii. For scholarship holders or students for whom the fee has been waived off (fully or partly) by the University, the backlog fee will be 1/10th of the actual or standard tuition fee for the term and not the fee after scholarship or waiver. iv. For students admitted to dual and / or integrated programmes, the backlog fee shall be charged after considering whether it pertains to the lower degree or the higher degree. v. In case a student’s batch has graduated or passed out, the backlog registration fee for a course shall be 1/10th of the student’s standard tuition fee of the programme. vi. For term off and non-promoted students: Backlog fee will be 1/10 of his/her fellow batch’s fee until his/her fellow batch student is studying that program. Backlog fee will be 1/10 of the last term fee paid by his/her fellow batch in case the batch has passed out. vii. Once student has paid the backlog courses fee, courses cannot be De-registered. 5. Attendance Marking: i. Attendance in backlog courses will be included in the aggregate attendance of the student for the purpose of determining his/her eligibility for appearing in the ETE and for calculating the detention list. ii. Attendance will be counted from very next day of your registration confirmation i.e. after confirmation of your fee payment. 6. Equivalency of Courses: i. Students are required to ensure that the equivalent course allotted to them have not been previously studied by them. If equivalence course has already been studied by them, then they are required to report the same immediately by sending the email at academic.aac@lpu.co.in ii. Also, for equivalent courses, the credits of the new course will be applicable. 7. Step by Step guide for using the interface for backlog registration is attached along with these guidelines.

title: Guidelines for Freshmen for Autumn Term 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/200808/002) : (8/8/2020)
body: At the onset the University extends a very warm welcome to all the freshmen on their joining this prestigious University and as their first step in the development of their professional career. The Term-I (Autumn Term) of the Academic Session 2020-21 shall be conducted in the online mode. The University has completed all necessary arrangements to offer you a seamless learning environment equivalent to face to face learning through the “LPU My Class” platform. The link for assessing this platform is myclass.lpu.in In this context, find appended the links to a series of videos explaining various aspects of using LPU My Class platform. All the students are advised to judiciously go through these videos so that you become familiar and fully equipped to use “LPU My Class” platform. A. How to Join online Class https://youtu.be/KtxJy6djQFc B. How to Interact with Teachers https://youtu.be/0BKj03veTmI C. How to Use Presenter Tools https://youtu.be/cuvwuEyq048 D. Giving Mobile Version Chrome Browser permission in Android phones https://youtu.be/BO1YQ_P4ki0 The students are further advised to refer to certain important issues given below with regard to the online classes. You are expected to meticulously go through these and follow them in full letter and spirit. Regarding Courses Registered, Time Table and Attendance: 1. The courses (subjects) that a student shall be studying in this term shall be registered to the students before the commencement of the upcoming term and the courses will be visible to students on the landing and home page of their UMS (University Management System) portal. 2. The time table of the courses registered to the students shall also be available to the students on the UMS Landing and Home Page in parallel to the path: UMS Navigation--->LMS--->View Time Table The students are expected to always keep a copy their time table always handy and ensure that no class is missed. 3. Attendance for the online session (class) will be mandatory for all the students. The attendance for a particular online class shall be calculated automatically by the associated software with “LPU My Class” platform. The attendance for each lecture shall be based on the following parameters: a. Ontime during the complete online session for each lecture. b. Participation in the MCQ based polling during the lecture session conducted by the faculty. Hence it is advised that students remain present for full duration and attentive throughout the session. Conduct of Classes 1. The online classes will be compulsorily held as per the time table on the “LPU My Class” platform. It is reiterated that students should watch the related videos using the links given above, so as to get a clear-cut understanding regarding the use and features of “LPU My Class” platform. 2. Although, the classes shall be held on the “LPU My Class” platform, however, all supporting material for the classes including video lectures, supportive PPTs and explanations, link of YouTube channels, reading materials etc. shall be provided by the faculty through the “LPU LIVE” app. Hence, it is mandatory for all the students to download this app. The students can download the app from Google Play Store or App Store. 3. From the courses offered in the online mode, if some of these courses require practical or hands on learning, opportunity for the same shall be provided to all students when the University re-opens. Academic Tasks (Assignments/Tests) 1. For each course registered to the student, there shall be three Assignments/Tests that the faculty shall allocate to the students during the term. 2. The Assignments/Tests shall be aimed at evaluating the level of understanding of the students towards the concepts learnt and the application of the concepts understood by the students. 3. The assignments/Tests shall be allocated to the students at equal intervals of time during the Term. 4. The students should take care to submit the allocated academic tasks as per the prescribed timelines. Access to Online Resources: For the students requiring extra learning materials in addition to their regular classroom activities, University is providing e-resources and online databases for their support. 1. To access these library resources, LPU has also subscribed to a remote access software EzProxy which can be accessed through UMS from outside the campus. The link to access the same is: UMS Navigation---->Library Management System--->e-resources A student can directly login using http://ezproxy.lpu.in/login 2. For complete information regarding University library facilities, kindly visit University Website https://www.lpu.in/academics/libraries.php. Finally, the team of Division of Academic Affairs would like to wish you all the best towards your goal of achieving the best in your academics. It is also ensured that we have a dedicated team allocated to handle all your queries and concerns regarding your classes. You can approach your faculty mentor for resolution of your queries or call at 01824-517450 in case of any required support.

title: Work from home, part-time job opportunities by bluehawks : (8/7/2020)
body: Dear Students, Taking on a part-time job while pursuing a degree is hard work, but the benefits are typically greater than the amount of a pay check. Students who work during their college careers may develop better time-management skills than their counterparts because they have to apply it to their daily lives. They earn money that can be used for fun or for tuition, while gaining experience in the workplace that will be attractive to future employers after graduation. Some of the notable benefits of part time jobs with bluehawks are: 1. Monetary Value 2. Teaches you responsibility 3. Two words: Resume builder 4. You learn valuable time management skills 5. It improves your “people skills” In line with the University part time job policy, bluehawks is looking for talents for various work from home part-time job roles as given below · Digital marketing intern · SEO Intern · Full stack app development Intern (Android) · Full stack app development Intern (iOS) · Video Editing Intern · Full stack web development Intern · Graphic Designing Intern ·Business Development Intern (Sales) ·Talent acquisition Intern · Content writing Intern Job Tenure: - 01st September 2020 to 31st December 2020 Salary will be Incentive based starting from Rs. 650 to Rs 10,000. Certificates to all Interns will be provided. How to register: Step 1: All interested candidates would be required to Register on the given path on their UMS Link for Registration: - UMS NAVIGATION >>>> DIVISION OF STUDENT WELFARE >>>> PART TIME JOB REGISTERATION Step 2: Upload 30 seconds video CV and fill the application form using this link https://bit.ly/30iQJJZ (copy and paste in browser) Last Application Date is 20 August 2020 Note; - Shortlisted students will be Interview through Google Meet on 23rd August 2020 at 10:00 AM (The E-mail for the same google meet link will be shared to students after the shortlisting from the first Round) For any query please contact Mr Pushkar Kumar-(hello@campus.bluehawks.in) or mail to ptj.dsw@lpu.co.in

title: Guidelines for Freshmen for Autumn Term 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/200806/001) : (8/6/2020)
body: At the onset the University extends a very warm welcome to all the freshmen on their joining this prestigious University and as their first step in the development of their professional career. The Term-I (Autumn Term) of the Academic Session 2020-21 shall be conducted in the online mode. The University has completed all necessary arrangements to offer you a seamless learning environment equivalent to face to face learning through the “LPU My Class” platform. The link for assessing this platform is myclass.lpu.in In this context, find appended the links to a series of videos explaining various aspects of using LPU My Class platform. All the students are advised to judiciously go through these videos so that you become familiar and fully equipped to use “LPU My Class” platform. A. How to Join online Class https://youtu.be/KtxJy6djQFc B. How to Interact with Teachers https://youtu.be/0BKj03veTmI C. How to Use Presenter Tools https://youtu.be/cuvwuEyq048 D. Giving Mobile Version Chrome Browser permission in Android phones https://youtu.be/BO1YQ_P4ki0 The students are further advised to refer to certain important issues given below with regard to the online classes. You are expected to meticulously go through these and follow them in full letter and spirit. Regarding Courses Registered, Time Table and Attendance: 1. The courses (subjects) that a student shall be studying in this term shall be registered to the students before the commencement of the upcoming term and the courses will be visible to students on the landing and home page of their UMS (University Management System) portal. 2. The time table of the courses registered to the students shall also be available to the students on the UMS Landing and Home Page in parallel to the path: UMS Navigation--->LMS--->View Time Table The students are expected to always keep a copy their time table always handy and ensure that no class is missed. 3. Attendance for the online session (class) will be mandatory for all the students. The attendance for a particular online class shall be calculated automatically by the associated software with “LPU My Class” platform. The attendance for each lecture shall be based on the following parameters: a. Ontime during the complete online session for each lecture. b. Participation in the MCQ based polling during the lecture session conducted by the faculty. Hence it is advised that students remain present for full duration and attentive throughout the session. Conduct of Classes 1. The online classes will be compulsorily held as per the time table on the “LPU My Class” platform. It is reiterated that students should watch the related videos using the links given above, so as to get a clear-cut understanding regarding the use and features of “LPU My Class” platform. 2. Although, the classes shall be held on the “LPU My Class” platform, however, all supporting material for the classes including video lectures, supportive PPTs and explanations, link of YouTube channels, reading materials etc. shall be provided by the faculty through the “LPU LIVE” app. Hence, it is mandatory for all the students to download this app. The students can download the app from Google Play Store or App Store. 3. From the courses offered in the online mode, if some of these courses require practical or hands on learning, opportunity for the same shall be provided to all students when the University re-opens. Academic Tasks (Assignments/Tests) 1. For each course registered to the student, there shall be three Assignments/Tests that the faculty shall allocate to the students during the term. 2. The Assignments/Tests shall be aimed at evaluating the level of understanding of the students towards the concepts learnt and the application of the concepts understood by the students. 3. The assignments/Tests shall be allocated to the students at equal intervals of time during the Term. 4. The students should take care to submit the allocated academic tasks as per the prescribed timelines. Finally, the team of Division of Academic Affairs would like to wish you all the best towards your goal of achieving the best in your academics. It is also ensured that we have a dedicated team allocated to handle all your queries and concerns regarding your classes. You can approach your faculty mentor for resolution of your queries or call at 01824-517450 in case of any required support.

title: Work from home, part-time job opportunities by bluehawks : (8/3/2020)
body: Dear Students, Taking on a part-time job while pursuing a degree is hard work, but the benefits are typically greater than the amount of a pay check. Students who work during their college careers may develop better time-management skills than their counterparts because they have to apply it to their daily lives. They earn money that can be used for fun or for tuition, while gaining experience in the workplace that will be attractive to future employers after graduation. Some of the notable benefits of part time jobs with bluehawks are: 1. Monetary Value 2. Teaches you responsibility 3. Two words: Resume builder 4. You learn valuable time management skills 5. It improves your “people skills” In line with the University part time job policy, bluehawks is looking for talents for various work from home part-time job roles as given below · Digital marketing intern · SEO Intern · Full stack app development Intern (Android) · Full stack app development Intern (iOS) · Video Editing Intern · Full stack web development Intern · Graphic Designing Intern ·Business Development Intern (Sales) ·Talent acquisition Intern · Content writing Intern Job Tenure:- 01st September 2020 to 31st December 2020 Salary will be Incentive based starting from ? 650 to ? 10,000. Certificates to all Interns will be provided. All interested candidates would be required to Register on the given path on their UMS Link for Registration: - UMS NAVIGATION >>>> DIVISION OF STUDENT WELFARE >>>> PART TIME JOB REGISTERATION and also upload their 30 seconds video CV and fill the application form using this link https://bit.ly/30iQJJZ (copy and paste in browser) Last Application Date is 20 August 2020 Note; - Shortlisted students will be Interview through Google Meet on 23rd August 2020 at 10:00 AM (The E-mail for the same google meet link will be shared to students after the shortlisting from the first Round) For any query please contact Mr Pushkar Kumar-9878909807 or mail to ptj.dsw@lpu.co.in

title: Instructions for Students attending online class using Google Meet (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/200801/001) : (8/1/2020)
body: In order to further streamline process of taking Online Attendance of 3rd / 4th Year students in applicable courses following process shall be followed from 3rd August 2020 onwards. i. All students shall be required to utilize a single Gmail Account for attending online classes throughout semester as per scheduled time-table for attending Google Meet based lectures as communicated by their respective teachers. ii. Students needs to submit / update their chosen Gmail address at following UMS Interface latest by 3rd August 2020: UMS Navigation >Learning Management System > Online Classroom Attendance > (fill and submit) This email-id after updation as explained below shall only be used for attending the classes on google meet platform. iii. All students must ensure that they are present in the online class at-least for 55-58 minutes and join 2-3 minutes before start of the class, failing which no attendance shall be awarded. iv. All students shall be allocated a non-numeric Unique Code by the University and communicated via UMS My Messages which they will be required to use in updating their Google Gmail Account Information as per steps provided in “How to use Unique Code in Gmail.pdf” file. v. Students will use the Unique Code and update their Last Names in Gmail Account information so as to look similar to following example name: First Name: Sundar, Last Name: Sharma, Unique Code: xARDHxhsGz To Sundar Sharma xARDHxhsGz (First Name + Last Name + Unique Code) vi. It is mandatory for students to ensure that their First Name, Last Name match exactly with university records / any errors made would lead to undue anomalies in final attendance calculation.

title: Guidelines for students enrolled in Online classes for Autumn Term for Session, 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200731/005) : (7/31/2020)
body: In these ongoing unprecedented times, we all are trying to achieve the established goals by going an extra mile. In this order all students are required to follow the below given instructions to help achieve the desired objectives. 1) Join the online session (class) exactly as per the lecture time. Delay in joining the class might lead to loss of attendance for the session. 2) The students should be decently dressed while attending online video mode classes. 3) The students should ensure that they have good internet connectivity while attending lectures as no requests/excuses to get attendance in relation to poor connectivity shall be looked into. 4) Students shall be awarded attendance on the basis of presence in online sessions and participation in MCQ based questions (wherever being held) during the session. 5) If a student gets late, then he/she should not expect the Faculty to respond to his/her messages in relation to attendance/any other issue via LPU LIVE App when the Faculty is already taking an online Session on another platform i.e. My Class, Google Meet etc. 6) Students who are listening to the online lecture via My Class, Google Meet etc. should not respond to their classmates’ messages in LPU LIVE App during an on-going lecture. The pop sound of the LPU LIVE messages disturbs other students or distracts them and in turn they start distracting the teachers with these issues wasting Lecture time. 7) No student will get attendance after Faculty member has already taken attendance if the student joins late or in between the online lecture. 8) If any student joins the lecture after attendance has been taken by the Faculty, then the student can listen to the course content but will not be eligible for attendance. 9) The students should keep their microphones muted during the lecture to avoid unnecessary disturbance coming from their backgrounds/microphones. 10) Only when a Faculty member asks a question the students may unmute their microphones. 11) For students registered in 'G' grades, it is not compulsory for them to attend classes. But it is advised that to have a better understanding of the concepts, they must attend classes.

title: Enrollment into Career Services-2022 graduating batch students : (7/29/2020)
body: Kind attention: Students expected to graduate in 2022. This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the students graduating in 2022 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2022. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. Registration Deadline: Career Services Registration with immediate access to placement/internship opportunities is open till 30th Aug 2020 (revised). Registration Process: * Pathway: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: * Process Step-I: Initial Consent for enrollment into Career Services * Process Step-II: Profile Update and PEP Fee payment ** Process Step-I: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. Process Step-1 will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). ** Process Step-II: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-1. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. (At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface). PEP Fee shall be paid online through Placement Registration interface itself. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Student will not be allowed to avail Career Services/PEP activities without paying the PEP test fees. The registration is considered complete only after Process Step-II is successfully completed with applicable PEP fee payment. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. body: In an endeavor to ensure that academic progress of the students is not halted in this unprecedented situation of COVID-19,the University is going to commence the upcoming term in the online mode as per the already announced dates in the Academic Calendar of Autumn Term,2020-21.The University has completed all necessary arrangements to offer you a seamless learning environment equivalent to face to face learning, in this context, find appended detailed guidelines regarding the conduct of the upcoming term in the online mode. 1. It is Mandatory to register at the link to attend the webinar. 2. Students should register with their local punjab address. Aims and Objectives of PGRKAM Society: 1. To create the necessary framework to facilitate Wage and Self-employment for the unemployed people of the State of Punjab. 2. To improve employability through skill training/skill up-gradation. 3. To identify areas having potential for employment generation and to harness that potential with government intervention. The main objectives to be pursued by PGRKAM Society are: 1. To create an exhaustive data base of Unemployed Households in the State of Punjab. Also to create all such databases as may be necessary for the purpose of employment generation. 2. Creating web portals for generating and managing such data. 3. Conducting surveys etc for creation of such database. 4. To develop and promote an eco-system amongst all stakeholders, which is conducive to employment Generation. To enable the establishment of flexible delivery mechanisms that respond to the characteristics of a wide range of needs of all stakeholders 5 . To promote public-private partnership models (Including CSR) to encourage private sector initiatives in the field of Employment Generation. 6. To Plan and set targets including preparation of State Employment Plan and District Employment Plan. To develop and oversee the functionalities of Ghar Ghar Rozgar portal which will facilitate the registration of all eligible job seekers, registration of job providers and organizing job fairs etc online either in-house or through professional firm via project Management Consultant(s). 7. To facilitate the job seekers for placement in Govt./ Private Jobs/ Overseas Employment and Skill training as per the aptitude and skills of the Job seeker. 8. To facilitate Punjab Youth in Overseas Study and to undertake such ancillary activities may lead to fulfilment of this object. 9. To do social mobilization of the Job seekers with focus on Unemployed Household. 10. To conduct and support Research and Development in the Employment Generation Sector(s) to learn from innovative and emerging trends globally for improving rate of employment. 11. Establishing call centers and keeping consultants for culling out and managing data regarding unemployment/ employment for pushing employment generation program with vigor. 12. To co-ordinate and monitor the 22 District Bureaus of Employment and Enterprises (DBEE’s) formed in the districts. 13. To take such actions, incidental, ancillary or conducive to the attainment of the objects stated above or any other similar object, as per requirement prescribed by Central Government or State Government or any other Organization.

title: Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS) of Ph.D. Scholars (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200721/001) : (7/21/2020)
body: This is in reference to the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) which will be conducted tentatively from 16th September 2020 onwards. It is mandatory for all research scholars to clear SAS within two years from the date of registration otherwise their admission may be deemed as cancelled. The main key points for SAS evaluation are as follows: a) To finalize the Title of the proposed research work. b) To finalize the Objectives of the proposed research work. c) To finalize the research methodology of the proposed research work. The scholars are required to follow the following 3 steps to be eligible for appearing in SAS. 1. Registration for SAS Scholars who have successfully completed their course work or exempted from the course work (due to M.Phil.) can register for SAS seminar through the interface available in the UMS at the following link. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development --> SAS Registration form Interface for registration will remain active till 13th August 2020. Only those Scholars should register for their SAS seminar who are willing to appear for the evaluation in the month of September-October, 2020 and have the approval of their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor for the same. 2. Uploading of synopsis Once the scholar has registered for the SAS, he/ she needs to upload the synopsis for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the panel of experts. The scholar needs to visit the same UMS link for uploading of the synopsis of SAS along with the other relevant documents. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development -->SAS Registration form The last date for uploading the synopsis report is 20th August 2020. 3. Recommendation of the synopsis by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor Once the Scholar has uploaded the synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> Scholar File Verification --> SAS --> Download The last date for verification of the synopsis is 25th August 2020. 4. Evaluation of the State of the Art Seminar (SAS) via online platform It is for the information of the all concerned that due to the prevailing situation of the threats imposed by novel corona virus, the SAS evaluation shall be planned via online platform google meet. Important Note: For Registration: a) At the time of SAS registration, the scholars should opt for the domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisors/Co-Supervisors/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension shall be given for registration beyond the last date. c) No request for deregistration shall be entertained beyond the last date of registration and the scholar shall be marked absent. d) Scholars having pending dues are not eligible to register for the SAS evaluation. Therefore, scholars are requested to clear the pending dues and get registered for the SAS evaluation before the last date. e) If a scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but is absent at the date of seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from December 2020 onwards) only after the clearance of fine. For Uploading Synopsis: a) The scholar shall not be eligible for uploading any synopsis report without completing registration process. b) The Scholars are strongly advised that synopsis file must be uploaded only after the thorough discussion with the Supervisor. Same should be defended during the presentation on the day of evaluation. For preparing the presentation the scholar should refer to the format for SAS presentation (Attachment) c) No extension shall be given for uploading synopsis report beyond the last date. d) Read the attached guidelines very carefully before uploading the synopsis. e) All the scholars must upload single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I duly verified and signed by respective supervisors as per the attached guidelines or else their SAS registration may be cancelled. He/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation (with fee of Rs. 5000/-). No second chance shall be given to upload the synopsis. f) Scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using SAS registration interface) before registering and uploading the synopsis at the interface. For recommendation of the Synopsis: a) The scholar must upload the synopsis well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. For online evaluation of the State of the Art Seminar (SAS) a) The scholar must have laptop/ desktop or any other suitable mean with proper audio/ video facility. b) The scholar must have high speed internet facility to appear for the online SAS evaluation. In case, the scholar has registered for the SAS evaluation but could not appear for the same due to any issue, he/she shall be marked absent for the evaluation and he/shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- with subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. c) The scholar must be well versed with the online google meet platform. It is strongly advised that the scholar must present his/ her presentation to the respective supervisor prior to appearing in actual SAS evaluation so that there is no confusion on the day of evaluation. All the scholars who have completed two years from date of registration and have the last chance to appear in the SAS seminar in September-October, 2020 are advised to avail this chance as no further extension shall be given for the same. In case, any of the eligible scholar has query regarding the following issues: 1. Registration/Uploading of synopsis write at rdc.sas@lpu.co.in or contact Ms. Poonam (7986479141)/ Dr. Jashanpreet (8968875079) 2. Supervisor / Co-supervisor related query write at drp@lpu.co.in.

body: Kind attention: Students expected to graduate in 2022. Registration Deadline: (Revised) Career Services Registration with immediate access to placement/internship opportunities is open till 30th Aug 2020. Registration Process: * Pathway: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: * Process Step-I: Initial Consent for enrollment into Career Services * Process Step-II: Profile Update and PEP Fee payment ** Process Step-I: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. Process Step-1 will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). ** Process Step-II: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-1. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. (At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface). PEP Fee shall be paid online through Placement Registration interface itself. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Student will not be allowed to avail Career Services/PEP activities without paying the PEP test fees. The registration is considered complete only after Process Step-II is successfully completed with applicable PEP fee payment. Students are advised to carefully read the respective policy available on placement portal before enrolling for University Career Services; same is attached below for your reference. title: Guidelines for Students of 2nd year for School of Agriculture for Autumn Term 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/200715/004) : (7/15/2020)
body: In an endeavor to ensure that academic progress of the students is not halted in this unprecedented situation of COVID-19, the University is going to commence the upcoming term in the online mode as per the already announced dates in the Academic Calendar of Autumn Term, 2020-21.The University has completed all necessary arrangements to offer you a seamless learning environment equivalent to face to face learning through the “My Class” platform. In this context, find appended detailed guidelines regarding the conduct of the upcoming term in the online mode, also find attached the guidelines and videos to assist you in attending the classes over the “My Class” platform. Certain important issues with regard to the online classes are given below meticulously go through them: Regarding Courses Registered, Time Table and Attendance: 1. The courses shall be registered to the students before the commencement of the upcoming term and the courses will be visible to students on the home page of the students’ UMS. All the students are advised to verify the courses as there are minor changes in the scheme of courses which have been made due to the ongoing situation wherein all courses especially practical courses are not feasible to be offered in the online mode. 2. However, from the courses offered in the online mode, if there is any requirement for some of these courses to have hands on learning, opportunity shall be provided to the students in this when the University re-opens. 3. The time table of the registered courses shall be available to the students on the UMS Home Page in parallel to the path: UMS Navigation--->LMS--->View Time Table. 4. Attendance for the online session (class) will be mandatory for all the students. The attendance shall be calculated automatically by the associated software with the platform- My Class. The attendance for each lecture shall be based on the following parameters: a. On time during the complete online session for each lecture. b. Participation in the MCQ based polling during the lecture session conducted by the faculty. Conduct of Classes 1. The Classes shall be conducted on the “My Classes” platform and a detailed set of guidelines regarding the procedure to login in these classes and links to access communication videos to guide you with regard to the use and features of this platform are attached. All students are advised to mandatorily read the guidelines and also go through with these videos to understand the platform. 2. However, all supporting material for the classes including video lectures, supportive PPTs and explanations, Link of YouTube channel, Reading materials etc. shall be provided by the faculty through the LPU LIVE app. Hence, it is mandatory for all students to download this app. 3. The online classes will be compulsorily held as per the time table and no deviation request will be entertained. Assignments 1. For each course registered to the student, there shall be three Assignments that the faculty shall allocate to the students during the term. 2. The Assignments shall be aimed at checking the understanding of the students towards the concepts learnt and the application of the concepts understood by the students. 3. The assignments shall be allocated to the students at equal intervals of time during the course of the Term. Two best out of the three assignments allocated to the students shall be considered. Further in case the students are facing any issues with regard to the use of app they can contact at 01824-517450.

body: The University is elated to inform all the students that we are initiating the commencement of classes for Autumn Term, Session 2020-21(as per already announced dates in previous term). It is our primary endeavour to ensure that the academic progress of the students and their health is not hampered among these unprecedented times. The University has developeda robust e-Learning based online platform for ensuring smooth conduct of teaching and learning process. Specially designed course content can be accessed in the form of presentations, videos,lecture notes, reading material and use other powerful features along with learning progress indicators.The face-to face classes will resume as soon as the circumstances gets better and intimation of the same will be given to you well in advance as per Government’s regulations. Furthermore, the important processes with respect to the commencement of the next term are as follows: 1. Registration Process Before the start of semester, all students shall be auto registered subject to clearance of all formalities in relation to the registration process. 2. Term Off The University is equally concerned for students who are unable to attend online classes due to personal reasons or lack of infrastructure/resources or any other reason. The students shall be given the provision of taking ‘Term-Off’ in the current term.In case the students avails the option of ‘Term Off,’ then all courses of the current term shall be converted to ‘F’ grade. The student would be required to register the current term courses in backlog mode in subsequent term(s) as and when offered by the University. Such students should keep in mind that this may lead to the extension of the duration of their degree. As a special gesture, the University shall not charge the fee applicable for processing ‘Term Off’ requests. The students who want to opt for “Term Off” should state the reason in the below mentioned link: Link: UMS Navigation - > Examination System -> Application for Term Off For any query you may contact 01824-517450
