title: AMCAT ( WriteX & SVAR) and Cocubes practice tests(DCT) tests for B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA/MBA placement registered students graduating in 2021. : (7/10/2020)
body: Dear Aspirants, We hope that you and your family are safe in this unprecedented time. As you are aware that the placement season has already started and in order to make you ready for the upcoming placement drives, we have schedule AMCAT (WriteX & SVAR) and CoCubes DCT tests from 11 July 2020 onwards. Before moving on to detailed plan lets have some overlook about tests to be conducted: Write X: The only Written English Test driven on Machine Learning to help you in assessing the overall quality of a candidate's written sample. Major factors that attribute towards the construction of a great write-up like grammar, usage, mechanics, style, organization and development etc. Write X will be conducted in 2 different versions; Write X Essay Writing & Email Writing. SVAR: IVR Based, Spoken English Test to assess Student's Fluency, Pronunciation, Active Listening, Spoken English Understanding, Grammar, Vocabulary & more. A crucial test essential for Interviews or Client based Interaction Profiles. Based on CEFR Levels. DCT: It is a series of tests which covers all the required subjects used for making the students get trained for CoCubes Pre-Assess® exam. It helps students to get clarity and practice for Pre-Assess® Important pointers: 1. All tests, AMCAT (SVAR & Write X) and COCUBES DCT tests are mandatory for every student. 2. These Scores will be shared with companies and will be helpful for you to get shortlisted in the upcoming drives. 3. For SVAR, kindly check your schedule in the file attached below with name “Svar schedule”. Make sure that you take this test on the date mentioned against your name. 4. For SVAR make sure you have Earphones/Headphones with mic in working conditions. 5. Kindly don't enter SVAR ID in SVAR Test APP for checking SVAR ID is working or not and closing APP without taking the Test will also invalidate your test. 6. Kindly check the guidelines and details of AMCAT(SVAR & WriteX) in the file attached below with name “AMCAT.rar” before taking test. 7. Kindly check the guidelines and details of CoCubes DCT practice tests in the file attached below with name “CoCubes.rar” before taking test. 8. PEP policy for the test attempt will be applicable and hence it is advised to take the test with full spirit. 9. AMCAT SVAR logins will be shared on the test day itself through UMS My messages. 10. title: Largest Cook Together Event Online in association with Amul on 10th July,2020 : (7/8/2020)
body: It gives us immense pleasure to announce that we are organizing a Largest Cook Together Event Online in association with Amul on 10th July,2020 i.e. Friday at 11am. This event could be an attempt for a World record to promote Cook at home & Stay home and also promotes building better health and immunity. This would be a great opportunity to give yourself a great treat for food and also an opportunity to Cook together with your LPU family from your home on Zoom Platform. All Student,Faculty and Staff will be preparing a dish on 10th July at 11am on Zoom app from the below given ingredients : Amul Pizza Cheese : 200 gms Amul Butter Amul Cheese Slice : 1 No. Whole wheat bread : 2 slices Chopped Onion : Half Chopped tomato: Half Chopped Capsicum : Half 1 Tbsp : Black Pepper 1 Tbsp : Pizza Pasta Sauce Oregano Salt to taste Amul Milk : 1 Cup Amul Ghee : Half Table spoon Turmeric Powder : 1 Tspoon Grated Ginger : 1 Tbsp Cinnamon Stick : 1 No. Honey : 1 Tsp (Note : The above ingredients has to be arranged by the faculty before the event and are easily available at home ) The above dish would help build Immunity during the Covid which is the need for the hour and provide better health benefits. Once the Student,Faculty and Staff registers on the link, they will be added in a whatsapp group created by Amul. They will give the instructions on that group and will share some easily available ingredients for the Cook Together event. title: Regarding preference polling of Open Elective for Autumn Term 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200705/001) : (7/5/2020)
body: The preference polling for Open Elective shall be started from 6th July, 2020 (2:00 PM onwards) till 8th July, 2020 (Midnight). The student will be required to fill 5 preferences for the Open Elective. Merit List shall be generated according to CGPA criteria. Details of allocation mode can be referred from attachment Allocation Criterion. In the current open elective polling, student has to choose the courses (as per programme scheme) to study in the next term i.e. 20211. For the open electives to be studied in the subsequent terms, separate polling stations shall be scheduled prior to start of each term. In order to facilitate the students to make the choice when the polling for Open Elective starts, School wise folder of list of Open Elective to be offered to you is available at the link: Important Links---->Examination Instructions and Guidelines---->Open Elective Folder The link to participate in preference polling is given below- UMS Navigation---->Learning Management System---->Open Elective Course Preference. Note: The students can participate in only one polling i.e. either for open minor preference polling or the student can participate in the open elective preference polling. Student who had already participated in the Open Minor preference polling will not be allowed to participate in the preference polling of Open Elective. OE allocation criteria, Disclaimer and User Manual for using polling interface are attached below. For any query, please contact your school Academic Operations Coordinator (AOC) on the email ID as per list attached below. Note: 1. The allocation of OEs through polling shall be done through allocation criteria mentioned in the interface and NOT ON FIRST COME FIRST SERVE BASIS. 2. title: Summer PEP for students of B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA graduating in 2021- Starting from 06th July : (7/4/2020)
body: Dear Students, As you know that a good performance in academics will make way for a successful career. Hence the academics and placement preparation need to go hand-in-hand for your career ahead. Summer PEP activities for the students having their last ETE on or before 04-July-2020(list attached), will resume from 06-July-2020. The list has details of your respective faculty UIDs, to be connected through LPU Live app. Important points: 1. The PEP schedule is from 06th July to 28th July. 2. PEP classes are mandatory and the attendance will be marked for these classes. 3. You have to follow a specific schedule for your PEP classes. (Refer attachment -Student wise Schedule and Guidelines) 4. Students have to install LPU live app mandatorily as all the content will be shared through LPU live app only. 5. Time table will be punched on your UMS by 04th July. You can check it at: UMS Navigation-> Learning Management System-> View Time Table 6. For telephonic interviews in Soft Skills, dates mentioned against student registration number to be followed. The students are required to have their CV ready for the interview and they must share the same with the faculty through LPU Live. The CV file should be saved in .pdf format with file name as: Registration number_CV. 7. For the students who have not submitted VideoCV, you can refer to student guidelines attached below and submit your videoCV accordingly to the faculty assigned in the list. 8. For the students having remarks “only test as per guidelines” against the section(in either aptitude or verbal or both), all tests will be open for them and it is mandatory for them to take these tests on the platforms mentioned in the student guidelines. 9. For the students with remarks “To be notified later”, you will receive your schedule in the upcoming PEP classes announcement through UMS announcement. 10. All the students must continue attempting practice test on 3rd party practice platforms (MyPerfectice, Bullseye, Examly) as per PEP policy timelines.

title: Webinar on “Effective use of MS Word for academic writing” : (7/3/2020)
body: Most people use MS Word as an editor, there is need to learn more about using the features of MS Word that can help you format your work more efficiently and consistently. This webinar focuses on how to use Word for academic writing, in particular how to use Word efficiently to format long documents, formatting tables and figures, creating table from text, compare documents side by side, track changes, creating watermarks, footnotes/endnotes, creating automatic table of contents, formatting breaks and sections and quick keys. Contents for the webinar:- 1. Introduction to the all parts of MS Word – Bars, Ribbons and Buttons. 2. Entering Data and its formatting with the tips, tricks and shortcuts. 3. Inserting Tables / Figures and their formatting / labeling. 4. Inserting headers & footers, Illustration, breaks. 5. Formatting – Table of Contents, Table of Figures/Tables. 6. References –Citations with sources and Styles. 7. Reviewing a document 8. Proof reading Department of Physics, School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences, Lovely professional University invites you for webinar on, “Effective use of MS Word for Academic Writing”. Resource Person: Dr. Uma Kamboj and Dr. Neha Munjal Assistant Professor, Department of Physics, School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences, Lovely Professional University. Participants: This webinar is useful for students and researchers of any level who need help with formatting long documents such as dissertations and theses. Date of webinar: 8th July 2020 Time: 3:00 pm – 5:00 pm Interested students register at following link https://forms.gle/jK4iSiW8V3Gex3rs8 Zoom link will be shared with the registered students. For more information contact: Dr. Uma Kamboj (uma.21636@lpu.co.in) Dr. Neha Munjal (neha.18869@lpu.co.in) Assistant Professor, Department of Physics School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences

title: CHANGE OF PROGRAM FOR THE CONTINUING STUDENT (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200702/001) : (7/2/2020)
body: This is for the information of all continuing students that they can apply for Change of Program as per the attached Guidelines through online mode in the interface available at the link: UMS Navigation -->Change of Program--> Request for Change of Program. (Procedure to use interface has been provided as attachment) The online process of change of program will start from 2nd July 2020 & the last date of applying for the Change of Program is 5th August, 2020. No program change will be allowed after 5th August, 2020 under any circumstances. The course mapping details (i.e. number of Backlogs and Waivers) of Change of program will be declared on UMS in two phases. For students who have applied till 20th July,2020,the course mapping details will be displayed by 25th July,2020 and for students who apply upto 5th August,2020, course mapping details will be displayed by 9th August,2020. A non-refundable application processing fee of Rs. 1000/- will be payable along with the online request. On approval of the program change request, a consolidated “Change of Program fee” of Rs. 4000/- along with cumulative fee (if applicable) shall be required to be paid by the student. The details about calculation of cumulative fee have been duly explained in the guidelines. The students are strictly advised to go through the detailed guidelines judiciously which have been provided with this communication as attachment before applying for change of program. Please Note:- 1. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old program after approval of Change of Program request or after paying the ‘Change of Program Fee’. 2. The announcement for mode of payment of ‘Change of Program’ Fee will be uploaded along with the result of Change of program. In case, student fails to pay the ‘ Change of program’ fee, the approval for Change of Program will stand cancelled and student shall continue in their current program 3. Due to course mapping if student is allocated additional courses to study to complete the requirements of the new program he/she will have to register such courses as backlog by paying the 1/10th of the tuition fee (per course) without any scholarship. 4. Only one chance is given to the students for change of program during the entire program duration, hence the students are advised to be very careful while availing this chance. 5. It may take up to a week after the student pays his/her change of program fees to register the student into his/her courses. 6. No benefit of missed CA or Attendance will be given to the student applying for Change of program after start of classes. To avoid this, students are strongly advised to apply for change of program before the start of the term. Important Note: The attendance will be calculated from the date of start of classes of new program in which student has sought change and not from the date the student gets registered in the course of the new program. All queries by the students shall be handled through e-mail at academic.aac@lpu.co.in

title: Regarding preference polling of Open Minor for Autumn Term 2020-21 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200701/006) : (7/1/2020)
body: An Open Minor is a group of 4 courses that shall be offered to the students in an unrelated area to develop additional skills enhancing employment opportunities. Polling for Open Minor shall be held only once and selection once made shall automatically lead to selection of the 4 courses corresponding to the area for subsequent terms. In order to facilitate the students to make the choice when the polling for Open minors starts, School wise folder of list of open minors to be offered to you is available at the link: Important Links---->Examination Instructions and Guidelines---->Open Minor Folder It is for your information that the preference polling for Open Minor for session 2020-21 will not be on First Come First Serve basis. Students who wish to choose Open Minor can provide their preferences in the interface. In case a student wants to choose open elective instead Open Minor, the polling schedule for the open elective shall be initiated shortly. Details regarding the same shall be informed via a separate UMS announcement. Note: The students can participate in only one polling i.e. either for open minor preference polling or the student can participate in the open elective preference polling which will be tentatively scheduled next week. The preference polling for Open Minor Area shall start on 2nd July, 2020 (12:00 PM onwards) till 5th July, 2020 (2:00 PM). For any query, please contact your school Academic Operations Coordinator (AOC) on the email ID as per list attached below. OM allocation criteria, Disclaimer and User Manual for using polling interface are attached below. The link to participate in preference polling is given below- UMS Navigation---->Learning Management System---->Open Minor Area Preference. Note: 1. The allocation of OMs through polling shall be done through allocation criteria mentioned in the interface and NOT ON FIRST COME FIRST SERVE BASIS. 2. Polling process is just for recording preferences. Polling for a particular OM does not guarantee its allocation to the students.

title: Yoga Blogging Contest : (6/20/2020)
body: *A fit body, a calm mind, a house full of love. These things cannot be bought – they must be earned.* This lockdown period has been very challenging for the people to maintain our health due to the limitation of physical work. This further leads to boredom and lack of concentration. LPU NSS under the aegis of Community Service Cell, Division of Student Welfare in association with Patanjali Yog Samiti, Ministry of Ayush, Youth Services, Punjab and MyFm is organizing a *Picture Blogging Contest* on the occasion of *International Yoga Day*. The participants are required to share a picture of themselves performing the Yoga. The picture would be uploaded on the official Instagram handle of LPU NSS @lpu_nss The main aim of this contest is to encourage and motivate the people to inculcate the habit of practising Yoga everyday. The benefits of Yoga are endless with no side effects. *Benifits:-* • Merite Certificate to all Winners • E-Certificate to all participants. Last Date of Entry: - 21st June 2020 *Note:-* 1) Upload your picture:- https://tiny.cc/yoga-mahotsav 2) Participants need to upload 4 images of different yoga postures or practising Yoga with Family. 3) Participates must upload photo on social media tagging LPUNSS and using three hashtags. #YogaAtHome #YogaWithFamily #InternationalYogaDay2020 The entry will have to be submitted online before 21st June 2020 (Midnight)

title: Summer PEP for students of B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA graduating in 2021-22nd June : (6/18/2020)
body: Dear Students, All the best for your End Term Exams. As you know that a good performance in academics will make way for a successful career. Hence the academics and placement preparation need to go hand-in-hand for your career ahead. Summer PEP activities for the students having their last ETE on or before 19-June-2020(list attached), will resume from 22-June-2020. The list has details of your respective faculty UIDs, to be connected through LPU Live app. Important points: 1. The PEP schedule is from 22nd June to 11th July. 2. PEP classes are mandatory and the attendance will be marked for these classes. 3. You have to follow a specific schedule for your PEP classes. (Refer attachment -Student wise Schedule and Guidelines) 4. Students have to install LPU live app mandatorily as all the content will be shared through LPU live app only. 5. Time table will be punched on your UMS by 19th June. You can check it at: UMS Navigation-> Learning Management System-> View Time Table 6. For telephonic interviews in Soft Skills, dates mentioned against student registration number to be followed. The students are required to have their CV ready for the interview and they must share the same with the faculty through LPU Live. The CV file should be saved in .pdf format with file name as: Registration number_CV. 7. For the students who have not submitted VideoCV, you can refer to student guidelines attached below and submit your videoCV accordingly to the faculty assigned in the list. 8. For the students having remarks “only test as per guidelines” against the section(in either aptitude or verbal or both), all tests will be open for them and it is mandatory for them to take these tests on the platforms mentioned in the student guidelines. 9. All the students must continue attempting practice test on 3rd party practice platforms (MyPerfectice, Bullseye, Examly) as per PEP policy timelines.

title: Important Guidelines for Online End Term Examination (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200614/002) : (6/14/2020)
body: The online End Term Examination are scheduled to start from 15th June 2020. Regarding the same, the students are advised to make a note of certain important points given below: 1. Use the same URL(https://eproctor.myperfectice.com/) or Mobile App (Perfectice eProctor”-version 0.3.8), while taking the online examination, as was used by you in the mock session. 2. For login, use the same username and password shared with you via UMS “My Messages” for mock sessions. 3. Check your UMS seating plan for the updated schedule of your exam session on daily basis, one day before the examination. The dates of exams shall remain same as shared in your seating plan; however, minor modifications shall be made in timings of exam session. Earlier the exams were scheduled in two shifts 10AM-2PM and 2-4 PM. However, now the exams shall be conducted in 4 shifts in a day: 8-10 AM, 11 AM- 1 PM, 2- 4 PM and 5-7 PM. Hence, make sure you check your updated session slot one day before your exam on regular basis. 4. You shall see certain instructions on the first page of your app/examination webpage pertaining to objective type questions. Avoid these instructions as your examination shall be purely subjective, hence these are not applicable to you. 5. The detailed guidelines to be followed for online exam, advisories regarding malpractices and Unfair Means Case (UMC), FAQs, step-by-step guides on how to appear for the examination using laptop or Android phone and related videos for online exam are available at the link given below for ready reference of the students: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15BYS4u84kOSHxK1EYBCHAolswz9utM9z?usp=sharing. Refer to these files and videos for clarity and strictly adhere to them during the examination. 6. It is mandatory for the students who have registered for taking the online examination to be present in the exam as per the date sheet. Ensure your mandatory presence in the scheduled examinations, so that the result processing and marks prorations can be carried out timely for you. 7. You shall be continuously monitored online via an AI enabled software and screenshots of your activities shall be taken at random intervals. Hence, do not indulge in any malpractices during the examination. Two sets of guidelines are being attached with this communication. One is “General Guidelines” detailing the pre-requisites and advisories regarding the online examination. Second file contains the Instructions to be followed during the online examinations. Students are advised to meticulously go through these instructions and adhere to them strictly. During the exam, in case you face any issue, you can contact on the helpline number 01824-517450 to seek the resolution. The students are advised to study hard and prepare well for the examination. All the Best to the students and looking forward towards a good performance by all the students in the examination! Stay Home, Stay Safe !

title: Enrollment into Career Services-2022 graduating batch students - Registration Date Extended! : (6/13/2020)
body: Kind attention: Students expected to graduate in 2022. This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the students graduating in 2022 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2022. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. title: Employability Diagnostic Assessment for Freshmen 2020 (6/6/2020)
body: Dear Students, We once again welcome you all to Lovely Professional University ! As we say that the best way to get something done is to begin. So working on the mantra of Why Wait, University has taken an innovative step to introduce a Diagnostic Assessment Test right at the beginning of your academic journey to ensure overall skill enhancement and to make you industry ready. Diagnostic Assessment helps you to know your strengths, areas to fill the gaps, building capacity, stand out amongst your peers, and have a clear road map ahead and finally you will be an inch closer to get your dream job. These tests assess you on critical areas like communication skills, logical reasoning and quantitative skills. These skills play a pivotal role in the entire placement process and help the recruiter to identify the suitability of a candidate. This methodology is rapidly emerging as an industry benchmark with companies like Cognizant, Capgemini, Amazon, TCS, Infosys, and Microsoft for recruitment at entry level roles. The diagnostic assessment test will also help the University to plan appropriate activities and training initiatives for your future endeavours. Based on this Diagnostic Assessment, your placement specific credited and non-credited input will be planned. On the whole, the Diagnostic Assessment Test will act as a Gateway to Placements. NOTE* -Find attached the general instructions and the steps you can follow to take the test. -Test credentials will be shared with you through UMS my messages and mails. HeadCentre for Professional Enhancement

title: Important Information. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200531/001) : (5/31/2020)
body: Dear Students, This communication is directed towards resolving certain queries raised by students regarding the conduct of End Term Examination for term 19202 in the online mode: First of all, it is for the information of all students that the students can attempt their online examination through only Smart Phone (only android) as well in case they are facing any kind of difficulty with regard to the availability of laptop/desktop. In such a case a student shall be successfully able to attempt the examination with a mobile phone having battery backup of maximum upto 2 hrs and with an average net connection. Secondly, the Smart Phone (only android) shall be only used to display the questions to the students and after that the student shall be required to answer these questions on A4 size sheets available with them and upload the responses through the camera pictures (using the mobile phone back camera) on the interface. This mode of giving responses on A4 size sheets has been chosen in the interest of students to make them comfortable in giving the responses in their usual handwritten format and also to remove the botherations with regard to typing speed. Further, in the handwritten mode the student shall be comfortable for making diagrams, tables etc. in their responses. The students should also note that separate time shall be provided to them to upload the response sheets and which shall be additional to their time taken for attempting the questions. Thirdly, to make the students comfortable with the interface for online Examination a mock session shall be held for all the students before their actual examination. Herein the students shall be able to understand completely the working of the interface before the actual examination. In between the examination sessions as well in case the student faces any technical issues a call center shall be available to resolve such issues. Fourthly, the online examination shall comprise of only three questions (one from each of the Unit 4, 5 and 6 of the course syllabus), the questions shall basically judge your ability and the understanding of the concepts and also they have been designed keeping in mind that you have been taught for these units in the online mode. Finally, it is worth mentioning here that in case a student is not satisfied with his/her performance in these examinations, they shall be given a chance of improvement (without fee) in the hard copy mode as soon as the University re-opens. The datesheet for these examination, detailed guidelines for the attempting the online examination as well as the schedule of mock test for the students (to make them conversant with the examination interface) shall be shortly updated to the students. Kindly register for these examination before June 2nd, 2020.

title: Details of course codes for End Term Examination (term 19202) (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200530/004) : (5/30/2020)
body: Dear Student, The below mentioned points are submitted for your information with regard to End Term Examination (term 19202): 1. The list of courses for which you shall be appearing for examination in the online mode has been displayed in the “Exam Seating Plan” tab in your UMS login. Follow the path UMS Navigation---->Examination System---->Exam Seating Plan to view the same. The courses wherein the Exam type is “Theory End Term-Online Examination” only for those courses Online Examination shall be conducted. 2. For rest of the courses registered to you in term 19202, online examination shall not be applicable, and you shall be graded on the basis of your performance in previous assessments including CA, Attendance and Mid Term Test. 3. The pattern of the online examination shall be: a. One subjective question each from Unit 4, 5 and 6. b. Each question shall carry 15 marks. c. The total duration of examination shall be 90 minutes (approximately 30 minutes to attempt each question). 4. The weightage of these examinations shall be as below: For courses where MTT component exists Component Weightage MTT 50 CA+ Attendance 25 ETE (online mode) 25 For courses where MTT component does not exist Component Weightage CA+ Attendance 65 ETE (online mode) 35 Because of these changed weightages (as specified above) in case the student’s grade is getting affected (owing to absence or not performing well in the MTT) such students shall be given an opportunity to improve their performance, through an improvement chance (without any fee), when the University re-opens. The End Term weightage of this improvement examination shall be 75 and remaining 25 will be calculated on the basis of CA and Attendance only. In light of the above all students should not miss the chance being offered in the online mode examination. Hence all students are thus advised to immediately register for the online examination at the below given link on UMS: UMS Navigation ---- Examination System ---- Exam Registration ----- Online Exam Registration 5. The datesheet for these examinations shall be displayed to the students shortly. Further, with regard to the conduct of the examination detailed guidelines shall be provided and also a mock session shall be scheduled to make the students conversant with the Online examination conduct interface. 6. In case, a student is unable to arrange the necessary facilities required for online examination or unable to appear for the online exam for any reason. You shall be given a chance to appear in the normal 3-hour duration examination in hard copy mode when the University re-opens, alongwith the ongoing semester at that time. Note: The above points have been planned and designed in the interest of all students keeping in consideration, the suggestive guidelines issued by the regulatory bodies. Hence, the students are strictly advised to refrain from putting forward unreasonable requests such as cancellation of exam, on any platforms. Regarding your preparation for the examination, do take help from various online sources, learning material shared by your faculty and refer to your syllabus/IP. Feel free to contact your course teachers for doubt clearing and reading material. Prepare well and give in your best. In case of any query/concern, you can submit your RMS under the category – “Online ETE-term 19202”.

The training empowers, educates and encourages citizens to follow news/info/updates from authentic government sources only. body: Dear Student, The University is going to start the conduct of the End Term Examination for Spring Term of Academic Session 2019-20 in the online mode from June 15th, 2020 tentatively. The registration process for these examinations has been started now and it is expected that all students shall mandatorily register for these Examination as the conduct of these examination requires the satisfaction of the following three basic facilities by the students detailed below: 1. The student can attempt the Examination through any of the two modes described below: Mode 1: Laptop/Desktop alongwith Smart Phone (Only Android) Mode 2: Only through Smart Phone (Only Android) However, it is advisable that the student attempts the Examination through Mode 1 i.e. Laptop/Desktop as primary device this shall give optimum opportunity to the student to properly view the questions (which may include diagrams/images/case studies etc. requiring scrolling). The configuration requirements of Laptop/Desktop and Smart Phone are given as below: Laptop/Desktop Smart Phone (Only Android) a. Windows/Mac/Linux based. a. Processor: 1.8 Ghz or above. b. RAM : 2GB or above. b. Android 5.0 or above. c. A working We cam. c. Camera above 8 megapixel and allow app or browser to access camera and camera should be of good resolution. d. All Browsers with latest version (except Safari browser on Windows). d. Google Chrome Browser (latest version). e. Active Internet Connection of 2-3 Mbps speed or above. e. Active Internet Connection of 2-3 Mbps speed or above through mobile data or WiFi. f. No battery or power related issues for examination duration (2hrs). f. No battery or power related issues for examination duration (2hrs). 2. Basic Examination Stationery including size sheets, 2 Pens, a Pencil, Scale, a calculator, highlighter, eraser, sharpener, water bottle etc. 3. An isolated-disturbance free sitting space for the examination duration. The last date for registering for these examinations is June 3rd, 2020 kindly register at the below given link on UMS: UMS Navigation--->Examination System--->Exam Registration--->Online Exam Registration The registration shall require the submission of your Mobile No. and e mail ID on the UMS interface so kindly keep these handy before the registration process. Be careful about submitting these details as these shall not be changed later on and also these shall be extensively used in the conduct of the examination. The datesheet shall be released for the conduct of online examination after the process of registration has been completed. For the practical/dissertation/capstone/project based courses separate announcements shall follow shortly. The Examination to be held shall be from the Units 4, 5 and 6 of the syllabus and the pattern and process of Examination shall be shortly notified to you. The questions shall be analytical/numerical, case based/situation based etc. which means that they would basically test/judge your concept clarity so kindly prepare accordingly. The weightage of these examination shall be as below: For courses where MTT component exists Component Weightage MTT 50 CA 25 ETE (online mode) 25 For courses where MTT component does not exist Component Weightage CA 65 ETE (online mode) 35 Further, those students who do not have an access to the above basic facilities are informed that there is no need to panic as their examination shall be conducted as special category examination in regular hard copy examination mode of 3 hrs duration in the regular examination pattern as soon as the University re-opens. It is expected that you would start preparing for these upcoming Examination and perform well in the same.

title: Colors and Personality - How color affects behavior? (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/200509/001) : (5/9/2020)
body: Most of us are curious to find out, how color effects behavior ? Some interesting facts about color psychology · Different colors evoke different emotions · Colors can even play tricks on your mind. · You’re more likely to forget something when it’s in black and white. · It’s possible to be afraid of certain colors. · Men and women see red differently. · 62-90% of a first impression is due to colors. Your personality is important because it determines how you interact with your environment and the people around you. Psychologist from Counseling & Happiness cell has selected a very interesting personality Test on color Psychology Colorquiz is a five minute personality test with immediate results, based on decades of research by color psychologists around the world. This test is based on the work of Dr. Max Luscher and is widely used in Europe and overseas. There are a number of corporations and colleges that use this test as part of their hiring/admissions processes. There are no complicated questions to answer, you simply choose colors with a click of the mouse! Your test results are completely confidential. Take the test now. http://www.colorquiz.com/

title: Study from Home and COVID 19 Research Resource Repository through NDL : (5/6/2020)
body: All students, Research scholars, staff and faculty are informed that the unprecedented challenges posed by COVID-19 to Higher Educationwill not let our spirit down and we will continue to serve our stakeholders in more innovative ways. Towards this goal we wish to inform all users thatthey can access online resources through National Digital Library (NDLI), developed by IIT, Kharagpur under the aegis of NMEICT,MHRD, Govt. of India. eBooks, articles, theses, video lectures, audios, other educational materials in 76 languages are accessible on NDL portal which can be accessed on the NDL portal on the link given below. https://www.ndl.gov.in/ or https://ndl.iitkgp.ac.in/ Video about NDL: https://youtu.be/LEwAyHGKeLw NDL has come with a special collection called "Corona Outbreak: Study from Home" Which contains both academic and research material to enable students and faculty to have continued access tocontent during the Pandemic Lockdown. In addition, MHRD and IIT Kharagpur have also released a first of its kind Consolidated Covid-l9 Research Resources Repository which can be accessed through National Digital Library of India. This repository is an initial collection of latest Scholarly Publications, Publisher / Indexed Contents, DataRepositories. Documents, Videos. Journals, Conferences and ldea Calls from the nation as well as the world. In addition, it also enables people to contribute their works to this valuable repository through a Contribute button. At the moment all resources can be accessed without becoming members of NDL. However, for your convenience guidelines for using NDL for members as well registration process has been attached here for your reference. In case of any query write us at central.library@lpu.co.in

Preference polling done by students depicted that for some courses, the number of students opting those courses in the Summer Term was very less, hence although these courses are being offered to the students for registration but the mode in which they shall be offered has been re-structured in interest of the students. The details for which are being provided below. 2. In order to facilitate all the students and to ensure that all the students can register for summer term for the courses submitted by them as their preferred courses, the summer term shall be offered in the following two modes: Mode A: Learning through Continuous Assessment Mode B: Learning through Online Academic Connect 3. All the courses offered in summer term have been grouped under the above mentioned two modes i.e. A and B. However, this grouping of courses (being shown in the interface) is tentative and the final mode of offering the course shall be decided only after completion of the final registration process. The same shall be informed duly to the students in their UMS login. A brief outline and explanation for the two modes is given below: For courses offered under Mode A: Learning through Continuous Assessment i. For courses under mode A wherein the student registration in the course is very less, the students shall study the course on the pattern of Reading Mode Courses. ii. The students shall be allocated 3 assignments spanning over the whole course syllabus, at regular time intervals. (Each assignment shall be from two units of the syllabus) iii. The assignments shall be learning outcome-based and shall be designed to make the students work systematically in the course. The objective being that the student exhaustively goes through the content of the course and hence gains clarity on all the concepts and the subject-matter of the course. The outcomes of the assignments shall be aligned with the overall course outcomes to ensure that the student gets a good grip of the course. iv. No time-table shall be applicable for the courses offered under Mode A. v. Dates of summer term examination shall be informed in due course of time. For courses offered under Mode B: Learning through Online Academic Connect i. The classes for summer term shall be held tentatively from 1st week of May 2020 to mid-June 2020 (from Monday to Saturday). ii. The course learning material shall be in the form of PPTs, Video lectures, Lectures Notes etc. and shall be shared by the faculty via online platforms such as LPU UMS, LPU LIVE App etc. iii. The doubt-clearing and interaction sessions shall be conducted by the faculty via online platforms such as Zoom, Google Meet etc as per the course time-table (which shall be duly intimated to the students). iv. Attendance of students shall be mandatory in all the online sessions as per their time-table. v. The CA task shall be given by faculty in the online sessions and submitted by students in online mode (as specified by the faculty). vi. As the faculty-student interaction as well as student attendance marking shall be carried out in online mode using Zoom sessions etc., having a laptop and good internet connectivity are pre-requisites for students for attending the summer term classes. vii. The final attendance and detention calculation for summer term shall be done in accordance to University rules and regulations considering the student attendance in the online sessions. viii. Dates of Summer term examination shall be informed in due course of time. Guidelines for registration process a. Link to be followed for registration of summer term courses: UMS Navigation→ Examination→ Summer Term → Summer Term Course Registration b. On the basis of preferences received from students, a tentative course wise time-table has been displayed in the registration interface itself. c. Based on the displayed timetable, the student can select the finalized course codes and register for the selected courses in the summer term. d. A student can register upto 6 F grades only or upto 12 G grade courses only or a maximum of total 12 F+G grade courses (taken together) out of which not more than 6 F grade courses can be registered in this summer term. e. The student shall be required to pay Rs.2000/- per course code, as registration fee, through online mode at the time of registering through the interface mentioned above. Confirmation of registration shall be done only after the payment of registration fee. f. For the payment of balance fee, the students can pay the same at the time of registration itself. If any student seeks extension in submission of the balance fee, then they can submit the balance fee latest by 25th June 2020. The students should clear their pending dues by the said date in order to become eligible for appearing in the final summer term examination. g. The Registration will be on first-come-first-serve basis. The detailed step-by-step guide and instructions to register for the summer term courses are being attached for the reference of all the students. Note: For international students, separate guidelines for registration and fee payment have been mentioned in the step-by-step guide for international students. In case of any clarification the students can mail their query at academic.operations@lpu.co.in.

title: Important information related to Community Development Project/CDP(MGN231/MGN222) (Autumn Term-20211) (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200424/001) : (4/24/2020)
body: It is for the information of all the students who are required to undergo a community development project/CDP in May-June 2020 as per their program scheme. In order to facilitate the students who are unable to find relevant options for community development project/CDP due to the threats posed by novel corona virus following shall be applicable. Option-1: Projects which can be completed in collaboration with NGO/local organizations involved in community development areas offering work from home and does not require to work in field or in contact with any person. Important points: 1. The students are required to produce the certificate from the NGO/ local organizations involved in community development areas offering work from home option describing the topic and number of hours worked by the student to complete the project in the final report to be submitted to be eligible for appearing the ETP. 2. Minimum number of hours required to complete the community development project should be at least 30 hours or it should be for at least 4 weeks. Option-2: The students can opt from the number of MOOCs certifications which are available online (listed below) which can be equated to the community development project. Important points: 1. The student must complete at least 30 hours or 4 weeks of MOOC certification to be eligible for appearing in ETP. Probable list of topics While opting for any MOOC certification or work from home option, the student must ensure that the broader area of the certification falls under either of the following category: 1. Environmental studies 2. Yoga 3. Renewable sources of energy 4. Sustainable agriculture practices 5. Pollution management 6. Re-cycling/ reuse of waste 7. Social awareness 8. Management of diseases 9. Innovative practices in teaching 10. e-resources development The students can approach their respective heads for more information on the topics for community development project or the portals where such MOOCs are available. Option-3: The students can also work on topics like effluent treatment plant, solar plant, waste management, energy saving and other best practices related to community development followed by different organizations. For this, the student can refer to the websites of the respective organizations or relevant reading material available on internet sources. Further, the students are required to prepare a detailed project report on how those practices or setups can be implemented in society or in LPU. Important points: 1. The students can approach their respective HOD for more information on the topics/ideas that can be worked upon/explored. 2. The project report should be elaborative in nature and should include various aspects like operational cost, design features, environmental factors and complete working mechanism of the proposed topic/idea. 3. Students will be evaluated by a panel of internal experts on this project idea. Important point for Heads All the heads to ensure that the detail of all the eligible students in terms of their choice of option (either option-1,option-2 or option-3) and the details of MOOC certification school wise is to be shared with DPI in the attached format latest by 30th May 2020 for the planning of final ETP. The final ETP viva for Community Development Project shall be tentatively scheduled after commencement of classes of Upcoming Autumn Term 20211. The final schedule shall be communicated to students at least 7-10 days in advance in due course of time. In case of any queries or concerns, kindly email at academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in

title: Important information related to upcoming Summer Internship/ Industrial internship (Autumn Term-20211). (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200423/001) : (4/24/2020)
body: It is for the information of all the students who are required to undergo Summer Internship/ Industrial training in May-June 2020 as per their program scheme. In order to facilitate the students who are unable to find relevant options for Summer Internship/Industrial Training due to the threats posed by novel corona virus following shall be applicable. Available Options for Summer Internship/ Industrial training Important points Option-I: Summer internship/Industrial training/ with Industry/Other relevant organization (Work from Home) The student can opt for summer internships/Industrial training with organization that offer them work from home, that can be undertaken in collaboration with Industry/Organization/Company at their hometown which does not involve travel, contact with outsiders etc. Option-1:Applicable for all Schools 1. The approval of the company for summer internship/ industrial training shall be done through School TPC as per the existing guidelines (Annexure-I). Option-2: Through MOOCs Student can also opt for MOOCs certification from the list of relevant areas/ specializations offered by respective School-TPC which shall be treated equivalent to summer internship/ industrial training. Option-2: Applicable for all Schools 1) The students must ensure that the MOOCs are approved from their respective TPC in case of summer internship/ industrial training otherwise they shall not be considered for final evaluation. 2) The minimum duration of MOOCs which shall be considered equivalent to summer internship/ industrial training should be minimum of 50 hours or 4 weeks. Option-3: Summer internship/Industrial training on the challenging problems allocated by School. The students can opt from the emerging or challenging problems which shall be floated at school level to work upon. Option-3: Applicable only for Lovely School of Architecture and Design, Mittal School of Business, School of Hotel Management, School of Journalism and Film Production, Fashion, School of Social Sciences and School of Education where in creative work is involved and sufficient number of MOOC courses may not available. Students can get in touch with respective TPC to get the problems for summer internship/ Industrial training. Important points: 1. School TPC’s are requested to get the list of MOOC courses as well as emerging and challenging problems for Summer Internship approved by respective School HOS/HOF and share the same with respective students on UMS. 2. The students shall choose any one of the options listed above and should confirm same to School-TPC latest till 30th April 2020 for final approval. 3. Respective School TPC shall then intimate the final approved course to the students. 4. Respective School-TPC’s are requested to compile data of all their respective students as per the above mentioned Options and share the same in attached format with DPI-Examination for planning of final ETP Viva. 5. The final evaluation of all the option shall be conducted through End Term Evaluation. The final ETP viva for Summer Internship courses shall be tentatively scheduled after commencement of classes of Upcoming Autumn Term 20211. The final schedule shall be communicated to students at least 7-10 days in advance in due course of time. In case of any queries or concerns, kindly email at academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in

title: Backlog course registration for Summer Term May-June 2020. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200420/001) : (4/20/2020)
body: Multiple requests and queries have been received from students recently, requesting for the conduct of the summer term classes so that they get an opportunity to clear their backlog courses which they could not register in their regular terms due to some reasons. In order to cater to these requests, the University has decided to conduct the summer term classes for all students (except Part-time) in May-June 2020. In view of the prevailing critical times due to COVID-19, this summer term shall be conducted in online mode for students via online academic connect with the faculty through platforms such as Zoom, LPU LIVE, LPU UMS etc. Only the courses in which online teaching is feasible shall be offered to students in this summer term. The detail of courses shall be visible to the students in the concerned UMS interface itself. The summer term registration shall be carried out in following two phases: Phase I: Preference polling of courses: 1. The list of courses in which a student is eligible to register summer term shall be displayed to him/her in the polling interface. 2. The student shall give the preference for the course(s) which he/she wishes to register in this summer term. 3. The polling interface shall remain active from 20th April 2020 till 24th April 2020. 4. The link to submit the preferred course codes for summer term registration is given below: 5. UMS Navigation→ Examination → Summer Term → Summer Term Backlog Course Preferences 6. A student can give preferences for a maximum of total 9 F grade and G grade courses (taken together), out of which he/she can select only upto 4 F grade courses in this summer term. 7. Step-by-step guidelines to use the above-mentioned interface are attached with this communication. Phase II: Registration of courses 1. On the basis of preferences received from students, a tentative student wise time-table shall be generated and displayed in the student UMS login. 2. Based on the displayed timetable, the student can select the finalized course codes and register for those courses in this summer term. 3. The detailed timelines and process for registration shall be informed via a separate UMS announcement. 4. The student shall be required to pay Rs.2000/- per course code, as registration fee, in online mode, at the time of registering the backlog courses. Confirmation of registration shall be done only after the payment of registration fee. 5. For the payment of balance fee, the students can pay the same at the time of registration itself. If any student seeks extension in submission of the balance fee, then they can submit the balance fee latest by 25th June 2020. The students should clear their pending dues by the said date in order to become eligible for appearing in the final summer term examination. Important: Submission of course preferences, does not guarantee the availability of those course codes for summer term registration process. If preferences received for any course code are very less in number, then time-table for those courses shall not be generated and they shall not be available for registration in the upcoming summer term. Note: Before registering for summer term, the students should judiciously and carefully go through the below mentioned important points for strict compliance. Important Points: i. The classes for summer term shall be held tentatively from 1st week of May 2020 to mid- June 2020 (including Sundays). ii. The doubt-clearing and interaction sessions for students shall be conducted by the faculty via online platforms such as Zoom. iii. Attendance of students shall be mandatory in all the online sessions as per their time-table. iv. As the faculty-student interaction as well as the student attendance marking shall be carried out via online sessions, thus, having a laptop and good internet connectivity are pre-requisites for students for attending the upcoming summer term classes. v. The final attendance and detention calculation for summer term shall be done in accordance to University rules and regulations considering the student attendance in the online sessions. In case of any clarification, the students can mail their query at academic.operations@lpu.co.in.

title: Extension in dates for Final Report Submission for Project, Dissertation and similar courses (Spring Term-19202) and related guidelines (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200411/001) : (4/11/2020)
body: In order to facilitate the students, so that they can utilise their preponed summer break for the efficient preparation of their final report, the dates for final report submission for project and dissertation courses have been extended. The new timelines and the detailed guidelines regarding the project report submission are being shared in this communication. The students are advised to strictly follow the same in letter and spirit. 1. Final report submission for project/dissertation courses to be continued in upcoming term · For the project courses like Capstone-I/Dissertation-I/Dissertation-II/Pre-dissertation (Attachment-I) which will be continued in the upcoming term, the students are required to interact with their respective supervisors through video/ audio calling or via email and prepare a final report for their project to be submitted in the current term. · For experiment/field-based projects, the students can prepare a report based upon the experimental work done during in-person attendance in the University. The students will be evaluated on the amount of the work done as mentioned in the final report submitted. · For group projects, the students can conduct an online meeting via platforms such as Zoom, with their team members and supervisor and prepare their reports based on the discussion. · New Timelines for project submission by student and recommendation by supervisor: Last date for online submission of final reports 25th May 2020 Last date for verification and online recommendation of the reports by respective supervisors 30th May 2020 Submission of hard copy of the final report to A.O. office To be informed in due course of time 2. Final report submission for project/dissertation courses whose last phase shall be completed in this term and the courses will not be continued in the upcoming term For the courses like Standalone Projects/Capstone Project-II/ Dissertation-III and similar courses (Attachment-I) which shall not be continued in the upcoming term, the submission shall be conducted under following two categories: Category 1. Projects which are not experimental/field based · The students are required to interact with their respective supervisors through video/ audio calling or via email and prepare a final report for their project. · For group projects, the students can conduct an online meeting via platforms such as Zoom, with their team members and supervisor and prepare their reports based on the discussion. · New Timelines for project submission by student and recommendation by supervisor: Last date for online submission of final reports 25th May 2020 Last date for verification and online recommendation of the reports by respective supervisors 30th May 2020 Submission of hard copy of the final report to A.O. office To be informed in due course of time Category 2. Experimental/field-based projects Students who are not able to complete their experimental research work due to prevailing situation regarding the threats posed by COVID-19, can submit their final reports as per the following dates: Last date for online submission of final reports 25th June 2020 Last date for verification and online recommendation of the reports by respective supervisors 30th June 2020 Submission of hard copy of the final report to A.O. office To be informed in due course of time IMPORTANT: 1. It is compulsory for the students to follow the guidelines for report preparation and submission process as mentioned in the attachment “Process for Submission of Final Project/Dissertation Report (Spring Term 19202)”. In case, any deviation is observed from stated guidelines in the submitted report by any student, the same shall not be considered for evaluation. 2. The final ETP viva for project and dissertation courses shall be tentatively scheduled from June 2020 onwards. The final schedule of Viva shall be communicated to students at least 15 days in advance, in due course of time. 3. The above stated schedule is tentative and subject to minor variations as per the guidelines received from various statutory/regulatory bodies. The students should regularly check their UMS for updated information in this regard. In case of any queries or concerns, kindly email at academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in

title: Mental Health and coping during COVID 19 Shared by UGC - MHRD – Govt.of India (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/200408/003) : (4/8/2020)
body: Dear LPU community The outbreak of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) may be stressful for all. Fear and anxiety about a disease can be overwhelming and cause strong emotions. Coping with stress will make you, the people you care about, and your community stronger Stress during an infectious disease outbreak can include * Fear and worry about your own health and the health of your loved ones * Changes in sleep or eating patterns * Difficulty sleeping or concentrating * Worsening of chronic health problems * Worsening of mental health conditions * Maintaining work life balance while working from home Taking care of yourself, your friends, and your family can help you cope with stress. Helping others cope with their stress can also make your community stronger. Watching these YouTube videos shared will help you. · Minding your mind during the COVID 19 https://www.mohfw.gov.in/pdf/MindingourmindsduringCoronaeditedat.pdf · Various health experts on how to manage mental health and well-being during the #COVID19 outbreak. – YouTube https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iuKhtSehp24 · Practical tips to take care of your mental health during the stay in – YouTube https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uHB3WJsLJ8s · Behavioural Helpline : Psycho -Social toll free helpline - 0804611007 Ministry of Health & Family Welfare https://www.mohfw.gov.in/ STAY INDOORS , STAY HEALTHY , STAY SAFE

title: Enrollment into Career Services-2022 graduating batch students - Registration Date Extended! : (4/7/2020)
body: Kind attention:Students expected to graduate in 2022. This is for the information of all the concerned that the Career Services Registration has been opened for the students graduating in 2022 as per the following details: Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and International) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2022. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. Registration Deadline: (Revised) Career Services Registration with immediate access to placement/internship opportunities is open till 15th June 2020. Registration Process: * Pathway: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration * Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: * Process Step-I: Initial Consent for enrollment into Career Services * Process Step-II: Profile Update and PEP Fee payment ** Process Step-I: Student Consent for placement registration. title: NIF invite innovative citizens to participate in Challenge COVID-19 Competition (C3) : (4/6/2020)
body: Dear Students In this lock down period, serve the society by your Innovative Ideas. At a time when the country is facing a great crisis due to the Corona pandemic, National Innovation Foundation – India (NIF), an autonomous institute under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India has come up with a call inviting innovative citizens to participate in its Challenge Covid-19 Competition (C3). All interested innovators are welcome to participate with their creative ideas and innovations for problems or issues like reducing transmission of Corona virus through original creative ideas, innovations, which can supplement the efforts of the government in slowing or eliminating the spread further, innovative ideas which can make activities like sanitising one’s hands, body, home items, and home, public places wherever required more interesting and effective, supply and distribution of essential items to people specially the elderly living alone like ideas for the door-to-door supply of essential products and services which obliterate the need to move out of the home. Ideas are also invited for gainful engagement of people at home, healthy food for nutrition and boosting immunity specially at the time of lockdown when raw materials are limited, (Personal Protective Equipment) PPE’s and rapid diagnostic testing facilities for capacity building of healthcare, rethinking contactless devices for the post-Corona implementation, varying needs of the different segment of the population during COVID-19 like differently-abled, people with special needs and mentally challenged population. The selected technological ideas and innovations will be supported for incubation and dissemination. The details of ideas and innovations may be sent to campaign[at]nifindia[dot]org & http://nif.org.in/challenge-covid-19-competition with complete details about the person (Name, Age, Education, Occupation, Address, Contact Number, Email) and details about the idea/ innovation (including photo and video, if any). you can share your ideas for any technical help to rajesh.23402@lpu.co.in , if submitted directly to DST share details of innovation at same e-mail id. title: Important Information (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/200406/001) : (4/6/2020)
body: In view of the critical times being faced worldwide due the pandemic COVID-19, the University is also working dedicatedly towards ensuring the health and safety of its students and providing all necessary guidance and assistance to them. In a step towards this initiative, the Summer break for the students has been preponed for their convenience, in order to reduce their travel costs and botheration. The exact joining date for the students shall be shared in due course of time. In view of the above, the information regarding various academic activities is given below. 1. The Term-II of session 2019-20 (Spring Term 19202), as informed earlier, shall close as per the programme wise academic calendar and the students shall continue their study through online academic connect for the remaining time period of the term. 2. The End Term Examination (theory and practical) (for Spring Term 19202) shall be scheduled just before the commencement of new session i.e. Autumn Term 20211. 3. Tentatively, the End Term Examination-19202 shall be scheduled from the 3rd week of June 2020 onwards, however, the exact date sheet and schedule for ETE-19202 shall be conveyed to students at least 15 days before the start of exams, in accordance to the guidelines issued by statutory/ regulatory bodies. 4. The students are advised to make their travel arrangements only after the exact schedule is shared with them by the University. 5. The syllabus coverage and unit wise weightages for the End Term Examination (theory and practical) shall be informed to the students shortly via a separate communication. 6. Viva Examinations for Capstone/Dissertations/Trainings/Internships shall also be scheduled during the time period of End Term Examination- 19202. 7. The criteria for final attendance calculation for Spring Term 19202 shall be as per the directives issued by government or regulatory bodies and will be informed to the students in due course of time. 8. The next term i.e. Term-I of session 2020-21 (Autumn Term 20211) shall commence immediately after the completion of End Term Examination (theory) of Term-II of session 2019-20 (Spring Term 19202). 9. Hence, the students are advised to carry all the study material, belongings and other necessities required by them for the next session when they report to the University for ETE-19202, as they shall not have any time to go back to their hometown/native places after the completion of exams. They shall be required to join the classes of next session i.e. term 20211 immediately after completion of examination process of term 19202. Students should keep themselves regularly updated through UMS for exact schedule. The students are further advised to utilise the time of summer break for efficient preparation of their examination. title: Registration for Ph.D. Annual Seminar (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200402/001) : (4/2/2020)
body: This is in reference to the Ph.D. Annual Seminar evaluation tentatively scheduled from May 2020 onwards. All the Ph.D. Scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs before July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for Annual Seminar after each year from the date of successful completion of SAS. The main aim of the Annual Seminar is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the suggestions given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation. The scholars are required to follow the following 2 steps for appearing in Annual Seminar: 1. Registration and uploading of Annual Seminar report Scholars who have successfully received their candidacy letter and have cleared at least one End Term Report (ETR) are eligible to register for Annual seminar through the following UMS interface link: UMS Navigation --> Research & Development --> Annual Seminar Registration form Interface for registration will remain active till 25th April 2020. Once the scholar has registered for the Annual seminar, he/she needs to upload the annual progress report for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC). The Scholar should visit the following UMS link for uploading of the annual progress report. The guidelines for preparation of report and presentation along with their respective formats are attached with UMS announcement. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development --> Annual Seminar Registration form The last date for uploading the Annual Seminar report is 25th April 2020. All eligible scholars as per attached list (List of Eligible Scholars for Annual seminar May 2020) are required to register for Annual Seminar Evaluation and Upload their files. 2. Recommendation of the Annual Seminar Report by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor Once the Scholars have registered for the Annual Seminar and uploaded their Annual seminar report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> PhD Seminar File Verification --> Annual --> Download The last date for verification of the Report is 30th April 2020. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of Annual seminar report: 1. Scholars need to register for the evaluation and upload the annual report strictly as per the guidelines for completion of registration process or else their registration shall be deemed cancelled and they will be marked absent for the evaluation. 2. As per current guidelines, the scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such scholars who have either missed or are Not Recommended in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the Annual Seminar evaluation. 3. The scholars must upload single PDF file for Annual seminar report duly verified and signed by respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for Annual Seminar) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 4. In case the scholars are unable to get a signed copy of the synopsis from their respective supervisor due to prevailing situating of novel coronavirus, they can upload the soft copy of the synopsis without supervisor signature. But it is required that the synopsis uploaded by them must be strictly as per the guidelines and it must be verified by their supervisor through UMS interface on or before 30th April 2020. 5. Scholars are required to submit one hard copy of the reports duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/co-supervisor/administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) in Block 30, room Number– 302B till the date which shall be communicated separately in due course of time. 6. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 7. No extension shall be given for uploading report beyond the last date. 8. Scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using Annual registration interface) before registering and uploading the Annual seminar reports at the interface. For Recommendation of the Annual seminar report: The scholar must upload the Annual seminar report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. Any queries can be directed to Ms. Shaifali through rdc.sas@lpu.co.in

title: Automation Anywhere program during - COVID-19 : (4/2/2020)
body: Learning being Home - An initiative from Lovely Professional University, in association with Automation Anywhere. About the program: Lovely Professional University is excited to announce a short duration learning program to its students to help building critical skills on Robotic Process Automation. In the wake of the coronavirus (Covid-19,) organizations are turning to RPA to mitigate business disruptions and advance public health, keep global supply chains moving and governments afloat. Organizations across the globe are going through a never experienced transformation, which is drastically changing the polarity of skills and hence, the learning requirement. Academic institutions in India are currently under locked down phase and thus the students are finding difficult to cope up with changed learning priorities. LPU brings the learning program to extend the support to the students to build the skills online using Automation Anywhere University platform. All the students are advised to take advantage of the program and stay essential at the fast-changing workforce. Google Link for consent: https://tinyurl.com/va598kb

title: Food Arrangement for Students Staying Outside Campus : (3/27/2020)
body: Looking into the concerns raised by District Administration and the University students staying outside the Campus regarding request for availability of cooked food, the students staying outside campus are informed that an arrangement for the same shall be made by the vendor of “Food Factory”. The Google map for location and necessary directions to reach “Food Factory” is attached with this notification. The students should note the following points: 1. University has facilitated this arrangement to resolve the problems regarding food faced by the students. However, the dealing of students with the vendor in terms of services and payment shall be direct and without any intervention of the University. 2. Vendor will provide packed breakfast, lunch and dinner to the students. The student will have to pay Rs 2000 (@ 200 per day for 10 days) to the vendor either through Cash or through Paytm/ Bhim app etc. This amount is Non Refundable. 3. The payment will be done through Paytm QR code which will be shared with you through whattsapp when you call the vendor’s number 9646998484 / 9876298833 4. Once the payment is received ( online / offline), the student will get a confirmation from the vendor through whattsapp. 5. The student will have to collect the packet from food factory at a specified time (allotted to student so as to maintain social distancing). In case the student fails to collect the packet for any meal, no refund will be given to the student. 6. The student will have to collect the parcel himself (after showing I Card). The packet will not be given to any other person. 7. Meal wise inclusion is given below : (a) Breakfast : 2 Paranthas, Pickle (b) Lunch : 3 Chapatti , Rice , Daal and Vegetable (c) Dinner : 3 Chapatti , Rice , Daal and Vegetable *(Daal and vegetable depends on the availability on a given day) 8. This facility is open for subscription till 29th March 2020 only. 9. This food facility will start once first 75 students opt for the same. The schedule along with meal collection time will be informed to the students through whatsapp. In case the students are less than 75, the service will not be operational and the amount will be returned to registered students through Paytm latest by 30th March 2020. 10. Google map Link of Food factory ( copy the link in your browser) Food Factory https://maps.app.goo.gl/DTUWUB7qaiupXJeEA

title: Regarding information of Open Elective courses (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200321/002) : (3/21/2020)
body: Open Elective courses are standalone elective courses offered to a student by various schools of the university other than his own school. The students usually choose these courses out of their interest in a particular area. The students are allotted these courses through polling. For the upcoming term this polling is going to be organized shortly. Some salient points about this polling activity are:- 1. A student has to choose one or two courses (as per scheme) to study as open elective course in the next term in the current polling (to be scheduled shortly). 2. title: Regarding information for Open Minors and Open Elective courses (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200321/001) : (3/21/2020)
body: All the concerned students of the program and batches mentioned in the attached list please note that they can now participate in the polling to select either an Open Minor Area or an Open Elective course of their choice in this term which they shall be studying in their upcoming terms. Certain important points about both these are specified as below: For Students going to opt Open Minor Area For Students going to opt Open Elective course An Open Minor is a group of 4 courses that shall be offered to the students in an unrelated area to develop additional skills enhancing employment opportunities. Polling for Open Minor shall be held only once and selection once made shall automatically lead to selection of the 4 courses corresponding to the area for subsequent terms. In case of Open Electives a student has to choose one or two courses(as per scheme) to study in the next term in the current polling and subsequent polling shall be held in future for the subsequent terms for the Open Elective courses that the student has to study. In order to facilitate you to make this choice when the polling for Open Minor starts, School wise folder of list of Open Minor areas to be offered to you is available at the link: Important Links ---> Examination Instructions and Guidelines----> Students ----> Open Minor Folder The folder contains a list of open minors along with a brief description of 4 courses to be offered in each open minor option. You are required to critically analyze each open minor option being offered in your school from the same so that you are ready with your choice before the polling starts. For the Open Elective courses to be offered school wise a description of courses to be offered for your school to help you understand the dimensions of the courses the description has been made available at the link: Important Links ---> Examination Instructions and Guidelines----> Students ----> Open Elective Folder You are required to critically analyze each open elective option being offered in your school from the same so that you are ready with your choice before the polling starts. Note that there are limited seats available in each of the Open Minor Area as well as the Open Elective courses. You are hence advised to rigorously go through the description of each of the option available in your school so that in case you are not able to pick your first preference due to lack of seats you may quickly move to your subsequent best fit options available as polling for the same will be on first come first serve basis. Please note that if a student does not participate in polling for the choice between Open Minor Area and Open Elective, he/she will be open for Open Elective polling and no request for Open Minor Elective Area polling will be entertained.
