title: LPU HACK is rescheduled on 11-12 April 2020 : (3/16/2020)
body: LPU Hack is rescheduled on 11-12 April 2020. Registration Open for LPU HACK Opportunity to participate in an event which is designed for innovative minds of LPU, irrespective of their domains. Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship is organizing hackathon to bring each school of LPU under a single umbrella and to learn from pragmatic aspects of science and technology. This platform will play a vital role to connect the inter-disciplinary students for the realization of innovative and useful products for the society. This event will also provide platform to the students for participating national / international competitions. Excited prizes for the winners!!!! Registration link- https://forms.gle/e45yJx5d1XWffMLN9 Registration fee per team- Rs. 400. Last date of online registration is 25th March 2020. Date of event- 11-12 April 2020. The event is open for students of- 1. School of Architecture & Design 2. School of Bio Engineering and Biosciences 3. School of Civil Engineering 4. School of Computer Application 5. School of Electronics and Electrical Engineering 6. School of Journalism, Films and Creative Arts-1 7. School of Chemical Engineering and Physical Sciences 8. School of Agriculture 9. School of Journalism, Films and Creative arts-2 10. School of Polytechnic 11. School of Computer Science and Engineering 12. School of Law 13. School of Mechanical Engineering 14. School of Design-III (Multimedia) 15. School of Design (Interior& Product Design) 16. Mittal School of Business 17. School of Hotel Management and Tourism 18. School of Design- II (Fashion Design & technology) 19. School of Social Sciences and Languages 20. LIE (Department of Education)/ LSE (Department of Education) 21. LIE (Department of Physical Education) 22. LIT (Pharmacy)/ Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences 23. School of Physiotherapy and Paramedical Sciences Guidelines- 1. Four members are mandatory in a team (try to form multi disciplinary team). 2. Duty leaves for the participants in case of classes. 3. Refreshments in between the event. 4. More number of females in a team will get one extra point in case of tie of winners. 5. Teams are required to select problem statement from the list attached. 6. Prepare a proposal in the attached format, save it with name of your team and submit online. 7. Proposals will be evaluated by panel and finalist will be called for LPU hack. 8. There are limited seats for finalist of each problem statement. 9. For hardware category, students are required to bring their own components. 10. Hostel leaves for the candidates residing in hostels. For any query visit Innovation Studio (Block-39) or contact rajesh.23402@lpu.co.in

Nature of Job: 1- Counseling students in In-campus as well as Out-campus offices. 2- File handling and file processing. · 3-Dispatching Prospectus in Postal cell. 4-Telephonic calls handling/follow up including replying to chats/web forums/emails etc. · 5-Campus Visits to students and their parents. · 6- Inquiry feeding and data entry. · 7- Admission Processing etc. Personality Traits, Working Hours and Salary: 1- Good teamwork 2- Efficient handling of Procedures. 3- Good Information of LPU’s strength processes and interfaces. 4- Good knowledge of using computers/internet/social networking/office tools. 5- Salary offered to the students will be Rs. 10,000 per month. 6- Estimated number of days in a week is 6 and working hours will be 8 hrs which can be extended on rotational basis depending upon the task allotted. 7- Hostel Services on Subsidized rates & Food will be Actual basis. title: Important Information. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/200315/001) : (3/15/2020)
body: Dear Student, The University has been closely monitoring the recent global developments regarding the threats posed by COVID-19 also known as novel corona virus. It is putting in best possible efforts towards adopting the necessary preventive measures as per the communications received from Department of Health and Family Welfare and Ministry of Human Resources and Development (MHRD). In alignment with the directives issued by the Punjab Government, all classes in the University shall remain suspended till March 31st, 2020. However, during this period the University shall transit from in-person teaching to online/remote academic connect. In this regard the following guidelines should be adhered to by the students:- . Students should download and install the “LPU Live” App for online/remote academic connect (the details in this regard have been updated on UMS). The students shall continue their studies through the “LPU Live” App and LPU-UMS. . The University shall remain functional and faculty/staff shall be available during the working hours for all kinds of academic support required by the students. . Incase students opt to undertake any personal domestic travel; it is advised that all necessary precautionary measures and hygiene advisories should be followed. . International travel by the students is strongly discouraged. . Students should avoid participation in large gatherings or venturing out to crowded places. . All University events scheduled till March 31st, 2020 stand postponed till further notice. . There shall be no changes in the Academic Calendar of the current term We are confident that we will emerge stronger from this as ever and in the next few days we shall be disseminating further information regarding this. title: Important information regarding suspension of in-person instruction and adoption of online academic connect (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/200314/002) : (3/14/2020)
body: The University has been closely monitoring the recent global developments regarding the threats posed by COVID-19 also known as novel corona virus. It is putting in best possible efforts towards adopting the necessary preventive measures and advisories issued by the Government. In alignment with the communications received from Department of Health and Family welfare and Ministry of Human Resources and Development (MHRD) for preventive measures, all classes in the University shall remain suspended till March 31st, 2020. However, during this period the University shall transit from in-person teaching to online/remote academic connect. To ensure that the students continue with their academic progress and do not face any academic loss, the University shall transit to the model of online connect through LPU UMS and “LPU LIVE” Mobile App being the primary platforms for the same. The following guidelines should be adhered to by all the students: 1. All the students should download LPU LIVE Mobile App on their mobiles. 2. Once you register, by default you will be included in your class/section/group. 3. The reading material/lecture notes/assignments etc. shall be made available to the students in their UMS login as well as the same shall be shared by the concerned faculty via LPU LIVE App. 4. The students can interact with the faculty in groups or on one-to-one basis via LPU LIVE App in order to clarify their queries/doubts with regard to the course material shared with them. 5. The students staying in hostels should avoid venturing out especially at crowded places. 6. The University shall remain open and functional. The staff and faculty shall be available for assistance of students via all online platforms during working hours. 7. The detailed guidelines for using LPU LIVE App are being attached with this communication. 8. It is mandatory for the students to download and read the study material shared by the concerned faculty members judiciously on regular basis. All the students are also advised that these measures are being undertaken to facilitate the need of Social Distancing required for the prevention of this disease. Hence, the students are expected to cooperate and not create a situation of panic.

title: Part time job opportunity for sales enthusiasts by Bluehawks : (3/12/2020)
body: Dear Students, Taking on a part-time job while pursuing a degree is hard work, but the benefits are typically greater than the amount of a pay check. Students who work during their college careers may develop better time-management skills than their counterparts because they have to apply it to their daily lives. They earn money that can be used for fun or for tuition, while gaining experience in the workplace that will be attractive to future employers after graduation. Some of the notable benefits of part time jobs with Bluehawks are: 1. The money (obviously)2. It teaches you responsibility3. Two words: Resume builder4. You learn valuable time management skills5. title: Call for the Part (Full) Time Job as Admission Counselor : (3/11/2020)
body: Division of Admissions is recruiting students for part (Full) time job as an Admission Counselor. The primary purpose is to utilize student's talent, zeal and enthusiasm positively for In-campus/Out campus admission tasks like counselling through walkin/telephonic, preparation of ID cards and handling files, inquiry feeding, dispatching prospectus in postal cell etc. in the Division. Nature of Job: 1- Counseling students in In-campus as well as Out-campus offices. 2- File handling and file processing. · 3-Dispatching Prospectus in Postal cell. 4-Telephonic calls handling/follow up including replying to chats/web forums/emails etc. · 5-Campus Visits to students and their parents. · 6- Inquiry feeding and data entry. · 7- Admission Processing etc. Personality Traits, Working Hours and Salary: 1- Good teamwork 2- Efficient handling of Procedures. 3- Good Information of LPU’s strength processes and interfaces. 4- Good knowledge of using computers/internet/social networking/office tools. 5- Salary offered to the students will be Rs. 10,000 per month. 6- Estimated number of days in a week is 6 and working hours will be 8 hrs which can be extended on rotational basis depending upon the task allotted. 7- Hostel Services on Subsidized rates & Food will be Actual basis. Shortlisting and Academic Criteria: 1- Students of Diploma/UG/PG/PH.D (with no active backlogs) Students having any curriculum requirement/Placement activity scheduled during the period of job(May to July) need not apply. · Students will be relieved one day before the start of classes. However, they may apply for leave within the tenure of the job. Minimum CGPA --- 6 CGPA without backlogs Working Hours: 9 AM to 5 PM -Min 08 Hrs Selection Procedure: Online Test & Personal Interview Start Date of Registration: 11th March 2020 Last Date for registrations: 21st March 2020 Interested Students can register through the following link: https://tinyurl.com/admissioncounselor-2020 For any query mail at:- ptj.dsw@lpu.co.in

title: Opportunity to spend a semester abroad at 100% tuition fee scholarship : (3/11/2020)
body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for LPU students of various program (mentioned below) to attend a fully tuition fee waived semester at partner foreign University i.e. students have to pay only tuition fees applicable at LPU and they get opportunity to study for one semester at partner University without paying tuition fees of partner university. All formalities and fees relating to VISA, travel,accommodation, food and any other fees of the partner foreign University has to be borne by the student. Details of available institutions are available in the attachment. Eligibility: 1. Minimum CGPA 6.5 with no backlogs and reappearances 2. Regular Attendance 3. Active Participant in extracurricular activities 4. Excellent communication skills 5. Capacity to Sustain himself/herself overseas while studying (Estimated budget 2 Lakh to 3.5 Lakh depending on country anduniversity of choice) 6. A valid Passport Interested students must fill the form before 18th March 2020: https://goo.gl/forms/FoNDAuYwwePMdPTj2 Please Note: 1. Selection would be based on multiple interviews 2. Student can apply only to one university 3. Information sessions for Semester abroad are held every Monday to Saturday from 9 AM to 5 PM 4. Seats would be filled on first in-first out basis and are fully at the discretion of selection committee at LPU & partner University. For further information please contact Division of International Affairs at Block 32-308 or email at studyabroad@lpu.co.in

title: Employability Diagnostic Assessment for Engineering Students of 2018 & 2019 Admission Batch (3/9/2020)
body: Dear Students, We once again welcome you all to Lovely Professional University ! As we say that the best way to get something done is to begin. So working on the mantra of Why Wait, University has taken an innovative step to introduce a Diagnostic Assessment Test right at the beginning of your academic journey to ensure overall skill enhancement and to make you industry ready. Diagnostic Assessment helps you to know your strengths, areas to fill the gaps, building capacity, stand out amongst your peers, and have a clear road map ahead and finally you will be an inch closer to get your dream job. These tests assess you on critical areas like communication skills, logical reasoning and quantitative skills. These skills play a pivotal role in the entire placement process and help the recruiter to identify the suitability of a candidate. This methodology is rapidly emerging as an industry benchmark with companies like Cognizant, Capgemini, Amazon, TCS, Infosys, and Microsoft for recruitment at entry level roles. The diagnostic assessment test will also help the University to plan appropriate activities and training initiatives for your future endeavours. Based on this Diagnostic Assessment, your placement specific credited and non-credited input will be planned. On the whole, the Diagnostic Assessment Test will act as a Gateway to Placements. NOTE* -Find attached the general instructions and the steps you can follow to take the test. -Test credentials will be shared with you through UMS my messages and mails. Students who work during their college careers may develop better time-management skills than their counterparts because they have to apply it to their daily lives. They earn money that can be used for fun or for tuition, while gaining experience in the workplace that will be attractive to future employers after graduation. Some of the notable benefits of part time jobs with Bluehawks are: 1. The money (obviously) 2. It teaches you responsibility 3. Two words: Resume builder 4. You learn valuable time management skills 5. It improves your “people skills” In line with the University part time job policy, Bluehawks invites applications of enthusiastic and energetic students having ample confidence and communication skills. title: CLUB CATALYST under the aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement-III is organizing an activity on “Spell-Bell” : (3/5/2020)
body: CLUB CATALYST under the aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement-III is organizing an activity on “Spell-Bell” “If you can spell "Nietzsche" without Google, you deserve a cookie.” ? Lauren Leto.” A WARM GREETING TO ALL VERTOS! Spell-Bell is an activity in which students will get a chance to show their spelling skills in English language. The student can work on word pronunciation as well as the spelling structure of the word. The student will get a chance to learn new words through the activity. The speaker will pronounce 20 words and their meanings and students have to write it on paper. 10 students with the most number of correct spellings will get into the second round in which they can win the activity in pairs. title: Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS) of Ph.D. Scholars (Ref. LPU/DOE/IC/200304/005) : (3/4/2020)
body: This is in reference to the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) which will be conducted tentatively from 29th April. 2020 onwards. It is mandatory for all research scholars to clear SAS within two years from the date of registration otherwise their admission may be deemed as cancelled. The main key points for SAS evaluation are as follows: a) To finalize the Title of the proposed research work. b) To finalize the Objectives of the proposed research work. c) To finalize the research methodology of the proposed research work. The scholars are required to follow the following 3 steps to be eligible for appearing in SAS. 1. Registration for SAS Scholars who have successfully completed their course work or exempted from the course work (due to M.Phil.) can register for SAS seminar through the interface available in the UMS at the following link. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development -->SAS Registration form Interface for registration will remain active till 1st April, 2020. Only those Scholars should register for their SAS seminar who are willing to appear for the evaluation in the month of April 2020 and have the approval of their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor for the same. 2. Uploading of synopsis Once the scholar has registered for the SAS, he/ she needs to upload the synopsis for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the panel of experts. The scholar needs to visit the same UMS link for uploading of the synopsis of SAS along with the other relevant documents. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development -->SAS Registration form The last date for uploading the synopsis report is 7th April 2020. 3. Recommendation of the synopsis by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor Once the Scholar has uploaded the synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> Scholar File Verification --> SAS --> Download The last date for verification of the synopsis is 14th April 2020. Important Note: For Registration: a) At the time of SAS registration, the scholars should opt for the domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisors/Co-Supervisors/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension shall be given for registration beyond the last date. c) No request for deregistration shall be entertained beyond the last date of registration and the scholar shall be marked absent. d) Scholars having pending dues are not eligible to register for the SAS evaluation. Therefore, scholars are requested to clear the pending dues and get registered for the SAS evaluation before the last date. e) If a scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but is absent at the date of seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with fee of Rs. 5000/-. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from September 2020 onwards) only after the clearance of fine. For Uploading Synopsis: a) The scholar shall not be eligible for uploading any synopsis report without completing registration process. b) The Scholars are strongly advised that synopsis file must be uploaded only after the thorough discussion with the Supervisor. Same should be defended during the presentation on the day of evaluation. For preparing the presentation the scholar should refer to the format for SAS presentation (Attachment) c) No extension shall be given for uploading synopsis report beyond the last date. d) Read the attached guidelines very carefully before uploading the synopsis. e) All the scholars must upload single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I duly verified and signed by respective supervisors as per the attached guidelines or else their SAS registration may be cancelled. He/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation (with fee of Rs. 5000/-). No second chance shall be given to upload the synopsis. f) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. g) Scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using SAS registration interface) before registering and uploading the synopsis at the interface. For recommendation of the Synopsis: a) The scholar must upload the synopsis well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. All the scholars who have completed two years from date of registration and have the last chance to appear in the SAS seminar in April, 2020 are advised to avail this chance as no further extension shall be given for the same. In case, any of the eligible candidate has query regarding supervisor and co-supervisor can report at Block- 38 Room-202 or send a mail to drp@lpu.co.in.

body: Educational Tie-ups & Skill Development Cell & Student Research and Project Cell Division of Student Welfare in Collaboration with Punjab State Council for Science and Technology brings an opportunity to be a part of "Mission Innovate Punjab". An Innovation contest is planned to strengthen the research and innovation ecosystem in the state. All the interested female students/faculties are invited to register for the Innovation Challenge Event. The participants have to select a problem theme from the below mentioned areas: · Health · Environment · Agriculture · Sanitation · Biotechnology · Pollution Control · Waste Management · Clean Technologies · Artificial Intelligence · Computing · Start-ups · Industry · Employment Generation Eligibility Criteria:· The contest is open to all female faculty and students. · The entire participant must be bonafide student/staff member of the university/Institution. · Aspirant must be a female. Selection process:All the interested female faculty/students have to submit their ideas as per the questionnaires’ provided in the form. Out of submitted ideas, jury members will select best ideas and selected ones will be called for Final presentation on 2nd of MARCH 2020 . Evaluation Criteria: ·The participant need to prepare a presentation in the attached format mentioning all the details. · The evaluation will be done on the following parameters: a. Problem statement background b. Cost effectiveness of the project. c. Industrialization & commercial exposure of the project d. Project Uniqueness e. Impact on Society Schedule of the Event: Round 1: Registration and online submission of synopsis through the registration link till the 28th of Feb 2020 The last date of registration is 28th Feb 2020.Based on the submission top 40 teams will be selected for the Round 2. Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/srpc-innovation Result of round 1 will be declared on 29th Feb 2020 on UMS Round 2: Final presentation of selected ideas on 2nd March 2020 Timing of Round 2 :4 pm onward.Late night hostel duty leaves will be provided to the participants.Time per presentation:5-8 Minutes Venue :Block 39, Innovation Studio For more Information:Contact: Event Coordinators at 8725985407/8528226484/9888121794, or email to etsd.dsw@lpu.co.in or walk in to Educational Tie-ups & Skill Development Cell, Room No. 207, Block 13 / Student Research and Project Cell,DSW, Block 39, Innovation Studio.

title: CPL (Commerce Premier League) (2/16/2020)
body: Come and show your confidence, communication skills, knowledge, spontaneity and commerce concepts. Quaestors club (MSB ATOM) -Mittal School of Business Activity Team of Management in collaboration with Centre for Professional Enhancement II is going to organize ‘CPL (Commerce Premier League)’. Get rid of your stage fright and enthusiastically display creativity and knowledge on stage. Event Details:DATE: 21st February 2020 VENUE AND TIME: - Block 14-301L, 5 P.M onwardsPermission for late entry in hostels for girls will be granted. Last Date to Register: 20th February 2020, 1:00PM Students will register themselves in a team of two and both will participate in three rounds. The details of the rounds are shared as follows: Round 1 (QUIZICAL SUSPECTS) In first round the teams would be asked to answer 30 questions related to commerce. The team will be given 30 minutes to solve it. Top 15 teams will move on to the next round. Round 2 (SELL IT IF YOU CAN) In this round each selected team will be asked to pick one slip and team members will promote the given product written on the slip as a salesperson using different techniques of selling and marketing mix in 2 minutes. Top 5 teams will go to final round. Round 3 (BID IT TO WIN) Top 5 selected teams will be provided with Rs.1000 virtual money. The teams will be asked commerce related questions, they will bid to answer that question and the team with the highest bid will get the chance to answer that question. If the answer is right, then their virtual money will be doubled but if their answer is wrong then there will be deduction from their virtual money as per their bid amount. At last the team having the highest amount of virtual money will be declared as winner. Prizes: The winner team and first runner up team will be awarded with trophies and certificates. FOR ANY QUERY CONTACT:Abhijeet Moitra: +91-7544014372 Tushar:+91-9034522669 Head Centre for Professional Enhancement

title: Club Genesis invites you to be a part of a competitive activity “Sentence Race and Tale” on 19th Feb, 2020. : (2/13/2020)
body: Knowledge of language is the doorway to wisdom. –Roger Bacon Club Genesis under the aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement-III invites you to be a part of a competitive activity “Sentence Race and Tale” on 19th Feb, 2020. Underestimating the power of a right vocabulary is a sin! Through the activity we intend to focus on enhancing sentence structure and learning new vocabulary words and the application of the same. Before the end, both the teams would make, relate and present a story, based on the words given at the moment. It will be a fun based competitive activity where several rounds will be played between two teams to compete and win in the end. The team with the most points at the end of the game wins. Learning outcomes: Improvisation and learning new vocabulary, building grammatically right sentences, application of different parts of speech. Activity is open to all the students who wish to learn. Date and Time: 19th Feb/ 5 p.m. onwards Venue: 25- 304 Resource person: Mitali Sareen, for any queries contact - 9717953765

title: Science Buster 5 (2/11/2020)
body: Dear Students, Aside from food, water, and shelter, the one thing that a person will most need in life is an education. Of those four necessities, education is the only one that can help ensure consistent ability to provide himself or herself with the other three. Unfortunately, the importance of logical thinking skills is underestimated in education, and training in logical thinking skills is therefore grossly neglected. Department of Analytical Skills under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct a workshop on Science Buster 5. The intention of the workshop will be to develop the logical thinking of students by screening test and then by subsequent phases they will develop their awareness towards the current topics. The main objectives of the workshop will be: To improve their logical reasoning ability. To develop their awareness about the current affairs. To improve their general awareness. Mark the details: Resource person: Mr. Rohit Sharma, Assistant Professor, Department of Analytical Skills, Lovely Professional University. title: AMCAT diagnostic exam on 15 Feb 2019for placement registered students passing out in 2021. (2/10/2020)
body: Dear Aspirants, This is to inform you that the Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled your AMCAT diagnostic exam on 15thFeb, 2019 for placement registered students passing out in 2021. A good score in AMCAT will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So consider it very important as this is your first step towards a great career ahead. About AMCAT: AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates based on their core skills which include reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills. AMCAT is also known as an employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. Aspiring Minds conducts the AMCAT exam for engineering freshers who apply for IT jobs. The objective of the AMCAT exam is to grade the students based on their performance. For more information, you can also visit on web link: https://www.myamcat.com. Key Pointers AMCAT exam is mandatory for all students (as per the attached list). Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not appear in this exam, hence attempting it with full spirit. AMCAT exam timings will be shared through “UMS-My Message” one day before the test. Scores of this exam will be shared with companies and will be helpful for you to get shortlisted in the upcoming drives. Hence participate in this exam with full enthusiasm. Exam will be in auto-proctored mode. Kindly read the instructions/guidelines carefully before taking the exam. Duty leave will be provided for attempting the exam. So attempt accordingly. Login Credentials for the exam will be shared with you through UMS my messages on the day of the exam. Upload By:-Centre for Professional Enhancement

body: Dear Aspirants, Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled a renowned exam named CoCubes (Y-1) for 2020 batch placement registered students(Engineering/MCA) on 10 FEb , 2020. Good Score in CoCubes will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So come prepared and attempt the exam with full enthusiasm. Why CoCubes Exam is important: CoCubes is an industry renowned testing platform. Most of the companies use CoCubes as their testing platform during placement drives. CoCubes is India’s largest assessment and hiring platform. CoCubes helps us in gauging your current performance levels which will be utilized to design customized training inputs for the students. You can know more about CoCubes at: www.cocubes.com Important Instructions: It is mandatory for all the students. Total duration of the exam is 240 minutes approx. containing different modules. You must attempt every module. In case you miss any module your exam will not be considered as completed and will not be evaluated for final result. You can attempt any module at any time within the given time span (9 AM, to 11 PM). Scores of this exam will be shared with companies and will help you to get shortlisted for upcoming placement drives. Score of this exam will also be considered for shortlisting students for special training and companies therefore students should attempt this seriously. Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not take this exam, hence attempt the test with full spirit. No Duty Leave will be provided for test attempts. Exam will be in auto-proctored mode. Therefore, don’t use any unfair means during exam. Kindly read the instructions/guidelines carefully before taking the exam. Presentation/ Interview skills are a set of abilities that enable an individual to interact with the audience and transfer the messages clearly, engage the audience while presenting and interpret and understand the mindsets of the listeners. Department of Soft Skills under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct an Event- Coffee with Professor Season-3 by entire team of Department of Soft Skills-IV. In this event, students will learn on how to deal with any given scenario in an interaction with hiring partners. The main objectives of the workshop will be: To boost confidence amongst pupils to face the different scenarios set by the interviewer. Students will be made aware about dos and don’ts in the interview. Current issues and general awareness questions will also be raised to make students aware about the type of questions asked in the interview. Mark the details: Resource person: Mr. Mukesh Virmani, Assistant Professor, Department of Soft Skills, Lovely Professional University. title: Registration for R grade viva of Project, Dissertation or similar courses. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200205/002) : (2/5/2020)
body: All the students awarded with R grade (in term Autumn Term 19201) in Capstone Projects, Dissertations, and similar courses (List attached) are required to register for R grade for which the final ETP evaluation shall be scheduled from last week of Feb 2020 onwards. The students are required to ensure the following points for R grade Registration. 1. Filling of Online Registration Form: Students are required to fill the online R grade registration form and to pay R grade registration fee online via visiting following UMS Link: (for detailed process refer attachment 1) UMS Navigation--------> Reappear Registration-----------> Registration Form The Last date for R grade registration and fee payment is 14th Feb. 2020 (without any late fee) and 21st Feb. 2020 (with late fee of Rs.2000/-) No request of R grade registration shall be entertained after 21st February 2020. 2. Uploading Soft Copy of Report: Students are required to upload the soft copy of final report (if required) for the courses as per the information available in attachment 3 (i.e. List of Projects, Dissertation and similar courses) via visiting the following UMS link UMS Navigation------>LMS-------> Upload Research Project It is mandatory for the students to get the online recommendation on the same by respective Supervisor. The last date to upload soft copy of report and getting online recommendation of supervisor is 22nd Feb 2020. 3. Final Report Submission in A.O office Students are required to take the print out of fee receipt generated online along with the final hard copy report duly signed by the supervisor and visit the respective AO office for getting the final hard copy report signed and stamped by the AO officer. The final hard copy report signed and stamped by the AO need to be produced on the day of R grade viva by the student. Important Note: 1) AO officer will take the submission through online mode till 5PM on 22nd Feb 2020. 2) R Grade viva schedule shall be communicated to the students via UMS my messages at least 7 days in advance from the ETP viva date. 3) In case a student does not register for R grade or misses the report submission as per UMS timelines then R grade viva shall not be conducted and grade would be converted to F. title: YourDOST – 24/7 Emotional wellness Support for students (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/20130/001) : (1/30/2020)
body: An INITIATIVE BY DIVISION OF STUDENT RELATIONSHIP - COUNSELING & HAPPINESS CELL Dear Students, University life can be very exciting. But sometimes it can also be a stressful phase in a student’s life as real-life responsibilities and career prospects loom in the near future. Transition from school to University life, leaving home, old school friends and familiar surroundings, having to cope with academic pressure, course work, deadlines, exams, financial difficulties and relationship issues can be challenging and stressful at times. This is also the time when students have to more or less decide the course of their lives and this pressure can sometimes cause stress, depression, anxiety as well as many minor and major mental health issues. However, we can cope with this phase and achieve much more by channelizing our thoughts and emotions and reminding ourselves that it's perfectly okay to seek support when we're going through a rough patch. Where to seek support? We are happy to announce our collaboration with YourDOST, India’s first and the largest online mental health and emotional wellness platform, to be your confidant. This initiative, brings you expert advice from 900+ Experts, with complete privacy, confidentiality and anonymity on a range of subjects including: · Academic pressure · Loneliness · Stress · Time Management · Anxiety, mood and eating disorders · Confidence Building · Relationship issues · Career Coaching None of the sessions you take on the platform are shared with anyone, including the institution. With this, we also want to reaffirm the fact that apart from your academic and professional success, we at LPU also care tremendously about your complete well-being. To use this service, all you need to do is visit YourDOST at www.yourdost.com. Make sure you're connected to our University /hostel WiFi when you are registering for the first time. This will ensure you get unlimited and free access to all their services. You may also signup without connecting to University WiFi, Just enter the Special access Code "LPUYD2020" in the User Menu after signup and your account will be activated for free services. All the students are advised to make most of their services as and when they feel the need to do so. · Step by step guide to help you Login and utilize YourDOST services for free , refer to attachment below

title: Space Program @ LPU – Call for Student trainees : (1/29/2020)
body: Center for Space Research, under the aegis of Division of Research and Development invites application from students as trainees to form a “Student Satellite Project Team” for the LPUSAT-1 project. The trainees will have the opportunity to design, build, test and finally launch their space objects. With this objective, we have initiated the LPUSAT-1 project, which is aimed to train the students to study space technology, satellite engineering through practical design of satellites until the flight model is operational. A set of activities have been planned by Center for Space Research for which the student trainees will be engaged: 1. Satellite system design and system engineering 2. Satellite payload and sub-system design and development 3. Satellite assembly, integration, and testing 4. Satellite launch and operation 5. Satellite payload data processing and application 6. Explore national and international collaborative research opportunities in space technology 7. HAM Activities 8. Research Activities leading to Publications/Patents 9. Participating in Space Competitions 10. Ground station networking 11. Scientific extension activities 12. Incubation support If you are excited to join this elite group of students, you may send the expression of interest by registering yourself in the given link. The Application format must be uploaded for your registration. Selection will be based on interview and group discussion. Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/spaceprogram-lpu Eligibility: 1st, 2nd year students of Engineering/Physics/Mathematics Last Date to Apply: February 02, 2020. Should you have any queries, please feel free to mail us at lpusat@lpu.co.in

title: Great opportunity for the students of LPU to study abroad through ISEP : (1/29/2020)
body: Division of International Affairs brings great opportunity for students of LPU to fulfill their dream of studying abroad through ISEP (International Student Exchange Program). ISEP is a non-profit educational community dedicated to helping students overcome financial and academic barriers to study abroad. title: Invitation for Startup Conclave at IIT Ropar : (1/27/2020)
body: Dear Students, Greetings from Division of Start up,LPU! We feel immense pleasure to announce that the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Ropar will be organizing its Annual Technical Fest - Advitiya from 7th to 9th February 2020 in the premises of its new campus. ADVITIYA’20 has been a tremendous success in the past, achieving over 15000 footfall and hosting 30+ events in its previous editions. It is hence a platform for the exchange of ideas about the technology around us & its show casing. To groom the budding entrepreneurs, we are organizing a Startup Conclave in Advitiya'20, in which Boot Camp, Idea Pitching Sessions & Showcasing of the products are planned. In boot camp innovative startup ideas can grab soft loan up to Rs 20Lacs* from IIT Ropar Technology Business Incubator to scale their idea/concept subject to the approval of its project evaluation & monitoring committee (PEMC). Startups participating will be having another opportunity of getting funding for their idea’s from the angel investors or venture capitalists of the region. We will also provide stalls to establish startups who wish to show case their products in front of the intellectual audience of the fest which includes UG, PG, Ph.D. students of different colleges including IITs and NITs, eminent professors of IIT Ropar as well as investors. The top 10 idea’s from Boot Camp will also be allowed to pitch their ideas in this event to the investors & TBI as mentioned above. So we invite all aspiring entrepreneurs to come forward and participate in the exciting events in the Start-up Conclave, Advitiya’20 at IIT Ropar from 7th to 9th February 2020. Registration for participation can be made through the following link. Brochure covering all information is attached for reference.The registration charges are as follows: Entry to any event at Advitiya’20 (including Startup Conclave): 400 INR per Participant. Stall (3x3 sq Mtr) for the exhibition of prototype/product: 1500 INR . Registration Link: https://advitiya.in/startup_conclave/ Once you have registered, please send your confirmation mail to dupinder.23206@lpu.co.in.

title: Agri Business Incubators' Conclave : (1/27/2020)
body: Dear Students, As you might be aware that the Punjab Agricultural University has been awarded Punjab Agri Business Incubator by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare under Scheme RKVY RAFTAAR. The main objective of the Incubator is to promote Agripreneurship to help farmers to increase their income. Punjab Agricultural University is organizing Agri Business Incubators’ Conclave on February 6, 2020 with the objective to bring all the agribusiness incubators, incubatees and investors together to create a network to boost Agribusiness Startup Ecosystem. Through this platform, incubators in the field of Agribusiness and allied sectors we will brought together in order to create linkages between agribusiness incubators, incubatees and investors. Using the demonstration of different incubatees’ products, the startups will be motivated for collaborative business. Further, it will explore the spectrum of opportunities for agripreneurs in the form of business, tie-ups, funds and government policies We expect a high footfall during this event due to the crowd of innovative farmers, humongous students and faculty members, incubatees, incubators and people, associated with us from in and around Punjab and India at large. Also, academicians, bankers, venture capitalists, and industrialists will participate in the conclave. You are cordially invited for the event and we look forward to your support and positive response for the participation of your startups in the Agri Business Incubators’ Conclave. The registration Fee is Rs 1000 for each delegate/startup. You can send your confirmation, along with payment, as mentioned on the web link given below, Additionally send a confirmation mail to dupinder.23206@lpu.co.in when you have made the payment. title: Registration for Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200125/001) : (1/25/2020)
body: This is in reference to the End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled in the month of March 2020. All the Ph.D. Scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs after July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of The Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after each 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. The main aim of the End Term Presentation is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the suggestions given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation The scholars are required to follow the following 2 steps for appearing in ETP: 1. Registration and uploading of ETP reports All eligible scholars as per the attached list (List of scholars eligible for ETP in March 2020) are required to register for ETP evaluation and upload their files through following UMS link: UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Scholar Activity Details --> Upcoming Activity The last date for registration and uploading of report is 17th February 2020. 2. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the Scholars have registered for the ETP and uploaded their ETP reports for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> Scholar File Verification --> ETP The last date for verification of the synopsis is 20th February 2020. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of ETP report: 1. As per current guidelines, the scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such scholars who have either missed or are Not Recommended in one or two Ph.D. evaluations are strongly advised to register for the ETP evaluation. 2. The scholars must upload single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP March 2020) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 3. File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. 4. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 5. No extension shall be given for uploading report beyond the last date. 6. Scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using ETP registration interface) before registering and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. For Recommendation of the ETP Report: 1. The scholar must upload the ETP report well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. Any queries can be directed to Ms. Astha Malhotra through rdc.etrs@lpu.co.in or in Block-Room: 30-508A.

title: UPGRAD : (1/23/2020)
body: upGrad is an IIT Delhi alumni and Ronnie Screwvala founded a company where we focus on enabling universities to take their programs online. You can know more on https://www.upgrad.com/ About the Campus Ambassador Internship Program: We are looking for passionate hustlers who have to promote the activities of the company within the campus. The core responsibilities of the ambassador include making students aware of the upGrad programs and to make sure that majority students participates in the activities promoted by the company within the campus. Campus Ambassador’s day-to-day responsibilities include: 1) Be the face and voice of upGrad in the campus by organizing various marketing and promotional activities, conducting meetings with potential upGrad learners 2) Maintaining a constant communication channel with leads through phone, meetings, email, chat and social media. 3) Maintaining a detailed database of all the interactions with the leads and providing constant feedback to the Student Experience Manager in order to optimize lead closure. 4) Initiate awareness campaigns on campus and organize events with support from our management team. 5) Gather and present the feedback to the SEM. 6) Create one-of-a-kind experiences to generate buzz, boost brand awareness and build student loyalty. Perks: Internship certificate, a stipend of Rs.5000 per month along with exciting benefits Selection procedure: Group Discussion followed by a personal interview and then HR Round. Skill(s) required: Sales bent of mind, Passion to deliver the highest levels of customer service at all times, a team player with the ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet targets/deadlines, Excellent written and spoken communication skills (English proficiency) and Basic proficiency in MS Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel). Who can apply: Only those candidates can apply who: * are available from 22nd Jan’20 to 24th Jan'20 for selection process. * are available for the duration of 4 to 5 months. * have relevant skills and interests Benefits: * Build public relations/customer service skills * A great leadership opportunity * Paid position * Certificate from upGrad Registration Link: https://forms.gle/1HbZj8CbfppjdbWq6 Last date of registration: - 26th Jan 2020 before 12 PM Additional Information: Preference will be given to students who are hostellers & had prior experience in organizing events or head of any committee

title: Anger Management : (1/22/2020)
body: Department of Soft Skills under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement is organizing a workshop on “Anger Management” to provide education about the physiological, cognitive, and behavioral components of anger and facilitates the application of these newly acquired skills. Anger is a completely normal, usually healthy, human emotion. But when it gets out of control and turns destructive, it can lead to problems; problems at work, in your personal relationships, and in the overall quality of your life. It can also make you feel as though you’re at the mercy of an unpredictable and powerful emotion. The workshop will be free of cost. Objectives: 1. Understand the physiology of anger and identify triggers 2. Participants will learn how to normalize anger 3. Develop better lifestyle choices 4. Practice relaxation techniques Course duration: Friday 5PM – 6PM Course Fee: Free Resource Person Ms. Neetu Madan – Soft Skills (Assistant Professor, 23842) Venue : Block 34/102 Date & Time: 24th January’20 5PM – 6PM For Registration: Visit to Shortto.com/cpeevent and select “ Anger Management”.

This edition is going to be a combined track for both campus students and corporate professionals and start-ups. Full-time students and full-time working professionals from all over India, are encouraged to submit innovative solutions to solve following challenges for the Tata Crucible Hackathon 2020, and get recognized. 1. Identification of diamond using hand-held detectors - Develop a device or detector to keep vigilance on misuse and pilferage of diamond, which is very challenging due to its small size. 2. Low cost technology solution for effective sanitization of community toilets - Maintenance is the key issue in community/ household toilets in urban areas (mostly connected to sewage systems). Due to very frequent usage, there is a high chance of microbial contamination at these places which is often overlooked during maintenance and cleaning. A technology enabled stand alone or user behavior intervention, that is affordable (keeps overall usage cost less than 1 rupee per usage) that can effectively sanitize toilets and ensure proper maintenance, especially for community toilets which are used frequently. 3. Road safety measures for two-wheelers - Develop innovative safety solutions for two wheelers using latest technology which can remove or minimize the risk and impact of accidents. This could either be innovations for the bike itself or for the rider (for instance stability of bike/developing wearable’s which enhances the rider safety). 4. Façade challenge - Now day’s solar modules are becoming more popular for roof top, BIPV (Building integrated photovoltaic), facade, car port and others. Many people find the general look of traditional solar panel to be ugly and not so attractive. In such applications, the aesthetics of module become a considerable factor by the customer. Depending on the color chosen, colored solar module can blend in with the overall design of the building. On the other hand, it can be made fun and creative. This way, everyone can find a flavor of solar panel they can live with, even enjoy. There could be several options to add beauty to the conventional module to add additional feature to the product. The artist can take over, creating a design that has the color, pattern, or image to attract customers for such specific applications. The artist can make the design on any component of the module. When the modules are installed on the facade, the front view of the module becomes critical for aesthetic view. It is expected that artist can suggest designs that attracts customers with minimal reduction in module wattage. 5. Queue management for check in counters and boarding point - Often, pushing and shoving is observed among air passengers at the check-in counters, boarding points and also inside the flight. This creates a chaotic situation for the Vistara authorities to manage and handle and further delays the process of quick onboarding. It also causes inconvenience among air passengers. Hence, we are looking for solutions and suggestions to make the experience of flyers more convenient. For details you may visit - https://tatacrucible.com/hackathon/challenges.php Highlights- 1. Win Prizes worth Rs.70000/- 2. There is no entry fee. Important Guidelines 1. Team would comprise of 2 to 5 members. 2. Team leader needs to fill the Google form on behalf of the team. 3. For any guidance please contact Dr. Rajesh Singh, Professor (rajesh.23402@lpu.co.in) or Dr. Anita Gehlot, Associate Professor (anita.23401@lpu.co.in) at Innovation Studio (block-39), LPU

An exhilarating gregarious event which is a package of language, general awareness, extemporaneous speaking, and extramural activities, which would help students to overcome speech impediments, and students would learn the application of productive and receptive knowledge of vocabulary in different spheres of the event. title: Training for CISCO Cyber Operations in CISCO Network Academy at Lovely Professional University : (1/16/2020)
body: We are pleased to announce that Lovely Professional University in collaboration with CISCO has started new training program on Cyber Operations. The CCNA Cybersecurity Operations curriculum provides an introduction to the knowledge and skills needed for a Security Analyst working with a Security Operations Center team. It teaches core security skills needed for monitoring, detecting, investigating, analyzing and responding to security events, thus protecting systems and organizations from cybersecurity risks, threats and vulnerabilities. By the end of the course, students will be prepared to: 1. Understand cybersecurity operations network principles, roles and responsibilities as well as the related technologies, tools, regulations and frameworks available. 2.Apply knowledge and skills to monitor, detect, investigate, analyze and respond to security incidents. 3. Apply for entry-level jobs as Assoicate Security Analyst and Incident Responder. 4. Take the Cisco CCNA Cybersecurity Operations Certification exam.CCNA Cybersecurity Operations is a hands-on, career-oriented course with an emphasis on practical experience to help students develop specialized skills to sucessfully handle the tasks, duties, and responsibilities of an associate-level Security Analyst working in a Security Operations Center (SOC). Advantages to pursue training program in CISCO Network Academy 1.Training certificate from CISCO after training 2.Discount in CCNA Certification after training 3.Access to Online Curriculum and interactive tools 24 x 7 from anywhere 4.CISCO Facilitates Placement Assistant to CCNA graduates 5.State of the art online assessments Including quizzes, chapter and final exams, and simulation-based skills exams Requirement Basic Operating System (Windows, Linux) and networking concepts Registration detail:Duration of training:3rd Feb 2020 to 30th April 2020 Venue: Block-38 (Research and development) - Lovely Professional university Training cost: Rs. 4000 Registration Process: 1.An amount of Rs. 4000 need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees for “Cisco Network Academy” 2.Student need to fill the registration form on www.tinyurl.com/netacadlpu by providing all basic information of student along with payment receipt number. 3.Student once register cannot withdraw the application 4.Registration fees is non refundable 5.Seats are First Come First Serve basis. For any type of query contact: Dr. Rahul Saha 9915030838 or visit Block 38-203

title: Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SAS) of Ph.D. Scholars. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/200114/003) : (1/14/2020)
body: This is in reference to the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) which will be conducted tentatively from 24th Feb. 2020 onwards. It is mandatory for all research scholars to clear SAS within two years from the date of registration otherwise their admission may be deemed as cancelled. The main key points for SAS evaluation are as follows: a) To finalize the Title of the proposed research work. b) To finalize the Objectives of the proposed research work. c) To finalize the research methodology of the proposed research work. The scholars are required to follow the following 3 steps to be eligible for appearing in SAS. 1. Registration for SAS Scholars who have successfully completed their course work or exempted from the course work (due to M.Phil.) can register for SAS seminar through the interface available in the UMS at the following link. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development -->SAS Registration form Interface for registration will remain active till 28th January, 2020. Only those Scholars should register for their SAS seminar who are willing to appear for the evaluation in the month of February 2020 and have the approval of their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor for the same. 2. Uploading of synopsis Once the scholar has registered for the SAS, he/ she needs to upload the synopsis for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the panel of experts. The scholar needs to visit the same UMS link for uploading of the synopsis of SAS along with the other relevant documents. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development -->SAS Registration form The last date for uploading the synopsis report is 3th February 2020. 3. Recommendation of the synopsis by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor Once the Scholar has uploaded the synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor by visiting the following the link: UMS link: UMS navigation --> Division of Examination --> Ph.D. --> Scholar File Verification --> SAS --> Download The last date for verification of the synopsis is 7th February 2020. Important Note: For Registration: a) At the time of SAS registration, the scholars should opt for the domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisors/Co-Supervisors/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension shall be given for registration beyond the last date. c) No request for deregistration shall be entertained beyond the last date of registration and the scholar shall be marked absent. d) Scholars having pending dues are not eligible to register for the SAS evaluation. Therefore, scholars are requested to clear the pending dues and get registered for the SAS evaluation before the last date. e) If a scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but is absent at the date of seminar/evaluation then strict action shall be taken against the scholar and fine shall also be applicable. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from May 2020 onwards) only after the clearance of fine. For Uploading Synopsis: a) The scholar shall not be eligible for uploading any synopsis report without completing registration process. b) The Scholars are strongly advised that synopsis file must be uploaded only after the thorough discussion with the Supervisor. Same should be defended during the presentation on the day of evaluation. For preparing the presentation the scholar should refer to the format for SAS presentation (Attachment) c) No extension shall be given for uploading synopsis report beyond the last date. d) Read the attached guidelines very carefully before uploading the synopsis. e) All the scholars must upload single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I duly verified and signed by respective supervisors as per the attached guidelines or else their SAS registration may be cancelled. All penalties applicable for absentees shall be applicable to him/her. No second chance shall be given to upload the synopsis. f) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. g) Scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using SAS registration interface) before registering and uploading the synopsis at the interface. For recommendation of the Synopsis: a) The scholar must upload the synopsis well in advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/ Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. All the scholars who have completed two years from date of registration and have the last chance to appear in the SAS seminar in February, 2020 are advised to avail this chance as no further extension shall be given for the same. In case, any of the eligible candidate has query regarding supervisor and co-supervisor can report at Block- 38 Room-202 or send a mail to drp@lpu.co.in.

title: LPU Launched in-house communication App : LPULive : (1/8/2020)
body: The advancement in technology has made Lovely Professional University to look beyond just emails and calls for effective in-house communication. Keeping this in mind, Division of Infotech is pleased to announce a chat app - LPU Live, that empowers communication, collaboration, and engagement on a single platform. With easy integration to UMS, LPU Live is the perfect tool for streamlining internal communication. The app enables the students and staff members to keep themselves informed and stay connected with the university. It can be used across all platforms, right from the web ( lpulive.lpu.in ) to mobile (Android, iOS). LPU Live supports individual chat or group messaging. In addition, the app also makes it possible to make one-to-one or group audio/video calls. File sharing feature enables the users to transfer a large amount of data without any hassle. To foster student-teacher collaboration, the app automatically assigns the students and faculty members to their respective Section/ Department/ Division groups; all you have to do is log in with UMS IDs and the rest is being taken care of. LPU Live is the perfect app for official communication, the development of this app is indeed a big step to curb data thefts thereby enhancing data security. Download Link: Android App : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lpuchat&hl=en IOS App : https://apps.apple.com/in/app/lpu-live/id1491482310

title: Excellent opportunity for the students of Computer Science Engineering to earn fully sponsored 1-2-months internship program at MIT Singapore and Arad Romania : (1/7/2020)
body: Division of International Affairs has come up with an opportunity for the students of the Department of Computer Science Engineering. This is a 1-3 months research internship program fully based on practical approach in MIT alliance Singapore and Aurel Vlaicu University, Arad Romania. MIT alliance Singapore is fully owned by MIT, USA. They are open to deserving students who can contribute to the ongoing projects. Their acceptance is decided on the condition that they obtain entry permits from the Singaporean Government and have funds for their travel and stay in Singapore. For one of the current projects, an undergraduate or postgraduate student well versed in C++, or MATLAB or Python is needed. The project involves Raman spectroscopy/imaging of food items. The student will have the opportunity to get trained in building photonic systems and developing multivariate data analysis tools. On merit basis, the student can also be allowed weekly remuneration of ~ 100 SGD. Other than this, if you are able to crack the web interview, there is a chance that your stay and airfare is fully sponsored as well. Aurel Vlaicu University offers accommodation for all its incoming students. The total amount the student will receive is 3220 euros: financial support of 800 euros/month+820 euros for transportation. title: Online option taking activity for Credit Transfer. (Ref. No. LPU/DAA/IC/200106/001) : (1/6/2020)
body: Credit Transfer option is an initiative taken by the University to facilitate students who aspire to study abroad. They can go through all the sensitive issues and other important guidelines in relation to studying in a foreign University. Thus they should consult their parents and thereafter opt for “Interested” or “Not Interested”. The eligible students who want to opt for Credit Transfer can fill the ONLINE UNDERTAKING available on the UMS as per the following link UMS Home Page-> UMS Navigation -> Learning Management System (LMS) -> Undertaking for Credit Transfer Option Eligibility: For continuing students: A student should have a minimum 6.5 CGPA with no backlog(s)/reappear(s) and should have no indiscipline case (initiated or action taken) against him/her during his/her stay at LPU. For Freshmen: 65% marks in lower qualifying exam in case of freshmen where credit transfer option is offered. (Note-The option for taking Credit Transfer may be taken in advance; but the student will be sent to the partner/receiving University after completion of at least one year in LPU). Other important information: 1. An eligible student needs to select “Interested” in the online undertaking form to confirm their choice and thereafter click on “save” button. 2. If an eligible student does not fill the option, then he/she will be considered in the category of “Continue with LPU”. 3. The interface of filling the ONLINE UNDERTAKING is open now. The interface will be closed at 5:00 pm on March 31, 2020. The guidelines have been attached for your reference. In case of any query you may write at apcr.daa@lpu.co.in or call Ms. Mamta Rana at 01824- 444342

title: Regarding Submission of accommodation disclosure undertakings by students, who opt to stay outside university premises for Term -19202 (Jan-May, 2020) (1/6/2020)
body: All the students who have decided to stay outside university premises for the coming term 19202, are required to submit their compulsory accommodation details at Ums Navigation ->Important Links - >PG/Private/Rented Accommodation Details link. UMS interface available at above mentioned link will provide the following options for the required submission, these options will be visible to all students who have submitted their accommodation details at least once in the last term i.e. 19201 (Aug-Dec, 2019): a) Click Option -Yes, If you are staying in the same accommodation as of previous Term i.e. 19201 (Aug-Dec, 2019). b) Click Option - No, If you have changed accommodation and are no longer staying in the same accommodation as of previous term i.e. 19201 (Aug-Dec, 2019). Note: Students who were staying in university premises in last term i.e. 19201(Aug-Dec, 2019) and have left the university residential facility recently or their previous submission was not approved due to any of the reasons. title: Reporting Schedule for the On Joint Campus drive by CAPGEMINI INDIA PVT. LTD. : (12/30/2019)
body: This is for the information for all the concern that the On Joint campus Placement drive for BCA,B.Sc Computer Science/IT/Non Medical/Chemistry/Maths/Physics,B.A,B.Com,BBA,Diploma (All Streams) students passing out batch year 2020 and passed out in 2019 is scheduled as below: Reporting Date: 14th Jan 2020 for Tech Support profile and for Service Desk profile is 15th Jan 2020 Reporting Venue: Block 32-313 Reporting Time: 9:00 AM Registration Link: http://www.lpu.in/jpd About Company: With more than 1,80,000 people in over 40 countries, Capgemini is a global leader in consulting, technology and outsourcing services. Capgemini offers an array of integrated services that combine top-of-the-range technology with deep sector expertise and a strong command of its four key businesses: * Consulting Services (Capgemini Consulting) help businesses and organizations to identify, build and carry through transformation programs that will improve growth and sharpen their competitive edge on a long-term basis. * Technology Services design, develop and implement a wide range of technology projects that involve complex systems integration and IT application development. * Outsourcing Services manage, wholly or partially, over several years, IT systems for applications and infrastructures of a client (or a group of clients), and their associated business processes such as Business Process Outsourcing. * Local Professional Services (Sogeti) delivers professional technology services to suit local requirements for infrastructure, applications, engineering, testing and operations. Job Profile offered: 1. Service Desk 2. Tech Support Eligibility Criteria: 1. Tech Support: ** Student should be completing his/her Graduation in the year 2020 ** Should have scored 55% or above in academics SSC , HSC and graduation (aggregate of 4th semesters of his/her current course) with No Standing Arrears ** Only 1 year gap is allowed post HSC (12th) and not after SSC (10th) or between graduation year ** Must have good English written / verbal communication skills ** No active backlog/KT is allowed. ** Only Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Statistics and BCA/BCS branch students are eligible. 2. Service Desk: ** BSC IT, BBA, B.Com, BA, Plain BSC and Diploma all Streams students to participate in the Service Desk Campus Recruitment Process Eligibility : ** Student should be completing his/her Graduation in the year 2019 & 2020 Batch Both ** Should have scored 55% or above in academics SSC , HSC and graduation (aggregate of 4th semesters & 6th Semester of his/her current course) ** Only 1 year gap is allowed post HSC (12th) and not after SSC (10th) or between graduation year ** Must have good English written / verbal communication skills ** Students with no active KT will be allowed to sit for the recruitment proces ** B.Com, BBA, BA, Plain BSC and graduate branches are eligible. ** No Service Agreement. Salary Offered: 1. For 2019 batch: CTC Rs 2.1 LPA 2. For 2020 batch: CTC Rs 2.5 LPA Job Location: Noida and Bangalore Selection Process: *Registration *Online Test *Technical Interview *HR Interview Important Points: 1.Students have to register mandatorily on: http://www.lpu.in/jpd/ latest by 12th Jan 2020. 2. Students from nearby colleges and universities are also invited to attend the same (Students need to ensure the requisite eligibility criteria before participation). 3. body: LPU Internal Hackathon (LPUIH-2020) to select teams to participate in SMART INDIA HACKATHON – 2020 SIH2020: Government of India is providing this platform with innovative themes and seeking the participation from students to present unique solutions to the societal problems and win exciting prizes. This time it is mandatory for an Institute/ University to select teams through internal hackathon, to participate in the SIH2020. This is a grand opportunity to showcase your potential to the world. It will surely act as a catalyst in your career growth. In SIH 2020, the students would also have the opportunity to work on challenges faced within the private sector organisations and create world class solutions for some of the top companies in the world, thus helping the private sector hire the best minds from across the nation. For details you may visit https://www.sih.gov.in/ The registration for nominations for LPUIH-2020, is open now. Registration link- https://tinyurl.com/svw27qo Last date for registration- 10th Jan 2020 (Hackathon dates at LPU will be shared soon, tentatively in between 18th – 20th Jan 2020) Important Guidelines 1. Team would comprise of total SIX members (at least ONE member should be female). 2. Team leader need to fill the google form on behalf of the team. 3. One student can not be member of more than one team. 4. Select problem statement from the sheet attached with this notification. 5. title: Excellent opportunity for the students of Computer Science Engineering to earn fully sponsored 1-2-months internship program at MIT Singapore : (12/7/2019)
body: Dear Students, This is to inform you that the division of international affairs has come up with an opportunity for the students of the Department of Computer Science Engineering. This is a 1-2 months research internship program fully based on practical approach. MIT alliance Singapore is fully owned by MIT, USA. They are open to deserving students who can contribute to the ongoing projects. Their acceptance is decided on the condition that they obtain entry permits from the Singaporean Government and have funds for their travel and stay in Singapore. For one of the current projects, an undergraduate or postgraduate student well versed in C++, or MATLAB or Python is needed. The project involves Raman spectroscopy/imaging of food items. The student will have the opportunity to get trained in building photonic systems and developing multivariate data analysis tools. On merit basis, the student can also be allowed weekly remuneration of ~ 100 SGD. Other than this, if you are able to crack the web interview, there is a chance that your stay and airfare is fully sponsored as well. Hurry up to grab the opportunity...!! If interested kindly meet us at Block 32 Room No. 310 Cabin No. 6

title: Prevention from dengue fever : (12/7/2019)
body: Ringworm is a fungal skin infection that causes a red, circular, itchy rash. Take care of yourself to prevent this infection. Do’s -Regular bathing, Body cleansing is must -Before wearing clothes, drying out yourself to prevent excess moisture -Wearing loose clothes -Laundering clothes of infected person in hot water and washing with anti-septic agent -Drying clothes in sunlight for at least 2 hours. -Wearing clothes after ironing them and placing them separately -Washing your hands with anti-septic and water frequently. -Keeping hair, nails and scalp clean -Wearing well ventilated shoes with cotton socks, not sharing comb and other utilities with other family members. -Eating healthy food which boost immunity, drinking 2-3 liters of water everyday
uploaded_by: Office of HOD Division of Health Services *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

title: Go Green in the City Challenge for all Engineering students by Schneider Electric : (11/29/2019)
body: Schneider Electric – Go Green in the City Challenge for all Engineering students Dear Students, Schneider Go Green is now celebrating 10 years and our 2020 edition is going to be even more special! We are looking for students like you around the world who are willing to put their skills and ideas to the test. About Schneider Electric: Schneider Electric is leading the Digital Transformation in Energy Management and Automation. They are always on the lookout for bold ideas that can shape the future of their industries and company. Share your bold idea with them under 4 categories: Sustainability & Access to Energy: Digitize our business and enable access to energy or sustainable developments. Buildings of the Future: Can buildings be smarter, more sustainable and incorporate new technologies? Plants of the Future: Apply IoT, AI, Machine Learning and more to the industries of the present or future. Grids of the Future: Imagine the future of energy management and distribution! The Contest is organized in three steps, with each step followed by a period of review, assessment and selection who will move onto the next stage in the competition. Phase I – Submission of the Initial Application. Phase II – Semi-finals, as defined below. Phase III – The Final Round will run until the final presentations in June 2020. Eligibility: *Only university students eighteen (18) years of age or older at the time of submission of the Initial Application are permitted to submit their proposals. *Be a Bachelor’s (at least 2nd year) or Master’s student *Studying Engineering, Business, Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics and other Sciences Location: worldwide (Team members must be studying in the same Region for the duration of the competition.) At least one team member must be a woman, in line with our Diversity & Inclusion philosophy. Be proficient in English (the Grand Finale pitch will be presented in English.) Prizes: Trip to Boston - visit Schneider Innovation HUB + Personalized MIT and Greentown lab tour. Selected teams will be invited to a fully sponsored trip to the Schneider Electric Innovation Summit in Las Vegas to pitch for the Grand Prize Participants will receive mentorship from Schneider Electric experts to polish their proposals and make it to the Grand Finale! One all-female team from the semi-finals will win the Women in Energy Award, securing a place in the finals and cash prize of USD $1,000. For registration and more information please visit website link: https://gogreen.se.com/en/challenges/2020-greater-india?lang=en Last date of team registration: 10 February 2020 Note: All students who are registering themselves in the competition are required to fill their details in the link given below: https://tinyurl.com/Schneider-competition-CPE3
