title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (11/22/2019)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a bite from the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Only the female mosquito transmits the dengue virus. This mosquito is a daytime biter, both inside and outside homes, and is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed inside and outside the home in containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. They do not breed in creeks, swamps, pools or other bodies of water. --Signs and symptoms This disease has a sudden onset and symptoms may include: • Fever for 3 to 7 days • Intense headache and pain behind the eyes • Muscle and joint pain • Loss of appetite • Vomiting and diarrhea • Skin rash • Bleeding, usually from the nose or gums. Recovery is sometimes associated with prolonged fatigue and depression. Repeated episodes of dengue fever may result in excessive bleeding and shock but, with appropriate treatment, are rarely fatal. --Prevention • There is no vaccine to prevent human infection by this virus. • Wear long, loose fitting, light coloured clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. Mosquitoes can bite through tight clothing like jeans. • Personal protection and the environmental management of mosquitoes are important in preventing illness. • When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. • Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. • Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label. - All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use.

title: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for State Police Personnel (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/191119/002) : (11/19/2019)
body: Registration process for Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for State Police Personnel has been started on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2019- 20. Last date for the scholarship is 15th December 2019 The link for National Scholarship Portal is as under:- Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in (A) Eligibility Criteria for State Police Forces Dependent wards of State Police Personnel who are martyred during Terror/ Naxal attacks are eligible under this category subject to the following:- 1. Students pursuing first professional degree programme in the field of Engineering, BBA, BCA, B. Pharma, B.Sc (Nursing, Agriculture etc.), MBA and MCA etc. in accordance with the guidelines are eligible (Refer guidelines available on UMS link mentioned below). 2. Having minimum 60 % marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ) i.e 10+2/ Diploma/ Graduation or equivalent in case of new applicant. Or applicants applying for Renewal category, it is mandatory to pass the each subsequent academic year of the professional courses being pursued by them with minimum 50 % marks. 3. Aadhaar number linked with bank account is mandatory. (B) Exclusions 1. Students pursuing professional courses through correspondence / distance learning are not eligible. 2. Students availing benefits of other scholarship scheme/ getting stipend and financial assistance are not eligible. 3. Students already availed scholarship under PMSS scheme are not eligible. Documents required for verification and to be uploaded on NSP Scholarship Portal are as under:- 1. Certificate issued by the State Govt. concerned indicating that the state police personnel was martyred in terror/ naxal violence (Refer State Police Forces guidelines). 2. Attested scanned copy of the Mark sheet MEQ i.e. XII/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent. 3. Copy of Aadhar Card (linked with bank account). 4. Copy of Bank Passbook (Aadhar number linked with bank account is mandatory). 5. Domicile/ Resident Certificate. 6. One passport size photo. 7. Salary Slip of Father. 8. Current session Fee receipts. All the eligible students have to submit the above mentioned documents in SSIV Cell, Block No. 32, Room No.102, Window No. 1. Note:- While entering the university detail students have to select the University name as per the following detail:- State – PUNJAB District – KAPURTHALA, University Name – Lovely Professional University, JULLUNDER (AISHE CODE-U-0379). The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying this scholarship can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of student:- Link: - UMS Navigation---->Scholarship Management System---->Scholarship Policies---->Session 2019-20---->National Scholarship schemes. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on any working day in Block No.32, Room No.102 between 10.00 AM to 4.00 PM.

body: Registration process for Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles has been started on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2019- 20. Last date for the scholarship is 15th December 2019 The link for National Scholarship Portal is as under:- Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in (A) Eligibility Criteria for CAPFs and Assam Rifles 1. Wards/widows of deceased CAPFs & AR personnel died in harness/election duty, wards of personnel disabled due to causes attributable to Government service and Wards of Ex-CAPFs & AR personnel in receipt of Gallantry Awards. 2. Wards/widows of retired and serving CAPFs & AR Personnel. (Personnel below Officer Rank). 3. Students pursuing first professional degree programme in the field of Engineering, BBA, BCA, B. Pharma, B.Sc (Agriculture etc.), MBA and MCA etc. are eligible (Refer guidelines available on UMS link mentioned below). 4. Having minimum 60% marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 10+2/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent in case of new applicant. Or For applicants applying under renewal category, it is mandatory to pass the each subsequent academic year of the professional courses being pursued by them with minimum 50% marks. 5. Aadhaar number linked with bank account is mandatory. (B) Exclusions 1. Students pursuing professional courses through correspondence / distance learning are not eligible. 2. Students availing benefits of other scholarship scheme/ getting stipend and financial assistance are not eligible. 3. Students already availed scholarship under PMSS scheme are not eligible. Documents required for verification and to be uploaded on NSP Scholarship Portal are as under:- 1. PPO/Discharge Certificate/Book (Mandatory for category A to F) (Refer CAPFs and Assam Rifles guidelines). 2. Disability Certificate (Mandatory for category B & D) (Refer CAPFs and Assam Rifles guidelines). 3. Death Certificate (Mandatory for category A & C) (Refer CAPFs and Assam Rifles guidelines). 4. Certificate of Gallantry award (Mandatory for category E) (Refer CAPFs and Assam Rifles guidelines). 5. Service Certificate to be issued by the Head of Office (H.O.O) in case of serving personnel as per Annexure- A. (Refer CAPFs and Assam Rifles guidelines). 6. Attested scanned copy of the Mark sheet MEQ i.e. XII/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent. 7. Copy of Aadhar Card (linked with bank account). 8. Copy of Bank Passbook (Aadhar number linked with bank account is mandatory). 9. Domicile/ Resident Certificate. 10. One passport size photo. 11. Salary Slip of Father. 12. Current session Fee Receipts. All the eligible students have to submit the above mentioned documents in SSIV Cell, Block No. 32, Room No.102, Window No. 1. Note:- While entering the university detail students have to select the University name as per the following detail:- State – PUNJAB District – KAPURTHALA, University Name – Lovely Professional University, JULLUNDER (AISHE CODE-U-0379). The detailed eligibility criteria and instructions for applying this scholarship can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of student:- Link: - UMS Navigation----->Scholarship Management System----->Scholarship Policies----->Session 2019-20----->National Scholarship schemes. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on any working day in Block No.32, Room No.102 between 10.00 AM to 4.00 PM.

title: Voice & Accent Training: Workshop for students from Mittal School of Business (11/15/2019)
body: Stress is the relative emphasis that may be given to certain syllables in a word, or to certain words in a phrase or sentence. In English, stressed syllables are louder than non-stressed syllables. Also, they are longer and have a higher pitch. English is a stress-timed language. That means that stressed syllables appear at a roughly steady tempo, whereas non-stressed syllables are shortened. Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to organize a workshop Voice and Accent Training. The main objectives of the workshop: To ensure proper articulation of the sound with required stress and intonation. To let students understand the importance of voice modulation and rising-falling tones. title: AIU Student Research Convention : (11/14/2019)
body: We are delighted to inform you that the Educational Tie-ups and Skill Development Cell, Division of Student Welfare in collaboration with the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) is organizing the University Level "Anveshan: Student Research Convention" a pioneering initiative to identify and nurture the research talent among young researchers. The event is scheduled to be held in two phases – Round 1 – Saturday 16th November 2019 Round 2 – Tuesday 10th December 2019 Round 1 (16th November 2019) Concept notes of innovative and unconventional research projects are invited from students of Lovely Professional University which will be screened by the University Level Committee. Register and submit concept notes your projects for Round 1 University Level Convention using the link - https://forms.gle/9HDcstmVxRUGc743A In round 1, Students can present their projects in either of the forms like posters/presentations/prototype or demonstration model, etc. Last Date of registration for round 1 is 14th November 2019. There is no registration fee for participation. Duty leaves will be provided to all the participants (if their School has scheduled classes on Saturday). Three projects from each category (Total 15 from 5 categories) will be selected from round 1 to present their projects in round 2. Round 2 (10th December 2019) The students will be required to present their complete working project/prototype model with all technical information/feasibility details etc. Zonal and National Level Selected projects from Round 2 (One from each category) will get the chance to represent LPU at Zonal Level and the best 15 projects from Zonal Level will be given entry to compete at the National level. The zonal level event is scheduled to be held from 16th to 17th January 2020 at Amity University, Manesar, Gurgaon, Haryana. Projects selected for the national level will be given cash awards, mementos, and certificates. The overall winner projects across five Categories will be awarded a Gold Medal The areas/fields in which Projects (Individual and Group Projects*) are invited: Agriculture Basic Sciences Engineering & Technology Health Sciences and Allied Subjects, Pharmacy, Nutrition, etc. Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce and Law (Objective and Result Oriented Projects) *In case of a Group project, only three members (one principal investigator and two major contributors) are allowed to participate in the zonal/ national convention. Eligibility for Participation BONAFIDE full-time Students/Research Scholars from Undergraduate to Doctoral Degree level is eligible to take part in the convention. Those who are below 30 years of age are only eligible to take part in the Convention. Criteria for Assessment of Projects All the projects will be assessed on the basis of the following criteria:- Scientific Thoughts and Principles 20 Creativity 20 Thoroughness 10 Skill 10 Relevance 20 Cost-Effectiveness 10 Teamwork 10 Apart from the above criteria, the Scope of Commercialization of the projects will be considered as an additional merit. However, there will be no weightage point for this criterion. In the case of the projects having scored equal cumulative weightage point, this criterion will be considered for making the final decision Registration Fees, Travel, Boarding and lodging for zonal and national level participation LPU will bear the cost of registration fees, Travel, Accommodation and food for the students representing the University at the zonal and national levels. You all are requested to motivate students of your school to participate in the convention with innovative projects. For any further queries contact Program Coordinator Dr. Saurabh Satija at +91-7206226042 or email to Program Convener Dr. Sorabh Lakhanpal at headdsa.office@lpu.co.in

title: Optional full term internship for all B.tech CSE/IT students passing out in 2020 : (11/14/2019)
body: Dear Student, For all final Year B.tech CSE/IT students Passing out in 2020. Optional full term internship can be done in two modes: 1) In an Company/Organization: a) For Company & Organization it is to notify you all that the students who want to go for the internship in next semester are require to submit the form on the link given below: Link: www.shortto.com/company b) You have to submit the confirmation letter given by the company showing that you are selected for internship with joining details, stipend details & duration of your internship. c) Internship with 'No Stipend' will not be recommended by the department. It’s a very good platform where you can search good internship offers of reputed companies of your choice. The link for portal is: https://www.letsintern.com/ 2) Via MOOC'S approved by the department: a) Students can opt for internship via MOOC'S through reputed online platform with either a Master/Nano degree etc in which a group of courses for a technology are opt together. b) The MOOC'S needs to be approved by the department before student enrolls for the same. c) Students can apply for approval of course in the given link below: Link: www.shortto.com/moocs d) Minimum duration of course should be 6 Months. e) A student is required to invest 4 hours everyday in a classroom where facilitator will be appointed to take the attendance & insured discipline. f) Students will be allowed to register for backlogs, appear for reappear & improvement exams, if any, but the university will not be responsible for providing a clash free schedule. IMPORTANT: It is mandatory to upload your offer letter in PDF format only & students need to submit their hard copy of offer letter to Ms. Aakriti in 33-204 in the given timeline only. title: AIU Student Research Convention : (11/13/2019)
body: We are delighted to inform you that the Educational Tie-ups and Skill Development Cell, Division of Student Welfare in collaboration with the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) is organizing the University Level "Anveshan: Student Research Convention" a pioneering initiative to identify and nurture the research talent among young researchers. The event is scheduled to be held in two phases – Round 1 – Saturday 16th November 2019 Round 2 – Tuesday 10th December 2019 Round 1 (16th November 2019) Concept notes of innovative and unconventional research projects are invited from students of Lovely Professional University which will be screened by the University Level Committee. Register and submit concept notes your projects for Round 1 University Level Convention using the link - https://forms.gle/9HDcstmVxRUGc743A In round 1, Students can present their projects in either of the forms like posters/presentations/prototype or demonstration model, etc. Last Date of registration for round 1 is 13th November 2019. There is no registration fee for participation. Duty leaves will be provided to all the participants (if their School has scheduled classes on Saturday). Three projects from each category (Total 15 from 5 categories) will be selected from round 1 to present their projects in round 2. Round 2 (10th December 2019) The students will be required to present their complete working project/prototype model with all technical information/feasibility details etc. Zonal and National Level Selected projects from Round 2 (One from each category) will get the chance to represent LPU at Zonal Level and the best 15 projects from Zonal Level will be given entry to compete at the National level. The zonal level event is scheduled to be held from 16th to 17th January 2020 at Amity University, Manesar, Gurgaon, Haryana. Projects selected for the national level will be given cash awards, mementos, and certificates. The overall winner projects across five Categories will be awarded a Gold Medal. The areas/fields in which Projects (Individual and Group Projects*) are invited: * Agriculture * Basic Sciences * Engineering & Technology * Health Sciences and Allied Subjects, Pharmacy, Nutrition, etc. * Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce and Law (Objective and Result Oriented Projects) In case of a Group project, only three members (one principal investigator and two major contributors) are allowed to participate in the zonal/ national convention. Eligibility for Participation BONAFIDE full time Students/Research Scholars from Undergraduate to Doctoral Degree level are eligible to take part in the convention. Those who are below 30 years of age are only eligible to take part in the Convention. Criteria for Assessment of Projects All the projects will be assessed on the basis of the following criteria:- Scientific Thoughts and Principles 20 Creativity 20 Thoroughness 10 Skill 10 Relevance 20 Cost-Effectiveness 10 Teamwork 10 Apart from the above criteria, the Scope of Commercialization of the projects will be considered as an additional merit. However, there will be no weightage point for this criterion. In the case of the projects having scored equal cumulative weightage point, this criterion will be considered for making the final decision Registration Fees, Travel, Boarding and lodging for zonal and national level participationLPU will bear the cost of registration fees, Travel, Accommodation and food for the students representing the University at the zonal and national levels. You all are requested to motivate students of your school to participate in the convention with innovative projects. For any further queries contact Program Coordinator Dr. Saurabh Satija at +91-7206226042 or email to Program Convener Dr. Sorabh Lakhanpal at headdsa.office@lpu.co.in

body: Post Matric Scholarship scheme is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme and implemented through State Government and UT administration. The Scheme provides financial assistance to the Scheduled Caste and Other Backward Class students studying at post matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. These scholarships are available for studies in India only and are awarded by the government of the State/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongs i.e. permanently settled. The students can apply on Dr. Ambedkar Scholarship Portal. The portal is open for the student’s w.e.f. 04-Nov. 2019. The User Id & password for scholarship portal will be generated by the Scholarship Cell. The User id will be sent to the students through email/mobile message/UMS message. After receiving the User Id details the students can apply for the scholarship on the Dr. Ambedkar scholarship portal. All the renewal & fresh students who have submitted their documents for Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Punjab are hereby informed to report in Building No.32, Room No.102 as and when called by the SSIV Cell. The link of Dr. Ambedkar Scholarship Portal is as under:- Link: - www.punjabscholarships.gov.in Eligibility Criteria:- 1. Scholarship holder under this scheme will not avail any other scholarship / stipend for pursuing the same course from any other government agencies/department. 2. The annual income of parents/ guardian from all sources is as under: Income Ceiling: For SC Students – Less than Rs.2,50,000/- (Per annum) For OBC Students – Less than Rs.1,50,000/- (Per annum) The detailed eligibility criteria, required documents and instructions for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in Students UMS Login :- Link: - UMS Navigation----->Scholarship Management System----->Scholarship Policies----->Session 2019-20----->Post Matric Scholarship Schemes (PMS). title: AIU Student Research Convention : (11/11/2019)
body: We are delighted to inform you that the Educational Tie-ups and Skill Development Cell, Division of Student Welfare in collaboration with the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) is organizing the University Level "Anveshan: Student Research Convention" a pioneering initiative to identify and nurture the research talent among young researchers. The event is scheduled to be held in two phases – Round 1 – Saturday 16th November 2019 Round 2 – Tuesday 10th December 2019 Round 1 (16th November 2019) Concept notes of innovative and unconventional research projects are invited from students of Lovely Professional University which will be screened by the University Level Committee. Register and submit concept notes your projects for Round 1 University Level Convention using the link - https://forms.gle/9HDcstmVxRUGc743A In round 1, Students can present their projects in either of the forms like posters/presentations/prototype or demonstration model, etc. Last Date of registration for round 1 is 13th November 2019. There is no registration fee for participation. Duty leaves will be provided to all the participants (if their School has scheduled classes on Saturday). Three projects from each category (Total 15 from 5 categories) will be selected from round 1 to present their projects in round 2. Round 2 (10th December 2019) The students will be required to present their complete working project/prototype model with all technical information/feasibility details etc. Zonal and National Level Selected projects from Round 2 (One from each category) will get the chance to represent LPU at Zonal Level and the best 15 projects from Zonal Level will be given entry to compete at the National level. The zonal level event is scheduled to be held from 16th to 17th January 2020 at Amity University, Manesar, Gurgaon, Haryana. Projects selected for the national level will be given cash awards, mementos, and certificates. The overall winner projects across five Categories will be awarded a Gold Medal. The areas/fields in which Projects (Individual and Group Projects*) are invited: Agriculture Basic Sciences Engineering & Technology Health Sciences and Allied Subjects, Pharmacy, Nutrition, etc. Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce and Law (Objective and Result Oriented Projects) *In case of a Group project, only three members (one principal investigator and two major contributors) are allowed to participate in the zonal/ national convention. Eligibility for Participation BONAFIDE full time Students/Research Scholars from Undergraduate to Doctoral Degree level are eligible to take part in the convention. Those who are below 30 years of age are only eligible to take part in the Convention. Criteria for Assessment of Projects All the projects will be assessed on the basis of the following criteria:- Scientific Thoughts and Principles 20 Creativity 20 Thoroughness 10 Skill 10 Relevance 20 Cost-Effectiveness 10 Teamwork 10 Apart from the above criteria, the Scope of Commercialization of the projects will be considered as an additional merit. However, there will be no weightage point for this criterion. In the case of the projects having scored equal cumulative weightage point, this criterion will be considered for making the final decision Registration Fees, Travel, Boarding and lodging for zonal and national level participationLPU will bear the cost of registration fees, Travel, Accommodation and food for the students representing the University at the zonal and national levels. You all are requested to motivate students of your school to participate in the convention with innovative projects. For any further queries contact Program Coordinator Dr. Saurabh Satija at +91-7206226042 or email to Program Convener Dr. Sorabh Lakhanpal at headdsa.office@lpu.co.in 20 20

body: We are delighted to inform you that the Educational Tie-ups and Skill Development Cell, Division of Student Welfare in collaboration with the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) is organizing the University Level "Anveshan: Student research Convention" a pioneering initiative to identify and nurture the research talent among young researchers. The event is scheduled to be held on 16 th November 2019(Round 1) and 10th December 2019 (Round 2). Round 1 (16 th November 2019) Concept notes of innovative and unconventional research projects are invited froms tudents of Lovely Professional University which will be screened by the University Level Committee. Register and submit concept notes your projects for Round 1 University Level Convention using the link - https://forms.gle/WAb6SqMdhJrqRrhCA In round 1 Students can present their projects in either of the form like posters/presentations/prototype or demonstration model etc.Last Date of registration for round 1 is 13th November 2019. There is no registration fees for participation.Duty leaves will be provided to all the participants. Three projects from each category (Total 15 from 5 categories) will be selected from round 1 to present their projects in round 2. Round 2 (10 th December 2019) The students will be required to present their complete working project/prototype model with all technical information/feasibility details etc. Zonal and National Level Selected projects from Round 2 (One from each category) will get the chance to represent LPU at Zonal Level and the best 15 projects from Zonal Level will be given entry to compete at the National level. The zonal level event is scheduled to be held from 16th to 17th January 2020 at Amity University, Manesar, Gurgaon, Haryana. Projects selected for the national level will be given cash awards, mementos, and certificates. The overall winner projects across five Categories also to be awarded a Gold Medal. The areas/fields in which Projects (Individual and Group Projects*) are invited: * Agriculture *Basic Sciences * Engineering &Technology * Health Sciences and Allied Subjects, Pharmacy, Nutrition, etc. * Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce and Law (Objective and Result Oriented Projects) In case of a Group project, only three members (one principal investigator and two major contributors) are allowed to participate in the zonal/ national convention. Eligibility for Participation BONAFIDE full-time Students/Research Scholars from Undergraduate to Doctoral Degree level are eligible to take part in the convention. Those who are below 30 years of age are only eligible to take part in the Convention. Criteria for Assessment of Projects All the projects will be assessed on the basis of the following criteria:- Scientific Thoughts and Principles 20 Creativity 20 Thoroughness 10 Skill 10 Relevance 20 Cost-Effectiveness 10 Teamwork 10 Apart from the above criteria, the Scope of Commercialization of the projects will be considered as an additional merit. However, there will be no weightage point for this criterion. In the case of the projects having scored equal cumulative weightage point, this criterion will be considered for making the final decision Registration Fees, Travel, Boarding and Lodging for zonal and national level participation LPU will bear the cost of registration fees, Travel, Accommodation and food for the students representing the University at the zonal and national level. For any further queries contact Program Coordinator Dr. Saurabh Satija at +91-7206226042 or email at etsd.dsw@lpu.co.in

title: Prevention from dengue fever : (11/9/2019)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a bite from the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Only the female mosquito transmits the dengue virus. This mosquito is a daytime biter, both inside and outside homes, and is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed inside and outside the home in containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. They do not breed in creeks, swamps, pools or other bodies of water. --Signs and symptoms . This disease has a sudden onset and symptoms may include: • Fever for 3 to 7 days • Intense headache and pain behind the eyes • Muscle and joint pain • Loss of appetite • Vomiting and diarrhea • Skin rash • Bleeding, usually from the nose or gums. Recovery is sometimes associated with prolonged fatigue and depression. Repeated episodes of dengue fever may result in excessive bleeding and shock but, with appropriate treatment, are rarely fatal. --Prevention • There is no vaccine to prevent human infection by this virus. • Wear long, loose fitting, light coloured clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. Mosquitoes can bite through tight clothing like jeans. • Personal protection and the environmental management of mosquitoes are important in preventing illness. • When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. • Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. • Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label. - All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use.

Design and development of Waste collection and monitoring with its geo mapping based on autonomous vehicle An Autonomous vehicle will be designed for automatic collecting and monitoring the garbage from the bins. title: LPU Student Research Convention : (11/7/2019)
body: We are delighted to inform you that the Educational Tie-ups and Skill Development Cell, Division of Student Welfare in collaboration with the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) is organizing the University Level "Anveshan: Student research Convention" a pioneering initiative to identify and nurture the research talent among young researchers. The event is scheduled to be held on 16 th November 2019(Round 1) and 10th December 2019 (Round 2). Round 1 (16 th November 2019) Concept notes of innovative and unconventional research projects are invited froms tudents of Lovely Professional University which will be screened by the University Level Committee. Register and submit concept notes your projects for Round 1 University Level Convention using the link - https://forms.gle/WAb6SqMdhJrqRrhCA In round 1 Students can present their projects in either of the form like posters/presentations/prototype or demonstration model etc.Last Date of registration for round 1 is 10 th November 2019. There is no registration fees for participation.Duty leaves will be provided to all the participants. Three projects from each category (Total 15 from 5 categories) will be selected from round 1 to present their projects in round 2. Round 2 (10 th December 2019) The students will be required to present their complete working project/prototype model with all technical information/feasibility details etc. Zonal and National Level Selected projects from Round 2 (One from each category) will get the chance to represent LPU at Zonal Level and the best 15 projects from Zonal Level will be given entry to compete at the National level. The zonal level event is scheduled to be held from 16th to 17th January 2020 at Amity University, Manesar, Gurgaon, Haryana. Projects selected for the national level will be given cash awards, mementos, and certificates. The overall winner projects across five Categories also to be awarded a Gold Medal. The areas/fields in which Projects (Individual and Group Projects*) are invited: * Agriculture * Basic Sciences * Engineering &Technology * Health Sciences and Allied Subjects, Pharmacy, Nutrition, etc. * Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce and Law (Objective and Result Oriented Projects) In case of a Group project, only three members (one principal investigator and two major contributors) are allowed to participate in the zonal/ national convention. Eligibility for Participation BONAFIDE full-time Students/Research Scholars from Undergraduate to Doctoral Degree level are eligible to take part in the convention. Those who are below 30 years of age are only eligible to take part in the Convention. Criteria for Assessment of Projects All the projects will be assessed on the basis of the following criteria:- Scientific Thoughts and Principles 20 Creativity 20 Thoroughness 10 Skill 10 Relevance 20 Cost-Effectiveness 10 Teamwork 10 Apart from the above criteria, the Scope of Commercialization of the projects will be considered as an additional merit. However, there will be no weightage point for this criterion. In the case of the projects having scored equal cumulative weightage point, this criterion will be considered for making the final decision Registration Fees, Travel, Boarding and Lodging for zonal and national level participation LPU will bear the cost of registration fees, Travel, Accommodation and food for the students representing the University at the zonal and national level. For any further queries contact Program Coordinator Dr. Saurabh Satija at +91-7206226042 or email at etsd.dsw@lpu.co.in

title: LPU Student Research Convention : (11/6/2019)
body: We are delighted to inform you that the Educational Tie-ups and Skill Development Cell, Division of Student Welfare in collaboration with the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) is organizing the University Level "Anveshan: Student research Convention" a pioneering initiative to identify and nurture the research talent among young researchers. The event is scheduled to be held on 16 th November 2019(Round 1) and 10th December 2019 (Round 2). Round 1 (16 th November 2019) Concept notes of innovative and unconventional research projects are invited froms tudents of Lovely Professional University which will be screened by the University Level Committee. Register and submit concept notes your projects for Round 1 University Level Convention using the link - https://forms.gle/WAb6SqMdhJrqRrhCA In round 1 Students can present their projects in either of the form like posters/presentations/prototype or demonstration model etc. Last Date of registration for round 1 is 10 th November 2019. There is no registration fees for participation. Duty leaves will be provided to all the participants. Three projects from each category (Total 15 from 5 categories) will be selected from round 1 to present their projects in round 2. Round 2 (10 th December 2019) The students will be required to present their complete working project/prototype model with all technical information/feasibility details etc. Zonal and National Level Selected projects from Round 2 (One from each category) will get the chance to represent LPU at Zonal Level and the best 15 projects from Zonal Level will be given entry to compete at the National level. The zonal level event is scheduled to be held from 16th to 17th January 2020 at Amity University, Manesar, Gurgaon, Haryana. Projects selected for the national level will be given cash awards, mementos, and certificates. The overall winner projects across five Categories also to be awarded a Gold Medal. The areas/fields in which Projects (Individual and Group Projects*) are invited: * Agriculture * Basic Sciences * Engineering &Technology * Health Sciences and Allied Subjects, Pharmacy, Nutrition, etc. * Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce and Law (Objective and Result Oriented Projects) In case of a Group project, only three members (one principal investigator and two major contributors) are allowed to participate in the zonal/ national convention. Eligibility for Participation BONAFIDE full-time Students/Research Scholars from Undergraduate to Doctoral Degree level are eligible to take part in the convention. Those who are below 30 years of age are only eligible to take part in the Convention. Criteria for Assessment of Projects All the projects will be assessed on the basis of the following criteria:- Scientific Thoughts and Principles 20 Creativity 20 Thoroughness 10 Skill 10 Relevance 20 Cost-Effectiveness 10 Teamwork 10 Apart from the above criteria, the Scope of Commercialization of the projects will be considered as an additional merit. However, there will be no weightage point for this criterion. In the case of the projects having scored equal cumulative weightage point, this criterion will be considered for making the final decision Registration Fees, Travel, Boarding and Lodging for zonal and national level participation LPU will bear the cost of registration fees, Travel, Accommodation and food for the students representing the University at the zonal and national level. For any further queries contact Program Coordinator Dr. Saurabh Satija at +91-7206226042 or email at etsd.dsw@lpu.co.in

title: Regarding Registration for Annual Seminar evaluation by Ph.D. Scholars (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/191106/003) : (11/6/2019)
body: This is for the kind attention of all Ph.D. Scholars that the online registration for Annual seminar will begin from 6th November till 16th November, 2019. The objective of the Annual seminar is: a) To present the progress of the proposed research work since last evaluation till date. b) To present incorporation of suggestions recommended by Departmental Doctoral Board (DDB) panel members in last evaluation. The scholars are required to follow the following 2 steps so as to be eligible for appearing in Annual seminar evaluation. 1. Registration for Annual seminar: Scholars who have successfully received their candidacy letter and have cleared at least one End Term Report (ETR) are eligible to register for Annual seminar through the following UMS interface link: UMS Navigation --> Research & Development --> Annual Seminar Registration form Interface for registration will remain active from 6th November, 2019 to 16th November, 2019. Only those students should register for Annual seminar who are willing to appear for the seminar in the month of December 2019 and have secured approval of their respective Supervisor and Co-supervisor for the same. 2. Uploading of Annual Seminar report Once the scholar has registered for the Annual seminar, he/she needs to mandatorily upload the annual progress report for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the panel of experts. The Scholar must visit the following UMS link for uploading of the annual progress report. The guidelines for preparation of report and presentation along with their respective formats is attached with UMS announcement. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development --> Annual Seminar Registration form The last date for uploading the Annual Seminar report is 25th November, 2019. Important Note: For Registration: a) No extension whatsoever shall be provided for registration beyond the stipulated last date. b) If a scholar registers for the Annual seminar evaluation but is absent on the date of seminar/ evaluation then he/she shall be marked absent. Such Scholars can appear for Annual seminar during the next scheduled Annual seminar. For Uploading Progress report: a) Scholar cannot upload any progress report without completing registration process. b) No extension whatsoever shall be given for uploading progress report beyond the last date. c) Read the attached guidelines very carefully before uploading the report. d) The progress report should be strictly as per the prescribed format. e) The uploaded documents must be properly verified and signed by the respective supervisor. f) In case, the progress report is not as per the format or is not signed by the supervisor, it shall be considered as rejected and the scholar shall be marked absent in that seminar. No second chance shall be given to upload the synopsis. The evaluation will take place from December, 2019 onwards. In case, any of the eligible candidate is unable to register for annual seminar and has query regarding the same can contact at drp@lpu.co.in or visit the Centre for Degree Research Programme at Block- 38 Room-202.

title: LPU Student Research Convention : (11/5/2019)
body: We are delighted to inform you that the Educational Tie-ups and Skill Development Cell, Division of Student Welfare in collaboration with the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) is organizing the University Level "Anveshan: Student research Convention" a pioneering initiative to identify and nurture the research talent among young researchers. The event is scheduled to be held on 16 th November 2019(Round 1) and 10th December 2019 (Round 2). Round 1 (16 th November 2019)Concept notes of innovative and unconventional research projects are invited from students of Lovely Professional University which will be screened by the University Level Committee. Register and submit concept notes your projects for Round 1 University Level Convention using the link - https://forms.gle/9HDcstmVxRUGc743A In round 1 Students can present their projects in either of the form like posters/presentations/prototype or demonstration model etc. Last Date of registration for round 1 is 10 th November 2019. There is no registration fees for the participation. Duty leaves will be provided to all the participants. Three projects from each category (Total 15 from 5 categories) will be selected from round 1 to present their projects in round 2. Round 2 (10 th December 2019) The students will be required to present their complete working project/prototype model with all technical information/feasibility details etc. Zonal and National Level Selected projects from Round 2 (One from each category) will get the chance to represent LPU at Zonal Level and the best 15 projects from Zonal Level will be given entry to compete at the National level. The zonal level event is scheduled to be held from 16th to 17th January 2020 at Amity University, Manesar, Gurgaon, Haryana. Projects selected for the national level will be given cash awards, mementos, and certificates. The overall winner projects across five Categories also to be awarded a Gold Medal. The areas/fields in which Projects (Individual and Group Projects*) are invited: * Agriculture * Basic Sciences * Engineering &Technology * Health Sciences and Allied Subjects, Pharmacy, Nutrition, etc. * Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce and Law (Objective and Result Oriented Projects) In case of a Group project, only three members (one principal investigator and two major contributors) are allowed to participate in the zonal/ national convention. Eligibility for Participation BONAFIDE fulltime Students/Research Scholars from Undergraduate to Doctoral Degree level are eligible to take part in the convention. Those who are below 30 years of age are only eligible to take part in the Convention. Criteria for Assessment of Projects All the projects will be assessed on the basis of the following criteria:- Scientific Thoughts and Principles 20 Creativity 20 Thoroughness 10 Skill 10 Relevance 20 Cost-Effectiveness 10 Teamwork 10 Apart from the above criteria, the Scope of Commercialization of the projects will be considered as an additional merit. However, there will be no weightage point for this criterion. In the case of the projects having scored equal cumulative weightage point, this criterion will be considered for making the final decision Registration Fees, Travel, Boarding and Lodging for zonal and national level participation LPU will bear the cost of registration fees, Travel, Accommodation and food for the students representing the University at the zonal and national level. For any further queries contact Program Coordinator Dr. Saurabh Satija at +91-7206226042 or email at etsd.dsw@lpu.co.in 20

title: Schedule of AMCAT and COCUBES for 2021 Passout B. Tech, M.Tech and MCA Students : (11/5/2019)
body: Dear Aspirants This is to inform you that Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled your AMCAT and COCUBES exam on 14th, 15th, 16th and 17th November 2019. Both of these tests are mandatory for you as these will create lots of career opportunities for you in the future. Good Score in AMCAT and COCUBES will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training session and exemption from some classes is well. So consider it very important as this is your first step towards a great career ahead. About AMCAT AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates on the basis of their core skills which includes reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills.. AMCAT is also known as employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. Aspiring Minds conducts AMCAT Test for engineering freshers who apply for IT jobs. The objective of AMCAT test is to grade the students based on their performance. Duration of each modules of AMCAT Exam: Module Duration Test Date AMCAT (ELQ, Domain, Personality test) 2 Hours 30 Minutes 14th, 15th and 16th November 2019 Automata 30 Minutes 14th, 15th and 16th November 2019 Write X 30 Minutes Will be informed soon SVAR 30 Minutes Will be informed soon For AMCAT Module visit: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-DDj0oONXEpt2YwoKhmxyZcib0p93Ql1/view?usp=sharing For AMCAT Syllabus visit: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HhGfwURyQlkyVlH44kEjmyDqOmcmi_HW/view?usp=sharing For more information you can also visit on web link: https://www.myamcat.com About COCUBES CoCubes is India’s largest assessment and hiring platform. It runs assessments to measure employability across all domains-from programming to plumbing. CoCubes is the acronym for Connecting Colleges Companies and was founded by IIT Bombay graduates Harpreet and Vibhore in 2007. CoCubes has access to more than a million candidates through their platform. They run 3 million+ assessments each year in 250+ cities. Detail of Cocubes assessments Assessments Duration Test Date Quantitative Aptitude Test : QAT 60 Mins Will be informed soon Analytical Reasoning Test: ART 60 Mins Will be informed soon English Usage Test: EUT 60 Mins Will be informed soon CoCubes Y-1 147 Mins 16th and 17th November 2019 QAT, ART, EUT (These tests are your practice test and this will be opened before Cocubes Y-1 Test) You will be informed regarding this soon. For COCUBES Exam Syllabus visit: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Q-w-XIK0bpuEauGJKlBjpGr6ME1s77C3/view?usp=sharing For more information you can also visit on web link: www.cocubes.com Note: Final Seating Plan for both the exam will be shared soon.

title: CLUB CATALYST is organising an activity on “ODD-ONE-OUT”. : (11/5/2019)
body: CLUB CATALYST is organising an activity on “ODD-ONE-OUT”. “One of these things is not like the others. One of these things doesn’t belong.” A WARM GREETING TO ALL VERTOS!!!! Odd-One-Out is one of the important topics in competitive exams for different types of employment test in which logical questions are being asked. Students can improve their aptitude skills by practicing the questions and answers on odd one out. There are multiple reasons why each item could be the odd one out. This activity encourages the participants to think of a unique reason and explain their rational. If the students are clear with the concepts and ideas of this topic, they can easily solve any type of problems in this topic. The odd one out activity can only be identified by considering several pieces of information at the same time. This relies on a part of your cognitive repertoire known as deductive reasoning. The activity is open to all students of Lovely Professional University. Date: 06, Nov 2019 Timings: 05:00-06:00 pm Venue: 25-304 Resource Person: Ms. Shivani Verma Assistant Professor Dept. of Verbal Ability-II

title: Club ELECTECH cordially invites you to attend the “Workshop on Shun Your Stress” : (11/5/2019)
body: Club ELECTECH cordially invites you to attend the “Workshop on Shun Your Stress” A WARM GREETING TO ALL VERTOS! Stress, in everyday terms, is a feeling that people have when they are overloaded and struggling to cope with demands. CLUB ELECTECH, under the aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement-III is organizing a Workshop on Shun Your Stress. Stress can be a motivator. It can be essential to survival. The "fight-or-flight" mechanism can tell us when and how to respond to danger. However, if this mechanism is triggered too easily, or when there are too many stressors at one time, it can undermine a person's mental and physical health and become harmful. This workshop will help you learn the techniques for dealing with stress you face in your life. Who all can participate? It is open for all students of Lovely Professional University who would like to enhance their time management skills. Date: 8th Nov’2019 Timings: 05:00-06:00 p.m. Venue: 25-504 Register yourself on the following link: https://tinyurl.com/Shun-Your-Stress E-certificates would be provided to all participants Resource Person: Poonam Tarpial Assistant Professor, Dept of Soft Skills-II, Center For Professional Enhancement-3 +91-9872241829

body: Last date has been extended for applying for Financial Assistance for Education (Scholarship) to the Children of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers on National Scholarship portal for the session 2019-20. title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (11/4/2019)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a bite from the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Only the female mosquito transmits the dengue virus. This mosquito is a daytime biter, both inside and outside homes, and is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed inside and outside the home in containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. They do not breed in creeks, swamps, pools or other bodies of water. --Signs and symptoms This disease has a sudden onset and symptoms may include: • Fever for 3 to 7 days • Intense headache and pain behind the eyes • Muscle and joint pain • Loss of appetite • Vomiting and diarrhea • Skin rash • Bleeding, usually from the nose or gums. Recovery is sometimes associated with prolonged fatigue and depression. Repeated episodes of dengue fever may result in excessive bleeding and shock but, with appropriate treatment, are rarely fatal. --Prevention • There is no vaccine to prevent human infection by this virus. • Wear long, loose fitting, light coloured clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. Mosquitoes can bite through tight clothing like jeans. • Personal protection and the environmental management of mosquitoes are important in preventing illness. • When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. • Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. • Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label. - All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use.

body: Club MRIDA cordially invites you to attend the activity “Tips on Time management” “This time is, like all times is a very good one, if we know but what to do with it” — Ralph Waldo Emerson A WARM GREETING TO ALL VERTOS! Whether we assign a dollar value to it or not, time is valuable to us. Good time management skills allow us to accomplish more in shorter period, giving us more free time, which lets us take advantage of learning opportunities, lowers our stress, and helps us focus. Time management, thus, is an important key to lead a successful and less stressful life. title: Club ELECTECH cordially invites you to attend the Workshop on “Pictures Speak volumes.” : (10/30/2019)
body: Club ELECTECH cordially invites you to attend the Workshop on “Pictures Speak volumes.” (1st November 2019) “Life is weird and complex but very simple at the same time. It’s all about PERCEPTION.” — Tyler Posey A WARM GREETING TO ALL VERTOS! There are some questions for which one wishes to seek answers: When is a surface with marks on it called a "picture”? How do pictures carry meaning? What kinds of meaning can pictures carry? Is there a grammar of picturing? Is picture perception essentially innate, or is it a skill that must be learned? Once you decide what a picture is, you will be able to understand what it conveys or how to interpret it. Perception refers to the cognition of what one sees. Enhancing picture perception skills improves one’s decision making and reasoning skills and helps in brainstorming. CLUB ELECTECH under the Aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement-III is organizing a Workshop on “Pictures Speak volumes.” It is open for all students of Lovely Professional University who would like to enhance their creative skills. E- Certificates would be given to all participants and no registration fees. Date: 1st November 2019 Timings: 05:00 p.m. onwards Venue: 25-504 Register yourself on the following link: https://tinyurl.com/picturesspeakvolumes-cpe3 Resource Person: Ms. Parveen Kumari Assistant Professor Department of Verbal Ability II Centre for Professional Enhancement-III Contact No: +91-7009898337

title: Opportunity to be associated with projects at "innovation Studio" : (10/25/2019)
body: Opportunity to be associated with projects at "innovation Studio" It gives me immense pleasure to announce the opening for interdisciplinary students (Mechanical Engg./ Electrical Engg./Electronics Engg./Computer Science/Design ) to be associated with the projects at "Innovation Studio". Students with required skill sets and zeal to work on innovative projects are welcome to join us by registering on link- https://tinyurl.com/innovationstudioprojects1 Selection: Team Selection will be on the basis of interview. Last Date of registration: 8th Nov. 2019 Details of projects are as follows- 1. Design and development of Waste collection and monitoring with its geo mapping based on autonomous vehicle An autonomous vehicle will be designed for automatic collecting and monitoring the garbage from the bins. The bins will be connected to the vehicle with the help of wireless communication module. An offline geographic-map will be embedded in the vehicle, so that it can reach to the bins and collect the garbage. Team Requirement · Mechanical structure design- 5 members (Structure modelling, Design of mechanical structure) · Electronics and electrical system design-5 members (Good knowledge of register level coding in any given microcontroller, Selection of hardware, PCB design on Tina, BLDC motor control, Controller design for electric motor, driver design to control BLDC motor, Coding of microcontroller, Sensor selection and its coding, BLDC Motor design, GPS data collection and filtering, path following algorithms, experience with Kinect sensor coding, Vision and image processing using Raspberry Pi) · Firmware development (Computer Science) -5 members (GUI, Coding for cloud server, geo mapping of data from hardware, Machine learning, AI) · Outer Design-2 members (Knowledge to design outer aesthetic of the model etc.) 2. Self-balancing bike with remote A self- balancing bike will be designed to reduce the impact on the person for going to parking point. The bike will reach to the parking place without any intervention. This bike is wirelessly connecting to the mobile application, and with the help of this application, a person sends the request to the bike for picking up. Team Requirement · Mechanical structure design-5 members (Modelling of self-balancing mobile structure, Design of structure) · Electronics and electrical system design-5 members (Good knowledge of register level coding in any given microcontroller, Selection of hardware, PCB design on Tina, Coding of microcontroller, Sensor selection and its coding, Actuator selection and its coding) · Firmware development (Computer Science)-5 members (GUI, Coding for cloud server, data logging in excels from real hardware, Machine learning, AI, Android application design) · Outer Design -2 members (Knowledge to design outer aesthetic of the model etc.) 3. Multimedia and guide robotic chatbot for front office A chatbot will be designed for guiding and assisting the person at the front office. This chatbot will be preinstalled with a navigation path for guiding the people according to their destination. A person can ask queries and get assistance through chatting. Team Requirement · Mechanical structure design-5 members (Modelling of self-balancing mobile structure, Design of structure) · Electronics and electrical system design-4 members (Good knowledge of register level coding in any given microcontroller, Selection of hardware, PCB design on Tina, Coding of microcontroller, Sensor selection and its coding, Actuator selection and its coding) · Firmware development (Computer Science)-4 members (Coding for cloud server, data logging in excels from real hardware, Machine learning, AI, GUI, Android application design) · Outer Design -2 members (Knowledge to design outer aesthetic of the model etc.) 4. Design and development of the sun tracking system An object will be designed for sun tracking. This object is developed in such a way that, the object rotates according to the direction of the sun. Team Requirement · Mechanical structure design-10 members (Structure modelling, Design of mechanical structure) · Electronics and electrical system design-5 members (Good knowledge of register level coding in any given microcontroller, Selection of hardware, PCB design on Tina, Coding of microcontroller, Sensor selection and its coding, Actuator selection and its coding) · Firmware development (Computer Science)-5 members (Coding for cloud server, data logging in excels from real hardware, Machine learning, AI, GUI, Android application design) · Outer Design -2 members (Knowledge to design outer aesthetic of the model etc.) 5. Holography globe with robotic Hand A holographic based globe will be designed for showing the virtual videos. The videos of real objects will be recorded with the assistance of scattered light and then projected. The robotic hand will designed for placing the holography globe. Team Requirement · Mechanical structure design-20 members (Structure modelling, Design of mechanical structure) · Electronics and electrical system design-10 members (Good knowledge of register level coding in any given microcontroller, Selection of hardware, PCB design on Tina, Coding of microcontroller, Sensor selection and its coding, Actuator selection and its coding) · Firmware development (Computer Science)-10 members (Coding for cloud server, data logging in excels from real hardware, Machine learning, AI, GUI, Android application design, Coding related to holography, data analytics) · Outer Design -5 members (Knowledge to design outer aesthetic of the model etc.) 6. Self-balancing luggage e-cart to help people at airport and railway station A self-balancing luggage e-cart will be designed for helping the people for carrying the luggage. The navigation path is embedded in the e-cart for carrying out the old age people luggage to taxi point. This e-cart reaches to the place after getting the request through a mobile application. title: Registration for State of the Art Seminar (SOTA) of Ph.D. Scholars (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/191025/005) : (10/25/2019)
body: This is in reference to the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SOTA) seminar which will be conducted tentatively from 4th- 11th Dec. 2019. It is mandatory for all research scholars to clear SOTA within two years from the date of registration otherwise their admission may be deemed as cancelled. The main key points for SOTA evaluation are as follows: a) To finalize the Title of the proposed research work. b) To finalize the Objectives of the proposed research work. c) To finalize the research methodology of the proposed research work. The scholars are required to follow the following 2 steps to be eligible for appearing in SOTA. 1. Registration for SOTA Scholars who have successfully completed their course work or exempted from the course work (due to M.Phil.) can register for SOTA seminar through the interface available in the UMS at the following link. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development -->SOTA Registration form Interface for registration will remain active from 25th October to 11th November, 2019. Only those Scholars should register for their SOTA seminar who are willing to appear for the seminar in the month of December 2019 and have the approval of their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor for the same. 2. Uploading of synopsis Once the scholar has registered for the SOTA, he/ she needs to upload the synopsis for the same (within a stipulated time period) which shall be evaluated by the panel of experts. The scholar needs to visit the same UMS link for uploading of the synopsis of SOTA along with the other relevant documents. UMS Navigation --> Research & Development -->SOTA Registration form The last date for uploading the synopsis report is 19th November 2019. Important Note: For Registration: a) At the time of SOTA registration, the scholars should opt for the domain for their SOTA Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisors/Co-Supervisors (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension shall be given for registration beyond the last date. c) No request for the deregistration shall be entertained beyond the last date of registration and the scholar shall marked absent. d) Scholars having pending dues are not eligible to register for the SOTA evaluation. Therefore, scholars are requested to clear the pending dues and get registered for the SOTA evaluation before the last date. e) If a scholar registers for the SOTA evaluation but is absent at the date of seminar/ evaluation then strict action shall be taken against the scholar and fine shall also be applicable. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SOTA (scheduled tentatively from March 2020 onwards) only after the clearance of fine. For Uploading Synopsis report: a) A scholar shall not be eligible for uploading any synopsis report without completing registration process. b) No extension shall be given for uploading synopsis report beyond the last date. c) Read the attached guidelines very carefully before uploading the synopsis. d) All the scholars must upload single PDF file for the synopsis including Annexure-I duly verified and signed by respective supervisors as per the attached guidelines or else their registration may be cancelled. All penalties applicable for absentees shall be applicable to him/her. No second chance shall be given to upload the synopsis. e) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. f) Scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using SOTA registration interface) before registering and uploading the synopsis at the interface. All the scholars who have completed two years from date of registration and have the last chance to appear in the SOTA seminar in December, 2019 are advised to avail this chance as no further extension shall be given for the same. In case, any of the eligible candidate has query regarding supervisor and co-supervisor can report at Block- 38 Room-202 or send a mail to drp@lpu.co.in.

title: End Term Presentation (Ph.D. Scholars) (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/191025/001) : (10/25/2019)
body: All the Ph.D. Scholars who have registered for their respective Ph.D. programs after July 2016 and have successfully completed their State of The Art Seminar (SOTA) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after each 6 months from the date of successful completion of SOTA. The registration and file uploading process for ETP shall be starting from 25th October 2019 onwards. The ETP shall be conducted tentatively from 28th November 2019 to 3rd December 2019. The main aim of the End Term Presentation is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the suggestions given by the Department Doctoral Board (DDB) panel members in the last evaluation. b. Justification in case a particular suggestion is not incorporated c. To present amount of work done or progress made since last evaluation All eligible scholars as per the attached list (List of scholars eligible for ETP in Dec 2019) can register for ETP evaluation and upload their files through following UMS link: UMS Navigation -->Research & Development --> Ph.D. Scholar Activity Details --> Upcoming Activity The last date for registration and uploading of report is 20th November 2019. Note- 1. As per current guidelines, for all the scholars who are either absent or are not recommended in any Ph.D. evaluation 2 times in a row or 3 times overall, the Ph.D. admission may be deemed cancelled. Therefore, all such scholars are strongly advised to register for the upcoming ETP. 2. All the scholars must upload single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by respective supervisors as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for End Term Presentation Dec 2019) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. 3. File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. 4. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. 5. No extension shall be given for uploading report beyond the last date. 6. Scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using ETP registration interface) before registering and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. Any queries can be directed to Ms. Astha Malhotra through rdc.etrs@lpu.co.in or in Block-Room: 30-508A.

title: “MIND BUZZ” : (10/22/2019)
body: Booster Club under the aegis of Department of Verbal Ability I cordially invites you to attend the departmental event “MIND BUZZ”, a fun way to enhance vocabulary and mind power. The event will be in two rounds Round 1: WHAT’S IN A WORD? The students will be divided into groups of four or five. A pile of cards with random nouns will be placed in the center of each group. One team member will describe a noun for their group members to guess. The team that guesses correctly will get a point, so there’s competition to see which team has the most cards at the end of the game. Duration: 2 minutes per team Round 2: COMICAL JIGSAW Each team will be provided with separate portions of a comic strip and they have to arrange them in a proper order. The team that arranges the comic strip the fastest will be adjudged winners. Winners will be provided certificates Objectives: To familiarize students with new words To activate curiosity and memory power To enhance logical and coherent thinking To imbibe dexterity and peer group learning Date: 23rd October Timings-5 PM onwards Venue-34-413 Register yourself on the following link: To register: shortto.com/cpeevent and select “ MIND BUZZ " For feedback after event: shortto.com/cpefeed and select ” MIND BUZZ "

body: Centre of Professional Enhancement is going to organize Human intelligence vs Artificial intelligence for the students of School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering. Intelligence can be defined as a general mental ability for reasoning, problem-solving, and learning. Because of its general nature, intelligence integrates cognitive functions such as perception, attention, memory, language, or planning. On the basis of this definition, intelligence can be reliably measured by standardized tests with obtained scores predicting several broad social outcomes such as educational achievement, job performance, health, and longevity. title: MINDBUZZ- Event for students from School of Computer Science and Engineering and School of Computer Application (10/18/2019)
body: The Booster Club under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement will organize an event MIND BUZZ, a fun way to enhance vocabulary and mind power. The event will be in two rounds; Round 1: WHAT’S IN A WORD? The students will be divided into groups of four or five. A pile of cards with random nouns will be placed in the center of each group. One team member will describe a noun for their group members to guess. The team that guesses correctly will get a point, so there is competition to see which team has the most cards at the end of the game. Duration: 2 minutes per team Round 2: NAME: COMICAL JIGSAW Each team will be provided with separate portions of a comic strip and they have to arrange them in a proper order. The team that arranges the comic strip the fastest will be adjudged winners. Winners will be provided certificates The main objectives of the workshop: To familiarize students with new words and to activate curiosity and memory power To enhance logical and coherent thinking and to imbibe dexterity and peer group learning . title: Final Report Submission for Project, Dissertation and similar courses Autumn Term-19201 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/191015/001) : (10/15/2019)
body: This is for the information of all the students registered in Project, Dissertation and similar courses (Annexure-I) that in order to be eligible for the Final End Term Presentation (ETP) viva, each student registered in such courses need to fulfil the following points as per the specified timelines: 1. Uploading of soft copy of final report: All the students need to prepare the final report for their Project/Research work as per the guidelines attached (Annexure-II) and upload the soft copy of the same in three parts i.e. PDF File-1, PDF File-2 and PDF File-3 via their UMS interface by visiting the following link: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project In PDF File 1, Students need to upload their Complete Project/ research Report. In PDF File 2, Students need to upload “only Content Report” which is without any student identification Information (e.g. Student’s Name, Registration Number or Title Page). In PDF File 3, Plagiarism Report is to be uploaded for Standalone Project(s), Capstone-II, Dissertation–II or Dissertation- III (As per Annexure-I). Allowed Plagiarism limit shall be as per the LPU Policy which has been described under the following link available on UMS: UMS Navigation->Division of Research and Development->Researcher’s Corner->Policies and Guidelines->Anti-Plagiarism.pdf 2. Recommendation of Final Report by Supervisor. Student must ensure that final report uploaded by them should be recommended by their respective supervisor before the last date of submission as per Annexure-III. 3. Submission of hard copy of the final report in the respective administrative officer (A.O.) office Once the respective supervisors have recommended the soft copy of the report submitted by the students, one hard copy either spiral or hard bound (As per Annexure-I) of the same duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor must be submitted by the students in respective A.O. office as per timelines specified in Annexure-III. The hard copy report shall be stamped by the respective A.O. office and students need to produce the same hard copy report on the day of ETP viva. Important Note- 1. It is advised that students must ensure the timely uploading of the final report before the last date of submission so that the respective supervisors get sufficient time to approve or modifications suggested by supervisor can be incorporated well in advance and to submit the hard copy of the report in the respective administrative officer (A.O.) office. No Extension beyond the specified timelines shall be provided for the final approval through respective supervisor. 2. Reports will be accepted in AO offices latest by 17:00 hrs. as per the last dates mentioned in Annexure-III. In case of any queries or concerns, kindly contact Mr. Mohit Prakram in 30-507 or email at academic.evaluation@lpu.co.in

title: CLUB CATALYST is organizing an activity on “Ted Talk: Ideas Worth Sharing” : (10/12/2019)
body: CLUB CATALYST under the aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement-III is organizing an activity on “Ted Talk: Ideas Worth Sharing” ““My way is the way of silent revolution; revolution to raise the human consciousness through positive vibrations.” A WARM GREETING TO ALL VERTOS! Ted Talk is an activity in which the speaker will presents his/her views or creative ideas related to education, business, science, psychology, human experience, literature and philosophy, technology, etc. based on their knowledge and research. The information should contain the facts and evidence with relevant examples and illustrations. A student will be provided 2 to 3 minutes to present their views. title: Registration open for workshop on “Image processing with Raspberry pi” on 25 & 26 Oct 2019 & 1-2 Nov.2019 : (10/9/2019)
body: Registration open for workshop on “Image processing with Raspberry pi”, on 25 & 26 Oct 2019 & 1-2 Nov.2019, Under the Umbrella of “Innovation Studio”. Due to Dusherra holiday and weekend, registration date is extended upto 19th Oct. 2019) Participants: For undergraduate/postgraduate/scholar from any discipline irrespective of year. Resource Persons Dr. Rajesh Singh, Professor & CoD (Innovation studio) Ms. Navjot Rathour, Assistant Professor, SEEE Dr. Anita Gehlot, Associate Professor, SEEE Note- 1. Classes are on 25 & 26 Oct 2019 & 1-2 Nov.2019, 5:00 P.M-7:00P.M (Friday) and 10:00A.M-5:00 P.M (Saturday). 2. No. of Seats– 50 3. Registration Link : https://tinyurl.com/IoT1LPU 4. Registration Fees for students and research scholars - Rs.1500/participant. 5. Last Date for Registration is 19th Oct. 2019, with fee submission. 6. Certificates will be issued on completion of workshop with minimum 80% attendance. Fee will be deposited in LPU accounts department under the head “Workshops at Innovation Studio” and scan copy of fee deposited need to be submitted through mail to anita.23401@lpu.co.in, to confirm your seat. Workshop details: 1. Image and video capturing using Raspberry Pi 1.1. Raspberry Pi and image processing basics Image processing is the process of performing some mathematical functions and operations on an image, images or video. The output that we get after image processing is a set of parameters or some altered image, images or videos. 2. Ball Tracking 2.1. Tracking each of the objects as they move around frames in a video, maintaining the assignment of unique IDs 3. Document Scanner 3.1. Building a document scanner with OpenCV can be accomplished in just three steps. 4. Number plate detection The system of vehicle number plate detection and recognition is used to detect the plates then make the recognition of the plate that is to extract the text from an image and all that thanks to the calculation modules that use location algorithms, segmentation plate and character recognition. 5. Drowsiness Detection Many proponents of autonomous, self-driving vehicles argue that the first industry that will be completely and totally overhauled by self-driving cars/trucks (even before consumer vehicles) is the long haul tractor trailer business. 6. Optical Mark detection Optical mark recognition (also called optical mark reading and OMR) is the process of capturing human-marked data from document forms such as surveys and tests. They are used to read questionnaires, multiple choice examination paper in the form of lines or shaded areas. 7. Pan tilt detection 8. Real Time Facial landmark 9. Size of object detection

title: workshop on “Image processing with Raspberry pi” during 10th October 2019 to 19th Oct. 2019 : (10/5/2019)
body: Registration open for workshop on “Image processing with Raspberry pi”, Under the Umbrella of “Innovation Studio”. Participants: For undergraduate/postgraduate/scholar from any discipline irrespective of year. Resource Persons Dr. Rajesh Singh, Professor & CoD (Innovation studio) Ms. Navjot Rathour, Assistant Professor, SEEE Dr. Anita Gehlot, Associate Professor, SEEE Note- 1. Classes are starting from 10th October 2019 to 19th Oct. 2019, 5:00 P.M-7:00P.M (Thursday to Saturday). 2. No. of Seats – 50 3. Registration Link : https://tinyurl.com/IoT1LPU 4. Registration Fees for students and research scholars - Rs.1500/head. 5. Last Date for Registration is 8th Oct. 2019, with fee submission. 6. Certificates will be issued on completion of workshop with minimum 80% attendance. Fee will be deposited in LPU accounts department under the head “Workshop at Innovation Studio” under STUDENT TRAINING EXPENCES” and scan copy of fee deposited need to be submitted through mail to anita.23401@lpu.co.in, to confirm your seat. Workshop Details 1. Image and video capturing using Raspberry Pi 1.1. Raspberry Pi and image processing basics Image processing is the process of performing some mathematical functions and operations on an image, images or video. The output that we get after image processing is a set of parameters or some altered image, images or videos. 2. Ball Tracking 2.1. Tracking each of the objects as they move around frames in a video, maintaining the assignment of unique IDs 3. Document Scanner 3.1. Building a document scanner with OpenCV can be accomplished in just three steps. 4. Number plate detection The system of vehicle number plate detection and recognition is used to detect the plates then make the recognition of the plate that is to extract the text from an image and all that thanks to the calculation modules that use location algorithms, segmentation plate and character recognition. 5. Drowsiness Detection Many proponents of autonomous, self-driving vehicles argue that the first industry that will be completely and totally overhauled by self-driving cars/trucks (even before consumer vehicles) is the long haul tractor trailer business. 6. Optical Mark detection Optical mark recognition (also called optical mark reading and OMR) is the process of capturing human-marked data from document forms such as surveys and tests. They are used to read questionnaires, multiple choice examination paper in the form of lines or shaded areas. 7. Pan tilt detection 8. Real Time Facial landmark 9. Size of object detection
