title: Regarding polling for Open Minors and Open Elective courses.. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/190503/001) : (5/3/2019)
body: Dear Students, Note that it is mandatory for the students of all programs (except management programs) currently in fourth term to select either an Open Minor area or an Open Elective course of their choice in this term which they shall be studying from their fifth term onwards. Certain important points about both these are specified as below: For Students going to opt Open Minor Area For Students going to opt Open Elective course An Open Minor is a group of 4 courses that shall be offered to the students from their 5th term onwards. Polling for Open Minor shall be held only once and selection once made shall automatically lead to selection of the 4 courses corresponding to the area for subsequent terms i.e. fifth, sixth and two courses in the seventh term. In case of Open Electives a student has to choose only one course to study in the fifth term in the current polling and subsequent polling shall be held in future for the subsequent terms for the Open Elective courses that the student has to study. Students shall poll for a second course to study in sixth term (polling shall be held in the fifth term) and two more courses for seventh term (for which polling shall be held in the sixth term) In order to facilitate you to make this choice when the polling for Open Minor starts, School wise folder of list of Open Minor areas to be offered to you is available at the link: Important Links ---> Examination Instructions and Guidelines----> Students ----> Open Minor Folder The folder contains a list of open minors along with a brief description of 4 courses to be offered in each open minor option. You are required to critically analyze each open minor option being offered in your school from the same so that you are ready with your choice before the polling starts. For the Open Elective courses to be offered school wise a description of courses to be offered for your school to help you understand the dimensions of the courses the description has been made available at the link: Important Links ---> Examination Instructions and Guidelines----> Students ----> Open Elective Folder You are required to critically analyze each open elective option being offered in your school from the same so that you are ready with your choice before the polling starts. Note that there are limited seats available in each of the Open Minor area as well as the Open Elective courses. You are hence advised to rigorously go through the description of each of the option available in your school so that in case you are not able to pick your first preference due to lack of seats you may quickly move to your subsequent best fit options available. The polling for Open Minor Area shall start on May 4th, 2019 (5:00 PM onwards) and shall be closed on May 6th, 2019 (at 5:00 PM). Date for the polling of Open Elective courses will be announced shortly.

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (5/2/2019)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a bite from the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Only the female mosquito transmits the dengue virus. This mosquito is a daytime biter, both inside and outside homes, and is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed inside and outside the home in containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. They do not breed in creeks, swamps, pools or other bodies of water. --Signs and symptoms This disease has a sudden onset and symptoms may include: • Fever for 3 to 7 days • Intense headache and pain behind the eyes • Muscle and joint pain • Loss of appetite • Vomiting and diarrhea • Skin rash • Bleeding, usually from the nose or gums. Recovery is sometimes associated with prolonged fatigue and depression. Repeated episodes of dengue fever may result in excessive bleeding and shock but, with appropriate treatment, are rarely fatal. --Prevention • There is no vaccine to prevent human infection by this virus. • Wear long, loose fitting, light co loured clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. Mosquitoes can bite through tight clothing like jeans. • Personal protection and the environmental management of mosquitoes are important in preventing illness. • When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. • Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. • Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label. - All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use.

You are required to critically analyze each open minor option being offered in your school from the same so that you are ready with your choice before the polling starts. For the Open Elective courses to be offered school wise a description of courses to be offered for your school to help you understand the dimensions of the courses the description has been made available at the link: Important Links ---> Examination Instructions and Guidelines-----> Students ----> Open Elective Folder You are required to critically analyze each open elective option being offered in your school from the same so that you are ready with your choice before the polling starts. title: Compulsory Information about stay of students in PG\Rented\Private Accommodation as per UGC, Police and other authorities (5/1/2019)
body: Dear Student, In pursuance of UGC Regulations on curbing the menace of ragging in higher educational institutions, 2009, it is mandatory for a student seeking to reside outside the university, to submit details regarding his/her accommodation to the university. Moreover, for security and safety concerns, the local authorities, including police administration, also seek accommodation related information of the students from the university from time to time. In this regard, every student who is not opting for residential facility inside the university campus is required to: 1.Submit an undertaking (as per Annexure I - Accommodation Information Form) duly signed by the parents about their place of stay during study period at the university. 2.As the information is to be shared with local authorities on demand, the information need to be compulsorily submitted before the start of classes for next session, failing which the student will not be allowed to attend classes till submission of the required documents. 3.In case the student is residing in PG/Rented/Private accommodation or with Guardians, additional undertaking and documents (as per Annexure II, III, IV, V and VI, whichever is applicable) need to be submitted regarding the same. 4.Any changes in the stay option will also have to be submitted before shifting to the new accommodation. 5.Submission of false or incomplete information will lead to disciplinary action by the university and/or may invite action by local authorities as per law. Note: The process of receiving the above documents will start from 1st June 2019 onwards through an online interface, details of which will be informed in due course of time. Attachment : Annexures Uploaded By: Accommodation Management Team

body: The interface for registration of Re-appear/Improvement examination to be conducted in June-July 2019 has been opened for all students. Student having ‘E’ grade(s) in any course code(s) (of any term) can register for re-appear through the provided interface. If any student wants to register for improvement course then he/she can do so via the same interface. Link for registration: UMS Navigation -> Examination System->Exam Registration->Registration Form with Date Sheet The detailed procedure is attached for reference. The tentative dates of examination for each course code have also been mentioned against the course code, so that the students can select their courses and prepare for them accordingly. The fee for re-appear/improvement registration is Rs. 350/- per course code and the last date with this fee is 9th May 2019. Note that after 9th May 2019 (12.00 a.m. onwards), the fee for registration will be increased to Rs. 500/- per course code and the last date with this fee is 11th May, 2019. For any scheduled lectures falling in the time slot of the examination, duty leave shall be given to the student for those lectures only (particularly in the time slot of exam time). In addition, duty leave shall also be given to the student for classes scheduled one hour prior and one hour after the time of examination. Important dates:- Registration start date 29th April, 2019 Last date of registration (without late fee) 9th May, 2019 Last date of registration (with late fee) 11th May, 2019 Display of seating plan-cum-final date sheet on UMS 15th May, 2019 Schedule of examination June-July, 2019

title: Facilities added exclusively for Hostelers from Session 2019 onwards : (4/26/2019)
body: Lovely Professional University (LPU) always strive to provide congenial and healthy environment to all the hostelers. As the new session is about to begin and students are already making choices for residential and related facilities, certain important points regarding various new options that have been made available exclusively for Hostelers are listed below: 1. Flexible Food and Mess Options: In order to provide students with more flexibility and increased choice of food varieties, the university is providing more options to the students in selecting the mess, menu etc. 2. Gym Facility (Separate for Boys and Girls): Special Gym facility is being introduced at three different locations exclusively for hostelers at 50% subsidized fee. 4. Indoor Stadium: With facilities like swimming pool, warm up pool, shooting range, squash court, badminton court, volleyball court, basketball court etc. at 50% subsidized fee. 5. Open Gym: In addition to special Gym facility as mentioned above, Open Gym (without charges) is also being created. 6. Apartment Facilities (with reduced fee): Compared to last year, the fee has been reduced approximately by upto 10-15% in Apartments with the same infrastructure and facilities. In addition to fee reduction, students can take add – on facilities at nominal cost. Please refer to the attached file for details regarding above facilities. Who All Can Apply? 1. title: Important Information regarding Polling of Engineering Minors. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/190423/001) : (4/23/2019)
body: Dear Student, Please note that it is mandatory for all the students of engineering programs currently in fourth term to select an Engineering Minor of their choice in this term. For this polling shall be held shortly. These engineering minors shall be included in your curriculum in the subsequent terms from third year. Hence it is important that you have a clear understanding of all the courses being offered so that you can make a choice suitable to your interest and aptitude. Note that for under each engineering minor, a group of 4 courses is offered which you will be studying from 5th term onwards. Selection of an engineering minor area shall automatically lead to selection of the 4 courses corresponding to the area. In order to facilitate you to make this choice when the polling for engineering minors starts, School wise folder of list of engineering minors to be offered to you is available at the link: Important Links----------> Examination Instructions and Guidelines ---------> Engineering Minor Folder The folder contains a list of engineering minors along with a brief description of 4 courses to be offered in each engineering minor option. You are required to critically analyze each engineering minor option being offered in your school from the same. For your facilitation a consultation room has also been established in each school (specified in the description of each engineering minor option) which shall remain operational from 3:00 pm to 7:00 pm from Apr. 23rd, 2019 to Apr. 25th, 2019 to enable you to develop a good understanding of each of the engineering minor option available. You can consult the faculty members at specified places for further clarification and removal of your doubts. Note that there are limited seats available in each engineering minor option. You are hence advised to rigorously go through the description of each of the option available in your school so that in case you are not able to pick your first preference due to lack of seats you may quickly move to your subsequent best fit options.

title: Earth Day 2019 Celebration : (4/20/2019)
body: Educational Tie-ups & Skill Development Cell and Community Service Cell, Lovely Professional University in collaboration with Ministry of Earth Sciences, New Delhi celebrating Earth Day 2019 here at Lovely Professional University, Phagwara, Punjab on Monday 22nd April 2019. On this occasion, we are organizing and Drawing & Painting Competition under following three categories/age groups. Category – I: Students of Primary class level (up to 5th Standard) for 1 hour duration. Category - II: Students from class 6th onwards and upto Secondary class (10th standard) level for 1½ hour duration. Category - III: Students from Senior Secondary (11th standard) and upto graduation level from college for 2 hour duration. Theme- Protect Our Species Topics for Drawing/Painting Competition – a) Sustenance of various ecosystems. b) Ocean resources (Living & Non living resources). c) Impact of Climate change. d) Deforestation & Aforestation and their significance. e) Atmospheric Ocean. f) Polar Science. g) Sustainable use of natural resources. h) Biosphere. There will be 4 cash Prizes; 1st Prize - Rs. 5,000/-, 2nd Prize – Rs. 4,000/- and 3rd Prize - Rs. 3,000/-, Consolation Prize - Rs. 2,000/-). Total prizes will be 12 worth Rs. 42,000/-. Each winner & participant will get the Certificate. Drawing Sheets (22”x15”) and Colours will be provided by University. The organizing committee of Earth Day Festival 2019 takes the pleasure to invite LPU students (only for category III) and wards of LPU staff members (for all categories) to take part in the drawing & painting competition . title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (4/18/2019)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a bite from the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Only the female mosquito transmits the dengue virus. This mosquito is a daytime biter, both inside and outside homes, and is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed inside and outside the home in containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. They do not breed in creeks, swamps, pools or other bodies of water. --Signs and symptoms This disease has a sudden onset and symptoms may include: • Fever for 3 to 7 days • Intense headache and pain behind the eyes • Muscle and joint pain • Loss of appetite • Vomiting and diarrhea • Skin rash • Bleeding, usually from the nose or gums. Recovery is sometimes associated with prolonged fatigue and depression. Repeated episodes of dengue fever may result in excessive bleeding and shock but, with appropriate treatment, are rarely fatal. --Prevention • There is no vaccine to prevent human infection by this virus. • Wear long, loose fitting, light colored clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. Mosquitoes can bite through tight clothing like jeans. • Personal protection and the environmental management of mosquitoes are important in preventing illness. • When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. • Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. • Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label. - All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use.

body: What is Self Worth? The dictionary defines self-worth as “the sense of one’s own value or worth as a person.” It is argued that there is a problem with society’s focus on high self-esteem. title: Summer School on Practical Robotics with 3D printing : (4/13/2019)
body: Division of International Affairs brings a great opportunity to spend summers at Tallinn University of Technology (TalTech), Estonia. title: Chanakya-Mind Bogglers, 2019 : (4/13/2019)
body: Chanakya Club (MSB ATOM), Mittal School of Business Activity Team Of Management in collaboration with Centre for Professional Enhancement II, Department of Soft Skills IV is organizing a Business Quiz competition ‘‘Chanakya-Mind Bogglers, 2019’’, to keep the students on track of latest happenings in the business world and to test their knowledge on these changes. Event details: Date:16th April 2019(Tuesday) Time: 5:00 PM onwards Venue: 14-501L Round 1- G.K Quiz In this round, students (individually) will be judged on an online questionnaire consisting of 20 multiple-choice related to current issues in business, in max 10 minutes. Top 15 students will be shortlisted after this round and they will be given 2 minutes of time to choose their partner leading to the formation of 5 teams of 3 students each. Round 2- Visual round In this round, 10 pictures or short videos will be displayed to teams. Team that will press the bell very first will get a chance to answer first. A right answer will fetch each team 2 marks while a wrong one will lead to the deduction of 1. A wrong answer will lead to the passing of question to the next team in a clockwise manner. Round 3- Audio round In this round, 10 audio clips will be played for the participants, which they have to identify. Same rules will be followed in this round as mentioned for round 2. Round 4- Logical round In this round, teams will be displayed random texts and images in the form of a logical connection but with broken links/missing information. Students will logically connect the pieces of information to reach to the right answer. Same rules will be followed in this round as mentioned for round 2 & 3. Prizes: The winner and first runner up team (3 students per team) will be awarded with trophies and certificates. Register on: tinyurl.com/chanakyaclub-mindboggler Last date to register: 15th April 2019 by 05:00 PM.

title: Silver Lining Foundation presents ‘Relationship, Stress & Crisis Management’ Workshop. (LPU/DSR/IC/190409/001) : (4/10/2019)
body: Warm Greetings Silver Lining Foundation under aegis of Division of Student Relationship - Counseling and Happiness cell invites residents of Boys Hostels to participate in ‘Relationship, Stress & Crisis Management’ Workshop Stress is not uncommon. Stress can have a major impact on a person’s happiness and sense of well-being. But it can and should be dealt with before it worsens. Common Stressors in youth – Relationship issues, family issues, Academic stress, social stress, poor self esteem, unhealthy competition, drastic changes in life Stress can manifest itself in different ways, mostly emotional and physical. Emotional signs of stress · Feel unhappy, depressed , agitated, anxious, aloof, irritable, get angry and overwhelmed easily and feel helpless Physical signs of stress · Feeling tired , fatigue, headaches, palpitations, loss of appetite Other symptoms of Stress · Poor memory, inability to focus, negative perspective and poor judgment, unable to handle problems and poor academic performance In this workshop you will be · Learn to recognize symptoms of Stress. · Learn coping strategies to help you manage stress and deal with relationship issues. · Taught and trained to use positive easy-to-learn Psychotherapeutic Techniques to deal with stress. Resource Person Ms Anusuya Hazarika - seasoned Clinical Psychologist and Certified Psychotherapist. With experience of more than 5yrs having worked with Multi-Specialist Hospitals, NGOs, Schools, Colleges and Corporates she has extensive expertise in Relationship, Stress & Crisis Management. An expert with numerous appearances in Television Talk Shows, with exceptional knowledge of research, and a positive admirable personality is an integral part of Dept. of Counseling and Happiness at Lovely Professional University. So Don’t miss this opportunity E- Certificates will be provided to participants Free Registration Hurry! Register today as seats are limited. title: Silver Lining Foundation presents ‘Relationship, Stress & Crisis Management’ Workshop. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/190409/001) : (4/10/2019)
body: Warm Greetings Silver Lining Foundation under aegis of Division of Student Relationship - Counseling and Happiness cell invites residents of Boys Hostels to participate in ‘Relationship, Stress & Crisis Management’ Workshop Stress is not uncommon. Stress can have a major impact on a person’s happiness and sense of well-being. But it can and should be dealt with before it worsens. Common Stressors in youth – Relationship issues, family issues, Academic stress, social stress, poor self esteem, unhealthy competition, drastic changes in life Stress can manifest itself in different ways, mostly emotional and physical. Emotional signs of stress · Feel unhappy, depressed , agitated, anxious, aloof, irritable, get angry and overwhelmed easily and feel helpless. Physical signs of stress · Feeling tired , fatigue, headaches, palpitations, loss of appetite. Other symptoms of Stress · Poor memory, inability to focus, negative perspective and poor judgment, unable to handle problems and poor academic performance. In this workshop you will be · Learn to recognize symptoms of Stress. · Learn coping strategies to help you manage stress and deal with relationship issues. · Taught and trained to use positive easy-to-learn Psychotherapeutic Techniques to deal with stress. Resource Person Ms Anusuya Hazarika - seasoned Clinical Psychologist and Certified Psychotherapist. With experience of more than 5yrs having worked with Multi-Specialist Hospitals, NGOs, Schools, Colleges and Corporates she has extensive expertise in Relationship, Stress & Crisis Management. An expert with numerous appearances in Television Talk Shows, with exceptional knowledge of research, and a positive admirable personality is an integral part of Dept. of Counseling and Happiness at Lovely Professional University. So Don’t miss this opportunity E- Certificates will be provided to participants Free Registration Hurry! Register today as seats are limited. body: Club ECHO LPU under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement invites you to take part in an open house discussion to hone your skills of being an effective speaker in a group of people and showcase your skills of negotiations and collaboration. body: Title:Digital India Internship Scheme 2019 - DELHI About:- An internship is an opportunity for a student to secure first hand and practical work experience under the guidance of a qualified and experienced Supervisor/Mentor. It also aims at active participation in the learning process through experimentation and putting into practice the knowledge acquired in the classrooms. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology is engaged in electronic development through e-Infrastructure creation to facilitate and promote (1) e-governance (2) Promotion of electronics hardware manufacturing and Information Technology & IT Enabled Services (IT-ITeS) Industry (3) Providing Support for creation of Innovation Infrastructure in emerging areas of technology (4) Providing support for development of e-Skills and Knowledge network and (5) Securing India's cyber space. For the larger benefit of the student community and with a view to enrich the management/implementation of its various schemes/programmes, the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology has decided to notify these “Internship Guidelines”, to provide a framework for engagement of Interns for a limited period. Organizer: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology -DELHI Link to Information: https://meity.gov.in/digital-india-internship-scheme-2019 Link for Apply: http://serviceonline.gov.in/serviceLinkHome.html?serviceToken=Ne0by5EA7D669 or http://serviceonline.gov.in/citizenRegistration.html?OWASP_CSRFTOKEN=1KMZ-5FMX-LLMW-KN3K-QP9H-90LY-UH6M-DPBP Deadline: Online Application Portal will be open until -30th April 2019 Duration: The minimum duration of internship shall be of two months, extendable up to three months, depending on the performance of the candidate, requirement of the Ministry and time the Intern is willing to spend with the Ministry. Stipend : Rs.10,000/- Per Month Eligible : (i) Indian students from recognized universities in India who have secured at least 60% marks in the last held degree or certificate examination and pursuing B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech/ MCA/ DoEACC ‘B’ level shall be eligible (Branches: Computer Science/Information Technology/Electronics and Communication). title: "Speak Out” An Open House Discussion" - Club ECHO LPU : (4/3/2019)
body: Club ECHO LPU under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement invites you to take part in an open house discussion to hone your skills of being an effective speaker in a group of people and showcase your skills of negotiations and collaboration. What is it on? The discussion is open for a certain topic as it would not hinder you from getting creative in what you want to speak. It can be on anything worth talking about. Why is an open house discussion important? By discussing, you are encouraged and exposed to different opinions of people and for once will look at things in a different way. Discussions involve concluding things without chaos. Who can attend? It is open to all the students who are wishing to develop and practice their speaking skills in social speaking environment. title: Programming Test for Product Based Pathway [2nd year students] : (3/30/2019)
body: School of Computer Science and Engineering will be offering a separate pathway named “Corporate – Product Based (Placement oriented track of Competitive Programming for product based companies)” to the students currently in second year of their study under CSE/IT programmes. Under this pathway, the following 03 courses based on competitive coding theme will be offered in the next two terms i.e. Term 5 and Term 6 besides the Engineering minor, Open Minor tracks and other regular courses. 1. COMPETITIVE CODING APPROACHES-TECHNIQUES 2. PRELUDE TO COMPETITIVE CODING 3. CODING PEARLS Maximum of 135 students will be registered for this pathway. The students will be selected on the basis of performance in online programming test. Following are the details of the shortlisting process: 1. A separate coding based diagnostic test of 50 marks shall be conducted on 20th April, 2019 (Saturday) on Hackerrank platform. The test will have 02 coding problems (each of 25 marks) to be solved in 01 hour. 2. Students who are willing to go for Product based pathway must register themselves through the following link by 9th April 2019. http://tinyurl.com/pbtregistration 3. Students having maximum of 02 E/F/G grade courses are allowed to take this pathway. 4. Seating plan for this diagnostic test will be shared with students shortly through a separate UMS announcement. 5. The shortlisted students from next term onwards will have to continue with the above mentioned pathway only. 6. Some selective few students may also get shortlisted as wild card entries. 7. The number of courses for the students in the next semesters will remain same as for all the other students in 3rd year. These courses will replace some of the courses. 8. Students must participate in pathway elective polling. Students selected for Product based pathway will be registered no matter which other pathway they have opted for. For any queries regarding the same the students can contact their respective section HoDs.

title: Researching Reality Internship 2019 - Centre for Civil Society - -Delhi : (3/27/2019)
body: Title: Centre for Civil Society - Researching Reality Internship 2019 -Delhi About:- Researching Reality is an annual six-week internship program that offers intensive training in policy-relevant research to undergraduate and graduate students of various disciplines. In the course of the internship, the interns frame a research question, analyse the data collected through primary and secondary sources, and author a research paper. While research-guides steer their projects and train them, various experts, academics and practitioners working in the field of public policy provide their knowledge and insights. One of the country's premier research internship program, 2018 marks the eighteenth edition of Researching Reality. This edition was jointly executed by the Academy and Research team of Centre for Civil Society. Organizer: - Centre for Civil Society – Delhi Link to Information: - https://ccs.in/ccs-academy/courses-and-programs/internship Link for Apply: https://ccs9.typeform.com/to/oL1C8K?fbclid=IwAR3TphlD1NBe5smWHk15RLiVpx5CE4OWStL6rotK_6zDZ-xadMnbc_VyE60 Deadline: -15th April -2019 Duration: 6 Weeks (June - July 2019) Eligibility: Researching Reality is a full-time six-week intensive internship To be considered for the internship program, a candidate must satisfy one of the following; 1.Current student enrolled in an undergraduate/ postgraduate course in any academic or professional discipline 2.Graduates / Researchers 3.International Baccalaureate / Cambridge International Students enrolled in the Diploma program or A Levels A candidate must demonstrate; 1.Interest in the public policy domain 2.Inquisitive and adept with basic research skills - data collection, inference and analysis. 3.Be open to fun, open and respectable environment 4.Be a team player, have strong analytical skills and ability to meet deadlines The Internship is open to both Domestic and International applicants. We offer assistance for visa applications in 'Volunteer Category' for International Students There is no registration fee to apply for the program. There is no stipend paid to Interns for the duration. However, reimbursements approved on actuals by the requisite guide/ coordinator for the purpose of research are provided. Interns are requested to make their own living arrangements in New Delhi. For queries contact us:- Ms. Monica Sandhu - 98760 11188 Email ID: monica.sandhu@lpu.co.in

title: International Internship in Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) -Taiwan : (3/27/2019)
body: Title: International Internship in Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) -Taiwan About :Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) is one of the world’s leading technology R&D institutions aiming to innovate a better future for society. Founded in 1973, ITRI has played a vital role in transforming Taiwan's industries from labor-intensive into innovation-driven. It focuses on the fields of Smart Living, Quality Health, and Sustainable Environment. Over the years, ITRI has incubated over 270 innovative companies, including well-known names such as UMC and TSMC. In addition to its headquarters in Taiwan, ITRI has branch offices in the U.S., Europe, and Japan in an effort to extend its R&D scope and promote opportunities for international cooperation around the world. Eligibility Criteria: This program is open to graduate and undergraduate students currently enrolled at accredited colleges and universities. Accepted interns MUST be able to provide documentary evidence from the university of student status during and after the entire period of the internship. Candidates must hold a valid passport from a country other than Taiwan (ROC). Program Dates: Summer Interns should be available to work for at least 10 weeks between May and September. Longer internships of 4-6 months are possible throughout the year. Dates are flexible depending on student and department needs, and are decided case-by-case when acceptance offers are made. Please indicate your desired internship dates in your application. What ITRI Provides [Note: The package described below is standard, but may vary significantly depending on the circumstances; details of your offer will be confirmed if you are selected.] 1.Free on-site accommodation on ITRI campus - modern dormitories on a spacious campus with dining and recreational facilities 2.Monthly stipend (before taxes): NT$22,000 – NT$36,000 per month, depending on student’s experience and department’s situation; if you are offered a position, the offer will specify the stipend and other details. 3.Free ITRI Group Insurance (Note: this is Accident Insurance - those who want full medical coverage must purchase it independently.) During summer internship (June/July): 1.A tour of the Hsinchu Science-Based Industrial Park with company site visits, to promote understanding of Taiwan’s technology industry. 2.Subsidized group trip to scenic destination in Taiwan. Organizer: - Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) Link for Inormation: https://www.itri.org.tw/eng/Content/Messagess/List.aspx?SiteID=1&MmmID=617731531432246346 Deadline: Online Application Portal will be open until -31st March 2019 Link for Apply: https://itri.applytojob.com/ Apply Mode: Online For queries contact us:- Ms. Monica Sandhu - 98760 11188 Email ID: monica.sandhu@lpu.co.in

To be eligible, the candidate is required to possess a First-Class degree or equivalent diploma of the same standard from a recognized university. title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (3/23/2019)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a bite from the Aedes aegypti mosquito. This mosquito is a daytime biter, both inside and outside homes, and is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. These mosquitoes breed inside and outside the home in containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. --Signs and symptoms This disease has a sudden onset and symptoms may include: • Fever for 3 to 7 days • Intense headache and pain behind the eyes • Muscle and joint pain • Loss of appetite • Vomiting and diarrhea • Skin rash • Bleeding, usually from the nose or gums. Recovery is sometimes associated with prolonged fatigue and depression. Repeated episodes of dengue fever may result in excessive bleeding and shock but, with appropriate treatment, are rarely fatal. --Prevention • There is no vaccine to prevent human infection by this virus. • Wear long, loose fitting, light coloured clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. Mosquitoes can bite through tight clothing like jeans. • Personal protection and the environmental management of mosquitoes are important in preventing illness. • When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. • Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. • Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Club ELECTECH PRESENTS- “Workshop on IP Address and Networking” : (3/20/2019)
body: Club ELECTECH cordially invites you to attend the “Workshop on IP Address and Networking” (20/03/2019) A WARM GREETING TO ALL VERTOS! IP address:An Internet Protocol address (IP address) is a numerical label assigned to each device connected to a computer network that uses the Internet Protocol for communication. An IP address serves two principal functions: host or network interface identification and location addressing.. CLUB ELECTECH, under the aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement-III is organizing a "Workshop on IP Address and Networking". Your ISP assigned IP address is your identity on the internet. If someone (who has time, willpower and skills to hack you) knows your IP address, then they might try. They may become successful or fail in their attempts depending on how secure your system is. The Role of Subnet Masks. The Class A subnet mask tells you the first 8 bits of the IP address represent the network portion of the address. The remaining 24 bits represent the host portion of the address. ... Using the default subnet mask, the network address would be 10.0.0.0. Who all can participate? It is open for all students of Lovely Professional University who are keen to have an insight into networking. Date: 20 th Mar’2019 Timings: 05:00-06:00 p.m .Venue: 27-309 Register yourself on the following link: https://tinyurl.com/Network-Subnet-Workshop E-certificates would be provided to all participants For Any Queries contact:Poonam Tarpial, Assistant Professor,Dept of Soft Skills-II,Center For Professional Enhancement-3+91-9872241829

title: JN Tata Endowment for the Higher Education of Indians. : (3/19/2019)
body: The J. N. Tata Endowment awards a one-time loan scholarship to Indian nationals only at the beginning of the course for full-time Postgraduate/ Ph.D./ Postdoctoral studies/Research Fellowships studies abroad, in all fields, irrespective of caste, creed, gender or community. The amount to be awarded to each scholar by way of loan scholarship is determined on the basis of the norms laid down for the purpose and does not cover the full cost of studies. The amount awarded as the loan scholarship ranges between Rs.1,00,000/- and Rs.10,00,000/-. All selected scholars do not necessarily qualify for the maximum amount. The selected scholars may also be recommended for a gift scholarship and travel assistance from our allied Trusts as may be decided at the sole discretion of the Trustees of the concerned Trusts. A gift scholarship can be for a maximum amount of Rs.7,50,000/- and the travel grant can be a maximum of Rs.50,000/-. Eligibility Criteria:-Applicants should be Indian nationals who are graduates of a recognized Indian university and have secured at least 60% in their last academic examination. Students in the final year of the degree course and those awaiting results are eligible to apply. Candidates may apply even if they do not have the admission/offer letters, at the time of making the application, from the Universities to which they have applied for the academic year 2019-2020. However,r they must update their applications status with the Endowment once they secure admission. Mid-career professionals not older than 45 years, with a good academic record and experience in their fields, specialization or training may also apply. Scholars going abroad for seminars, conferences and undergraduate studies are not eligible for a J. N. Tata Endowment Loan Scholarship. Selection for the Awards:- It is a matter of pride to be called a JN Tata Scholar. Staying true to our founder JamsetjeeNusserwanjee’s vision of rewarding the brightest and the best, we follow a rigorous selection process. Candidates may note the following points: Apart from consistent academic performance, we give importance to participation in both co-curricular and extra-curricular activities. A good GRE/GMAT/TOEFL/IELTS score is extremely important for those applying overseas. If you have received a low GRE score, it may be advisable to improve upon it, to increase your chances of receiving the loan scholarship. The statement of purpose carries considerable weight in the selection process. We have provided some guidance on our web site on how you can construct a good statement of purpose. Please ensure that your statement of purpose is written by you and free from plagiarism. After the initial screening of applications, candidates are shortlisted to undergo an online test which will be based on the lines of Thinking Skills Assessment (TSA), on Sunday, 14th April, 2019. Timing and other details will be informed accordingly. Candidates shortlisted based on the online test will be called for an interview. Such candidates should upload scanned copies of the required documents on the application form portal in the upload documents section, before the time of the interview. The Interview: -Candidates should note that to be shortlisted for an interview is no guarantee of receiving the loan scholarship. The interview, conducted in person at Mumbai or through Skype by a Technical Committee from April onwards, carries the most weightage in the selection process. Candidates should come prepared with knowledge of their subjects and chosen areas of interest with any specialistion, as shown in their application for admission. They will be examined in depth and detail and the greatest weight will be given to depth of understanding of the chosen area of study and career path. There will be two interviewers, one of who is a subject-expert and the other is Director of the Endowment. The final selection of scholars for the award of the loan scholarship is based on the following criteria:(1) Performance at the interview;(2) Score at the online test(3) Score based on academic results, GRE/GMAT/IELTS/TOEFL scores, Co-curricular and extra-curricular activities, research work, statement of purpose, and work experience. All the Awards will be announced together latest by the first week of July by mail. The Trustees' decision on the award of scholarships is final. Correspondence in this regard will not be entertained. Formalities to be a completed:- The candidate and the guarantor (preferably a parent or a relative having the capacity to repay the loan) will have to visit the Administrative Office of the Endowment, by prior appointment, to complete the necessary formalities, after obtaining the visa. They will be required to enter into a legal agreement with the Trustees and provide documentary evidence of the capacity of the guarantor to repay the loan. Candidates must repay the loan scholarship in five equal installments of 20% between third and seventh year. Candidates must begin to repay earlier than year three if they have started earning. PLEASE NOTE: (i) All applications have to be submitted online. (ii) Office remains closed on Saturdays, Sundays and Bank Holidays Website: -http://jntataendowment.org For queries contact us:- Ms Monica Sandhu-Dy. Director (DII) 9876011188 Mr Kapil Kaushal-Dy. Officer 9814818964 Email ID: - kapil.22622@lpu.co.in

title: Call for Enrolment - Mozilla Fellowship : (3/18/2019)
body: Dear All, Mozilla Fellows work on the front lines of internet health, at a time when the internet is entwined with everything from elections and free expression to justice and personal safety. Fellows ensure the internet remains a force for good — empowerment, equality, access — and also combat online ills, like abuse, exclusion, and closed systems.Mozilla is particularly interested in individuals whose expertise aligns with our 2019 impact goal: “better machine decision making or ensuring the artificial intelligence in our lives is designed with responsibility and ethics top of mind. For example: Fellows might research how disinformation spreads on Facebook. Or, build a tool that identifies the blind spots in algorithms that detect cancer. Or, advocate for a “digital bill of rights” that protects individuals from invasive facial recognition technology. Open web activists: Individuals addressing issues like privacy, security, and inclusion online. These Fellows will embed at leading human rights and civil society organizations from around the world, working alongside the organizations and also exchanging advocacy and technical insights among each other. Tech policy professionals: Individuals who examine the interplay of technology and public policy — and craft legal, academic, and governmental solutions. Scientists and researchers: Individuals who infuse open-source practices and principles into scientific research. These Fellows are based at the research institution with which they are currently affiliated. Register Till: 8th April, 2019 (Monday) Link: https://mozilla.fluxx.io/apply/fellowship

title: Prevention from Fungal Infection : (3/16/2019)
body: Ringworm is a fungal skin infection that causes a red, circular, itchy rash. Please take care of yourself to prevent this infection. Do’s -Regular bathing, Body cleansing is must -Before wearing clothes, drying out yourself to prevent excess moisture -Wearing loose clothes -Laundering clothes of infected person in hot water and washing with anti-septic agent -Drying clothes in sunlight for at least 2 hours. -Wearing clothes after ironing them and placing them separately -Washing your hands with anti-septic and water frequently. -Keeping hair, nails and scalp clean -Wearing well ventilated shoes with cotton socks, not sharing comb and other utilities with other family members. -Eating healthy food which boost immunity, drinking 2-3 liters of water everyday

title: CLUB ELECTECH PRESENTS-" WORKSHOP ON POWER OF PARAPHRASING" : (3/13/2019)
body: Club ELECTECH cordially invites you to attend the “Workshop on Power of Paraphrasing” (15/03/2019) A WARM GREETING TO ALL VERTOS! Are you confused about how to put the conversation in an effective manner in front of another person? Are your words often misunderstood? Paraphrasing is the key to this problem. CLUB ELECTECH, under the aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement-III is organizing a "Workshop on Power of Paraphrasing" Paraphrasing is repeating in your words what you interpreted someone else to be saying. Paraphrasing is powerful means to further the understanding of the other person and yourself, and can greatly increase the impact of another's comments. body: Club Electech under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement-III cordially invites aspirants to attend the workshop titled ‘Open- Ended Questions’. “The person who knows ‘how’ will always have a job. The person who knows ‘why’ will always be his boss.” ---Diane Ravitch Open-ended questions allow you to consider your own ideas, thoughts and feelings. They also encourage collaborative work and respect especially when the open-ended questions are part of a group discussion. Open-ended questions are truly effective learning tools, and can help you develop skills while you learn subject matter in an interesting and engaging way. title: The Robotarium: A remotely accessible swarm robotics research testbed : (3/8/2019)
body: The Robotarium project provides a remotely accessible swarm robotics research platform that remains freely accessible to anyone. Currently, robotics research requires significant investments in terms of manpower and resources to competitively participate. However, Georgia Institute of Technology believe that anyone with new, amazing ideas should be able to see their algorithms deployed on real robots, rather than purely simulated. In order to make this vision a reality, Georgia Institute of Technology have created a remote-access, robotics lab where anyone can upload and test their ideas on real robotic hardware. Steps to Use: 1. Download the Robotarium's Matlab or Python simulator. Matlab Link: https://github.com/robotarium/robotarium-matlab-simulator Python Link: https://github.com/robotarium/robotarium-python-simulator 2. Write and verify your script in the simulator 3. Sign up for a Robotarium account here and wait for getting approved by one of the Robotarium's admins. 4. Create your experiment in the web interface, upload your code, and submit it for execution. For all issues regarding access of robatarium contact persons are: 1. Sean Wilson (sean.t.wilson@gatech.edu) 2. Magnus Egerstedt (magnus@gatech.edu) Website: https://www.robotarium.gatech.edu/

title: Schneider Electric – Go Green in the City Challenge for all Engineering students : (3/8/2019)
body: Dear Students, The Go Green in the City challenge is now entering its 9th year running and their 2019 edition is going to be even bigger, better and bolder! They are looking for students like you from around the world who are willing to put their skills and ideas to the test. About Schneider Electric: Schneider Electric is leading the Digital Transformation in Energy Management and Automation. They are always on the lookout for bold ideas that can shape the future of their industries and company. Share your bold ideas under 4 categories: · Sustainability & Access to Energy: Digitize our business and enable access to energy or sustainable developments. · Buildings of the Future: Can buildings be smarter, more sustainable and incorporate new technologies? · Plants of the Future: Apply IoT, AI, Machine Learning and more to the industries of the present or future. · Grids of the Future: Imagine the future of energy management and distribution! Eligibility: · Be a Bachelor’s (at least 2nd year) or Master’s student · Studying Engineering, Business, Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics and other Sciences. · At least one team member must be a woman, in line with our Diversity & Inclusion philosophy. · Be proficient in English (the Grand Finale pitch will be presented in English.) Prizes: · The winning team will win job offers from Schneider Electric, and an all-inclusive international trip to two cities of their choice (where Schneider Electric has offices). · The Top 8 teams will be invited on a fully sponsored trip to the Schneider Electric Global Innovation Summit in Barcelona to pitch for the Grand Prize and an invitation to interview for Schneider Electric's Internship Program. · Participants will receive mentorship from Schneider Electric experts to polish their proposals and make it to the Grand Finale! One all-female team from the semi-finals will win the Women in Energy Award, securing a place in the finals and cash prize of USD $1,000 For registration and more information please visit website link: https://gogreeninthecity.se.com/en/challenges/gogreeninthecity Last date of team registration: 25th May 2019 Note: All students who are registering themselves in the competition are required to fill their details in the link given below: Link: https://tinyurl.com/Schneider-LPU For any query Email: manish.19164@lpu.co.in

title: Registration Date Extended for SASP-2 (Student Academic Support Program-Phase 2) (Ref. No. LPU/DSR/IC/190307/001) : (3/7/2019)
body: In Phase-2 of SASP, 11 courses have been floated. Registration deadline has also been extended as per the list attached. All students with E and G grades now have an opportunity to register and clear their fail grades before summer term. The classes for a course code shall span 25 lectures in total (spread over a tentative time frame of one month) after MTT. SASP shall serve the purpose of providing guidance to students who face difficulty in grasping the subject matter as a whole in regular classes. With the help of this model the students shall get an opportunity to clear their doubts, revise their concepts, bridge gaps in their learning,and ensure better interaction with the teacher in smaller groups. Conduct of SASP a. SASP Registration: Students can register for the same by following the link: - UMS Navigation--> Examination--> Exam Registration --> Student Academic Support Program b. Class Size, Timings & Duration i) Classes will run only if number of registrations in one course is 5 or more(In case, the total registrations in a course are less than 5, then the course shall be scrapped and fee for registered students shall be refunded) ii) Class Schedule & Timings: Throughout the week except MTT and Sunday. iii) Classes will be held in the morning/evening slot between 8-9 am/5-6 pm daily. iv) Class Duration: The duration of these classes shall be 60 minutes per lecture. c) Fee Rs.1000/- per course for 25-lectures support class In case, a student feels that support classes for an additional course code (not mentioned in the list) should be conducted, the same should be reported to Division of student relationship (DSR) in 32-100 (number of students must be 5 or more). Note: Student can register maximum one course and in no case, the student will be able to de-register for the course, if once registered. For any other query, visit 32-100 (Division of Student Relationship). The list of courses in which the SASP is being offered is attached.

title: Huge Opportunity to attend Summer School at EPF-ESTP, Paris and Troyes (France) : (3/4/2019)
body: Division of International Affairs encourages the student to apply for a Summer School at EPF-ESTP Paris and Troyes. Summer School program is intended to mainly to those students who are planning to attend the Summer School Program in Summer Vacations 2019, and are interested in a new dimension of life as well as absorbing academic inputs. Course Name: Smart Cities and Engineering for Sustainable Architecture. Eligibility: Undergraduate and Master students with a major in Engineering, Architecture, Urban Planning/ Design, Sociology or Computer Science. Duration & Program Details: 4 Week. The program is designed in 4 independent Modules in the two cities of Troyes and Paris: Week/ Module1 Energy Efficiency, Comfort & Culture July 1-5,2019 Troyes Week/ Module 2 Security & resilience in smart cities July 8-12,2019 Troyes Week/ Module 3 Bio-architecture & bio-city July 15-19,2019 Paris Week/ Module 4 Digital connected city & architecture July22-26,2019 Paris · Students can participate in one module or multiple modules or all modules and can last one week, two weeks, three weeks or a month. · Each module is of 1 week consisting of lectures, lab visits, cultural visits, meeting with researchers and French courses. · Within each module, the student will have a technical visit and work in teams on a real project under the supervision of a tutor/mentor. · Fee: the program fee is 950 Euros per module (week). (The programme fee of 950 Euros per module (week) covers: Tuition and documentation; Welcome and farewell events; Access to EPF and ESTP Paris facilities; Free internet access; Cultural and social events; Transportation; Lodging expenses; Food; Official programme certificate.) Note: Does not include: individual insurances, air ticket, and visa fees. · A special fee of 3500 Euros for students participating in all 4 modules · Group discounts are available. For more information: Students can mail at studyabroad@lpu.co.in or can meet Ms. Michelle in Block-32-310.

title: Network N+I: Engineering Master's in France with Scholarship Options : (3/4/2019)
body: Division of International Affairs brings an Opportunity for LPU Students to achieve the dream of pursuing Masters in France with various Scholarships Options. Those students who are interested they can grab this opportunity. Network N+I, is a single online portal for making a single application to 50+ elite engineering institutes in France. The Network trains highly qualified, multilingual engineers who can lead effectively on international projects in a multicultural environment. Benefits: 1. 90% of N+I students get a job offer, even before they graduate. 2. The average salary for the first job in France for a junior engineer is € 36,000 gross per year (+ 15 to 20 % for international experience) 3. The «n+i» Network offers three “Success Packages” for international students in France. For more details of Success Packages: https://www.nplusi.com/public/en/different-integration-packages Some significant points to study Masters in Engineering with Network N+I: 1. Two-year master’s degree in engineering ( after B.Tech) 2. Choice of 150 specialized masters in all domain of engineering. 3. 3 packages of adaptation: linguistic, cultural, and methodological. 4. GRE/TOEFL/ IELTS not required at the time of admission. 5. A single online application portal for admission and scholarships for all the 50+ Engineering institutes. 6. No prior knowledge of French is required. A basic level in French is highly recommended. 7. Maximum Total cost of the program: INR 18 to 28 lakhs for two years (1 semester of paid internships during the master program + APL grant ) **Personalized housing assistance (APL) is for single students or couples with or without dependents, which live in a dormitory with a convention in metropolitan France. 8. Students can apply for multiple scholarships while making admission applications to N+I. For further details of “N+I” Scholarships, click on a link given below: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1OLiF7gpw1viWpDEHO2h-HRSvuhYmYwzT For further information, Student can meet DIA in Block 32-310. **Online Applications Open

Being able to communicate effectively is one of the most important life skills to learn. Communication is defined as transferring information to produce greater understanding. title: Taking Option from students admitted in the dual degree programmes for Continuing or Discontinuing the pursuance of the higher degree for Session 2018-19 (Ref.No. LPU/DAA/IC/190226/001) : (2/26/2019)
body: The students of dual degree programmes shall be required to choose/opt for Continuing or discontinuing the pursuance of higher degree by filling the ONLINE UNDERTAKING available on the UMS under the link: UMS Home Page---> UMS Navigation ---> LMS --->Undertaking format for Option Taking Option shall be taken from students admitted in the dual degree programmes for Continuing or discontinuing the pursuance of the higher degree through online mode only. Important Note:- 1. It is mandatory for all students of dual degree programmes to fill the option for continuation or discontinuation. 2. All the HODs/CODs are requested to ensure that all the students have filled the online option for continuation or discontinuation. 3. After the student submits his/her option, message confirming the same shall be sent on student’s UMS account. The interface for giving the option by filling the ONLINE UNDERTAKING will be opened on 26, Feb, 2019. A student may change his/her option any number of times till 5:00pm of 31th March, 2019. No compounding fee shall be charged for the same. However, if any student who has not filled the option or wants to change his/her option after 31th March, 2019, he/she will fill the ONLINE UNDERTAKING at UMS link mentioned above and processing of case shall be done through I-CASH CARD and following slabs of Compounding fee shall be applicable: Sr.No. Period Compounding fee 1 1st April, 2019-30th April, 2019 Rs.1000/- 2 1st May,2019-31st May,2019 Rs.2000/- 3 1st June,2019 - upto 1 week from declaration of result of re-appear exams conducted in summer break Rs.5000/- 4 After this no change will be allowed --- Important Note for students who are giving their option with Compounding Fee and processing of case is done through I-CASH CARD: (i) Kindly ensure your payment status before closing the interface. Option given by the student shall be considered only after the verification of payment status. If it is “SUCCESS”, “NEW OPTION” shall be considered else the “OLD OPTION” shall prevail. (ii) Also ensure internet connectivity while making payment through I-CASH CARD. In case of any query, kindly report to DAA window located at Block 32-102(Window No.2) or e-mail at academic.aac@lpu.co.in

body: This is for the information of all the concerned that Phase-2 of Student Academic Support Program (SASP) wherein, support classes will be provided to the students to help them in clearing their fail grades is going to commence from 1st week of March,2019. title: Bihar Post Matric scholarship for ST&BC/EBC students for the session 2018-19 is open for registration-reg.(Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/190222/001) : (2/22/2019)
body: Registration process for applying in Post Matric Scholarship scheme Bihar for ST&BC/EBC students has been started for the session 2018-19. The students can apply for this scholarship on the following link:- Link:- https://scholarships.gov.in/ The last date for applying for this scholarship for students is 05.03.2019. Eligibility Criteria:- 1. Annual income of the parent of the ST students should not exceed Rs. 2.5 lakh per annum from all sources. 2. Annual income of the parents of the BC/EBC students should not exceed 1.5 lakh per annum from all sources. 3. Scholarship holder under this scheme will not avail any other scholarship / stipend for pursuing the same course from any other government agencies/department. 4. Seeding of Aadhar card with Bank account is mandatory otherwise scholarship will not be released. After submitting the application online on the National Scholarship Portal, the students have to submit his/her print application form along with the following self-attested documents at Block No. 32, Room No. 102:- 1. Passport size photograph of student - 01. 2. Previous year Mark Sheets from Matric onwards (e.g. 10th, 12th, Graduation etc.). 3. Income Certificate (latest Income certificate for the financial year 2018-19 duly issued by Bihar Govt. is required and the same will be verified online from RTPS website.) 4. Copy of Caste Certificate (to be verified online from RTPS website). 5. Copy of Domicile Certificate (to be verified online from RTPS website). 6. Copy of Bank Passbook copy of student with IFSC code mentioned on it clearly or cancelled cheque copy. 7. Copy of Aadhar Card. 8. Copy of Current Term Fee Receipts (to be attested from accounts department at Block No.32, Room No. 103, Window No. 11). 9. In case of Renewal, students have to submit the copy of scholarship received proof i.e. bank account Statement. Uploading of all the documents on National Scholarship portal is mandatory.(Minimum file size to upload each documents should be below 200 Kb. The students have to select the below mentioned university details while applying for scholarship online on the NSP portal:- State – PUNJAB District – KAPURTHALA University Name – Lovely Professional University (U-0379). If the students will select the wrong university detail other than mentioned above then his/her case will not be forwarded online by the university and students will be responsible themselves. All the students have to provide the valid (latest) contact number of self, father, mother etc. along with the email ID (of student) for communication. In case wrong information is provided, the students will be responsible for themselves. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on all working days between 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Note: 1. Students have to fill his/her name as mentioned on the Aadhar Card. 2. Students can check the Guidelines for Post Matric Scholarship for ST&BC/EBC on National Scholarship portal.

title: Opportunity For Internship In Germany : (2/21/2019)
body: Division of International Affairs brings a great opportunity for the students of Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electronics, Automobile, Electrical, BBA, Management students to pursue an internship in Germany. For this 15 Days Program, we have partnered with Indo Euro Synchronization, German-based Organization to provide the same to LPU students on a 25% Scholarship. Actual Program Cost is Rs. 1, 50,000. Special Fee for LPU students after a scholarship is Rs. 1, 10,000. Program Details: Summer schools: AutoSol June 2019 - Automation and Industrial Robotics /Automobiles. ElectroSol June 2019 – Electronics, Chip designing and IOT LeadSol June 2019 - International project management, Business plan for international activities, Innovation management – from idea to innovation with PINN International Exposure - Practical Industrial Robotics Training at European Centre for Mechatronics & at MSME-Agra FOR B. TECH STUDENTS FROM ALL COURSES AND YEARS Highlights of the 15-day program (3 days in Agra & 11 days in Germany): (1) 3 days cutting-edge training on industry-ready German technology in cooperation with Indo Euro Synchronization, Germany and Ministry of micro, medium and small scale industry development center Agra, India. The focus will be Industrial automation and robotics in order to provide better employment and higher education opportunities. (2) 11 days of hands-on training on German Machinery, lectures from German University professors and Industry experts, (3) Visit Manufacturing plants of Mercedes Benz and Porsche in Stuttgart, Germany (4) Museum tours of the world’s leading automotive companies, (5) 1-day optional cultural tour to Paris (6) 4 credit points from Indo Euro Synchronization and APS (7) 4 International certifications. Interested students can apply at www.internshipsatgermany.com and studyabroad@lpu.co.in Or WhatsApp at +91- 8008683020, +91-9501110434 or can meet Mr. Guravtar in Block 55- 207 and Ms. Kusum in Block 32-310.

Often times when businesses refuse to serve a customer's request, it's not about what they actually say that stings, as much as the way they say it. ... Every “no” in customer service is an opportunity for you to learn a little bit about your product, customers, and their use cases. CLUB ELECTECH, under the aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement-III is organizing a "Workshop on Saying No is an art." We all take denial very seriously. It can cause an emotional or even childlike response. We shout, hang up and threaten to leave. We are also quick to talk about it on social media – bad experiences are three times more likely to be shared than the positive ones. Forgoing responses can cause customer frustrations. To avoid that, you need to approach the difficult matter of saying no more carefully. This workshop aims at telling you the ways to say “No” to the customer or the client without using the word No. Who all can participate? It is open for all students of Lovely Professional University who would like to learn the art of rapport building to take giants steps in their career. Date: 20th Feb’2019 Timings: 05:00-06:00 p.m. Venue: 25-504 Register yourself on the following link- https://tinyurl.com/Service-No E-certificates would be provided to all participants Resource Person: Poonam Tarpial Assistant Professor, Dept of Soft Skills-II, Center For Professional Enhancement-3

title: Public Speaking : (2/16/2019)

title: CPL (Commerce Premier League) : (2/16/2019)
body: Come and show your confidence, communication skills, knowledge, spontaneity and commerce concepts. Quaestors club (MSB ATOM) -Mittal School of Business Activity Team of Management in collaboration with Centre for Professional Enhancement II is going to organize ‘CPL (Commerce Premier League)’. Get rid of your stage fright and enthusiastically display creativity and knowledge on stage. Event Details: DATE: 21st February 2019 (Thursday) VENUE AND TIME: - Block 14-301L, 5 P.M onwards Permission for late entry in hostels for girls will be granted. Last Date to Register: 20th February 2019, 1:00PM Students will register themselves in a team of two and both will participate in three rounds. The details of the rounds are shared as follows: Round 1 (QUIZICAL SUSPECTS) In first round the teams would be asked to answer 30 questions related to commerce. The team will be given 30 minutes to solve it. Top 15 teams will move on to the next round. Round 2 (SELL IT IF YOU CAN) In this round each selected team will be asked to pick one slip and team members will promote the given product written on the slip as a salesperson using different techniques of selling and marketing mix in 2 minutes. Top 5 teams will go to final round. Round 3 (BID IT TO WIN) Top 5 selected teams will be provided with Rs.1000 virtual money. The teams will be asked commerce related questions, they will bid to answer that question and the team with the highest bid will get the chance to answer that question. If the answer is right, then their virtual money will be doubled but if their answer is wrong then there will be deduction from their virtual money as per their bid amount. At last the team having the highest amount of virtual money will be declared as winner. Prizes: The winner team and first runner up team will be awarded with trophies and certificates. FOR ANY QUERY CONTACT: Abhijeet Moitra: +91-7544014372 Tushar:+91-9034522669

title: Network N+I: Engineering Master's in France with Scholarship Options : (2/16/2019)
body: Division of International Affairs brings an Opportunity for LPU Students to achieve the dream of pursuing Masters in France with various Scholarships Options. Those students who are interested they can grab this opportunity. Network N+I, is a single online portal for making a single application to 50+ elite engineering institutes in France. The Network trains highly qualified, multilingual engineers who can lead effectively on international projects in a multicultural environment. Benefits: 1. 90% of N+I students get a job offer, even before they graduate. 2. The average salary for the first job in France for a junior engineer is € 36,000 gross per year (+ 15 to 20 % for international experience). 3. The «n+i» Network offers three “Success Packages” for international students in France. For more details of Success Packages: https://www.nplusi.com/public/en/different-integration-packages Some significant points to study Masters in Engineering with Network N+I: 1. Two-year master’s degree in engineering ( after B.Tech) 2. Choice of 150 specialized masters in all domain of engineering. 3. 3 packages of adaptation: linguistic, cultural, and methodological. 4. GRE/TOEFL/ IELTS not required at the time of admission. 5. A single online application portal for admission and scholarships for all the 50+ Engineering institutes. 6. No prior knowledge of French is required. A basic level in French is highly recommended. 7. Maximum Total cost of the program: INR 18 to 28 lakhs for two years (1 semester of paid internships during the master program + APL grant ) **Personalized housing assistance (APL) is for single students or couples with or without dependents, which live in a dormitory with a convention in metropolitan France. 8. Students can apply for multiple scholarships while making admission applications to N+I. For further details of “N+I” Scholarships, click on a link given below: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1OLiF7gpw1viWpDEHO2h-HRSvuhYmYwzT For further information, Student can meet DIA in Block 32-310, Cabin-05. Online Applications Open

title: Training for CISCO Cyber Operations in CISCO Network Academy at Lovely Professional University : (2/16/2019)
body: We are pleased to announce that Lovely Professional University in collaboration with CISCO has started new training program on Cyber Operations. The CCNA Cybersecurity Operations curriculum provides an introduction to the knowledge and skills needed for a Security Analyst working with a Security Operations Center team. It teaches core security skills needed for monitoring, detecting, investigating, analyzing and responding to security events, thus protecting systems and organizations from cybersecurity risks, threats and vulnerabilities. By the end of the course, students will be prepared to: 1. Understand cybersecurity operations network principles, roles and responsibilities as well as the related technologies, tools, regulations and frameworks available. 2.Apply knowledge and skills to monitor, detect, investigate, analyze and respond to security incidents. 3. Apply for entry-level jobs as Assoicate Security Analyst and Incident Responder. 4. Take the Cisco CCNA Cybersecurity Operations Certification exam. CCNA Cybersecurity Operations is a hands-on, career-oriented course with an emphasis on practical experience to help students develop specialized skills to sucessfully handle the tasks, duties, and responsibilities of an associate-level Security Analyst working in a Security Operations Center (SOC). Advantages to pursue training program in CISCO Network Academy 1.Training certificate from CISCO after training 2.Discount in CCNA Certification after training 3.Access to Online Curriculum and interactive tools 24 x 7 from anywhere 4.CISCO Facilitates Placement Assistant to CCNA graduates 5.State of the art online assessments Including quizzes, chapter and final exams, and simulation-based skills exams Requirement Basic Operating System (Windows, Linux) and networking concepts Registration detail: Duration of training: 1st March 2019 to 30th April 2019 Venue: Block-38 (Research and development) - Lovely Professional university Training cost: Rs. 4000 Registration Process: 1.An amount of Rs. 4000 need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees for “Cisco Network Academy” 2.Student need to fill the registration form on www.tinyurl.com/netacadlpu by providing all basic information of student along with payment receipt number. 3.Student once register cannot withdraw the application 4.Registration fees is non refundable 5.Seats are First Come First Serve basis. title: Huge Opportunity to attend Summer School at EPF-ESTP, Paris and Troyes (France) : (2/15/2019)
body: Division of International Affairs encourages the student to apply for a Summer School at EPF-ESTP Paris and Troyes. Summer School program is intended to mainly to those students who are planning to attend the Summer School Program in Summer Vacations 2019, and are interested in a new dimension of life as well as absorbing academic inputs. Course Name: Smart Cities and Engineering for Sustainable Architecture. Eligibility: Undergraduate and Master students with a major in Engineering, Architecture, Urban Planning/ Design, Sociology or Computer Science. Application Deadline: 15th April 2019. Duration & Program Details: 4 Week. The program is designed in 4 independent Modules in the two cities of Troyes and Paris: Week/ Module 1 Energy Efficiency, Comfort & Culture July 1-5, 2019 Troyes Week/ Module 2 Security & resilience in smart cities July 8-12, 2019 Troyes Week/ Module 3 Bio-architecture & Bio-city July 15-19, 2019 Paris Week/ Module 4 Digital connected city & architecture July 22-16, 2019 Paris 1. Students can participate in one module or multiple modules or all modules and can last one week, two weeks, three weeks or a month. 2. Each module is of 1 week consisting of lectures, lab visits, cultural visits, meeting with researchers and French courses. 3. Within each module, the student will have a technical visit and work in teams on a real project under the supervision of a tutor/mentor. 4. Fee: the program fee is 950 Euros per module (week). (The programme fee of 950 Euros per module (week) covers: Tuition and documentation; Welcome and farewell events; Access to EPF and ESTP Paris facilities; Free internet access; Cultural and social events; Transportation; Lodging expenses; Food; Official programme certificate.) Note: Does not include: individual insurances, air ticket, and visa fees. 5. A special fee of 3500 Euros for students participating in all 4 modules 6.Group discounts available. For further information find the attached file of Boucher in the announcement. Applications are available on http://www.epf.fr/en For more information: Students can mail at studyabroad@lpu.co.in or can meet Ms. Kusum in Block-32-310 Cabin-05.

title: Seating Plan of AMCAT || WET & SVAR || AUTOMATA PROFESSIONAL || 16th & 17th February 2019 for 2020 Batch : (2/14/2019)
body: Dear Aspirants, An AMCAT Test will be conducted for students of B.Tech 2020 Passing out batch (all streams ) & MCA on 16th & 17th February '2019. It will evaluate your ability in communication skills & coding. AMCAT ( WriteX & SVAR) is going to assess the English Writing Ability and Voice and Accent on AMCAT platform and AMCAT (Automata Professional) is going to assess the coding ability. Students have to bring their Smart Phone & Laptops with them for the test. As you will be more comfortable in coding and typing on your laptops. The test details of the test to be conducted are -: Write X: Written English Test will help you in assessing the overall quality of your writing skills. Major factors that attribute towards the construction of a great write-up like grammar, usage, mechanics, style, organization and development etc. Write X will be conducted in 2 different versions; Write X Essay Writing & Email Writing. (The test will be of 20 minutes) SVAR: IVR Based, Spoken English Test to assess your Fluency, Pronunciation, Active Listening, Spoken English Understanding, Grammar, Vocabulary & more. A crucial test essential for Interviews or Client based Interaction Profiles. Based on CEFR Levels.For SVAR test you need to download and install the application on your smartphones. Below are the links to download the app. The app is available in Android and IOS. You just have to login using your SVAR IDs and rest of the process is self-explanatory and very easy to understand. For Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aspiringminds.amcat For IOS: https://itunes.apple.com/app/amcat-test/id1143409737?mt=8 The SVAR ID will be provided to you once you have reported to the venue. (The test will be of 25 minutes) NOTE: For CSE and MCA: Based on the grades of the SVAR test you will have to attend inputs as mentioned in the table below and in the file attached. AUTOMATA PROFESSIONAL: A unique assessment tool that will help you test your code writing capability and improve it as per the industry standards. It is the only tool to leverage advanced Machine Learning technology to evaluate code. It will be programming test where you will be writing code for the given problem statement. These tests will help us give you proper training on communication skills and coding capability, so every student is expected to take this test with utmost seriousness. Everyone is suggested to be present and take these test without fail, if you miss this test then the fine equivalent to missing a placement drive as per career service policy will be applicable on you by default. To know more regarding the tests please refer the attached documents. The seating plan and the venue details have been attached, kindly check your details and in case of any doubt please discuss with your respective Training and Placement Co-ordinator(TPC). Category Inputs A2,A1 Evening classes 4-6 hours in a week , total module covered will be of 30 hours B1 6 hours workshop on 3 Saturdays during this semester B2,C1,C2 Exempted from inputs in current term, summer classes will be given if required

title: Centre For Professional Enhancement presents- "“Workshop on Accent Neutralization” : (2/12/2019)
body: Is your accent a barrier while speaking? No need to worry now! Center For Professional Enhancement III cordially invites you to attend the “Workshop on Accent Neutralization” A WARM GREETING TO ALL VERTOS! The need for speaking in a neutral accent has been growing today because the customers and the clients have to interact in a universal language in a globally acceptable style and accent. Moreover, during an interview it is crucial to not let your accent be recruiter’s focus of attention, it may trigger an emotional response which may or may not be desirable. Department of Soft Skills II under the aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement-III is organizing a "Workshop on Accent Neutralization" Accent neutralization is not about adopting a new accent, and speaking like someone a person is not. Accent neutralization helps employees to get over MTI, stronger regional twangs and accents, and speak in a more neutral fashion so that callers from anywhere in the globe can understand them clearly. Who all can participate? It is open for all students of Lovely Professional University who would like to learn the art of accent neutralization to take giants steps in their career. Timings: 05:00-06:00 p.m. Venue: 28-402 Training cost per student: Rs. 500 Registration Process: 1. An amount of Rs. 500 need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees for "Workshop on Accent Neutralization (1st Feb to 31st March, 2019)" 2.
