title: "Voice and Accent Neutralization" Workshop : (2/11/2019)
body: Voice and Accent rounds are becoming very common in the job interview process. Due to Mother Tongue Influence, students may try to fake an accent, skip over words or sentences, speak too softly. Voice and Accent Neutralization classes will help develop a Neutral Accent. Centre for Professional Enhancement is to initiate the ‘Voice & Accent Neutralization’ classes. Duration of the course will be 20hrs. Certificates will be awarded to the participants with 70% and above attendance in the course. Take away of the course: 1. Learn to speak with the flow and rhythm and use appropriate stress patterns. 2. Identify and replace some common grammatical errors that are influenced by the native tongue with the correct English forms. 3. Speak with greater authority and vocal presence. 4. Overcome an 'accent barrier' through a voice and accent course. 5. Improve your articulation to avoid ambiguity. 6. Correct production of the sounds and structures of English. 7. Control over pitch and intonation to express attitude and meaning. 8. Accurate, fast listening skills - English becomes clearer when you know its sounds and structures. 9. Accent softening - the skills give you control over your accent. 10. Speak with greater clarity and confidence. 11. Better understand and use the power and potential of your voice. 12. Extend your vocal range through a voice and accent course. No. of Seats: 30 Batch timings and date: Session timings will be 5.30pm to 6.30pm (Mon to Fri) Commencement of course: 18th Feb’19 To Register: 1.Visit shortto.com/cpeclubs 2.Click on “Register here for events” and search “Voice and Accent Neutralization” Course fee: Rs 1200/- for LPU students Mode of Payment: Registered students can pay the course fee in accounts department or deposit the fee in 38-512 cabin no.15 through Paytm @ 9717282201. Certificates: To participants with and above 70% attendance. For any assistance, please contact Resource person: Ms Neetu Madan Centre for Professional Enhancement-1 ,Block 38/512

title: Call for Enrolment of Travel Decor Competition @ KAPSONS : (2/7/2019)
body: Dear Students, The budding talent from various Art Colleges in North India are invited to participate in ‘Travel Décor Competition @ KAPSONS’. Teams from School of Fashion Design and Technology will propose a plan to decorate the Kapsons store of their city with a particular travel theme. Each team will be given a popular global travel destination as the theme to decorate the store. The teams with the best ideas for store decoration will be selected and given the responsibility to decorate Kapsons store within a given budget. The participants are expected to maintain the same for 3 months following the completion of the project. This competition will be between 17 Kapsons stores and the winning teams will get the following rewards: 1st - Prize money of Rs. 1 Lakh to the team and a trophy to the college. 2nd – Prize money of Rs. 50000 to the team and a trophy to the college. 3rd – Gift Voucher of Rs. 25000 to the team and a trophy to the college. All participants will get a certificate of participation and a huge opportunity to display their talents. The participants will get 15 days time to execute their plan within the given budget and will have to maintain their work for 5 months. Rewards shall be given at the end of 5 months. The participating team’s photograph will be displayed in all Kapsons’ stores for six months and the winning team’s photograph will be published in the esteemed newspapers of their city. The teams are free to choose any TRAVEL DESTINATION as the theme and send us a presentation of the mock-up of the theme they intend to execute and display. Attached is the list of the TRAVEL DESTINATIONS that students can pick as their themes. Students can even take up a country like Spain for eg. as their theme, and then to different floors dedicated to different cities. Please keep a note of a few rules as well 1. No nails allowed. 2. Students can use tape to stick up stuff but they can’t use nails anywhere. 3. Students can paint the common areas ( try rooms, cash counter, lifts & staircase ) if they want but brand designated areas are out of bounds. 4. No movement of any fixture or furniture. 5. Clean and easy access for customers through out the store. 6. Students can even take 1 try room per store to create something inside if needed. Not more. 7. Stock rooms will not be available. 8. Kapsons branding should be prominently visible in designated selfie areas if any. 9. Students can use almost all in store branding. Duration of execution of the project - 1st to 15th March, 2019! Students can register themselves to Ms. Sindhu Kumari in block 1. The last date of entries - 20th February, 2019 For more details, please reach Mr. Vaneet K. Arora, Head- Department of Industry Interventions. (Contact No. 7508183832) Division of Industry Interface .

title: AMCAT diagnostic exam on 16 Feb, 2019 for placement registered students passing out in 2020. (2/6/2019)
body: Dear Aspirants, This is to inform you that the Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled your AMCAT diagnostic exam on 16thFeb, 2019 for placement registered students passing out in 2020. A good score in AMCAT will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So consider it very important as this is your first step towards a great career ahead. About AMCAT: AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates based on their core skills which include reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills. AMCAT is also known as an employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. Aspiring Minds conducts the AMCAT exam for engineering freshers who apply for IT jobs. The objective of the AMCAT exam is to grade the students based on their performance. For more information, you can also visit on web link: https://www.myamcat.com. Key Pointers AMCAT exam is mandatory for all students (as per the attached list). Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not appear in this exam, hence attempting it with full spirit. AMCAT exam timings will be shared through “UMS-My Message” one day before the test. Scores of this exam will be shared with companies and will be helpful for you to get shortlisted in the upcoming drives. Hence participate in this exam with full enthusiasm. Exam will be in auto-proctored mode. Kindly read the instructions/guidelines carefully before taking the exam. Duty leave will be provided for attempting the exam. So attempt accordingly. Login Credentials for the exam will be shared with you through UMS my messages on the day of the exam. Upload By:-Centre for Professional Enhancement

body: This is for the information of all the students that from the current term a new model of Student Academic Support Program (SASP) is being introduced by Division of Student Relationship wherein, support classes will be provided to the students to help them in clearing their fail grades. The classes for a course code shall span 25 lectures in total (spread over a tentative time frame of one month). SASP shall serve the purpose of providing guidance to students who face difficulty in grasping the subject matter as a whole in regular classes. With the help of this model the students shall get an opportunity to clear their doubts, revise their concepts, bridge gaps in their learning, and ensure better interaction with the teacher in smaller groups. Conduct of SASP a. SASP Registration: Students can register for the same by following the link:- UMS Navigation--> Examination--> Exam Registration --> Student Academic Support Program b. Class Size, Timings & Duration i) Classes will run only if number of registrations in one course is 5 or more (In case, the total registrations in a course are less than 5, then the course shall be scrapped and fee for registered students shall be refunded) ii) Class Schedule & Timings: Throughout the week from 11th Feb,2019 to 19th March,2019 (except MTT). iii) Classes will be held in the evening slot between 5-6 pm daily except Sunday iv) Class Duration: The duration of these classes shall be 60 minutes per lecture. c) Fee Rs.1000/- per course for 25-lectures support class In case, a student feels that support classes for an additional course code (not mentioned in the list) should be conducted, the same should be reported to Division of student relationship (DSR) in 32-100 (number of students must be 5 or more). Note: Student can register maximum one course and in no case, the student will be able to de-register for the course, if once registered. title: Training for CISCO Cyber Operations in CISCO Network Academy at Lovely Professional University : (2/2/2019)
body: We are pleased to announce that Lovely Professional University in collaboration with CISCO has started new training program on Cyber Operations. The CCNA Cybersecurity Operations curriculum provides an introduction to the knowledge and skills needed for a Security Analyst working with a Security Operations Center team. It teaches core security skills needed for monitoring, detecting, investigating, analyzing and responding to security events, thus protecting systems and organizations from cybersecurity risks, threats and vulnerabilities. By the end of the course, students will be prepared to: 1. Understand cybersecurity operations network principles, roles and responsibilities as well as the related technologies, tools, regulations and frameworks available. 2.Apply knowledge and skills to monitor, detect, investigate, analyze and respond to security incidents. 3. Apply for entry-level jobs as Assoicate Security Analyst and Incident Responder. 4. Take the Cisco CCNA Cybersecurity Operations Certification exam. CCNA Cybersecurity Operations is a hands-on, career-oriented course with an emphasis on practical experience to help students develop specialized skills to sucessfully handle the tasks, duties, and responsibilities of an associate-level Security Analyst working in a Security Operations Center (SOC). Advantages to pursue training program in CISCO Network Academy 1.Training certificate from CISCO after training 2.Discount in CCNA Certification after training 3.Access to Online Curriculum and interactive tools 24 x 7 from anywhere 4.CISCO Facilitates Placement Assistant to CCNA graduates 5.State of the art online assessments Including quizzes, chapter and final exams, and simulation-based skills exams Requirement Basic Operating System (Windows, Linux) and networking concepts Registration detail: Duration of training: 1st March 2019 to 30th April 2019 Venue: Block-38 (Research and development) - Lovely Professional university Training cost: Rs. 4000 Registration Process: 1.An amount of Rs. 4000 need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees for “Cisco Network Academy” 2.Student need to fill the registration form on www.tinyurl.com/netacadlpu by providing all basic information of student along with payment receipt number. 3.Student once register cannot withdraw the application 4.Registration fees is non refundable 5.Seats are First Come First Serve basis. title: Part time job opportunity for hostelers by Bluehawks : (1/30/2019)
body: Dear Students, Taking on a part-time job while pursuing a degree is hard work, but the benefits are typically greater than the amount of a pay check. Students who work during their college careers may develop better time-management skills than their counterparts because they have to apply it to their daily lives. They earn money that can be used for fun or for tuition, while gaining experience in the workplace that will be attractive to future employers after graduation. title: Students-Undergraduate Research Graduate Excellence (SURGE) program -- 2019 : (1/30/2019)
body: Under the Students-Undergraduate Research Graduate Excellence (SURGE) program 2019, students from IITK and other participating institutions undertake short duration, but focused research projects and push their intellectual abilities beyond those driven by the classroom. The SURGE participants are required to give a mid-term presentation after four weeks, to a review committee consisting of a group of academic staff members. The review committee gives feedback and suggests possible improvements in the work. At the end of the program all the SURGE students make a poster presentation of the work carried out at IITK. The poster presentation is open to the public. It is also evaluated by faculty members. The duration of the program is approximately 08 weeks and the beginning date of SURGE program is 13th May, 2019 and last date 10th July, 2019. An award plus a commendation certificate is given to those SURGE students who produce exceptional quality research during the period. The applicants (Non-IITK Indian Student) shall be required to pay the application fee of Rs. 200/- through Payment Gateway. The short listed SURGE participants coming under Institute funding, Self funding, IITK project funding and IITK-industry tie-up categories for SURGE 2019 are required to pay the SURGE administrative charges:- 1. For Non-IITK Indian student - Rs. 3500/- 2. For IITK student - Rs. 2500/-Eligibility Under this program, Non-IITK students will be eligible to apply for summer project at IIT Kanpur. The eligibility criteria for Non-IITK students are mentioned below: a). B.Tech/BE/B-Arch/BS (3rd year completed), b). Five year degree program (3rd year completed, 4th year completed) c). B.Sc/B.A. (2nd year completed) Interested students need to complete the online application form. The students should have the following items ready before filling the online application form. 1. Recent Passport size photograph in jpg format not more than 1MB. 2. A single file in PDF format not more than 3 MB containing Research Proposal not more than 500 words. Current Transcript. 3. A single file in PDF format not more than 1 MB containing Recomendation Letter one of any faculty who belongs to the applicant' institute. 4. A single file in PDF format not more than 1 MB containing Recomendation Letter two of any faculty who belongs to the applicant' institute. Important dates 1. Opening of Online application form – 10th January 2019. 2. Opening of Payment gateway link – 11th January 2019. 3. Closing of Online application form - 11th February 2019. 4. Closing of Payment gateway link – 13th February 2019. Fee for Online application form for SURGE (NONIITK only) 2019 is Rs 200/- For more information please visit: http://surge.iitk.ac.in/index.php

title: Registration for Re-appear/Improvement examination to be conducted in February-April, 2019 (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/190129/001) : (1/29/2019)
body: The interface for registration of Re-appear/Improvement examination to be conducted in February-April, 2019 has been opened for all students. Now, a student having ‘E’ grade(s) in any course code(s) (of any term) will be automatically registered in all his/her ‘E’ grade courses from the backend. In case, a student does not want to appear in some of the registered courses then he/she can de-register the course(s) through the provided interface. For the final selected courses, the student is required to directly pay the fee for the ‘E’ grade courses, thus omitting the first step of registration process. In case, a course is de-registered by mistake then the same can be registered again by the student through the online interface. The detailed procedure is attached for reference. The tentative dates of examination for each course code have also been mentioned against the course code, so that the students can select their courses and prepare for them accordingly. The fee for re-appear registration is Rs. 350/- per course code and the last date with this fee is 11th Feb, 2019. Note that after 11th Feb, 2019 (12.00 a.m. onwards), the fee for registration will be increased to Rs. 500/- per course code and the last date with this fee is 13th Feb, 2019. Note: The student who fails to pay fee by 13th Feb, 2019 will be automatically de-registered in the pending ‘E’ grade courses for which they have not paid the fee and these courses shall stop reflecting in their account. For any scheduled lectures falling in the time slot of the examination, duty leave shall be given to the student for those lectures only (particularly in the time slot of exam time). In addition, duty leave shall also be given to the student for classes scheduled one hour prior and one hour after the time of examination. Important dates:- Registration start date 29th January, 2019 Last date of registration (without late fee) 11th February, 2019 Last date of registration (with late fee) 13th February, 2019 Commencement of examination 16th February, 2019

body: Dear Student, PEP inputs for 2020 passing out batch will be starting from 2-Feb-2019. PEP inputs will be held every week on Saturdays for 5 hours. Inputs in this semester will be focused on Technical Subjects such as Data Structure, Programming and Database etc. Students are being provided with an opportunity to prove themselves and get exemption from these classes to utilize the same time for other constructive activities such as certifications in their interest areas. The opportunity is in form of a Test which be held on 19-Jan-19 of the same subjects for which the inputs are planned in the semester. Based on student’s performance in the test, they will be exempted from the respective input in which they have performed well. For example, if someone has performed well in all the subjects he / she will be exempted from all the inputs. Similarly, students who have performed well in Operating system will be exempted from Operating system only and the students will have to attend rest of the inputs. Details of Test:- Test will be of 3 hours. There will be 20 MCQ questions of each subject. For Programming 14 questions of C / C++ and 3 questions from each Java and Python. Subjects: Programming, Data Structure, Software Engineering, Operating System, Database, Artificial Intelligence, Comp. Network. Here is your golden opportunity to prove yourself and get rewarded with the one thing you cherish most "Time".

In the last three years, IndiaNext has leveraged the vision and skills of engineers, architects and builders from across the country to design for tomorrow's India. As it enters Edition 04, IndiaNext, true to tradition, delves right into the heart of a vision that is steadily turning real. India lives in its villages and that is where our future is evolving. The initiative is set to explore the compelling dynamics of development through a reality that cannot or rather, should not be denied anymore. Even before we live the 100 years of freedom between 1947 and 2047, this competition is poised to go beyond preconceptions and prejudices and design Village 2047. Eligibility : Professionals: Architects & Engineers (Civil/Structural) Students: 3rd, 4th, & 5th Year (Individuals and Groups) Important dates: Date Event Jan 31, 2019, Thursday Registration Closes Feb 15, 2019, Friday Submission Deadline Process : • Identify a Village • Generate the Design Brief • Respond to the Brief To register : https://www.ultratechindianext.com/register.aspx For any further assistance, please reach to Mr. Vaneet K Arora, Division of Industry Interface (7508183832, vaneet.arora@lpu.co.in )

title: Code For Good - NTT DATA Hackathon : (1/10/2019)
body: NTT DATA Services believes in utilizing technology to create new paradigms that contribute to resolving societal issues. The Hackathon - Code for Good - is an initiative to find technology driven high-impact social innovation. NTT DATA Services is looking forward for fresh Ideas, out of the box solutions and responses that bring new social changes to solve real-life problems on different issues like a flood, pollution, weather change etc. With advances in analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence, we can better predict events like climate behaviour and also visualize data more intuitively. There are all kind of data sources, where one lives, how much one travels, weather patterns, pollution levels etc. With the convergence of multiple technologies and the availability of extensive data, we can create opportunities and solutions that have the potential to impact our society positively. With this Hackathon, we want to know what these solutions could be, which new models could be brought into play and how they would deliver high impact to social innovations. Hosting Platform: TechGiG Category of Event: Hackathon (Idea submission based) Mode of Event Participation: Online followed by offline Nature of Event: Competition only with Prize Number of Rounds of this event: 3 Event Winner Prize: Prizes worth Rs.500000 to be won Last Date to Register: 07-Feb-2019 Event Start Date/Time: 09-Jan-2019/12:00 PM More Details and Event Registration URL: https://www.techgig.com/hackathon/ntt-data-code-for-good-student Provision for Duty Leave: Nil Provision for Academic Bonus points: 5 points for winning the competition (higher will be applicable) To avail participation benefits, submit your details to Training and Placement Cell on following link: https://shortto.com/cpedata

title: Opportunity to showcase your technical skills in SMART INDIA HACKATHON- 2019 : (1/2/2019)
body: Government of India is providing this platform with innovative themes and seeking the participation from students to come with unique solution to the societal problems and win exciting prizes. SMART INDIA HACKATHON- 2019, is a grand opportunity to showcase your potential to the world. It will surely act as a catalyst in your career growth. It is a nationwide initiative to provide students a platform to solve some of pressing problems we face in our daily lives, and thus inculcate a culture of product innovation and a mindset of problem solving. The last edition of the hackathon saw over 5 million+ students from various engineering colleges compete for the top prize at 35+ locations. In SIH 2019, the students would also have the opportunity to work on challenges faced within the private sector organisations and create world class solutions for some of the top companies in the world, thus helping the Private sector hire the best minds from across the nation. For details you may visit https://www.sih.gov.in/ The process details and information regarding the registration for nominations from Lovely Professional University, is attached herewith. Registration link- tinyurl.com/SIH2019LPU Last date for registration- 9th Jan 2019. Highlights 1. Win Prizes worth more than 2.5crores in different categories. 2. Many industries including ABB, BEL, adani power, Cognizant, DEL, GE, Indian Oil, Mahindra, Bosch, Paytm, Yamaha, Samsung etc. are associated with the event and have their problem statement. Important Guidelines 1. Team would comprise of total six members (at least one member should be female). 2. Team leader needs to fill the google form on behalf of the team. 3. For any query please contact Dr. Rajesh Singh, Professor (SEEE, LPU) @ Room No. 36-207, cabin no.-3 Email- rajesh.23402@lpu.co.in and Mr. Sumit Mittu @ Room No. 32-305 Email- sumit.12735@lpu.co.in

title: Allotment of Residential Facilities (Term-II) For Session 2018-19 : (12/29/2018)
body: Students who did not book the hostel/ food/ laundry facility earlier and now interested to avail the facility for term-II (session 2018-19) may apply for the same from 29th Dec. 2018 11:00 AM onwards through the following path: UMS Navigation >>> Residential and Vendor Services >>> Residential booking >>> Booking of Residential Facilities (Term-II). No need to purchase any scratch card/scholar card for registration process of hostel booking. Decide your hostel facility very carefully, because once the seat is booked no refund or seat de-allocation will be applicable for term-II (Session 2018-2019). For detail of process and charges students must go through the attached annexure Annexure-I Process to Book the Residential Facilities Term-II Session 2018-19 Annexure-II Fee For Residential Facilities Term-II Session 2018-19 (Updated) Other Important Instructions:- a) Students have to pay the complete hostel facilities fee within 07 days of booking the facility. In case of non submission of complete fee within said duration late payment charges will be imposed. b) Make sure that before booking the hostel facilities all the fee dues are cleared, otherwise late payment charges will be imposed. c) Group booking facility will not be available. d) The allotment would be on first come first serve basis. e) Hostel facility will be applicable from 10th Jan. 2019 till end of the regular academic session. f) Students having Active status can only book their hostel facility through online interface. Rest all the students can register themselves for re-appears or backlogs then submit their request in ODRS block 29-301 for hostel booking. ODRS official will confirm the registration of those students and book their hostel facility as per request. Note:- Food Fee uploaded earlier was wrong as wrong file was uploaded. Please check the correct updated food charges Rs. 17000/- (Full Meal), Rs. 15000/- (Skip Meal)/ 290 USD (Full Meal), 250 USD (Skip Meal)
